1.2.1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第16页／PDF第49页。范围状态：拓展：1.2信号频谱（纲领不要求）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 16 · PDF p. 49. Coverage: Extension: §1.2 signal spectra (outside syllabus).

先分清峰峰值、峰值和有效值Separate peak-to-peak, peak and RMS values

题目原文Transcribed question

写出下列正弦电压信号的表达式（设初始相角为零）：(1)峰—峰值10V，频率10kHz；(2)有效值220V，频率50Hz；(3)峰—峰值100mV，周期1ms；(4)峰—峰值0.25V，角频率1000 rads。Write zero-initial-phase sinusoidal voltages for (1)10V peak-to-peak,10kHz; (2)220V RMS,50Hz; (3)100mV peak-to-peak,1ms period; (4)0.25V peak-to-peak,1000 rads.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
模电教材式(1.2.1)采用正弦基准，零初相写sin；峰峰值除2、有效值乘√2才是表达式中的峰值。Analog Eq.(1.2.1) uses sine, so zero initial phase means sin. Divide peak-to-peak by2 or multiply RMS by√2 to obtain peak amplitude.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

前两问用频率换角频率Convert frequency to angular frequency

ω=2πf，频率先换Hz。Use ω=2πf with f in Hz.

v1=5sin(20000πt)V,v2=2202sin(100πt)V

后两问分别由周期和角频率确定Use period or the given angular frequency

第三问T=0.001s，第四问已经给ω，不再乘2π。Part3 has T=0.001s; part4 already gives ω, so do not multiply it by2π again.

v3=0.05sin(2000πt)V,v4=0.125sin(1000t)V

依次为5sin(20000πt)、2202sin(100πt)、0.05sin(2000πt)、0.125sin(1000t)V，t按秒计。The voltages are5sin(20000πt),2202sin(100πt),0.05sin(2000πt),0.125sin(1000t)V, with t in seconds.

易错点Common errors

  • 本题零相位按本书正弦形式；不能把电路教材的余弦基准直接搬来而不调整初相。Use this book’s sine convention; carrying over the Circuit cosine convention without adjusting phase changes the initial condition.

核验依据Verification

独立用原模型KCL、正弦有效值与功率、分贝反算、周期采样及原文指数复核。未读取完整外部答案，不声称与其一致。Independently checked by original-model KCL, sine RMS and power, inverse decibel calculations, cycle sampling and original exponent review. No claim is made of comparison against an unread external answer key.

1.2.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第16页／PDF第49页。范围状态：拓展：1.2信号频谱（纲领不要求）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 16 · PDF p. 49. Coverage: Extension: §1.2 signal spectra (outside syllabus).

方波总功率与傅里叶分量功率分别计算Compute square-wave power and Fourier-component powers separately

题目原文Transcribed question

图1.2.2所示方波电压信号加在电阻R两端，试用公式P=1T∫0Tv2(t)Rdt计算信号在电阻上耗散的功率；然后根据式(1.2.3)，分别计算方波傅里叶展开式中直流分量、基波分量、三次谐波分量在电阻上耗散的功率，并计算这3个分量在电阻上耗散的功率之和占电阻上总耗散功率的百分比。Apply the square wave in Fig.1.2.2 across R. Integrate v2R over one period for total average power. Using Eq.(1.2.3), calculate the DC, fundamental and third-harmonic powers, and their combined percentage of total power.

占空比12的单极性方波，从0跳到Vs，半周期后回零。A half-duty unipolar square wave switches between0 and Vs.

本题图在书第3页／PDF第36页。The source figure is on printed p. 3 · PDF p. 36.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
原波形在0～T2为Vs、后半周期为0，不是±Vs对称方波；直流分量不能漏。The original wave is Vs for half the period and0 for the other half, not a bipolar ±Vs square wave. Retain its DC component.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

直接积分原波形Integrate the original wave

只有半周期v2=Vs2。v2=Vs2 for only half the cycle.

P=1TVs2RT2=Vs22R

用各分量的有效值Use each component’s RMS value

原式的直流为Vs2，基波峰值2Vsπ，三次峰值2Vs(3π)。正弦功率用峰值平方除2R。DC is Vs2; sine peaks are2Vsπand2Vs(3π). Divide each sine peak squared by2R.

P0=Vs24R,P1=2Vs2π2R,P3=2Vs29π2R

利用周期正交相加Add powers using period orthogonality

不同谐波及直流交叉项的整周期平均为零，故三项平均功率直接相加。Cross terms among distinct harmonics and DC average to zero over a period.

P0+P1+P3P=12+409π2≈0.950316

单位幅度方波及直流、基波、三次谐波合成曲线，右图给各分量功率占比。Unit-amplitude square wave and its DC and fundamental and third-harmonic approximation, with component power percentages.

总功率Vs2(2R)；直流、基波、三次谐波分别占50%、约40.5285%、约4.5032%，合计约95.0316%。Total power is Vs2(2R). DC, fundamental and third harmonic contribute50%, about40.5285% and4.5032%, totaling about95.0316%.

易错点Common errors

  • 不是把电压峰值相加后再平方；遗漏的高次谐波仍占约4.97%的总功率。Do not add voltage peaks and square the sum. Higher omitted harmonics still carry about4.97% of total power.

核验依据Verification

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第17页／PDF第50页。范围状态：要求学习：1.4–1.5（放大模型与性能）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 17 · PDF p. 50. Coverage: Required: §§1.4–1.5 (amplifier models and performance).

源电压到负载输出要经过两次分压Source-to-load gain contains two loading dividers

题目原文Transcribed question

电压放大电路模型如图1.4.2(a)所示，设输出开路电压增益Avo=10。试分别计算下列条件下的源电压增益Avs=vovs：(1)Ri=10Rsi、RL=10Ro；(2)Ri=Rsi、RL=Ro；(3)Ri=Rsi10、RL=Ro10；(4)Ri=10Rsi、RL=Ro10。For the voltage-amplifier model in Fig.1.4.2(a), open-output voltage gain Avo=10. Find source-to-output Avs=vovs for (1)Ri=10Rsi,RL=10Ro; (2)Ri=Rsi,RL=Ro; (3)Ri=Rsi10,RL=Ro10; (4)Ri=10Rsi,RL=Ro10.

源vs串Rsi，输入Ri到地；输出为Avovi受控电压源串Ro到RL。Source vs has series Rsi feeding Ri. Output is a controlled Avovi source with series Ro and load RL.

本题图在书第7页／PDF第40页。The source figure is on printed p. 7 · PDF p. 40.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
开路增益只作用于实际输入vi；源端先被Rsi与Ri分压，输出再被Ro与RL分压。Open-circuit gain acts on the actual input vi, after source loading. Output loading adds a second divider.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先写统一表达式Write one common formula

两端分压系数都小于1。Both divider factors are below1.

Avs=AvoRiRsi+RiRLRo+RL

代入四组比值Insert all four ratios

输入、输出两种加载分别计算，不能把第(4)问误当两端都轻载。Calculate input and output loading separately; case4 has a heavy output load.

{Avs,1=1000121≈8.26446Avs,2=2.5Avs,3=10121≈0.0826446Avs,4=100121≈0.826446

四问依次约8.26446、2.5、0.0826446、0.826446。The four gains are approximately8.26446,2.5,0.0826446and0.826446.

易错点Common errors

  • Avo=10不等于带源和带负载后的Avs。The open-output gain10 is not the source-to-loaded-output gain.

核验依据Verification

1.4.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第17页／PDF第50页。范围状态：要求学习：1.4–1.5（放大模型与性能）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 17 · PDF p. 50. Coverage: Required: §§1.4–1.5 (amplifier models and performance).

单位增益缓冲器也能大幅改善带载电压A unity-gain buffer can greatly improve loaded voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

某电唱机拾音头内阻为1MΩ，输出电压为1V（有效值）。如果直接与10Ω扬声器相接，扬声器上的电压为多少？如果在拾音头和扬声器之间接入一个放大电路，其输入电阻Ri=1MΩ、输出电阻Ro=10Ω、输出开路电压增益为1，试求这时扬声器上的电压。A pickup has1MΩ internal resistance and1V RMS open output. Find the voltage across a directly connected10Ω speaker. Then insert an amplifier with Ri=1MΩ,Ro=10Ω and open-output gain1; find the speaker voltage.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
开路增益1不代表没有作用；缓冲器把高源阻抗和低负载阻抗分开，但题设Ri仍使输入衰减一半。Unity gain can still isolate high source resistance from a low load. The specified input resistance nevertheless halves the input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

直接连接Direct connection

按拾音头的1V开路等效源计算。Use a1V open-circuit pickup source.

Vdirect=110106+10V≈9.99990μV

加入放大电路Insert the amplifier

先在输入得到0.5V，开路输出仍0.5V，再经10Ω与10Ω分压。Input voltage is0.5V and open output0.5V; equal output and load resistances halve it again.

Vi=0.5V,VL=1(0.5)1010+10=0.25V

直接约10μV RMS；接放大电路后0.25V RMS。Direct: about10μV RMS. With the amplifier:0.25V RMS.

易错点Common errors

  • 缓冲器输入电阻是有限1MΩ，不是无穷；不能跳过输入端的12分压。The input resistance is finite1MΩ, so retain the input half-divider.

核验依据Verification

独立用原模型KCL、正弦有效值与功率、分贝反算、周期采样及原文指数复核。未读取完整外部答案，不声称与其一致。Independently checked by original-model KCL, sine RMS and power, inverse decibel calculations, cycle sampling and original exponent review. No claim is made of comparison against an unread external answer key.

1.5.1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第17页／PDF第50页。范围状态：要求学习：1.4–1.5（放大模型与性能）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 17 · PDF p. 50. Coverage: Required: §§1.4–1.5 (amplifier models and performance).

统一峰峰值比例，功率增益另用10logUse consistent peak-to-peak ratios and10log for power gain

题目原文Transcribed question

在某放大电路输入端测量到输入正弦信号电流和电压的峰—峰值分别为5μA和5mV。输出端接2kΩ电阻负载，测量到正弦电压信号峰—峰值为1V。试计算该放大电路的电压增益Av、电流增益Ai、功率增益Ap，并分别换算成dB数。An amplifier has input sine current5μA peak-to-peak and voltage5mV peak-to-peak. With a2kΩ resistive load, output voltage is1V peak-to-peak. Find voltage, current and power gains and their dB values.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
同种峰峰值直接相除得到幅值增益；按本章电阻性输入、输出模型算功率，峰峰值到有效值的因子相消。Consistent peak-to-peak ratios give magnitude gains. Under the chapter’s resistive input and output model, the common RMS conversion cancels in power ratios.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

幅值电压与电流增益Voltage and current magnitude gains

输出电流峰峰值为12000A=0.5mA。幅值数据不能判断反相符号。Output current is0.5mA peak-to-peak. Magnitude data do not determine inversion.

|Av|=10.005=200,|Ai|=0.00050.000005=100

功率及分贝Power and decibels

输入平均功率3.125 nW，输出62.5μW，功率增益20000。电压电流用20log，功率用10log。Input average power is3.125 nW and output62.5μW. Use20log for voltage and current and10log for power.

Ap=20000,Gv=20log10200≈46.0206dB,Gi=40dB,Gp=10log1020000≈43.0103dB

电压、电流、功率增益幅值分别200、100、20000；分贝分别46.0206dB、40dB、43.0103dB。Magnitude gains are200,100and20000; dBvalues46.0206,40and43.0103 respectively.

易错点Common errors

  • 功率比不能用20log；若不采用本章电阻性模型，还需输入电压电流相位才能确定有功输入。Do not use20log for a power ratio. Beyond the resistive model, input phase information is needed for active input power.

核验依据Verification

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第17页／PDF第50页。范围状态：要求学习：1.4–1.5（放大模型与性能）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 17 · PDF p. 50. Coverage: Required: §§1.4–1.5 (amplifier models and performance).

输出减少20%意味着保留80%A20% output drop means80% remains

题目原文Transcribed question

当负载电阻RL=1kΩ时，电压放大电路输出电压比负载开路（RL=∞）时的输出电压减少20%，求该放大电路的输出电阻Ro。With RL=1kΩ, output voltage is20% below its open-load value. Find output resistance Ro.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
把“减少20%”转成带载、开路=0.8，再套输出分压。Convert the drop into a loaded and open ratio0.8 and use the output divider.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

反解输出分压Invert the output divider

假设线性输出等效源不随加载改变。Assume the linear internal output source remains unchanged by loading.

1000Ro+1000=0.8⇒Ro=1000(10.8−1)=250Ω

Ro=250Ω。Ro=250Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把比例写成0.2，也不要直接令Ro=0.2RL。The ratio is0.8, not0.2, and Ro is not simply0.2RL.

核验依据Verification

开路升高量先除以带载电压Divide the open-load voltage rise by the loaded voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

一电压放大电路输出端接1kΩ负载电阻时，输出电压为1V；负载电阻断开时输出电压上升到1.1V。求该放大电路的输出电阻Ro。An amplifier outputs1Vinto1kΩand1.1V with the load disconnected. Find Ro.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
开路电压是等效源电压，输出电阻承受0.1V，而带载电流为1mA。The open voltage is the internal source voltage. Output resistance drops0.1Vat1mA load current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用电压差与负载电流Use voltage drop and load current

同样可由开路、带载电压比公式得到。The open and loaded ratio gives the same result.

Ro=1.1−111000Ω=100Ω

Ro=100Ω。Ro=100Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 电流由带载的1V而不是开路1.1V计算。Calculate load current from1V, not the open1.1V.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第17页／PDF第50页。范围状态：要求学习：1.4–1.5（放大模型与性能）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 17 · PDF p. 50. Coverage: Required: §§1.4–1.5 (amplifier models and performance).

开短路输出给内阻，再算带载增益Use open and short outputs to find resistance before loaded gains

题目原文Transcribed question

Output short current is10mA and open voltage10V. With a4kΩ load, find voltage, current and power gains and their dB values.

vi=(1μA)(10kΩ)=10mV,Ro=1kΩ,vo=1041+4=8V,io=2mA

|Av|=800,|Ai|=2000,Ap=1.6×106

分别选择20log或10logChoose20logor10log appropriately

题目原文Transcribed question

在电压放大电路的上限频率点处，电压增益比中频区增益下降了3dB。在相同输入电压条件下，该频率点处的输出电压是中频区输出电压的多少倍？At an amplifier’s upper cutoff, voltage gain is3dB below midband. For the same input voltage, what is the output-voltage ratio to its midband value?

完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

按字面3dB反算Invert aliteral3dB drop

同输入下输出比等于增益比。With equal input, the output ratio equals the gain ratio.

Vo,HVo,M=10−320≈0.707946

说明常用半功率近似State the half-power convention

严格半功率为−3.0103dB，常写−3dB，因此教材通常答12≈0.707。Exact half power is−3.0103dB, customarily called−3dB, giving12.

half power:Vo,HVo,M=12≈0.707107

约0.707倍；按字面恰下降3.000dB为0.707946倍。About0.707. Aliteral3.000dB drop gives0.707946.

易错点Common errors

  • 下降3dB不是电压减半；电压减半对应约−6.02dB。A3dB drop does not halve voltage; halving voltage gives about−6.02dB.

先读对指数：第二问就在上限频率Read the exponents: part2 is exactly at the upper cutoff

题目原文Transcribed question

设一放大电路的通频带为20Hz～20kHz，通带电压增益40dB，最大不失真交流输出电压范围为−3～+3V。(1)若输入10sin(4π×103t)mV的正弦波信号，输出波形是否会产生频率失真和非线性失真？若不失真，输出电压峰值是多大？(2)若vi=40sin(4π×104t)mV，重复回答(1)中的问题。(3)若vi=10sin(8π×104t)mV，输出波形是否会产生频率失真和非线性失真？为什么？An amplifier has20Hz–20kHz passband,40dB midband voltage gain and a distortion-free output range−3 to+3V. (1)For10sin(4π×103t)mV, assess frequency-response and nonlinear distortion, and find output peak when undistorted. (2)Repeat for40sin(4π×104t)mV. (3)Assess both effects for10sin(8π×104t)mV and explain.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

信号幅值与有效值、线性电阻模型、分压、增益和分贝；频谱题标作拓展。Signal peak and RMS values, linear resistive models, loading, gain and decibels; spectrum exercises are extensions.
三个频率分别2kHz、20kHz、40kHz。不能把第(2)问的104读成103；上限频率的增益约为中频的0.707倍。The three frequencies are2,20and40kHz. Part2has104, not103; at the upper cutoff gain is about0.707 times midband.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先算增益与频率Calculate gain and frequencies

40dB为电压增益100倍，f=ω(2π)。40dB means voltage gain100, and f=ω(2π).

|Av,M|=100,f1=2kHz,f2=20kHz,f3=40kHz

第(1)问：通带内小信号Part1: a small in-band signal

按题设平坦通带模型，无显著带外衰减，输出峰值1V低于3V，无削顶。Under the stated flat-passband model, output peak is1V, below3V, so there is no clipping.

Vo1,m=100(10mV)=1V

第(2)问：先计截止衰减，再判削顶Part2: include cutoff attenuation before clipping

20kHz处有约3dB衰减，相对中频出现频率响应误差（教材通常称频率失真）；峰值约2.83V仍未超过3V，无削顶。不能按中频增益误答4V。At20kHz, roughly3dB attenuation gives a frequency-response error relative to midband. The peak is about2.83V, below3V, so there is no clipping; using midband gain alone would incorrectly predict4V.

Vo2,m=40mV×100×10−320≈2.83178V(half-power convention: 22V)

第(3)问：带外精确增益欠定Part3: exact out-of-band gain is unspecified

40kHz超出通带，通常存在高频衰减；按普通带外衰减模型不会削顶。但仅凭带宽不能计算该点精确输出或严格排除任意带外峰化，需要完整幅频响应。单频正弦通过线性电路仍为同频正弦，衰减不等于新谐波。40kHz is outside the passband and normally attenuated. A conventional rolloff would not clip, but bandwidth alone gives no exact gain or universal bound against out-of-band peaking. A linear response to one sine remains a same-frequency sine; attenuation is not harmonic generation.

Vo3,m=10mV|Av(j2π40000)|,exact value unspecified

(1)通带内，峰值1V，无削顶；(2)在上限处约3dB衰减，峰值约2.83V，无削顶；(3)40kHz带外，通常衰减且不削顶，但精确输出及无额外模型时的严格上界不能由给定带宽确定。(1)In-band,1V peak, no clipping. (2)At upper cutoff, about3dB attenuation and2.83V peak, no clipping. (3)40kHz is out-of-band and normally attenuated without clipping; exact output and a universal bound require more response information.

易错点Common errors

  • 频率响应误差与非线性谐波失真应分开。原题只给指标，不提供相频曲线，不能虚构输出精确相位。Separate frequency-response error from nonlinear harmonic distortion. No phase-response curve is given, so do not invent an exact output phase.

分压；开环增益定义；输入电流可忽略。Voltage division; the open-loop gain definition; negligible input current.
没有输出回接输入的反馈通路。先算vP−vN，不能把外部20mV直接当成运放输入压差，也不能在开环中套用虚短。There is no output-to-input feedback path. Calculate vP−vN first; the external 20mV is not the op amp input difference, and an open-loop amplifier does not justify a virtual short.

求同相端分压Find the noninverting voltage

忽略运放输入电流，R1与R2构成串联分压；反相端接地。With negligible input current, R1 and R2 form an unloaded divider; the inverting input is grounded.

vP=viR2R1+R2=20mV1001=19.98001998μV,vN=0

由增益定义反求Recover the open-loop gain

题设零输入时零输出，排除了本次测量中的直流输出偏移；输出4V按线性开环关系计算。Zero output at zero input removes a DC output offset from this measurement; the measured 4V is interpreted through the linear open-loop relation.

Avo=vovP−vN=40.0201001=200200≈2.002×105

Avo=200200≈2.002×105VV；运放输入压差仅约19.98μV。Avo=200200≈2.002×105VV; the op amp input difference is only about 19.98μV.

易错点Common errors

  • 4V20mV=200是整个输入分压器加运放的增益，不是开环运放增益。4V20mV=200 is the gain including the input divider, not the op amp open-loop gain.
  • 此题只让增益有限，仍按默认模型忽略输入电流；若另计有限输入电阻，R2须与其并联。Only the gain is treated as finite here; input current is neglected under the default model. A specified finite input resistance would load R2 in parallel.

核验依据Verification

输入电阻无限大、输出处于线性开环区、输出4V未被电源或负载限幅；题目未给有限输入电阻或电源限制。Infinite input resistance and linear open-loop operation; neither supply nor load clips the measured 4V. No finite input resistance or supply limit is specified.

有限开环增益使线性输入范围非常窄。先用输出极限除以Avo，再用输入压差除以跨接两输入端的ri。Finite open-loop gain makes the linear input range very narrow. Divide the output limits by Avo, then divide the resulting input difference by the resistance between the two inputs.

线性输入范围Linear input range

在线性区vo=Avo(vP−vN)。等号处是线性区与饱和区的交界；严格在线性区时用开区间。In the linear region, vo=Avo(vP−vN). Equality marks the transition to saturation; strictly linear operation uses an open interval.

−10<106(vP−vN)<10⟹−10μV<vP−vN<+10μV

极限处输入电流Input current at the limits

输入电阻两端承受的是输入差分电压，并非10V电源电压。电流符号按从P端流向N端取正。The input resistance sees the differential input voltage, not the 10V supply. Define positive current from P to N.

ii=vP−vNri=±10×10−6109=±10−14A=±10fA=±0.01pA

线性区输入压差的边界为±10μV；严格线性范围为−10μV<vP−vN<+10μV。边界输入电流为±10fA（±0.01pA）。The input-difference boundaries are ±10μV; strictly linear operation requires −10μV<vP−vN<+10μV. The corresponding boundary currents are ±10fA(±0.01pA).

易错点Common errors

  • 109Ω是1GΩ；10μV1GΩ=10fA，不是10pA。109Ω is 1GΩ; 10μV1GΩ is 10fA, not 10pA.
  • 有有限增益就不能把差分输入机械地设成零。Finite gain requires a nonzero differential input for a nonzero output.

前置知识Prerequisites

vid=vP−vN；vic=(vP+vN)2；电压比dB换算；输出叠加。vid=vP−vN; vic=(vP+vN)2; voltage-ratio decibels; output superposition.
先看两输入之差决定主要输出，再看共模是否能忽略。正文CMRR定义用了绝对值，因此80dB只确定共模增益大小，不提供其正负。The input difference sets the main output; then assess the common-mode contribution. The body defines CMRR with an absolute value, so 80dB specifies common-mode gain magnitude but not its sign.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

分解两输入Decompose the inputs

差模信号为负的30μV，而共同的直流电平为6.040mV。The differential signal is −30μV and the common-mode level is 6.040mV.

vid=6.025−6.055=−0.030mV=−30μV;vic=6.025+6.0552=6.040mV

由CMRR求共模增益大小Find common-mode gain magnitude

正文印刷p22–23PDF55–56，式(2.1.10)为差模与共模输出叠加，式(2.1.11)定义KCMR=|AvdAvc|；绝对值不能给出Avc的符号。On printed pp22–23PDF55–56, equation (2.1.10) adds differential and common-mode outputs, while (2.1.11) defines KCMR=|AvdAvc|. Its absolute value does not determine the sign of Avc.

KCMR=108020=104,|Avc|=105104=10

完整条件化输出与工作区Conditional output and operating-region check

差模输出为−3V，共模项的绝对值为0.0604V。若Avc=+10，输出−2.9396V；若Avc=−10，输出−3.0604V。两种都远未达到±14V，无饱和。若忽略共模，常用近似为−3V。The differential output is −3V and the common-mode contribution has magnitude 0.0604V. Avc=+10 gives −2.9396V; Avc=−10 gives −3.0604V. Both are well inside ±14V. Neglecting common mode gives the usual −3V approximation.

vo=Avdvid+Avcvic=−3±0.0604V;|vo|<14V

差模近似vo≈−3V。若保留给定有限CMRR，题目未给共模增益符号，不能确定唯一精确值：Avc=+10时vo=−2.9396V；Avc=−10时vo=−3.0604V。均在线性区。The differential-only approximation is vo≈−3V. With finite CMRR retained, the common-mode gain sign is unspecified, so no unique exact value follows: vo=−2.9396V for Avc=+10, or −3.0604V for Avc=−10. Both remain linear.

易错点Common errors

  • 共模抑制比的分贝值用20log10，不用10log10。A voltage-gain ratio in decibels uses 20log10, not 10log10.
  • 大CMRR不等于共模输出严格为零；也不能从|AvdAvc|擅自选Avc的正号。Large CMRR does not make the common-mode output exactly zero, and |AvdAvc| does not justify choosing positive Avc.
  • 负差模输入产生负输出；不能因为两个输入端都为正而判输出正饱和。A negative differential input gives the dominant negative output; two positive input voltages do not imply positive saturation.

核验依据Verification

准静态线性叠加、无未给定失调项。CMRR只给增益大小比；未给Avc的极性。−3V仅为忽略共模项的近似，非唯一精确解。Quasistatic linear superposition with no unspecified offset. CMRR gives a magnitude ratio only; common-mode gain polarity is absent. −3V is the differential-only approximation, not a uniquely determined exact answer.

目视正文式(2.1.10)与绝对值定义(2.1.11)，分别重建Avc=±10两种输出，并逐一核对±14V限制。Visually verify body equations (2.1.10) and absolute-value definition (2.1.11), reconstruct both Avc=±10 outputs, and check each against ±14V.

增益、电流与理想输入功率分开核算Check gain, branch currents, and ideal input power

题目原文Transcribed question

同相放大电路如图题2.3.1所示。设vs=1V，（1）求闭环电压增益Av=vovs、输出电压vo、各支路电流ii、i1、i2、iL和io；（2）求电流增益Ai=iLii和功率增益Ap=PLPi；（3）在保持输入电压和闭环电压增益不变的情况下，要求流过R2的电流为100μA，请再求R1、R2的值。For the noninverting amplifier in Figure 2.3.1, let vs=1V. (1) Find closed-loop voltage gain Av=vovs, output voltage vo, and branch currents ii, i1, i2, iL, and io. (2) Find current gain Ai=iLii and power gain Ap=PLPi. (3) Keep input voltage and closed-loop gain unchanged, but require 100μA through R2. Find the new R1 and R2.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

同相端接vs，R1=1kΩ反相端接地，R2=9kΩ输出反馈到反相端，RL=1kΩ输出接地；所有电流箭头均保留。vs drives the noninverting input. R1=1kΩ connects the inverting input to ground, R2=9kΩ provides feedback, and RL=1kΩ loads the output; all current arrows are retained.

本题图在书第44页／PDF第77页。The source figure is on printed p. 44 · PDF p. 77.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放负反馈；同相增益；KCL；功率。Ideal op amp with negative feedback; noninverting gain; KCL; power.
先由虚短得反相端1V，再沿R1、R2及RL算电流。运放输出电流包含反馈电流和负载电流。Set the inverting node to 1V, then calculate currents through R1, R2, and RL. Op amp output current supplies both the feedback path and the load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 电压增益与输出(1) Voltage gain and output

同相端为1V；理想负反馈使反相端也为1V，且输入电流为零。The noninverting node is at 1V; ideal negative feedback places the inverting node at 1V with zero input current.

Av=1+R2R1=10,vo=10V,ii=0

(1) 按原图箭头计算电流(1) Branch currents in the original directions

i1向下流过R1，i2从输出向左流过R2，iL向下流过负载，io由运放向右流出。两次KCL都要闭合。i1 flows downward through R1, i2 leftward through R2, iL downward through the load, and io outward from the op amp. Check KCL at both nodes.

i1=11kΩ=1mA;i2=10−19kΩ=1mA;iL=101kΩ=10mA;io=i2+iL=11mA

(2) 理想模型没有有限电流、功率增益(2) No finite ideal current or power gain

负载功率为100mW，而信号源输入电流及输入功率均为零。两个增益的分母为零，因而没有有限实数值；通常以理想极限趋于无穷大表示。输出能量来自运放电源。Load power is 100mW, while source input current and input power are zero. The two ratios have zero denominators and no finite real value; they are conventionally described as unbounded ideal limits. Output energy comes from the op amp supplies.

PL=vo2RL=0.10W,Pi=vsii=0,Ai, Ap unbounded in the ideal limit

(3) 保持比例，按目标电流定阻值(3) Preserve the ratio and set the current

输出仍为10V、反相端仍为1V。R2两端9V对应100μA，所以R2=90kΩ；R1同流100μA且压降1V，所以R1=10kΩ。The output remains 10V and the inverting node remains 1V. The 9V across R2 at 100μA requires 90kΩ; R1 carries the same current at 1V, requiring 10kΩ.

R2=9V100μA=90kΩ,R1=1V100μA=10kΩ

(1)Av=10，vo=10V；按原图方向ii=0、i1=i2=1mA、iL=10mA、io=11mA。(2)Ai与Ap无有限值，理想极限无界；PL=100mW，Pi=0。(3)R1=10kΩ、R2=90kΩ。(1)Av=10 and vo=10V. In the original directions, ii=0, i1=i2=1mA, iL=10mA, and io=11mA. (2)Ai and Ap have no finite value and are unbounded in the ideal limit; PL=100mW and Pi=0.(3)R1=10kΩ and R2=90kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 同相增益为1+R2R1；输出电流为11mA，不能只报负载电流10mA。Noninverting gain is 1+R2R1; output current is 11mA, not just the 10mA load current.
  • 电流增益的输入电流是同相信号端的ii，不是R1或R2中的电流。The input current in Ai is the signal-input current ii, not the current through R1 or R2.
  • 理想无穷大功率增益不表示输出能量来自零输入功率，供电电源提供能量。Unbounded ideal power gain does not create energy from zero input power; the supplies provide it.

核验依据Verification

理想运放，负反馈线性工作，电源及输出驱动能力足以提供10V和11mA。电流与功率增益在理想模型中为无界极限，不能当作有限除法结果。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback with sufficient supply headroom and drive for 10V and 11mA. Current and power gains are unbounded ideal limits, not finite quotients.

独立求解反相节点KCL与vN=vP，再核对i2=i1及io=iL+i2；新电阻同时检查100μA目标与增益10。Independently solve inverting-node KCL with vN=vP, check i2=i1 and io=iL+i2, and verify both the 100μA target and gain 10 with the new resistors.

指定要求：2.3.2Assigned requirement: 2.3.2

含电压源的反馈电路：先定输入端电位Feedback with voltage sources: find input-node voltages first

题目原文Transcribed question

试分别求出图题2.3.2中各运放电路的VO电压值。Find the output voltage VO of each op-amp circuit in Fig. 2.3.2.

四种负反馈电路。(a)同相端接地，反相端与10kΩ、20kΩ分压节点V1之间串联2V源（V1为正端）；(b)同相端接+2V，反相端接同一分压节点；(c)同相端接地，输出经20kΩ和2V源反馈到反相端，源上端为正；(d)同相端接+2V，输出经20kΩ反馈到反相端。Four negative-feedback circuits. (a) The non-inverting input is grounded; a2V source, positive at divider node V1, connects V1 to the inverting input; V1 is between 10kΩ to ground and 20kΩ to the output. (b) The non-inverting input is at +2V and the inverting input connects directly to the same divider. (c) The grounded non-inverting input is paired with feedback through 20kΩ and a2V source positive at its upper terminal. (d) The non-inverting input is at +2V and feedback uses 20kΩ.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放虚短和虚断；电压源极性；KCL。Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; voltage-source polarity; KCL.
不要先套同相、反相放大器增益公式。先由同相端求反相端电位，再沿反馈路径用电压源极性和零输入电流求输出。First infer the inverting-input potential from the non-inverting input. Then use source polarity and zero input current along the feedback path to find the output.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

共同起点：虚短、虚断Start with ideal-input conditions

四图都为负反馈。理想线性运放满足VN=VP，且流入两个输入端的电流均为零。串在反馈中的独立电压源仍保留其规定电压。All four circuits use negative feedback. In ideal linear operation, VN=VP and both input currents are zero. An independent voltage source in the feedback path retains its specified voltage.

VN=VP,iN=iP=0

(a)：电压源使分压节点为2V(a): the source sets the divider node to 2V

VP=0，所以VN=0。2V源正端在V1，故V1=2V。在V1列KCL，流入运放支路电流为零，得到VO=6V。VP=0 implies VN=0. The 2V source is positive at V1, so V1=2V. KCL at V1, with no current into the input branch, gives VO=6V.

V1=VN+2=2V,210kΩ+2−VO20kΩ=0⇒VO=6V

(b)：直接由虚短确定分压节点(b): the virtual short sets the divider node

同相端为2V，故V1=VN=2V。与(a)相同的分压网络给出VO=6V。The non-inverting input is 2V, so V1=VN=2V. The same divider as in (a) gives VO=6V.

VO=(1+2010)2=6V

(c)：反馈电阻没有压降(c): the feedback resistor has no voltage drop

VN=VP=0。反相端支路没有其他通路，电流为零，所以20kΩ上压降为零。2V源上端比VN高2V，因此输出为2V。VN=VP=0. The inverting-input branch has no other current path, so its current is zero and the 20kΩ resistor has no voltage drop. The upper source terminal is 2V above VN, hence the output is 2V.

IR=0,VO=VN+2=2V

(d)：有反馈电阻的电压跟随器(d): a voltage follower with a feedback resistor

VN=VP=2V，反馈电阻电流为零，输出与反相端电位相等，故VO=2V。VN=VP=2V. With zero current in the feedback resistor, the output equals the inverting-input potential, giving VO=2V.

VO=VN=VP=2V

(a)6V；(b)6V；(c)2V；(d)2V。(a)6V; (b)6V; (c)2V; (d)2V.

易错点Common errors

  • 虚短是两个输入端电位相等，不是把串联的2V源短路。A virtual short equates the input potentials; it does not short the series 2V source.
  • (c)(d)反馈电阻电流为零；不能把它们错当作带接地输入电阻的普通放大器。The feedback-resistor current in (c) and (d) is zero; these circuits do not have the grounded input resistor of a conventional gain network.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

逐图检查电压源长线正端和实际反馈连接；独立代回KCL：(a)(b)两电阻电流均为0.2mA，(c)(d)反馈电流均为0。所有结果同时满足VN=VP。未声称与外部参考答案对照。Inspected each source positive terminal and actual feedback connection. Independent substitution into KCL gives 0.2mA in both divider resistors for (a) and (b), and zero feedback current for (c) and (d). All results satisfy VN=VP. No external-answer-key comparison is claimed.

同相端接vi，反相端经R1=1kΩ接地、经R2=59kΩ接输出，输出经RL接地。vi drives the noninverting input; R1=1kΩ grounds the inverting input, R2=59kΩ provides feedback, and RL loads the output.

本题图在书第44页／PDF第77页。The source figure is on printed p. 44 · PDF p. 77.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

同相增益；总输出电流；电流限幅；SPICE模型边界。Noninverting gain; total output current; current limiting; SPICE model boundaries.
先画未限幅的12V正弦，再同时检查15V电压边界与40mA电流边界。反馈支路也消耗输出电流，必须与负载并联计入。Start with the unclipped 12V sine, then check both the 15V voltage limit and 40mA current limit. Include the feedback path in parallel with the load because it also draws output current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一的增益与限流边界Gain and current-limit boundary

线性增益为60。输入电流为零时，无论是否限流，R1与R2都是从输出到地的串联60kΩ支路；因此限流时仍可求vN=vo60，但不能令vN=vi。The linear gain is 60. With zero input current, R1 and R2 remain a series 60kΩ path from output to ground even during current limiting. Thus vN=vo60 remains valid, but vN=vi does not.

Av=1+59kΩ1kΩ=60;vo,lin=12sinωtV;io=vo(1RL+160kΩ);Vlim=min(15,0.0401RL+160000)

(1)500Ω负载：不削顶(1)500Ω: no clipping

12V峰值时负载电流24mA、反馈电流0.2mA，总计24.2mA，小于40mA；12V也小于15V。At a12V peak, the load draws 24mA and the feedback path 0.2mA, totaling 24.2mA, below 40mA. The 12V peak is also below 15V.

RL=500Ω:vo=12sinωtV,|io|max=24.2mA

(2)100Ω负载：正负削平(2)100Ω: symmetric current clipping

未限幅时需要120.2mA，超出40mA。严格题设模型的平顶高度为3.993344V，常忽略反馈支路而近似成4V。输入幅度超过66.5557mV时进入限流。The unclipped demand is 120.2mA, exceeding 40mA. The exact textbook-model plateau is 3.993344V; 4V is the approximation that neglects feedback current. Current limiting begins when input magnitude exceeds 66.5557mV.

Vlim=0.0401100+160000=2400601=3.993344426V;vo(t)={12sinωt,|12sinωt|≤VlimVlimsgn(sinωt),|12sinωt|>Vlim

(3) 已运行的100Hz SPICE波形(3) Executed 100Hz SPICE waveforms

已实际运行ngspice 47，保留网表、数值数据及两种负载的输入、输出图。自写严格±40mA模型与上面分段式的最大误差小于3μV：500Ω输出约±12V，100Ω输出±3.993344V。厂商μA741宏模型另作器件对照。ngspice 47 was actually run; netlists, numerical data, and input and output plots for both loads are retained. A self-authored strict ±40mA model agrees with the piecewise expression within 3μV: about ±12V at 500Ω and ±3.993344V at 100Ω. Manufacturer μA741 macro-model runs provide a separate device comparison.

vi(t)=0.2sin(200πt)V,T=10ms;transient: 0–40ms, Δtmax=2μs

(3)μA741宏模型的限流参数不能混同(3) Distinguish μA741 macro-model current limits

TI官方SLOJ138中的UA741.301用VLPVLN=25，100Ω下仿真平顶约±2.55622V。为对照题目的40mA设定，仅把这两个控制参数改成40的研究副本得到约±4.05367V，实测软限流约±40.6043mA；它不是严格40mA硬限幅。500Ω时两个厂商模型都约为−11.98878到+11.99954V。题设(1)(2)的精确结论仍采用严格40mA模型；器件宏模型的有限带宽、偏置和软限流解释了细小差异。TI SLOJ138 supplies UA741.301 with VLPVLN=25; its simulated 100Ω plateaus are about ±2.55622V. A research copy changing only those two controls to 40 gives about ±4.05367V and measured soft limiting near ±40.6043mA, rather than an exact 40mA hard limit. At 500Ω, both manufacturer variants span approximately −11.98878 to +11.99954V. The exact answers to (1) and (2) still use the strict 40mA model; finite bandwidth, bias, and soft limiting account for macro-model differences.

100Hz实际SPICE：严格±40mA题设模型在500Ω与100Ω负载下的vi与vo；分别为12V正弦与±3.993344V削顶。Executed 100Hz SPICE input and output waveforms for the strict ±40mA textbook model at 500Ω and 100Ω: a12V sine and clipping at ±3.993344V, respectively.

实际SPICE对照严格40mA题设模型、原TI μA741模型（25控制值）及仅改40控制值的软限流副本；100Ω的平顶分别约3.993、2.556、4.054V。Executed SPICE comparison of the strict 40mA textbook model, original TI μA741 model (25 controls), and soft-limit research copy with 40 controls; 100Ω plateaus are approximately 3.993, 2.556, and 4.054V.

(1)vo=12sinωtV，无削顶。(2)vo为12sinωt在±3.993344V处对称削平，约±4V。(3)100Hz的SPICE网表、数据与输入、输出波形已提供；严格40mA模型复现上述结果。μA741厂商宏模型的原始25mA参数版与改40控制参数的软限流版已另图对照，不能把其平顶当作题设精确硬边界。(1)vo=12sinωtV without clipping. (2) Clip 12sinωt symmetrically at ±3.993344V, approximately ±4V. (3) Executed 100Hz SPICE netlists, data, and input and output plots are supplied; the strict 40mA model reproduces these answers. Separate plots compare the original manufacturer model with 25mA controls and the version with controls set to 40; their soft-limit plateaus are not the exact textbook hard boundary.

易错点Common errors

  • io不是只有voRL，还包括输出反馈电阻支路的电流。io includes the feedback-resistor path as well as voRL.
  • 进入限流后虚短失效；电阻分压关系vN=vo60仍然成立。A virtual short fails in current limiting; the resistor-divider relation vN=vo60 still holds.
  • 不能把官方UA741宏模型的25mA控制值或改40后的软限流结果，未经说明直接当作题设±40mA硬限幅。Do not silently equate either the official model’s25mA controls or the modified model’s soft limit with the exercise’s strict ±40mA boundary.

核验依据Verification

(1)(2)为除±40mA硬限流外的理想运放，供电±15V。严格SPICE模型采用大跨导1×106AV及min和max限流，结果均小于电源边界。(3)TI宏模型原版及仅调整VLPVLN的研究副本分别记录；其二极管软限流、有限增益、带宽与偏置不属于题设硬限流模型。Parts (1) and (2) use an otherwise ideal op amp with strict ±40mA limiting and ±15V supplies. The strict SPICE implementation uses large transconductance 1×106AV with min and max current clamping; every output stays inside the rails. Part (3) separately records the original TI macro model and a research copy changing only VLPVLN; their diode soft limiting, finite gain and bandwidth, and bias differ from the textbook hard-limit model.

先独立以输出节点KCL求电流极限，再逐点检查分段波形的线性误差、限流条件及±15V边界。实际执行6个ngspice瞬态任务，保存全部网表、日志、原始数据，逐样本核验输出节点KCL；严格模型对解析波形最大误差<3μV。Independently derive the current boundary by output-node KCL, then check the linear-error and current-limit conditions and ±15V limits pointwise. Execute six ngspice transients and retain every netlist, log, and dataset; verify output KCL sample by sample. The strict model differs from the analytical waveform by <3μV.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 · PDF p. 78. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

输入分压、同相增益、供电和带载能力Input division, gain, supply, and load capability

题目原文Transcribed question

放大电路如图题2.3.4所示。（1）试求电路的电压增益Av=vovi和输入电阻Ri；（2）若运放的饱和压降为2V，要求vo能在−10～+10V范围内变化，那么电源电压应为多少？（3）在（2）的基础上，若运放输出端最大电流为±20mA，且已知输出最大电压时，R2中的电流为500μA，那么电路对负载阻值有何要求？For the amplifier in Figure 2.3.4: (1) Find voltage gain Av=vovi and input resistance Ri. (2) With 2V output saturation headroom, what supply voltages allow vo to span −10 to +10V? (3) Under (2), the maximum output current is ±20mA and current through R2 at maximum output voltage is 500μA. What requirement must the load resistance satisfy?

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

vi经R3接同相端，同相端经R4接地；反相端经R1接地、经R2反馈至输出。输入电阻由vi端看入。vi reaches the noninverting input through R3 with shunt R4; R1 grounds the inverting input and R2 feeds back from the output. Ri is measured looking into the vi terminal.

本题图在书第45页／PDF第78页。The source figure is on printed p. 45 · PDF p. 78.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无载输入分压；同相放大；输出摆幅与电源压差；KCL。Unloaded input division; noninverting gain; supply headroom; KCL.
R3、R4先把输入衰减，R1、R2再同相放大。负载能力问题要从总输出电流中扣掉反馈电流。R3 and R4 attenuate the input before R1 and R2 provide noninverting gain. Subtract feedback current from total output-current capability to obtain load capacity.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 电压增益(1) Voltage gain

运放同相端不吸收电流，R3与R4为纯分压；负反馈运放再放大1+R2R1倍。Zero noninverting input current makes R3–R4 an unloaded divider; the feedback amplifier then multiplies by 1+R2R1.

vP=R4R3+R4vi,Av=(1+R2R1)R4R3+R4

(1) 输入电阻(1) Input resistance

输入源的电流只能依次流过R3与R4，不能流进运放输入端。Source current must pass through R3 and R4 in series because none enters the op amp.

ii=viR3+R4,Ri=R3+R4

(2) 电源至少±12V(2) Supplies of at least ±12V

正、负输出极限都要离相应电源轨2V，因此每侧供电的幅值至少12V。Each output extreme must remain 2V away from its respective rail; each supply magnitude must therefore be at least 12V.

V+≥+12V,V−≤−12V;minimum symmetric supplies: ±12V

(3) 剩余输出电流供给负载(3) Allocate remaining current to the load

在|vo|=10V时，反馈支路已占0.5mA，留给对地电阻负载最多19.5mA；正负峰值对称。At |vo|=10V, the feedback branch draws 0.5mA, leaving at most 19.5mA for a resistive load to ground; the positive and negative peaks are symmetric.

10RL+0.5mA≤20mA⟹RL≥100.0195=512.820513Ω

(1)Av=(1+R2R1)R4(R3+R4)，Ri=R3+R4。(2) 对称供电最低±12V。(3) 对地电阻负载RL≥512.82Ω；若要求留余量，应取更大值。(1)Av=(1+R2R1)R4(R3+R4), and Ri=R3+R4. (2) The minimum symmetric supplies are ±12V. (3)A resistive load to ground requires RL≥512.82Ω; a larger value provides margin.

易错点Common errors

  • 同相端有R4对地，因此从vi端看到的输入电阻不是无穷大。Because R4 shunts the noninverting node, input resistance at vi is not infinite.
  • 10V输出加2V饱和压降，对应每侧12V，双电源总差为24V。A10V output plus 2V headroom requires 12V on each rail, or 24V rail-to-rail.
  • RL≥500Ω会忽略0.5mA反馈电流，在10V峰值处超过总电流上限。RL≥500Ω neglects the 0.5mA feedback current and exceeds the total-current limit at the 10V peak.

核验依据Verification

理想运放线性负反馈；第(2)问额外计入2V饱和压降，第(3)问再加入对称±20mA限制。负载为输出到地的无源电阻；输入共模范围足够。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, augmented by 2V saturation headroom in (2) and symmetric ±20mA limiting in (3). The load is a passive resistor from output to ground; input common-mode range is sufficient.

用独立三节点方程检查输入分压及反馈比；在负载边界计算iL=19.5mA、if=0.5mA，总计20mA，并由if检查R1+R2=20kΩ。Check input division and feedback ratio with independent three-node equations; at the load boundary verify iL=19.5mA and if=0.5mA total 20mA, and infer R1+R2=20kΩ from if.

2.3.5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 · PDF p. 78. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

有限开环增益的跟随误差Follower error with finite open-loop gain

题目原文Transcribed question

若运放的开环差模电压增益为Avo，共模抑制比为无穷大。（1）求电压跟随器输出电压与输入电压的实际关系；（2）若要求跟随误差不超过0.01%，Avo至少要达到多少？An op amp has open-loop differential gain Avo and infinite common-mode rejection ratio. (1) Find the actual voltage-follower output and input relation. (2) How large must Avo be to keep following error at or below 0.01%?

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

开环传输式；单位负反馈；相对误差。Open-loop transfer; unity negative feedback; relative error.
此题要算有限增益误差，必须保留vi−vo。直接使用虚短会把要求计算的误差消掉。The finite-gain error is the quantity of interest, so retain vi−vo. Imposing an exact virtual short would erase that error.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 保留输入差，再解闭环关系(1) Keep the differential input and solve

跟随器同相端接vi，反相端直接接vo；共模项为零。The noninverting input receives vi and the inverting input receives vo directly; there is no common-mode contribution.

vo=Avo(vi−vo)⟹vovi=Avo1+Avo=1−11+Avo

(2) 按输入值定义跟随相对误差(2) Define relative following error with respect to input

对正的准静态开环增益，输出略小于输入。0.01%=10−4；这里采用|vi−vo||vi|的通常定义。For positive quasistatic open-loop gain, output is slightly smaller than input. Since 0.01%=10−4, use the usual error definition |vi−vo||vi|.

ε=|1−vovi|=11+Avo≤10−4⟹Avo≥9999≈104

(1)vo=[Avo(1+Avo)]vi。(2) 按相对于输入的跟随误差，精确下限Avo=9999VV，工程上约取104VV（约80dB）。(1)vo=[Avo(1+Avo)]vi. (2) For error relative to the input, the exact minimum is Avo=9999VV, commonly rounded to 104VV (about 80dB).

易错点Common errors

  • 本题不能先令vo=vi；那相当于把有限Avo重新理想化成无穷大。Do not start from vo=vi; that would replace the specified finite Avo with infinity.
  • 若把误差改定义成|vi−vo||vo|，结果是1Avo，下限为10000；分母必须写清。本解采用常见的输入归一化定义。If error were instead defined as |vi−vo||vo|, it would equal 1Avo and require 10000. State the denominator; this solution uses the usual input-normalized definition.

核验依据Verification

准静态正实数开环增益，单位负反馈稳定；其他特性理想，未发生输出限幅；误差相对于输入定义。vi=0时输出也为零，可用增益误差连续延拓。Positive real quasistatic gain, stable unity negative feedback, other properties ideal, and no output clipping. Error is input-normalized; at vi=0 both voltages are zero and gain error is defined by continuity.

对Avo=9999、104及多组较小、较大正值，独立解vo=Avo(vi−vo)，检查误差单调下降，并核验边界正好等于10−4。For Avo=9999, 104, and other positive values, independently solve vo=Avo(vi−vo), verify monotonic error reduction, and confirm the boundary equals 10−4.

2.3.6全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 · PDF p. 78. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

虚地让光电流全部进入反馈电阻Virtual ground sends the photocurrent through feedback

题目原文Transcribed question

电流-电压转换电路如图题2.3.6所示。设is是光探测仪的输出电流，Rsi是其内阻。（1）试证明输出电压vo=−isR；（2）当is=0.5mA、Rsi=10kΩ、R=10kΩ时，求输出电压vo和互阻增益Ar。For the current-to-voltage converter in Figure 2.3.6, is is the photodetector output current and Rsi its internal resistance. (1) Prove vo=−isR. (2) For is=0.5mA, Rsi=10kΩ, and R=10kΩ, find vo and transresistance gain Ar.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

光电流源is与Rsi并联注入运放反相端，反馈电阻R由输出接反相端，同相端接地；is向上、反馈电流向右。Photocurrent source is and parallel Rsi feed the inverting input; feedback resistor R joins output and inverting input, and the noninverting input is grounded. is points upward and feedback current rightward.

本题图在书第45页／PDF第78页。The source figure is on printed p. 45 · PDF p. 78.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

诺顿电流源；理想运放虚地、虚断；节点KCL；互阻单位Ω。Norton current source; ideal-op-amp virtual ground and zero input current; KCL; transresistance in ohms.
Rsi并在电流源两端，但虚地使它两端电压为零。因此它不分走信号电流，不能按普通并联分流公式处理。Rsi shunts the current source, but virtual ground gives it zero voltage. It therefore draws no signal current; ordinary current division does not apply.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 输入节点虚地与KCL(1) Virtual ground and input-node KCL

同相端接地且负反馈线性工作，故vN=0；运放输入电流为零，Rsi电流也为零。所有is经R流向输出。Grounded noninverting input and linear negative feedback give vN=0. Both op amp input current and Rsi current are zero, so all is passes through R toward the output.

vN=vP=0;is=vNRsi+vN−voR+iN=0−voR+0

(1) 得到互阻关系(1) Transresistance relation

正向注入的电流必须从输入虚地点经R流向负电压输出，因此输出符号为负。A positive injected current flows from virtual ground through R to a negative output, which establishes the minus sign.

vo=−isR,Ar≡vois=−R

(2) 代入数值(2) Numerical values

0.5mA乘10kΩ为5V；10kΩ内阻不改变理想虚地关系。0.5mA times 10kΩ is 5V; the 10kΩ internal resistance does not alter ideal virtual-ground operation.

vo=−(0.5mA)(10kΩ)=−5V,Ar=−10kΩ

(1)vo=−isR，Ar=−R。(2)vo=−5V，互阻增益Ar=−10kΩ。(1)vo=−isR and Ar=−R. (2)vo=−5V and transresistance gain Ar=−10kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 电流源内阻Rsi与反馈电阻R并不直接并联在同一对节点上；R另一端是运放输出，不是地。Rsi and feedback R are not directly across the same node pair; R terminates at the output, not ground.
  • 互阻增益的单位是Ω，不能只写无单位的−10。Transresistance has units of ohms; do not report a dimensionless −10.
  • 若输出饱和或带宽不足，虚地条件会失效，此时Rsi可能分流。If clipping or inadequate bandwidth destroys virtual ground, Rsi can draw part of the source current.

核验依据Verification

理想运放稳定负反馈，供电与输出电流能力足以达到−5V和0.5mA；准静态忽略探测器及输入寄生电容。Ideal op amp with stable negative feedback and sufficient supply and output capability for −5V and 0.5mA; quasistatic analysis neglects detector and input parasitic capacitance.

在原图输入节点独立写完整KCL并检查Rsi支路零电流；多组Rsi及电流符号数值代入均满足KCL，给定数值时R流过0.5mA。Independently write complete input-node KCL and verify zero Rsi current; numerical checks over several Rsi values and both current signs satisfy KCL, with 0.5mA through R in the stated case.

2.3.7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第45页／PDF第78页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 45 · PDF p. 78. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2.3.7Assigned requirement: 2.3.7

双运放差分输出与输入电阻Two-op-amp differential output and input resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.3.7所示，vi=0.5sinωtV。（1）试求vo1、vo2和vo；（2）求电路的电压增益Av=vovi和输入电阻Ri。The circuit is shown in Fig. 2.3.7, with vi=0.5sin(ωt)V. (1) Find vo1, vo2 and vo. (2) Find the voltage gain Av=vovi and the input resistance Ri.

输入vi同时接A1同相端前的12kΩ和A2反相端前的12kΩ；A1反馈40kΩ、反相端对地12kΩ；A2反馈30kΩ、同相端经12kΩ接地。输出vo定义上正下负，即vo1−vo2。Input vi connects through separate 12kΩ resistors to A1’s non-inverting input and A2’s inverting input. A1 has 40kΩ feedback and 12kΩ from its inverting input to ground. A2 has 30kΩ feedback and its non-inverting input is grounded through 12kΩ. Output vo is positive at vo1 and negative at vo2.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

同相、反相放大器；差分电压的参考极性；端口输入电阻。Non-inverting and inverting amplifiers; differential-output polarity; port input resistance.
先拆成上方同相放大器与下方反相放大器，分别求输出，再按图示正负端相减。输入电阻要从信号源的总取流量计算。Treat the upper stage as non-inverting and the lower stage as inverting. Find each output, then subtract according to the marked polarity. Find input resistance from the total current drawn from the signal source.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

上方A1：同相放大Upper A1: non-inverting gain

同相端不取电流，其前面的12kΩ无压降，故同相端电压就是vi。A1增益为1+4012=133。The non-inverting input draws no current, so its series 12kΩ resistor has no voltage drop and its voltage equals vi. A1’s gain is 1+4012=133.

vo1=(1+4012)vi=136sinωtV

下方A2：反相放大Lower A2: inverting gain

A2同相端为0，反相端为虚地。其增益为−3012=−52。A2’s non-inverting input is at 0V and its inverting input is a virtual ground. Its gain is −3012=−52.

vo2=−3012vi=−54sinωtV

按输出极性相减Subtract according to the output polarity

图中vo上正下负，故vo=vo1−vo2。下方输出本身为负，相减后两项的幅值相加。The output is marked positive at the top and negative at the bottom, so vo=vo1−vo2. Since the lower output is negative, the amplitudes add.

vo=(133+52)vi=416vi=4112sinωtV,Av=416

从输入总电流求RiFind Ri from the total input current

上方同相支路输入电流为零。输入电流全部通过下方12kΩ流向A2虚地，所以ii=vi(12kΩ)。The upper non-inverting branch draws zero input current. All input current flows through the lower 12kΩ resistor into A2’s virtual ground, so ii=vi(12kΩ).

Ri=viii=12kΩ

vo1=(136)sinωtV，vo2=−(54)sinωtV，vo=(4112)sinωtV；Av=416≈6.833，Ri=12kΩ。vo1=(136)sin(ωt)V, vo2=−(54)sin(ωt)V, and vo=(4112)sin(ωt)V; Av=416≈6.833 and Ri=12kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • vo是两个输出端之间的电压，不是某一个运放的对地输出。vo is the voltage between the two outputs, not either single output relative to ground.
  • 上方串联12kΩ不与下方12kΩ并联取流，因为理想同相输入端的电流为零。The upper series 12kΩ does not draw current in parallel with the lower 12kΩ, because the ideal non-inverting input current is zero.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

逐点代回运放反相节点KCL。A1节点电位vi满足vi12k+(vi−vo1)40k=0；A2虚地满足−vi12k−vo230k=0。输入取流式和输出极性独立核查均一致。Substituted into KCL at each inverting node. A1’s node at vi satisfies vi12k+(vi−vo1)40k=0; A2’s virtual ground satisfies −vi12k−vo230k=0. Input-current and output-polarity checks agree.

两个虚短先定电位，再测βUse two feedback constraints before finding β

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.3.8所示，三极管T电极b、e间的压差VBE=VB−VE=0.7V。（1）求三极管电极c、b、e的电位；（2）若电压表的读数为200mV，试求三极管电流放大系数β=ICIB的值。In Figure 2.3.8, transistor T has VBE=VB−VE=0.7V. (1) Find the collector, base, and emitter potentials. (2) If the voltmeter reads 200mV, find current gain β=ICIB.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

A1同相端+6V、反相端接T集电极，输出驱动T发射极；+12V经R1=6kΩ给集电极供电。A2反相端接基极，R2=10kΩ反馈，R3=10kΩ使同相端接地，输出电压表读200mV。A1 has +6V at its noninverting input, collector feedback at its inverting input, and drives the emitter. +12V supplies the collector through R1=6kΩ. A2 senses the base at its inverting input with R2=10kΩ feedback; R3=10kΩ grounds its noninverting input. Its output voltmeter reads 200mV.

本题图在书第45页／PDF第78页。The source figure is on printed p. 45 · PDF p. 78.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放负反馈；BJT电位与放大区条件；KCL；β=ICIB。Ideal op amp negative feedback; BJT terminal potentials and active-region conditions; KCL; β=ICIB.
A1通过晶体管把集电极钳在+6V；A2把基极保持在0V。不要把A1输出误当集电极，A1输出实际接发射极。A1 controls the transistor to hold its collector at +6V; A2 holds the base at 0V. A1 output is connected to the emitter, not the collector.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 两个理想反馈约束(1) Two ideal feedback constraints

A1两输入相等给VC=+6V。A2同相端经R3接地且无输入电流，因此VB=0。由给定VBE求发射极。Equal A1 input voltages give VC=+6V. A2 noninverting input is grounded through R3 without input current, so VB=0. Use the given VBE for the emitter.

VC=+6V,VB=0,VE=VB−VBE=−0.7V

(2) 集电极电流(2) Collector current

A1输入不取电流，R1的电流全部进入晶体管集电极。A1 input draws no current, so all current through R1 enters the collector.

IC=12−66kΩ=1mA

(2) 基极电流与β(2) Base current and β

NPN管基极需要正的流入电流，因此A2输出为正的+200mV，电流从输出经R2流向0V基极；R3不承载输入电流。The NPN base requires positive current into the device, so A2 output is +200mV. Current flows from that output through R2 toward the 0V base; R3 carries no input current.

IB=VO−VBR2=0.20010kΩ=20μA;β=1mA20μA=50

核对晶体管工作区与输出电流Check the transistor region and output currents

集电极高于基极6V，集电结反偏；基极比发射极高0.7V，发射结正偏，符合NPN正向放大。A1输出需吸收IE=1.02mA，A2输出提供20μA。The collector is 6V above the base, so the collector junction is reverse biased; the base is 0.7V above the emitter, so the emitter junction is forward biased. This is NPN forward-active operation. A1 must sink IE=1.02mA and A2 supplies 20μA.

VCB=6V>0,VCE=6.7V,IE=IC+IB=1.02mA

(1)VC=+6V，VB=0V，VE=−0.7V。(2)IC=1mA、IB=20μA，β=50；晶体管处于正向放大区。(1)VC=+6V, VB=0V, and VE=−0.7V. (2)IC=1mA, IB=20μA, and β=50; the transistor is forward active.

易错点Common errors

  • 6kΩ电阻的压降是12−6=6V，不是12V。The 6kΩ resistor drops 12−6=6V, not 12V.
  • 200mV是A2输出对地电压，基极本身由反馈保持0V。The 200mV reading is A2 output relative to ground; feedback holds the base itself at 0V.
  • 给定VBE=VB−VE=+0.7V，故基极0V时发射极为−0.7V。Given VBE=VB−VE=+0.7V, a0V base requires a−0.7V emitter.

核验依据Verification

两运放理想、反馈稳定且未饱和；供电、共模范围支持A1输入+6V、输出−0.7V及A2输出+0.2V。晶体管按题设VBE=0.7V，忽略漏电流；电压表输入电阻无限大。Both op amps are ideal, stable, and unclipped, with supply and common-mode capability for A1 inputs at +6V, its output at −0.7V, and A2 output at +0.2V. Use specified transistor VBE=0.7V, neglect leakage, and treat the voltmeter as infinitely resistive.

从两个独立运放约束与集电极、基极节点KCL重算；再检查NPN发射结正偏、集电结反偏及IE=IC+IB，避免先套β公式而遗漏工作区。Recompute from the two independent op amp constraints and collector and base KCL; then check NPN emitter forward bias, collector reverse bias, and IE=IC+IB rather than applying β without a region check.

题目原文Transcribed question

图2.3.8所示电路作为麦克风电路的前置放大器，麦克风的输入电压有效值为12mV，其内阻Rsi=1kΩ，R1=R1′+Rsi（R1′为外接电阻）。要求输出电压有效值为1.2V，求电路中各阻值，设计时该电路所有电阻小于500kΩ。Use the circuit in body Figure 2.3.8 as a microphone preamplifier. The microphone source voltage is 12mV rms and its internal resistance is Rsi=1kΩ; R1=R1′+Rsi, where R1′ is the external resistor. Design the resistances for an output of 1.2V rms, with every resistor below 500kΩ.

整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

正文T型反馈反相放大器：R1连接输入源与反相虚地点N，R2连接N与节点M，R3连接M与输出，R4连接M与地；同相端接地。图中的R1包括麦克风内阻及外接R1′。Body T−feedback inverting amplifier: R1 joins the source to virtual-ground N; R2 joins N to M, R3 joins M to output, and R4 joins M to ground. The noninverting input is grounded; R1 includes microphone internal resistance and external R1′.

本题图在书第29页／PDF第62页。The source figure is on printed p. 29 · PDF p. 62.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相运放虚地；T型网络节点KCL；有效值增益；源内阻串联。Inverting-amplifier virtual ground; T−network KCL; rms gain; series source resistance.
题目引用正文图2.3.8（印刷p29PDF62），不是下面的图题2.3.8晶体管测β电路。12mV是带1kΩ内阻的源电压，必须把内阻加进R1。设计解不唯一，给出一组满足全部约束的解即可。The reference is body Figure 2.3.8 (printed p29PDF62), not exercise Figure 2.3.8 for transistor β measurement. The 12mV belongs to a source with 1kΩ internal resistance, which must be included in R1. The design is not unique; one set satisfying all constraints is sufficient.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

目标源电压增益Required source-voltage gain

输出与输入有效值之比为100。正文电路反相，故所需带符号增益为−100。The ratio of output to source rms voltage is 100. The body circuit is inverting, so the required signed gain is −100.

Av=vovi=−1.20.012=−100,R1=R1′+Rsi

原图两个节点独立写KCLWrite KCL at both original nodes

N点为0V，输入电流等于从N流向M的电流；M点另有R4接地电流，不能把R2与R3简单串联。N is at 0V, so input current equals current from N to M. M also connects through R4 to ground, so R2 and R3 cannot be treated as a simple series pair.

viR1=−vMR2,vMR2+vMR4+vM−voR3=0

得到T型反馈的有效增益Derive T−feedback gain

消去vM；R2R3R4这一项可使等效反馈电阻很大，同时每个实际电阻都不必很大。Eliminate vM. The R2R3R4 term produces a large effective feedback resistance without requiring a large individual resistor.

Av=−R2+R3+R2R3R4R1

选择一组精确阻值Choose one exact set

取外接R1′=9kΩ，与麦克风1kΩ内阻合成R1=10kΩ；选R2=R3=100kΩ。所需等效反馈电阻为1MΩ，解得R4=12.5kΩ。全部实际电阻均严格小于500kΩ。Choose external R1′=9kΩ so the 1kΩ microphone resistance gives R1=10kΩ. Set R2=R3=100kΩ. The required effective feedback resistance is 1MΩ, giving R4=12.5kΩ. Every actual resistor is strictly below 500kΩ.

R1′=9kΩ, Rsi=1kΩ, R2=R3=100kΩ, R4=12.5kΩ;R2+R3+R2R3R4=100+100+800=1000kΩ

带源内阻核对输出与支路电流Verify with source resistance and branch currents

对12mV源电压，输入电流有效值1.2μA，麦克风端电压10.8mV；M点反相为−0.12V，对应输出−1.2V。以正的源电压相量为参考，图示i2=1.2μA、i4=9.6μA、i3=10.8μA，M点KCL闭合。For a12mV source, input current is 1.2μA rms and the microphone terminal voltage is 10.8mV. M has signed phasor −0.12V and output −1.2V. Relative to a positive source phasor, the drawn currents are i2=1.2μA, i4=9.6μA, and i3=10.8μA, satisfying M−node KCL.

VoVi=−100010=−100;|Vo|rms=1.2V;VM=−0.12V;i2+i4=i3

一组可行设计：R1′=9kΩ（外接）、Rsi=1kΩ（已有），因此R1=10kΩ；R2=R3=100kΩ，R4=12.5kΩ。源电压增益−100，输出1.2V有效值；全部电阻小于500kΩ。R1为总串联值，不能在已有内阻之外再接一个10kΩ电阻。One valid design is external R1′=9kΩ with existing Rsi=1kΩ, hence total R1=10kΩ; R2=R3=100kΩ and R4=12.5kΩ. Source-voltage gain is −100 and output is 1.2V rms; every resistor is below 500kΩ. R1 is the total series value, not an additional external 10kΩ resistor.

易错点Common errors

  • 图2.3.8和图题2.3.8是两个不同电路，须读正文T型网络图。Body Figure 2.3.8 and exercise Figure 2.3.8 are different circuits; this question uses the body’sT network.
  • 源内阻1kΩ必须与外接R1′相加；漏掉它会改变从麦克风源电压到输出的增益。Add the 1kΩ source resistance to external R1′; omitting it changes gain from microphone source voltage to output.
  • 等效反馈阻值1MΩ不是一个实际1MΩ电阻；实际最大电阻仍为100kΩ。The 1MΩ effective feedback value is not a physical 1MΩ resistor; the largest actual resistor here is 100kΩ.
  • 有效值比等于幅值比，输入与输出都用有效值，不要额外乘√2。An rms ratio equals the amplitude ratio; both stated voltages are rms, so do not insert an extra √2.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、稳定线性负反馈；题目12mV有效值视为源开路等效电压，R1按题设含源内阻。未给负载，默认输出高阻测量，且供电足以支持1.2V有效值（约1.697V峰值）。设计解不唯一。Ideal op amp with stable linear negative feedback. The stated 12mV rms is the Thevenin source voltage, and R1 includes source resistance as specified. No output load is given, so measurement is high impedance; supply headroom supports 1.2V rms (about 1.697V peak). The design is not unique.

目视正文p29PDF62的原图，独立求解包含1kΩ源内阻、9kΩ外接电阻及T网络的四节点线性方程；检查源端加载、N与M点KCL、增益−100及所有电阻上限。Visually inspect the body figure on p29PDF62 and independently solve four-node equations including the 1kΩ source resistance, external 9kΩ resistor, and T network. Check source loading, NM−node KCL, gain −100, and every resistance constraint.

平衡四电阻，让负载电压项抵消Balance four resistors to cancel the load-voltage term

题目原文Transcribed question

图题2.3.10所示电路可以将电压源vs转换为电流源iL，驱动线圈ZL。为使iL独立于ZL，电路中设定R2(R1R3)=1R4。试求iLvs表达式。The circuit in Fig. 2.3.10 converts source voltage vs to current iL to drive coil ZL. To make iL independent of ZL, set R2(R1R3)=1R4. Derive iLvs.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

vs经R1接反相节点，R2从该节点反馈到运放输出vo；同相端接负载上端vL。输出经R3接vL；R4及ZL分别由vL接地，iL箭头向下。vs connects through R1 to the inverting node, with R2 to output vo. The noninverting input senses load voltage vL. R3 connects output to vL; R4 and ZL each connect vL to ground. iL points downward.

本题图在书第46页／PDF第79页。The source figure is on printed p. 46 · PDF p. 79.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
不能把运放看成简单反相放大器：同相端不是地。先令vn=vL，最后用平衡条件消掉vL。This is not a grounded-input inverter: its noninverting input is vL. Set vn=vL and use the balance condition only after writing load KCL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

反相节点KCLInverting-node KCL

输入电流为零，先把vo写成vL和vs的函数。Zero input current expresses vo in terms of vL and vs.

vL−vsR1+vL−voR2=0⇒vo=(1+R2R1)vL−R2R1vs

负载节点KCLLoad-node KCL

由R3流入的电流要分给R4和线圈；不要把R3电流全当作iL。Current through R3 splits between R4 and the coil; it is not all load current.

iL=vo−vLR3−vLR4=(R2R1R3−1R4)vL−R2R1R3vs

代入平衡条件并检查符号Apply balance and check the sign

vL项抵消，向下为正的电流与vs反相。若ZL在线性频域为有限阻抗，vL=ZLiL，运放仍需提供随负载变化的vo；“电流不依赖负载”不等于无限输出余量。The vL term cancels. Downward-reference load current has opposite sign to vs. For finite linear impedance ZL, vL=ZLiL, while vo still changes with the load; load independence does not imply unlimited compliance.

iLvs=−R2R1R3=−1R4

iLvs=−R2(R1R3)=−1R4（按原图向下的iL参考方向）。iLvs=−R2(R1R3)=−1R4 for the downward iL reference in the source figure.

易错点Common errors

  • 这里有负号；若把输出电流箭头反向，才写成+1R4。Retain the negative sign; reversing the load-current arrow gives +1R4.
  • 电阻失配会留下vL项，实际负载独立性也受运放输出余量限制。Mismatch leaves avL−dependent term; real compliance also limits load independence.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

用独立线性节点求解扫描多组平衡电阻、源电压和负载电阻，逐项回代原反相节点与负载节点KCL；另用复数负载检查同一传输关系。Independent linear nodal solves scan balanced resistor sets, sources and resistive loads, then substitute both original KCL equations; complex loads verify the same transfer.

题目原文Transcribed question

电桥测量电路如图题2.3.11所示。试推导vo与δ的关系式，并说明电路特点。For the bridge measurement circuit in Fig. 2.3.11, derive vo as a function of δ and explain its characteristics.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

电桥顶端接VREF，底端由A1输出vo1驱动；上两臂均R1，下左臂R(1+δ)、下右臂R。左中点A接A1反相端，右中点B接A2反相端，A2以R2反馈；两同相端均接地。Bridge top is VREF and bottom is driven by A1 output vo1. Both upper arms are R1; lower left is R(1+δ) and lower right R. Midpoint A feeds A1 inverting input; B feeds A2 inverting input with R2 feedback. Both noninverting inputs are grounded.

本题图在书第46页／PDF第79页。The source figure is on printed p. 46 · PDF p. 79.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
两个中点都是0V，先从左臂平衡求桥底电压，再用右中点KCL求输出；不需要小δ展开。Both midpoints are held at 0V. Left-arm KCL determines the bridge-bottom voltage; right-arm KCL determines output without a small−δ expansion.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

左中点求驱动电压Find the bridge drive from A

A1输入不取电流，VREF经R1流来的电流全部经R(1+δ)流到vo1。A1 draws no input current, so the current from VREF through R1 flows through R(1+δ) to vo1.

vA=0,VREFR1+vo1R(1+δ)=0⇒vo1=−RR1(1+δ)VREF

右中点求输出Find output from B

B也为0V，R2反馈电流抵消右桥臂失衡电流。B is also at 0V; feedback through R2 cancels the right-arm imbalance current.

VREFR1+vo1R+voR2=0⇒vo=R2R1VREFδ

说明测量特点与边界Interpret the measurement and its limits

δ=0时输出0；在理想电阻和运放模型下对相对电阻变化δ严格线性，灵敏度为VREFR2R1，结果与下臂标称R无关。代价是两运放和足够输出余量；需1+δ>0，匹配误差、偏置和饱和会破坏理想结果。Output is zero at δ=0 and exactly linear in relative resistance change δ in the ideal model. Sensitivity is VREFR2R1, independent of nominal lower-arm R. It requires two op amps and output headroom, with 1+δ>0; mismatch, offsets and clipping cause errors.

vo=(R2R1)VREFδ；理想模型下零点平衡、对δ严格线性、灵敏度可调，且不依赖下臂标称R。vo=(R2R1)VREFδ: balanced zero, exactly linear ideal response, adjustable sensitivity, and independence from nominal lower-arm R.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把桥底端误当地；它是A1的可变输出。The bridge bottom is A1’s driven output, not ground.
  • 这里的线性是反馈电桥的精确理想结果，不是普通无源电桥的小信号近似。Linearity is exact for this ideal feedback bridge, not a small-signal approximation for a passive bridge.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

逐组独立解两中点KCL，扫描δ、VREF及不同R；核查δ=0输出为0和δ反号输出反号，并回代全部支路电流。Independent midpoint-KCL solves scan δ, VREF and R, verifying balanced zero and sign reversal, with branch-current substitution.

先算非零同相偏置，再做输出级功率账Find the nonzero bias before the output-stage power balance

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.3.12所示，设运放的静态电流IQ=1.5mA。（1）当vi=2V时，求输出电压vo、各支路电流和运放的耗散功率；（2）当vi=−2V时，再求输出电压vo、各支路电流和运放的耗散功率。For Fig. 2.3.12 with op-amp quiescent current IQ=1.5mA: (1) find output voltage, all branch currents, and op-amp dissipation for vi=2V; (2) repeat for vi=−2V.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

反相输入经10kΩ接vi、经30kΩ接输出；输出以2kΩ接地。同相输入经10kΩ接地、经140kΩ接−15V。运放供电±15V。Inverting input connects through 10kΩ to vi and 30kΩ to output. Output has a2kΩ load to ground. Noninverting input connects through 10kΩ to ground and 140kΩ to −15V. Supplies are ±15V.

本题图在书第46页／PDF第79页。The source figure is on printed p. 46 · PDF p. 79.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

带偏置的反相电路；源出、吸收输出电流；供电功率减输出功率。Biased inverting circuit; source and sink output current; supply power minus output power.
同相端不是地！10kΩ与140kΩ先分出−1V。输出级的电流还包含反馈电阻电流，不能只算2kΩ负载。The noninverting input is not grounded: the 10kΩ and 140kΩ divider sets −1V. Output current includes the feedback branch as well as the 2kΩ load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先求公共偏置与传输式Find the bias and transfer relation

分压支路电流为15V150kΩ=0.100mA，从地经10kΩ、140kΩ流向−15V。两运放输入电流均0，vn=vp=−1V。Divider current is 0.100mA, from ground through 10kΩ and 140kΩ to −15V. Both input currents are zero and vn=vp=−1V.

vp=−151010+140=−1V,vo=4vp−3vi=−4−3vi

规定电流参考方向Define branch-current references

定义ii从输入源流向反相节点，if从反相节点流向输出，iL从输出流向地，io从运放输出端流向外部电路。Define ii from source to inverting node, if from that node to output, iL from output to ground, and io out of the op amp.

ii=if=vi+110kΩ,iL=vo2kΩ,io=iL−if

（1）vi=+2V：输出吸收电流(1)vi=+2V: sinking output current

输出−10V；ii=if=+0.300mA，iL=−5.000mA，io=−5.300mA。实际负载电流由地流向输出；输出级把5.300mA送到−15V电源，输出级压差5V。Output is −10V; ii=if=+0.300mA, iL=−5.000mA, io=−5.300mA. Load current flows from ground toward output, and the stage sinks 5.300mA to −15V across a5V drop.

PD=30IQ+(15−|vo|)|io|=45mW+5(5.3mA)=71.5mW

（2）vi=−2V：输出提供电流(2)vi=−2V: sourcing output current

输出+2V；ii=if=−0.100mA，iL=+1.000mA，io=+1.100mA。输出向负载供1.000mA、向反馈支路供0.100mA，输出级从+15V取电，压差13V。Output is +2V; ii=if=−0.100mA, iL=+1.000mA, io=+1.100mA. Output supplies 1.000mA to the load and 0.100mA through feedback; its stage drops 13V from the +15V rail.

PD=45mW+13(1.1mA)=59.3mW

按各电源端独立核对Check independently at the supply terminals

（1）运放+轨取1.5mA、−轨吸收6.8mA，供电124.5mW，输出交付53.0mW，差71.5mW。（2）+轨取2.6mA、−轨吸收1.5mA，供电61.5mW，输出交付2.2mW，差59.3mW。偏置分压另耗1.5mW，属于外部电阻，不纳入运放。(1) Op-amp rail currents are 1.5mA from +15V and 6.8mA into −15V: 124.5mW supply minus 53.0mW output equals 71.5mW. (2) They are 2.6mA and 1.5mA: 61.5mW minus 2.2mW equals 59.3mW. The bias divider separately dissipates 1.5mW outside the op amp.

vp=vn=−1V，偏置支路0.100mA，输入端电流0。（1）vo=−10V，输出吸收5.300mA，运放耗散71.5mW；（2）vo=+2V，输出提供1.100mA，运放耗散59.3mW。各支路方向见步骤。vp=vn=−1V, divider current 0.100mA, input-pin currents zero. (1)vo=−10V, sinking 5.300mA, dissipation 71.5mW. (2)vo=+2V, sourcing 1.100mA, dissipation 59.3mW. Branch directions are defined in the steps.

易错点Common errors

  • 将同相端当0V会把两问输出都算错。Treating the noninverting input as 0V gives wrong outputs in both parts.
  • 运放耗散既不是负载功率，也不是总电源功率；需要扣除输出交付功率。Op-amp dissipation is neither load power nor total supply power; subtract delivered output power.
  • 电源总表若包含外部分压器，其负轨还多0.100mA；这不是芯片自身电流。A supply measurement including the external divider adds 0.100mA to the negative rail; it is not chip current.

核验依据Verification

理想运放输入端不取电流、在线性区，供电±15V；IQ=1.5mA为每条电源的静态电流。按教材输出级供电近似：源出电流由+15V供给、吸收电流流入−15V，除IQ外不加其他内部电流。外部电阻耗散不计作运放耗散。Ideal linear op amp, zero input currents, ±15V supplies; IQ=1.5mA is the quiescent current in each supply rail. Use the textbook output-stage approximation: source current comes from +15V and sink current enters −15V, without additional internal current beyond IQ. External resistor loss is not op-amp dissipation.

独立解反相与偏置两节点KCL，核对输出KCL；分别用输出级压降乘电流、各运放供电端输入功率减输出功率两种算法，均得71.5mW和59.3mW；再以含输入源及外部电阻的全电路功率平衡复核。Independent bias and inverting KCL and output KCL. Stage voltage-drop loss and rail-power-minus-output calculations both give 71.5mW and 59.3mW; a whole-circuit balance including the input source and external resistors provides another check.

题目原文Transcribed question

设计一反相加法器，使其输出电压vo=−(7vi1+14vi2+3.5vi3+10vi4)，允许使用的最大电阻值为280kΩ，求各支路的电阻。Design an inverting summer with vo=−(7vi1+14vi2+3.5vi3+10vi4). The largest allowed resistor is 280kΩ. Find the branch resistances.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相加法器与虚地KCL；电阻比设计。Inverting summation and virtual-ground KCL; resistor-ratio design.
系数等于RfRi，题目给的是电阻上限，解不是唯一。选择Rf=280kΩ可得到一组便于核对的输入电阻。Each coefficient is RfRi. A maximum resistance does not make the design unique; Rf=280kΩ gives a convenient valid set.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写通用设计约束Write the design constraints

四个输入各经Ri进入反相节点，Rf从输出反馈，同相端接地。虚地KCL给加权和。Each input reaches the inverting node through Ri; Rf feeds back output, and the noninverting input is grounded. Virtual-ground KCL gives the weighted sum.

vo=−Rf∑k=14vikRk,(R1,R2,R3,R4)=Rf(17,114,13.5,110)

选取一组满足上限的阻值Select a set within the limit

取Rf=280kΩ，各输入电阻如下；全部不大于280kΩ。理想模型下同相端可直接接地，不额外要求偏置补偿电阻。Choose Rf=280kΩ, giving the following input values; all satisfy the limit. The ideal noninverting input may connect directly to ground; no bias-compensation resistor is required.

Rf=280kΩ,R1=40kΩ,R2=20kΩ,R3=80kΩ,R4=28kΩ

逐输入激励核验Check one input at a time

分别只令一个输入为1V，其余接地，输出应为−7、−14、−3.5、−10V；这也是检查输入编号与权重是否交换的快速方法。Set each input to 1V in turn, grounding the others: outputs must be −7, −14, −3.5 and −10V. This quickly detects swapped input weights.

一组解：反馈Rf=280kΩ；输入R1=40kΩ、R2=20kΩ、R3=80kΩ、R4=28kΩ。也可同比缩小整组电阻。One solution: feedback Rf=280kΩ; inputs R1=40kΩ, R2=20kΩ, R3=80kΩ, R4=28kΩ. Uniformly smaller sets also work.

易错点Common errors

  • 权重越大，输入电阻越小，不是越大。A larger coefficient requires a smaller input resistance.
  • 系数关系不保证任意输入下都不饱和；实际输入幅值仍须满足输出范围。Correct ratios do not prevent clipping for arbitrary input levels; signals must fit the output range.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

四个独立单位输入与随机输入向量代入原虚地KCL，核对所有系数和280kΩ上限。Four unit-input checks and random input vectors are substituted into original virtual-ground KCL; all coefficients and the 280kΩ maximum are checked.

图a的输入平均与增益Circuit (a): weighted input and gain

同相节点KCL给两信号的电导加权平均；反相反馈的增益为1+R4R3。Noninverting KCL gives a conductance-weighted average; feedback gain is 1+R4R3.

vp=vi1R1+vi2R21R1+1R2,vo=(1+R4R3)R2vi1+R1vi2R1+R2

图a等值电阻Circuit (a): equal resistors

输入节点是二者平均值，闭环增益2正好抵消除以2。The input is the average, and gain 2 cancels the factor 12.

R1=R2=R3=R4:vo=vi1+vi2

图b为电压跟随器Circuit (b) is a follower

闭环增益1，输出直接等于三路输入的电导加权平均。Unity gain makes output equal to the three-input conductance-weighted average.

vo=vp=vi1R1+vi2R2+vi3R31R1+1R2+1R3;R1=R2=R3:vo=vi1+vi2+vi33

图a：vo=(1+R4R3)(R2vi1+R1vi2)(R1+R2)，等值时为两输入之和。图b：电导加权平均，等值时为三输入之和的13。(a)vo=(1+R4R3)(R2vi1+R1vi2)(R1+R2), giving the sum for equal resistors. (b)A conductance-weighted average, giving one third of the sum for equal resistors.

题目原文Transcribed question

差分放大电路如图2.4.3a所示，已知R4R1=R3R2，差模电压增益Avd=10。（1）若差模输入电阻Rid=20kΩ，且R1=R2，求R1、R2、R3和R4的阻值；（2）vi2=0时，求从vi1输入端看进去的输入电阻Ri1；（3）vi1=0时，求从vi2输入端看进去的输入电阻Ri2。For the differential amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.3(a), R4R1=R3R2 and differential gain Avd=10.(1) With differential input resistance Rid=20kΩ and R1=R2, find all four resistors. (2) With vi2=0, find input resistance seen at vi1. (3) With vi1=0, find input resistance seen at vi2.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

正文图2.4.3：vi1经R1接反相端，反馈R4；vi2经R2接同相端，同相端经R3接地；图b展示浮置差模测试源。Body Fig. 2.4.3: vi1 reaches the inverting node through R1, with R4 feedback. vi2 reaches the noninverting node through R2, with R3 to ground. Part (b) illustrates a floating differential test source.

本题图在书第34页／PDF第67页。The source figure is on printed p. 34 · PDF p. 67.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

求差电路；浮置差模端口；输入测试源法。Differential amplifier; floating differential port; input test-source method.
Rid、Ri1、Ri2是三种不同的测试连接。差模源跨两输入；单端测试则将另一输入接地。Rid, Ri1 and Ri2 correspond to different test connections: a differential source bridges both inputs, whereas single-ended tests ground the other input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

差模电阻与阻值设计Differential resistance and resistor design

浮置差模源的两端电流相等反向；由于vn=vp，源电压只降在R1+R2上。由增益10再定R3、R4。A floating differential source has equal opposite terminal currents. Since vn=vp, source voltage drops across R1+R2. Gain 10 then fixes R3 and R4.

Rid=R1+R2=20kΩ⇒R1=R2=10kΩ,R3=R4=100kΩ

vi2接地时With vi2 grounded

同相端为0V，反相端虚地；输入vi1直接看到R1。The noninverting node and virtual inverting node are at 0V, so vi1 sees R1.

Ri1=vi1vi1R1=R1=10kΩ

vi1接地时With vi1 grounded

同相输入引脚不取电流，vi2的全部输入电流经R2与R3串联到地；运放反馈自动调整反相节点，不会给同相支路增加引脚电流。The noninverting pin draws no current, so all vi2 input current passes through series R2 and R3 to ground. Feedback adjusts the inverting node without drawing current into the noninverting pin.

Ri2=R2+R3=110kΩ

R1=R2=10kΩ，R3=R4=100kΩ；Ri1=10kΩ，Ri2=110kΩ，而浮置差模输入电阻为20kΩ。R1=R2=10kΩ, R3=R4=100kΩ; Ri1=10kΩ, Ri2=110kΩ, while floating differential input resistance is 20kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把Rid直接当作任一单端输入电阻。Do not use Rid as either single-ended input resistance.
  • 本题引用正文图2.4.3，不是同号图题。This exercise refers to the body figure, not a similarly numbered exercise diagram.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

分别搭建浮置两端测试源、vi2短路、vi1短路三组原电路节点方程，以1V测试计算电流；独立得到50μA、100μA及9.090909μA。Three independent nodal tests use a floating differential source, grounded vi2, and grounded vi1. A1V test yields 50μA, 100μA and 9.090909μA respectively.

先读电桥分压，再确定求差极性Read the bridge dividers before assigning subtraction polarity

题目原文Transcribed question

电桥信号放大电路如图题2.4.4所示。（1）试写出vo=f(δ)的表达式（δ=ΔRR）；（2）当vi=7.5V、δ=0.01时，求vA、vB、vAB和vo；（3）说明A1、A2电路的作用。For the bridge signal amplifier in Fig. 2.4.4: (1) derive vo=f(δ), where δ=ΔRR; (2) find vA, vB, vAB and vo for vi=7.5V and δ=0.01; (3) explain the role of A1 and A2.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

电桥左臂上下均R，右上R(1+δ)、右下R，顶端+vi、底端地。A1、A2分别跟随vA、vB。A3反相输入经R1接vo1，反馈R2；同相输入经R1接vo2、经R2接地。Bridge left arms are both R, upper right is R(1+δ), lower right R, with +vi at top and ground at bottom. A1 and A2 buffer vA and vB. A3 has vo1 through R1 to its inverting input and R2 feedback; vo2 reaches its noninverting input through R1, with R2 to ground.

本题图在书第47页／PDF第80页。The source figure is on printed p. 47 · PDF p. 80.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

无负载分压；电压跟随器；匹配差分放大器。Unloaded divider; voltage follower; matched differential amplifier.
A1、A2隔离后，电桥按开路分压求电位。A3放大的是vB−vA，因此vo与按A减B定义的vAB反号。Buffers leave the bridge unloaded. A3 amplifies vB−vA, so output is opposite in sign to vAB defined as vA−vB.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）电桥输出与总传输(1) Bridge signal and total transfer

左中点vA=vi2，右中点vB=vi(2+δ)。按vAB=vA−vB化简，再用求差增益。vA=vi2 and vB=vi(2+δ). Simplify vAB=vA−vB and apply differential gain.

vAB=viδ2(2+δ),vo=−R2R1viδ2(2+δ)

（2）代入给定数值(2) Substitute the specified values

R2R1未给定，输出只能保留增益比，不能擅自设为1。δ=0.01使右中点略低。R2R1 is not specified; retain it rather than silently setting gain to 1.δ=0.01 makes the right midpoint slightly lower.

vA=3.750000V,vB=7.52.01≈3.731343V,vAB≈18.656716mV,vo≈−18.656716R2R1mV

（3）缓冲的作用(3) Role of the buffers

A1、A2为电压跟随器：高输入电阻避免后级电阻网络加载电桥，低输出电阻驱动A3；本身电压增益为1。A3求差并按R2R1放大，电阻比匹配时抑制共模电压。A1 and A2 are unity-gain buffers with high input resistance to avoid bridge loading and low output resistance to drive A3. A3 subtracts and amplifies by R2R1, rejecting common-mode voltage when ratios match.

小变化近似的使用Using the small-change approximation

只有|δ|远小于1时，才可将分母2(2+δ)近似为4。此题近似值18.75mV比精确值高0.5%，数值答案采用精确式。Only for |δ|≪1 may 2(2+δ) be replaced by 4. Here 18.75mV is 0.5% above the exact result, so numerical answers use the exact relation.

|δ|≪1:vo≈−R2R1viδ4

vo=−(R2R1)viδ[2(2+δ)]；给定数值时vA=3.75V、vB≈3.731343V、vAB≈18.656716mV、vo≈−18.656716(R2R1)mV。A1、A2为隔离电桥与求差级的跟随器。vo=−(R2R1)viδ[2(2+δ)]. Numerically vA=3.75V, vB≈3.731343V, vAB≈18.656716mV and vo≈−18.656716(R2R1)mV. A1 and A2 buffer the bridge from the subtractor.

易错点Common errors

  • 右上臂变化，正δ令vB降低；最终输出为负。An increase in the upper-right arm lowers vB; output is negative for positive δ.
  • 输出数值需保留未给定的R2R1。Retain the unspecified R2R1 in the numerical output.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

直接解左右分压节点、两跟随器约束以及A3两输入KCL；扫描δ及增益比并回代精确式，检查δ=0零输出。Direct solves use both divider nodes, follower constraints, and A3 input KCL; scans of δ and gain ratio verify the exact formula and zero output at δ=0.

2.4.5指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第47页／PDF第80页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 47 · PDF p. 80. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2.4.5Assigned requirement: 2.4.5

增益可调求差电路：两个反相节点列KCLAdjustable subtractor: KCL at both inverting nodes

题目原文Transcribed question

增益可调求差电路如图题2.4.5所示，试推导函数关系vo=f(v1,v2)。The adjustable-gain subtractor is shown in Fig. 2.4.5. Derive the relationship vo=f(v1, v2).

A1同相输入v1，A2同相输入v2。两个反相节点之间跨接RG。A1反相节点经R2接地、经R1接A1输出vo1；A2反相节点经R1接vo1、经R2接最终输出vo。A1’s non-inverting input is v1 and A2’s is v2. RG bridges their inverting nodes. A1’s inverting node connects through R2 to ground and R1 to vo1. A2’s inverting node connects through R1 to vo1 and R2 to the final output vo.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想运放虚短、虚断；节点电流法；代数消元。Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; nodal KCL; algebraic elimination.
RG连接两个反相节点，两个运放相互关联。直接把这两个节点电位分别写成v1、v2，再列两条KCL，消去中间输出vo1。RG connects the two inverting nodes, coupling the stages. Set their potentials to v1 and v2, write two KCL equations, and eliminate the intermediate output vo1.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定反相节点电位Set the inverting-node potentials

在理想负反馈下，A1反相节点为v1，A2反相节点为v2。两个输入端均不取电流。With ideal negative feedback, A1’s inverting node is v1 and A2’s is v2. Neither input draws current.

vN1=v1,vN2=v2

A1反相节点列KCLApply KCL at A1’s inverting node

以流出节点为正，把流向地、vo1和v2的三条支路电流相加为零，先解出vo1。Taking currents leaving the node as positive, sum the branches to ground, vo1 and v2. Solve first for vo1.

v1R2+v1−vo1R1+v1−v2RG=0⇒vo1=(1+R1R2)v1+R1RG(v1−v2)

A2反相节点列KCLApply KCL at A2’s inverting node

流向vo1、vo和v1的三条支路电流之和为零，把最终输出写成vo1的函数。Sum the currents toward vo1, vo and v1 to zero, then express the final output in terms of vo1.

v2−vo1R1+v2−voR2+v2−v1RG=0⇒vo=v2+R2R1(v2−vo1)+R2RG(v2−v1)

消去中间输出并整理Eliminate the intermediate output

代入vo1并合并v1、v2的系数，可见两者系数大小相同、符号相反，输出只与差值v2−v1有关。Substitute vo1 and collect the coefficients of v1 and v2. They have equal magnitude and opposite signs, so the output depends only on v2−v1.

vo=(1+R2R1+2R2RG)(v2−v1)

vo=[1+R2R1+2R2RG](v2−v1)。减小RG会提高差模增益；此结论以运放保持线性为前提。vo=[1+R2R1+2R2RG](v2−v1). Decreasing RG increases the differential gain, provided the op amps remain linear.

易错点Common errors

  • RG中电流为(v1−v2)RG，不是v1RG；它不接地。The current in RG is (v1−v2)RG, not v1RG; RG is not grounded.
  • 输出对应v2−v1；若将差分输入定义为v1−v2，增益需带负号。The output is proportional to v2−v1; if the differential input is defined as v1−v2, the gain is negative.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

以符号消元核查两条独立节点方程；v1=v2时输出为0，RG趋于无穷时退化为[1+R2R1](v2−v1)。另取R1=10kΩ、R2=20kΩ、RG=5kΩ、v1=0.1V、v2=0.2V，独立解节点方程得vo1=−0.05V、vo=1.1V，代回两式残差为0。Checked by symbolic elimination of the two independent nodal equations. Equal inputs give zero output, and RG→∞ gives [1+R2R1](v2−v1). With R1=10kΩ, R2=20kΩ, RG=5kΩ, v1=0.1V and v2=0.2V, an independent nodal solve gives vo1=−0.05V and vo=1.1V, with zero residuals.
