两级反馈先求驱动电阻上的压差Use both feedback constraints to find the drive-resistor voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

图题2.4.6所示电路可将电压vid转换为电流io，驱动负载ZL，且io与ZL无关。试求io与vid的函数关系。原图定义vid=v1−v2，io由负载上端向下流向地。The circuit in Fig. 2.4.6 converts vid to current io to drive ZL independently of the load. Derive io(vid). The figure defines vid=v1−v2 and io downward through the load to ground.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

A1反相端以两个相等R1接v1及v3；同相端以两个相等R1接v2及v4。A2跟随负载电压vo，故v4=vo。A1输出v3经R接负载上端vo，ZL由vo接地，io向下。A1 inverting node connects through equal R1 to v1 and v3; its noninverting node connects through equal R1 to v2 and v4. A2 follows load voltage vo, so v4=vo. A1 output v3 drives load node vo through R; ZL runs to ground with downward io.

本题图在书第47页／PDF第80页。The source figure is on printed p. 47 · PDF p. 80.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
先由A2得到v4=vo，再用A1两输入电位相等消去中点；需要的是v3−vo，不必先求负载电压。First use A2 to set v4=vo, then equate A1 input-node voltages. The needed quantity is v3−vo, not load voltage itself.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

跟随器和等阻分压Follower and equal-resistor averages

两输入节点均无引脚电流；同相和反相中点分别是对应两个端点的平均值。Zero pin currents make each midpoint the average of its two connected endpoint voltages.

v4=vo,vn1=v1+v32,vp1=v2+vo2

由虚短求R两端压差Find the voltage across R

vn1=vp1，整理出v3−vo=v2−v1=−vid。Equating input nodes gives v3−vo=v2−v1=−vid.

v1+v3=v2+vo⇒v3−vo=−vid

负载节点KCLLoad-node KCL

A2同相端不取电流，因此R的电流全部流入负载，按向下参考方向得到负跨导。A2 noninverting input draws no current, so all R current reaches the load. Its downward reference gives negative transconductance.

io=v3−voR=−vidR

说明负载独立的前提Explain compliance limits

R1只需四只相等以抵消中点关系，跨导由R设定。对有限ZL，vo=ZLio、v3=vo−vid；实际两个输出都须在允许范围，不能据理想式认为能驱动任意开路负载。The four R1 values must match; R sets transconductance. For finite ZL, vo=ZLio and v3=vo−vid. Both actual outputs must remain in range; the ideal relation does not give unlimited open-circuit compliance.

io=−vidR=−(v1−v2)R，按题图向下参考方向；与ZL及匹配的R1数值无关。io=−vidR=−(v1−v2)R for the downward reference; it is independent of ZL and the common R1 value.

易错点Common errors

  • 符号由vid正负端和io箭头共同决定，不能只套“电压除电阻”。The sign follows both the input polarity and load-current arrow.
  • A2输出不直接接负载；它通过R1网络提供电压反馈。A2 output is not connected directly to the load; it returns voltage feedback through R1.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

独立列两输入中点KCL、A2跟随条件和负载KCL，扫描源电压、匹配R1和负载（含复阻抗），得到同一负跨导。Independent midpoint KCL, follower constraint and load KCL are solved for multiple inputs, matched R1 values and loads, including complex impedances; all give the same negative transconductance.

先求同相权重，再汇总正负输入Find noninverting weights before combining all inputs

题目原文Transcribed question

加减运算电路如图题2.4.7所示，求输出电压vo的表达式。图中R1=40kΩ、R2=25kΩ、R3=10kΩ、R4=20kΩ、R5=30kΩ、R6=50kΩ。Find vo for the adding and subtracting circuit in Fig. 2.4.7, with R1=40kΩ, R2=25kΩ, R3=10kΩ, R4=20kΩ, R5=30kΩ and R6=50kΩ.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

vi1、vi2经R1、R2接反相端，R6反馈。vi3、vi4经R3、R4接同相端，同相端经R5接地。vi1 and vi2 enter the inverting node through R1 and R2, with R6 feedback. vi3 and vi4 enter the noninverting node through R3 and R4, with R5 to ground.

本题图在书第47页／PDF第80页。The source figure is on printed p. 47 · PDF p. 80.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.
同相端还有R5接地，所以加权平均的分母必须包括1R5；反相输入的存在也增加同相通路的闭环增益。Ground resistor R5 belongs in the noninverting conductance denominator. The inverting source resistors also contribute to gain from the noninverting node.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

同相节点电导加权Noninverting conductance weighting

把接地支路视为0V输入，所有电导都进入分母。Treat the grounded branch as a0V input; include every conductance in the denominator.

vp=vi310+vi420110+120+130=611vi3+311vi4

反相节点KCLInverting-node KCL

vn=vp；先保留vp再解vo，可避免遗漏增益里的1。Use vn=vp and solve for vo before substituting vp, retaining the unity term.

vo=(1+R6R1+R6R2)vp−R6R1vi1−R6R2vi2=174vp−54vi1−2vi2

合并四个输入系数Collect the four coefficients

代入同相权重并逐路核对正负号。Substitute the noninverting weights and check each input sign.

vo=−54vi1−2vi2+5122vi3+5144vi4

vo=−1.25vi1−2vi2+(5122)vi3+(5144)vi4，后两系数约2.318182、1.159091。vo=−1.25vi1−2vi2+(5122)vi3+(5144)vi4; the last two coefficients are approximately 2.318182 and 1.159091.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能忽略R5，也不能将两个同相输入各直接乘1+R6R1。Do not omit R5 or give each positive input the gain 1+R6R1.
  • 第一步以kΩ为统一单位，分子分母的电导单位相消。The first equation consistently uses kΩ; conductance units cancel.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

使用与推导不同的二节点线性矩阵求解，对四个单位输入和200组随机输入检查两节点KCL及最终系数。An independent two-node matrix solve checks both KCL equations and the final coefficients for four unit inputs and 200 random input vectors.

端点先精确设计，标称器件再核对覆盖范围Design exact endpoints, then check coverage with nominal parts

题目原文Transcribed question

仪用放大器电路如图2.4.5所示，设电路中R4=R3，R1为固定电阻R1′=1kΩ和电位器RP串联，若要求差模电压增益在5～400之间可调，求R2和RP的阻值，并选取R2、R3、R4和RP的标称阻值，要求电路中每个电阻值必须小于250kΩ。For the instrumentation amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.5, set R4=R3 and let R1 be fixed R1′=1kΩ in series with potentiometer RP. Find R2 and RP for adjustable differential gain magnitude 5–400, then choose nominal R2, R3, R4 and RP values, each below 250kΩ.

整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

正文图2.4.5是三运放仪用放大器：A1、A2同相输入v1、v2，反馈各R2，两个反相端之间R1；A3用匹配R3R4求差。此图不同于图题2.4.5的双运放电路。Body Fig. 2.4.5 is a three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier: A1 and A2 take v1 and v2 at noninverting inputs, each with R2 feedback and R1 between inverting nodes; A3 subtracts with matched R3 and R4. It differs from the two-op-amp exercise Fig. 2.4.5.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第69页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 69.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

三运放仪用放大器；端点设计；标称阻值与实际调节范围。Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier; endpoint design; nominal values and adjustment coverage.
增益大小在电位器阻值最小时最大。先按两个精确端点解R2和电位器最大有效电阻，再选标称值并重新验算，不能把四舍五入后的端点称为精确。Gain magnitude is largest at minimum potentiometer resistance. Solve exact endpoint values first, then select nominal parts and recompute the range; rounded endpoints are not exact.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用第一级KCL得增益Gain from first-stage KCL

正文图定义的输出对v1−v2为反相，教材的5～400指差模增益的大小。R4=R3使末级增益大小为1。The body figure inverts v1−v2, so the requested 5–400 is a gain magnitude. With R4=R3 the final stage has unity magnitude.

v3=v1+R2R1(v1−v2),v4=v2+R2R1(v2−v1),vo=−(v3−v4);|Avd|=1+2R21kΩ+rP

最大增益400定R2Set R2 using maximum gain 400

电位器有效阻值rP=0时最大；将1+2R21kΩ设为400。Maximum gain occurs at rP=0; set 1+2R21kΩ to 400.

R2=400−12(1kΩ)=199.5kΩ

最小增益5定最大电位器阻值Set the potentiometer maximum using gain 5

将1+399kΩ(1kΩ+RP)设为5。R3=R4可任取满足限制的匹配正电阻。Set 1+399kΩ(1kΩ+RP) to 5. Choose any matched positive R3=R4 satisfying the limit.

RP=399kΩ5−1−1kΩ=98.75kΩ

给一组常见标称阻值并验算Choose convenient nominal values and recheck

取R2=200kΩ、R3=R4=100kΩ、电位器RP=100kΩ，固定R1′仍1kΩ。理想标称增益范围约4.960396～401，覆盖5～400；要恰好输出400和5，电位器分别调到约2.506266Ω和99kΩ。若要求全行程端点恰为5与400，需按199.5kΩ和98.75kΩ校准或限位，不能直接声称标称组精确达到端点。Choose R2=200kΩ, matched R3=R4=100kΩ and a100kΩ pot, keeping fixed R1′=1kΩ. Nominal ideal gain spans about 4.960396–401, covering 5–400. Gains 400 and 5 occur at pot settings about 2.506266Ω and 99kΩ. Exact full-travel endpoints require calibrated 199.5kΩ and 98.75kΩ values or travel limits; the nominal set does not have exact endpoints.

Gmin=1+400101≈4.960396,Gmax=401,rP(G)=400kΩG−1−1kΩ

器件限制与误差Component limits and tolerance

单只R2=200kΩ、R3=R4=100kΩ、电位器100kΩ均小于250kΩ，R1总阻值也最多101kΩ。未给器件公差，标称覆盖不等于任意公差下保证；实作需测量调校并保持差分级电阻比匹配。Each 200kΩ, 100kΩ, 100kΩ and 100kΩ component is below 250kΩ, and total R1 is at most 101kΩ. Without tolerances, nominal coverage is not a worst-case guarantee; measure and calibrate actual parts and maintain final-stage ratio matching.

精确端点设计：R2=199.5kΩ、RP最大有效值98.75kΩ。标称可取R2=200kΩ、R3=R4=100kΩ、RP=100kΩ，理想可调范围约4.9604～401，覆盖目标5～400，需调校端点。Exact endpoint design: R2=199.5kΩ, maximum effective RP=98.75kΩ. A nominal set is R2=200kΩ, R3=R4=100kΩ, RP=100kΩ, giving approximately 4.9604–401 and covering 5–400 with endpoint calibration.

易错点Common errors

  • 引用的是正文图2.4.5三运放结构，不是图题2.4.5。Use the three-op-amp body figure, not exercise Fig. 2.4.5.
  • 增益与电位器电阻反向变化；最大增益发生在rP=0。Gain decreases with pot resistance; maximum gain is at rP=0.
  • 200kΩ100kΩ标称组合覆盖目标，却不是精确5～400的全行程。The 200kΩ and 100kΩ nominal set covers the target but does not have exact 5–400 full-travel endpoints.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

按原三运放图独立解四条KCL和虚短约束，检查两个精确端点、标称端点及5和400的电位器反解；所有元件上限逐项比较。Independent original-circuit KCL and equal-input constraints verify exact endpoints, nominal endpoints and inverse pot settings for gains 5400; every component is checked against the limit.

2.4.9指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第47页／PDF第80页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 47 · PDF p. 80. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2.4.9Assigned requirement: 2.4.9

INA128：先区分共模电压与两端信号极性INA128: separate common-mode voltage and signal polarity

题目原文Transcribed question

INA128型仪用放大器电路如图题2.4.9所示，其中R1是外接电阻。（1）它的输入干扰电压VC=1V（直流），输入信号vi1=vi2=0.04sinωtV，当R1=1kΩ时，求出v3、v4、v3−v4和vo的电压值；（2）当输入信号vi1=vi2=0.01sinωtV，要求vo=−6sinωtV，求此时外接电阻R1的阻值。The INA128 instrumentation amplifier is shown in Fig. 2.4.9, where R1 is an external resistor. (1) Its input interference voltage is VC=1V DC and its input signals are vi1=vi2=0.04sin(ωt)V. With R1=1kΩ, find v3, v4, v3−v4 and vo. (2) For vi1=vi2=0.01sin(ωt)V, require vo=−6sin(ωt)V. Find the required external resistance R1.

共模源VC=1V接在两信号源中点：上端v1=VC+vi1，下端v2=VC−vi2。前级两个反相节点之间是外接R1，每级反馈R2=25kΩ。后级匹配差分电路四个电阻均40kΩ，上端v3进反相支路、下端v4进同相支路，故vo=v4−v3。The 1V common-mode source connects to the midpoint of the signal sources: v1=VC+vi1 and v2=VC−vi2. External R1 bridges the first-stage inverting nodes; each feedback R2 is 25kΩ. The final matched difference amplifier uses four 40kΩ resistors, with v3 entering its inverting branch and v4 its non-inverting branch, so vo=v4−v3.

本题图在书第48页／PDF第81页。The source figure is on printed p. 48 · PDF p. 81.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

共模与差模；仪用放大器前级节点分析；匹配差分放大器。Common-mode and differential-mode signals; first-stage instrumentation-amplifier nodal analysis; matched difference amplifier.
必须按图中两信号源的正负端先写v1、v2。虽然vi1=vi2，上下输入节点并不相等；它们对共模中点的方向相反。先求前级两输出，再作后级相减。First write v1 and v2 from the source polarities. Although vi1=vi2, the two input-node voltages differ because the signals face opposite directions relative to the common-mode midpoint. Find the first-stage outputs, then apply the final subtraction.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从电压源极性写实际输入Write actual inputs from source polarities

图中上信号源上正下负，下信号源也上正下负，而VC接它们的中点。因此v1=VC+vi1，v2=VC−vi2。第（1）问差模输入为0.08sinωtV。Both signal sources have their positive terminal at the top, while VC connects to their midpoint. Thus v1=VC+vi1 and v2=VC−vi2. In part (1), the differential input is 0.08sin(ωt)V.

v1=1+0.04sinωt,v2=1−0.04sinωt,v1−v2=0.08sinωtV

列前级两个节点方程Write the two first-stage node equations

由虚短，反相节点A、B分别等于v1、v2。令R2=25kΩ，在两节点列KCL，解得v3、v4；相减得前级差模增益1+2R2R1。The virtual short gives node A=v1 and node B=v2. With R2=25kΩ, KCL gives v3 and v4; their difference has gain 1+2R2R1.

v3=v1+R2R1(v1−v2),v4=v2−R2R1(v1−v2),v3−v4=(1+2R2R1)(v1−v2)

第（1）问代入R1=1kΩPart (1): substitute R1=1kΩ

R2R1=25，故前级输出仍包含共同的1V直流分量，交流分量大小为2.04V且符号相反。R2R1=25. Both first-stage outputs retain the same 1V DC component, while their AC components have opposite signs and amplitude 2.04V.

v3=1+2.04sinωtV,v4=1−2.04sinωtV,v3−v4=4.08sinωtV

后级相减消除共模The final subtraction removes common mode

后级电阻比为1。v3进入反相支路、v4进入同相支路，所以vo=v4−v3，输出的1V直流分量消除。The final stage has matched resistor ratios of 1. Because v3 enters the inverting branch and v4 the non-inverting branch, vo=v4−v3, cancelling the 1V DC component.

vo=v4−v3=−4.08sinωtV

第（2）问先算所需差模增益Part (2): find the required differential gain

两信号源幅值都为0.01V，实际差模幅值为0.02V。要得到6V输出幅值，需要前级差模增益300。由1+50kΩR1=300解外接电阻。Each signal-source amplitude is 0.01V, so the actual differential amplitude is 0.02V. A6V output amplitude requires differential gain 300. Solve 1+50kΩR1=300 for the external resistor.

(1+50kΩR1)0.02=6⇒R1=50kΩ299≈167.224Ω

（1）v3=1+2.04sinωtV，v4=1-2.04sinωtV，v3−v4=4.08sinωtV，vo=−4.08sinωtV。（2）R1=50kΩ299≈167.22Ω。(1)v3=1+2.04sin(ωt)V, v4=1−2.04sin(ωt)V, v3−v4=4.08sin(ωt)V, and vo=−4.08sin(ωt)V. (2)R1=50kΩ299≈167.22Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • vi1=vi2不代表v1=v2；必须看两个电压源相对中点的极性。vi1=vi2 does not mean v1=v2; inspect each source polarity relative to the midpoint.
  • 求外接电阻时保留增益公式中的1，不能以50kΩ300替代精确结果。Retain the 1 in the gain equation; 50kΩ300 is not the exact required resistance.
  • 题干在第47页，电路在第48页，需合并阅读。The statement is on printed p. 47 and the figure on p. 48; read them together.

核验依据Verification

按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

按图中25kΩ、40kΩ和源极性重新推导。正弦峰值处，A=1.04V、B=0.96V，跨R1电流80μA；两25kΩ压降均2V，得v3=3.04V、v4=−1.04V。后级非反相节点v42=−0.52V，反相节点KCL得vo=−4.08V。第二问代回167.2240802676Ω得差模增益300、输出幅值6V。Re−derived from the actual 25kΩ and 40kΩ resistors and source polarities. At the positive sine peak, A=1.04V and B=0.96V, giving 80μA through R1; each 25kΩ feedback resistor drops 2V, so v3=3.04V and v4=−1.04V. The final non-inverting node is v42=−0.52V, and KCL at the inverting node gives vo=−4.08V. Substituting 167.2240802676Ω in part (2) gives gain 300 and output amplitude 6V.

电阻失配：先写一般求差式，再找最坏角点Resistor mismatch: derive the general subtractor before testing corners

题目原文Transcribed question

在图2.4.5所示的仪用放大器中，已知R1=2kΩ，R2=50kΩ，R3=30kΩ，R4=90kΩ。（1）求差模电压增益Avd；（2）如果R3有±5%的误差，求最大共模电压增益|Avc|和共模抑制比KCMR。In the instrumentation amplifier of body Fig. 2.4.5, R1=2kΩ, R2=50kΩ, R3=30kΩ and R4=90kΩ. (1) Find differential gain Avd. (2) If R3 has ±5% tolerance, find maximum common-mode gain magnitude and CMRR.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

引用正文图2.4.5三运放仪用放大器：首级反馈各R2，反相端之间R1；末级两输入串联电阻各标R3，反馈及同相接地电阻各R4。Uses the three-op-amp body Fig. 2.4.5: first-stage feedback R2 and a shared R1; final-stage input resistors are both R3, with R4 feedback and R4 from the noninverting node to ground.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第69页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 69.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.
“R3有±5%误差”必须说明两只R3的关系。主结果按两只独立取±5%且其他电阻精确；共同等比例偏移不会引入电阻失配共模增益。Specify how the two R3 errors relate. The main result uses independent ±5% tolerances with other resistors exact; identical tracking errors create no resistor-mismatch common-mode gain.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）标称差模增益(1) Nominal differential gain

以vid=v1−v2为差模输入，首级差值放大51倍，末级反相3倍。若把差模输入定义反向，增益符号也反向。For vid=v1−v2, the first stage multiplies the difference by 51 and the final stage inverts with magnitude 3. Reversing the differential-input definition reverses the gain sign.

Avd=−R4R3(1+2R2R1)=−3(51)=−153

不匹配末级的一般表达式General expression for the mismatched last stage

记反相输入串联电阻为ra，同相输入串联电阻为rb，F=90kΩ。节点KCL给vo=bv4−av3；共同输入下首级两个输出均等于vc。Let ra be the inverting input resistor, rb the noninverting input resistor and F=90kΩ. Nodal KCL gives vo=bv4−av3; equal common-mode inputs make both first-stage outputs vc.

a=Fra,b=(1+Fra)Frb+F,Avc=b−a=F(ra−rb)ra(rb+F)

两只独立误差的最坏共模角点Worst common-mode corner for independent errors

ra、rb各在28.5～31.5kΩ。|Avc|最大在ra=28.5、rb=31.5kΩ；反向角点略小。Each resistor lies in 28.5–31.5kΩ. Maximum |Avc| occurs at ra=28.5 and rb=31.5kΩ; the opposite corner is slightly smaller.

|Avc|max=90(31.5−28.5)28.5(31.5+90)≈0.07797271

用同一实际电路的差模增益求CMRRUse differential and common-mode gains of the same actual circuit

对称差模输入v1=+vid2、v2=−vid2，实际Avd=−(512)(a+b)。比值简化后，两只误差独立时最坏CMRR在两个反向角点，均为2040。不要用一个电路的标称差模增益与另一个电路的实际共模增益混成“精确CMRR”。For symmetric differential excitation v1=+vid2 and v2=−vid2, actual Avd=−(512)(a+b). The ratio simplifies; its worst value is 2040 at either opposite corner. A nominal differential gain divided by another circuit’s actual common-mode gain is not an exact CMRR.

KCMR=|AvdAvc|=512ra+rb+2F|ra−rb|,Kmin=2040≈66.19dB

说明其他误差解释与常用估算Other interpretations and the nominal-gain estimate

若沿用标称|Avd|=153估算，1530.07797271≈1962.225，约65.85dB，应注明是标称增益估算。若只有一只R3偏差、另一只精确，最坏|Avc|≈0.03947368，实际最坏CMRR=4054.5（72.16dB）。若两只R3同幅同向变化，则Avc=0，理想电阻模型CMRR无限；真实运放本身有限CMRR未由本题给出。Using nominal |Avd|=153 gives the explicitly nominal estimate 1962.225, about 65.85dB. If only one R3 varies and the other is exact, worst |Avc|≈0.03947368 and worst actual CMRR=4054.5(72.16dB). Identical tracking gives Avc=0 and infinite ideal resistor-model CMRR; real op-amp CMRR is not specified.

（1）Avd=−153（按v1−v2定义）。（2）两只R3独立±5%时，最大|Avc|≈0.07797271，实际最坏KCMR=2040≈66.19dB；用标称差模增益估算则约1962.225≈65.85dB。误差共同跟踪或仅一只误差的结果另见步骤。(1)Avd=−153 for v1−v2. (2) Independent ±5% errors give maximum |Avc|≈0.07797271 and worst actual CMRR=2040≈66.19dB. A nominal-differential-gain estimate is 1962.225≈65.85dB. Tracking and single-resistor cases are explained separately.

易错点Common errors

  • 两只同标号电阻不代表误差一定同向或完全一致。Two resistors sharing a label need not have tracking errors.
  • CMRR必须说明用实际还是标称差模增益。State whether CMRR uses actual or nominal differential gain.

核验依据Verification

理想线性运放；主结果为两只R3独立±5%，其余电阻精确；差模定义v1−v2，实际增益以对称差模激励测量。Ideal linear op amps; main result uses independent ±5% errors in both R3 values with other resistors exact; differential input is v1−v2 with symmetric excitation for actual gain.

独立原三运放节点矩阵分别施加共同和对称差模输入，扫描两个误差的二维网格及四角点；核对同向误差Avc=0、单只误差和同电路增益比。Independent original three-op-amp matrices are excited with common and symmetric differential inputs over a two-dimensional error grid and corners, checking tracking, single-resistor and same-circuit gain ratios.

2.4.11全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第48页／PDF第81页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 48 · PDF p. 81. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

先定抑制比，再用输出余量限制反馈增益Set suppression first, then limit feedback gain by output headroom

题目原文Transcribed question

在图2.4.6所示的心电信号放大电路中，设R12=1kΩ，Rsi=120kΩ，vcm的最大幅值为20V，所有运放的电源电压为±15V，A5的输出饱和压降为1V。（1）求心电信号的增益；（2）若要求加到INA128输入端的共模电压是vcm的1800，求R7的最大值和K的值。For the ECG amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.6, R12=1kΩ, Rsi=120kΩ, maximum vcm amplitude is 20V, all op-amp supplies are ±15V, and A5 output saturates 1V from either rail. (1) Find ECG differential gain. (2) To reduce common-mode input at INA128 to vcm800, find maximum R7 and gain K.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

正文图2.4.6：INA128的增益电阻R1分为两个R12，中心提取共模vic；A4跟随vic；A5以R6R5=K反相输出voc，经过R7返回共模节点；干扰vcm经Rsi到该节点。Body Fig. 2.4.6: INA128 gain resistor R1 is split into two R12 halves to sense vic. A4 buffers it; A5 inverts with K=R6R5 to produce voc, returned through R7. Interference vcm reaches the common-mode node through Rsi.

本题图在书第37页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 37 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.
R1是两个1kΩ串联的总值2kΩ。共模环路先由KCL给抑制比，再用A5的14V输出边界确定最大允许K。R1 is the total of two 1kΩ halves, hence 2kΩ. Common-mode KCL sets suppression, then A5’s14V output boundary sets the largest K.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）差模信号增益(1) Differential signal gain

教材图2.4.6与式2.4.15给INA128的增益大小1+50kΩR1；按vla−vra定义为负。共模提取点在对称差模下为0，不改变该差模增益。Body Fig. 2.4.6 and Eq. 2.4.15 give gain magnitude 1+50kΩR1; it is negative for vla−vra. The common-mode sensing point is zero under symmetric differential excitation, leaving differential gain unchanged.

Av=−(1+50kΩ2kΩ)=−26

（2）建立准确的共模方程(2) Establish exact common-mode equations

同相输入不取电流，A4输出vic，A5输出voc=−Kvic。对干扰、返回节点列KCL。Inputs draw no current. A4 outputs vic and A5 outputs −Kvic. Apply KCL at the interference and return node.

vcm−vicRsi=vic−vocR7,voc=−Kvic⇒vicvcm=11+(RsiR7)(1+K)

用1800和14V输出限制求边界Use 1800 and the 14V output limit

最大共模输入变为20800=0.025V；|voc|=0.025K≤14，故K≤560。保持800倍抑制需R7=Rsi(1+K)799，随K增大，因此最大值出现在K=560。Peak residual input is 20800=0.025V. Thus |voc|=0.025K≤14 gives K≤560. Suppression 800 requires R7=Rsi(1+K)799, increasing with K, so the limiting maximum occurs at K=560.

K=560,R7,max=120kΩ561799≈84.255319kΩ

区分近似结果与实作余量Distinguish approximation and headroom

若采用正文K远大于1+R7Rsi的近似，则R7≈14×120kΩ20=84kΩ，K≈560。精确边界84.255kΩ保留了1+K及分母799；要保证严格在线性区，R7、K应略小于此边界，并重新检查元件误差。The body’s large−K approximation gives R7≈14×120kΩ20=84kΩ and K≈560. Exact limiting values retain 1+K and denominator 799. Strict linear headroom requires slightly smaller R7K and a tolerance check.

（1）按vla−vra定义，增益−26，大小26。（2）精确饱和边界K=560，R7最大约84.2553kΩ；教材大增益近似为R7≈84kΩ。实际线性设计需留输出余量。(1) Gain is −26 for vla−vra, magnitude 26. (2) Exact saturation boundary: K=560 and maximum R7≈84.2553kΩ; large-gain approximation gives about 84kΩ. A linear implementation needs headroom.

易错点Common errors

  • R12=1kΩ不是R1=1kΩ。R12=1kΩ means R1=2kΩ.
  • A5可用输出峰值为14V，而非15V。A5 available peak output is 14V, not 15V.

核验依据Verification

教材理想共模等效电路，忽略人体阻抗和输入偏置；K=R6R5；A5输出边界±14V。仅为题设电路分析，非实际设备性能保证。Textbook ideal common-mode equivalent circuit, neglecting body impedance and input bias; K=R6R5 and A5 output boundary ±14V. This analyzes the specified model and does not guarantee actual device performance.

核读正文37～38页的图2.4.6与式2.4.15、2.4.18～20；独立解共模节点与A5虚地KCL，回代20V输入得vic=25mV、voc=−14V，两端返回电流均166.458333μA。Read body pp. 37–38, Fig. 2.4.6 and Eqs. 2.4.15, 2.4.18–20. Independent common-node and A5 KCL give vic=25mV and voc=−14V at 20V input, with matching return and source currents 166.458333μA.

题目原文Transcribed question

图题2.4.12所示为一增益线性调节运放电路，试推导该电路的电压增益表达式Av=vo(vi1−vi2)。For the linearly adjustable-gain circuit in Fig. 2.4.12, derive Av=vo(vi1−vi2).

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

A1、A2跟随两个输入。A3反相端经R1接vo1、经R2接地；同相端经R1接vo2、经R2接A4输出vo4。A4同相端接地，反相端经R3接其输出、经可调R4接最终vo。A1 and A2 buffer both inputs. A3 inverting node connects through R1 to vo1 and R2 to ground; its noninverting node connects through R1 to vo2 and R2 to A4 output vo4. A4 noninverting input is grounded; its inverting node has R3 feedback and adjustable R4 to final vo.

本题图在书第48页／PDF第81页。The source figure is on printed p. 48 · PDF p. 81.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.
A3没有直接的普通反相反馈电阻；反馈经A4反相后进入A3同相端，整体仍是负反馈。先分别写两个中点与A4虚地。A3 does not use an ordinary direct inverting feedback resistor. Its feedback is inverted by A4 before reaching A3’s noninverting input, making the total loop negative. Write midpoint and A4 virtual-ground constraints.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

输入缓冲和A3反相分压Input buffers and A3 inverting divider

A1、A2电压增益1；A3反相端分压为R2(R1+R2)倍vi1，其同相端电位相等。A1 and A2 have unity gain. A3 inverting input divides vi1 by R2(R1+R2); its noninverting input has the same potential.

vo1=vi1,vo2=vi2,vn3=vp3=R2R1+R2vi1

A3同相节点KCLA3 noninverting-node KCL

该节点从两个源接入，解出辅助输出vo4。The node connects to two sources; solve its KCL for auxiliary output vo4.

vp3−vi2R1+vp3−vo4R2=0⇒vo4=R2R1(vi1−vi2)

A4反相关系给最终增益A4 inversion gives the final gain

A4的输入电阻是可调R4、反馈是R3。由vo4=−(R3R4)vo解vo，结果随R4线性变化。For A4, the input resistor is adjustable R4 and feedback is R3. Invert vo4=−(R3R4)vo to obtain an output gain linear in R4.

voR4+vo4R3=0⇒Av=−R2R4R1R3

Av=−R2R4(R1R3)，电压增益随可调R4线性变化；前提是各运放未饱和、环路稳定。Av=−R2R4(R1R3), linear in adjustable R4, provided all amplifiers remain linear and the loop is stable.

易错点Common errors

  • R4是A4输入电阻，R3才是A4反馈电阻。R4 is A4’s input resistor; R3 is its feedback resistor.
  • A3同相端不是地，不能套标准反相式。A3 noninverting input is not grounded; do not use a standard inverter formula.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻、电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立构造四个未知量vn3、vp3、vo4、vo的原节点矩阵，扫描输入及正电阻，检查虚短、两个输入节点和A4虚地KCL。An independent original-node matrix for vn3, vp3, vo4 and vo scans inputs and positive resistors, checking equal-input and original KCL constraints.

（1）1V阶跃(1)A1V step

RC=100kΩ×2μF=0.2s，输出从0以−5Vs下降。RC=100kΩ×2μF=0.2s, so output starts at zero and falls at −5Vs.

vo(t)=−1RC∫0tvi(τ)dτ=−5tV(t in s),vo(1s)=−5V

（2）首脉冲面积(2) First pulse area

新的RC=0.047s=47ms。0～60ms斜率−647Vms，60ms时到达−36047≈−7.659574V。New RC is 0.047s=47ms. From 0 to 60ms, slope is −647Vms, reaching −36047≈−7.659574V.

vo(60ms)=−66047=−36047V

（2）负脉冲和完整分段式(2) Negative pulse and full piecewise result

vo={−647tms,0≤tms≤60647(tms−120),60<tms≤1200,tms>120V

本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。Input and output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

  • 第二问将C改为0.47μF，不要仍用2μF。Part (2) changes C to 0.47μF.
  • 时间刻度是ms，必须与RC单位一致。Time is in ms; match units to RC.

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.4.14所示，设电容的初始电压vC(0)=0。（1）写出vo与vi1、vi2和vi3之间的关系式；（2）当电阻满足R1=R2=R3=R4=R5=R6=R时，写出输出电压vo的表达式。For Fig. 2.4.14 with capacitor initial voltage vC(0)=0: (1) relate vo to vi1, vi2 and vi3; (2) specialize to all six resistors equal to R.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

A1：vi1经R1接反相端、R4反馈；vi2经R2接同相端、R3接地。A2：vo1经R5、vi3经R6接反相虚地，C反馈，同相端接地。A1: vi1 enters through R1, with R4 feedback; vi2 reaches the noninverting node through R2 with R3 to ground. A2 sums vo1 through R5 and vi3 through R6 at virtual ground, with C feedback and grounded noninverting input.

本题图在书第49页／PDF第82页。The source figure is on printed p. 49 · PDF p. 82.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.
A2是反相加法积分器，所以A1产生的正负号还要整体反相一次。A2 is an inverting summing integrator, so the signs from A1 are inverted again.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

A1通用求差式General A1 subtractor relation

先分压求同相电位，再列反相节点KCL。First divide for the noninverting voltage, then apply inverting-node KCL.

vo1=(1+R4R1)R3R2+R3vi2−R4R1vi1

A2电容KCL并积分A2 capacitor KCL and integration

零初始电容电压给vo(0)=0。输出导数等于两个输入支路电流之和的−1C倍。Zero initial capacitor voltage gives vo(0)=0. Output derivative is −1C times the sum of the input branch currents.

vo(t)=1C∫0t[R4R1R5vi1(τ)−(1+R4R1)R3(R2+R3)R5vi2(τ)−vi3(τ)R6]dτ

等值电阻化简Equal-resistor simplification

A1输出vi2−vi1，积分级再反相，把符号整理为vi1−vi2−vi3。A1 gives vi2−vi1; integration inverts again to produce vi1−vi2−vi3.

vo(t)=1RC∫0t[vi1(τ)−vi2(τ)−vi3(τ)]dτ

一般式见步骤；六电阻相等时，vo=(1RC)∫0t(vi1−vi2−vi3)dτ，vo(0)=0。Use the general expression above. For equal resistors, vo=(1RC)∫0t(vi1−vi2−vi3)dτ with vo(0)=0.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把A1的输入正负号直接当最终输出符号。Do not copy A1’s signs directly to the final output.
  • 非等值时同相输入系数需保留分压和闭环增益。For unequal values, retain both the divider and feedback factors.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻、电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

随机正电阻与输入独立解A1节点KCL，再用A2虚地电容KCL求导数，与一般积分式的被积函数一致；等值时逐路单位输入检查+1、−1、−1。Independent A1 node solves with random positive resistors and inputs followed by A2 capacitor KCL match the general integrand; equal-resistor unit inputs verify +1, −1 and −1 signs.

题目原文Transcribed question

差分式积分运算电路如图题2.4.15所示，设两电容器上的初始电压为零，且C1=C2=C，R1=R2=R。（1）当vi1=0时，推导vo与vi2的关系；（2）当vi2=0时，推导vo与vi1的关系；（3）求vo与vi1、vi2的关系式。For the differential integrator in Fig. 2.4.15, both capacitors initially have zero voltage, C1=C2=C and R1=R2=R. (1) Derive the response to vi2 with vi1=0.(2) Derive the response to vi1 with vi2=0.(3) Combine both inputs.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

vi1经R1接反相端，C1从输出反馈；vi2经R2接同相端，C2由同相端接地。vi1 reaches the inverting input through R1 with capacitor C1 feedback. vi2 reaches the noninverting input through R2, with C2 from that node to ground.

本题图在书第49页／PDF第82页。The source figure is on printed p. 49 · PDF p. 82.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

叠加定理；RC低通；理想运放电容KCL；零初值拉普拉斯变换。Superposition; RC low-pass; op-amp capacitor KCL; zero-initial-condition Laplace transforms.
不能把同相端直接视为vi2；它先经过RC低通。这个低通与同相闭环传输相乘后，恰好化成正积分。The noninverting node is not vi2; it follows an RC low-pass. Multiplication by the noninverting closed-loop transfer yields a positive integrator.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）只加vi2(1) Apply vi2 alone

同相节点传输为1(1+sRC)，带电容反馈的同相增益为1+1(sRC)。二者相乘后消去1+sRC。The noninverting node has transfer 1(1+sRC), while the closed-loop gain from that node is 1+1(sRC). Their product cancels 1+sRC.

Vo(s)Vi2(s)=(1+1sRC)11+sRC=1sRC⇒vo(t)=1RC∫0tvi2(τ)dτ

（2）只加vi1(2) Apply vi1 alone

vi2=0且C2初压0，使同相端恒0，退化为普通反相积分器。With vi2=0 and zero C2 voltage, the noninverting node remains at zero, leaving an inverting integrator.

Vo(s)Vi1(s)=−1sRC⇒vo(t)=−1RC∫0tvi1(τ)dτ

（3）叠加并用时域KCL核对(3) Superpose and check with time-domain KCL

令vp=vn，C2的KCL给RC·dvpdt=vi2−vp；C1反馈给RC·dvodt=RC·dvpdt+vp−vi1。相加抵消vp，得到差分积分；两电容零初值使vo(0)=0。C2 KCL gives RC·dvpdt=vi2−vp. C1 feedback gives RC·dvodt=RC·dvpdt+vp−vi1. Substitution cancels vp, yielding differential integration; both zero initial voltages imply vo(0)=0.

vo(t)=1RC∫0t[vi2(τ)−vi1(τ)]dτ

分别为正积分vi2、负积分vi1；总输出vo=(1RC)∫0t(vi2−vi1)dτ，vo(0)=0。The two responses are positive integration of vi2 and negative integration of vi1; total vo=(1RC)∫0t(vi2−vi1)dτ, with vo(0)=0.

易错点Common errors

  • 匹配R、C和零初值是抵消成立的条件。Matched RC values and zero initial conditions are required for the cancellation.
  • 同相端先低通，不可跳过后恰好得到错误的额外直通项。Retain the noninverting low-pass to avoid an erroneous direct-feedthrough term.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻、电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立复频域双节点KCL扫描频率与输入，核对两个单输入传输及叠加；时域两个电容微分方程直接消元确认输出导数。Independent complex-frequency two-node KCL scans verify both single-input transfers and superposition; direct elimination of the two capacitor ODEs independently verifies the output derivative.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

时间常数与微分关系Time constant and differentiation

用统一单位计算104Ω×100×10−6F=1s。Consistent units give 104Ω×100×10−6F=1s.

vo=−RCdvidt=−1sdvidt

逐段输出Output by interval

上升段斜率+0.1Vs，输出−0.1V；平顶0；下降段−0.1Vs，输出+0.1V；此后0。Rising slope +0.1Vs gives −0.1V output; the flat top gives zero; falling slope −0.1Vs gives +0.1V; then zero.

vo(t)={−0.1V,0<t<10s0,10<t<30s+0.1V,30<t<40s0,t>40s

转折点的理想化处理Ideal behavior at corners

输入连续、只有斜率改变，所以输出是有限阶跃而非狄拉克冲激；理想导数在转折瞬间按左右极限说明，不给唯一瞬时值。真实运放转换受带宽约束。Input is continuous with slope changes, so output has finite steps rather than Dirac impulses. At corners use one-sided limits, without a unique ideal instantaneous derivative; real transitions have finite bandwidth.

本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。Input and output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

0～10s输出−0.1V；10～30s为0；30～40s为+0.1V；之后0。转折点取单侧极限，输入连续所以无冲激。Output is −0.1V in 0–10s, zero in 10–30s, +0.1V in 30–40s, then zero. Use one-sided limits at corners; continuous input gives no impulse.

易错点Common errors

  • C是100μF，时间轴为s，不能改成nF或ms。C is 100μF and time is in seconds.
  • 不要把输入斜率跳变误当输入电压跳变。A slope discontinuity is not a voltage discontinuity.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻、电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立由每段ΔvΔt求电容电流±10μA，再由反馈电阻乘电流得∓0.1V；输出全时段积分反向恢复原梯形的增减量。Independent ΔvΔt gives capacitor currents ±10μA and resistor drops ∓0.1V; reverse integration of the output recovers the trapezoid changes.

两个极点限制微分频带Two poles bound the useful differentiation band

题目原文Transcribed question

一实用微分电路如图题2.4.17所示，它具有衰减高频噪声的作用。（1）确定电路的传递函数Vo(s)Vi(s)；（2）若R1=R2=R，C1=C2=C，试问应当怎样限制vi的频率，才能使电路不失去微分功能？The practical differentiator in Fig. 2.4.17 attenuates high-frequency noise. (1) Determine Vo(s)Vi(s). (2) If R1=R2=R and C1=C2=C, what input-frequency restriction preserves differentiation?

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

输入串联R1、C1到反相虚地；反馈R2与C2并联，同相端接地。Input has series R1 and C1 to virtual ground; feedback is parallel R2 and C2, with the noninverting input grounded.

本题图在书第50页／PDF第83页。The source figure is on printed p. 50 · PDF p. 83.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

复阻抗；反相传输−ZfZi；低频近似与幅相误差。Complex impedance; inverting transfer −ZfZi; low-frequency approximation and magnitude and phase error.
先按串联输入、并联反馈分别写阻抗。微分要求两个分母因子都接近1；不能只要求频率低于截止而不说明远低于。Write series input and parallel feedback impedances separately. Differentiation requires both denominator factors near 1; merely being below cutoff is insufficient.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）阻抗与传递函数(1) Impedances and transfer function

理想虚地反相式给−ZfZi，零初始条件下写s域表达式。The ideal virtual-ground inverter gives −ZfZi under zero initial conditions.

Zi=R1+1sC1,Zf=R21+sR2C2,VoVi=−sR2C1(1+sR1C1)(1+sR2C2)

（2）匹配参数下的频带(2) Frequency band for matched components

R、C相等时H(s)=−sRC(1+sRC)2。只有输入中需要微分的频率成分满足ωRC远小于1，才近似H≈−sRC。Matching gives H(s)=−sRC(1+sRC)2. Desired input-frequency components must satisfy ωRC≪1 to approximate H≈−sRC.

ωRC≪1⟺f≪12πRC;vo≈−RCdvidt

给可核查的误差尺度Quantify the approximation

令x=ωRC，实际传输与理想微分的比为1、(1+jx)2，幅度比1(1+x2)，额外相位−2arctanx。x=0.1时幅度低约0.99%，仍有约−11.42°相位偏差；频率上限应由允许的幅相误差决定。For x=ωRC, actual and ideal transfer is 1 and (1+jx)2, with magnitude 1(1+x2) and extra phase −2arctanx. At x=0.1 magnitude is about 0.99% low but phase error is still −11.42°; select the band from acceptable magnitude and phase errors.

高频噪声为何受到衰减Why high-frequency noise is attenuated

高频时传输衰减为1ω，而普通理想微分器增益随ω升高；两个极点抑制高频放大，但不能在高频仍称其精确微分。At high frequency the gain decays as 1ω, unlike the increasing gain of an ideal differentiator. Its poles suppress high-frequency amplification, at the cost of losing high-frequency differentiation.

|sRC|≫1:H(s)≈−1sRC

H(s)=−sR2C1[(1+sR1C1)(1+sR2C2)]。匹配时H=−sRC(1+sRC)2；输入需满足ωRC≪1，即f≪1(2πRC)，具体范围取决于允许幅相误差。H(s)=−sR2C1[(1+sR1C1)(1+sR2C2)]. For matched values H=−sRC(1+sRC)2; require ωRC≪1 or f≪1(2πRC), with the usable band determined by allowed magnitude and phase errors.

易错点Common errors

  • 两个RC分母都要保留，不能把实用微分器写成理想−sRC。Retain both RC factors; the practical differentiator is not exactly −sRC.
  • ω是rads，f是Hz，转换需要2π。ω is in rads and f in Hz; retain 2π.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻、电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立由输入支路电流和反馈支路电流KCL扫描复频率，核对传输的低频微分、高频衰减及x=0.1的幅相误差。Independent complex-frequency input and feedback branch KCL verifies low-frequency differentiation, high-frequency rolloff and magnitude and phase errors at x=0.1.

反相放大、反相积分，再做反相求和Invert, integrate, then invert their sum

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题2.4.18a所示，设电容器C上的初始电压为零。（1）求vo1、vo2、vo与输入电压的关系；（2）当输入电压vi1、vi2如图题2.4.18b所示时，试定量画出vo的波形。图中R1=R2=R3=R4=R23=100kΩ、R21=300kΩ、C=100μF；0～5s内vi1=−0.1V，vi2从+3V开始每1s在±3V之间切换。For Fig. 2.4.18(a), capacitor C initially has zero voltage. (1) Relate vo1, vo2 and vo to the inputs. (2) Draw a quantitative vo for (b). R1=R2=R3=R4=R23=100kΩ, R21=300kΩ and C=100μF. Over 0–5s, vi1=−0.1V and vi2 alternates ±3V every second, beginning positive.

本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

A1反相增益−R21R1；A2输入R2、反馈C为积分器；A3从vo1经R3、vo2经R4求和，反馈R23。图b为恒定−0.1V及1s间隔±3V方波。A1 inverts with −R21R1; A2 integrates through R2 and C; A3 sums vo1R3 and vo2R4 with R23 feedback. Figure (b) gives constant −0.1V and an alternating ±3V square wave at 1s intervals.

本题图在书第50页／PDF第83页。The source figure is on printed p. 50 · PDF p. 83.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相放大；积分；求和；分段连续累计。Inverting gain; integration; summation; continuous piecewise accumulation.
每级先算中间输出，最后再做求和反相。C×R2=10s，所以积分斜率大小为0.3Vs，不是3Vs。Compute intermediate outputs before final inversion. R2C=10s gives integration slopes of 0.3Vs, not 3Vs.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）三个输出关系(1) Three output relations

A1为−3倍；A2零初值积分；A3两输入权重均−1。A1 gain is −3, A2 integrates from zero, and A3 has −1 weights on both inputs.

vo1=−3vi1,vo2=−110s∫0tvi2(τ)dτ,vo=−vo1−vo2=3vi1+110s∫0tvi2(τ)dτ

（2）逐段累计积分输出(2) Accumulate the integrator output

vo1恒为+0.3V；vo2在每个+3V区间以−0.3Vs下降，在−3V区间以+0.3Vs上升，端点依次0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3V。vo1 is +0.3V. vo2 falls at −0.3Vs during +3V intervals and rises at +0.3Vs during −3V intervals; values at t=0…5s are 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3V.

最终输出及分段式Final output and piecewise waveform

vo=−0.3−vo2，因此最终端点依次−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0V，连成连续三角波。时间t以秒计，只在原图0～5s区间作答。vo=−0.3−vo2, giving endpoint values −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0V, joined linearly as a continuous triangular waveform. Time t is in seconds; the result covers only the plotted 0–5s interval.

vo(t)={−0.3+0.3(t−2k),2k≤t≤2k+1, k=0,1,2−0.3[t−(2k+1)],2k+1<t≤2k+2, k=0,1V

本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。Input and output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

vo1=−3vi1，vo2=−(110s)∫vi2dτ，vo=−vo1−vo2。给定输入下0～5s输出在−0.3与0V间线性往返，t=0、1、2、3、4、5s处分别−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0V。vo1=−3vi1, vo2=−(110s)∫vi2dτ and vo=−vo1−vo2. For the given input, output ramps between −0.3 and 0V, with values −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0V at t=0…5s.

易错点Common errors

  • 积分器每段必须继承上一段末值，不能反复重置0。Carry each interval’s final value into the next; do not reset the integrator.
  • 方波先+3V，最终输出先上升。The square wave begins at +3V, so final output initially rises.
  • 原图只规定0～5s，不擅自规定此后输入与输出。Do not invent input or output behavior beyond the plotted 0–5s interval.

核验依据Verification

理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻、电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

独立以每段30μC电容电荷计算vo2端点，再由A3原虚地KCL求最终输出；逐段检查连续性、斜率和1s端点。Independent 30μC capacitor-charge increments determine vo2 endpoints, followed by original A3 virtual-ground KCL for final output; continuity, slopes and all 1s endpoints are checked.

先统一单位，再反解指数式Unify units, then invert the exponential

题目原文Transcribed question

在室温（300K）情况下，若二极管的反向饱和电流为1nA，问它的正向电流为0.5mA时应加多大的电压？设二极管的指数模型为iD=IS(evD(nVT)−1)，其中n=1，VT=26mV。At 300K, a diode has reverse saturation current 1nA. What voltage produces a forward current of 0.5mA? Use iD=IS(exp(vD(nVT))−1), n=1 and VT=26mV.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

指数模型；自然对数；mA与nA单位换算。Exponential model; natural logarithms; mAnA conversion.
已知IS和目标电流，直接反解电压；这里的比值为500000。IS and target current are known, so invert for voltage; their ratio is 500000.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

反解并代入Invert and substitute

保留−1项，电流比使用同一单位。Retain the −1 term and use consistent current units.

VD=nVTln(1+IDIS)=0.026ln(500001)≈0.3411815V

回代检查Back-substitution

回代所得电流为0.5mA；强正向近似只差约52 nV。Back-substitution gives 0.5mA; dropping the −1 term changes voltage by only about 52 nV.

VD≈0.34118V。VD≈0.34118V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要将0.5mA1nA错算成500。0.5mA1nA is 500000, not 500.

核验依据Verification

题给指数模型，n=1，VT=26mV。Given exponential model, n=1 and VT=26mV.

独立回代指数式得到0.500000mA，并核对所有单位。Independent exponential back-substitution returns 0.500000mA; units were checked.

由指数模型求反向饱和电流与十倍电流电压Use the exponential model for saturation current and a tenfold current increase

题目原文Transcribed question

在室温（300K）情况下，若二极管加0.7V正向电压时，产生的正向电流为1mA。（1）求二极管的反向饱和电流；（2）当二极管正向电流增加10倍时，其电压应为多少？设n=1。At room temperature (300K), a diode carries 1mA when a forward voltage of 0.7V is applied. (1) Find its reverse saturation current. (2) Find its voltage when the forward current increases tenfold. Assume n=1.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管指数模型；热电压；自然对数。Diode exponential model; thermal voltage; natural logarithms.
先用已知工作点反求IS；换到新电流时使用同一个IS。电流按倍数变化对应电压按对数增加。Use the known operating point to recover IS, then keep that same IS for the new current. Multiplying the current produces a logarithmic voltage increase.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

选定本章室温参数Use the chapter’s room-temperature parameter

采用相邻题3.2.1给出的VT=26mV，且本题n=1。保留指数模型中的-1。Use VT=26mV, given in adjacent exercise 3.2.1, and n=1. Retain the -1 term in the exponential model.

ID=IS(eVDVT−1),VT=0.026V

第（1）问：反求ISPart (1): solve for IS

将0.7V、1mA代入指数模型。反向饱和电流是模型参数，不等于当前的正向电流。Substitute 0.7V and 1mA into the model. Reverse saturation current is a model parameter, not the present forward current.

IS=10−3e0.70.026−1≈2.0298×10−15A

第（2）问：将新电流代回Part (2): substitute the new current

新电流为10mA。由指数模型反解电压，得到约0.75987V。The new current is 10mA. Invert the exponential relation to obtain approximately 0.75987V.

VD2=VTln(1+10mAIS)≈0.759867V

用电压增量快速复核Quick check from the voltage increment

因两个正向电流都远大于IS，可以用ΔV≈VTln10复核，电压约增加59.87mV。Both forward currents greatly exceed IS, so ΔV≈VTln10 provides a check: the voltage rises by about 59.87mV.

ΔVD≈0.026ln10=59.867mV

采用VT=26mV：（1）IS≈2.03×10−15A；（2）VD≈0.75987V，较原来增加约59.87mV。Using VT=26mV: (1)IS≈2.03×10−15A. (2)VD≈0.75987V, an increase of about 59.87mV.

易错点Common errors

  • 指数函数的电压单位必须一致，0.70.026不是0.726。Use consistent voltage units in the exponent: 0.70.026, not 0.726.
  • 热电压采用26mV是教材近似；若取kTq的更精细数值，IS会有明显差别，因此必须说明参数。The textbook uses the 26mV approximation. A more precise kTq changes IS noticeably, so the chosen thermal voltage must be stated.

核验依据Verification

二极管指数模型，n=1；室温热电压按教材相邻题取26mV。Exponential diode model with n=1; room-temperature thermal voltage is 26mV as given in the adjacent textbook exercise.

将求得IS分别代回0.7V和0.759867V，独立回算电流为1mA和10mA。精确含-1式与强正向近似的差异远小于所报精度。Substituting the recovered IS at 0.7V and 0.759867V independently reproduces 1mA and 10mA. The exact -1 formula and strong-forward-bias approximation differ far below the reported precision.

把导通条件写成输入门限Express conduction as an input threshold

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.1所示，电源vs=2sinωtV，试分别使用二极管理想模型和恒压降模型（VD=0.7V）分析，绘出负载RL两端的电压波形，并标出幅值。For Fig. 3.4.1 with vs=2sinωtV, use both an ideal diode and a constant 0.7V drop to draw the load-voltage waveform and label its peak.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

电源vs、正向从电源接至负载的二极管D、RL串联；输出vL取RL上正下负。Source vs, diode conducting toward the load, and RL are in series; vL is positive at the load top.

本题图在书第84页／PDF第117页。The source figure is on printed p. 84 · PDF p. 117.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通、截止；KCL、KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on and off states; KCL and KVL; the stated simplified models.
截止时负载电流为零，所以输出为零；导通时用源电压减正向压降。Off means zero load current and voltage; on means source voltage minus forward drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

理想模型Ideal model

正半周导通，负半周截止，输出峰值2V。On for the positive half-cycle, off for the negative; peak is 2V.

vL=max(0,2sinωt)V

恒压降模型Constant-drop model

只有输入超过0.7V才导通；峰值降为1.3V。令θ=ωt，导通区θ∈(arcsin0.35,π−arcsin0.35)再按2π周期延拓。Conduction requires input above 0.7V; peak becomes 1.3V. For θ=ωt, the interval is (arcsin0.35, π−arcsin0.35), repeated every 2π.

vL=max(0,2sinωt−0.7)V

2V正弦输入：理想输出峰2V，0.7V模型峰1.3V。2V sine: ideal output peak 2V, constant-drop peak 1.3V.

理想半波峰值2V；恒压降半波峰值1.3V，导通起点约20.487°。Ideal half-wave peak 2V; constant-drop peak 1.3V, with turn-on at about 20.487°.

易错点Common errors

  • 截止输出是0，而不是负半周输入。Off-state output is zero, not the negative input half-cycle.

核验依据Verification

正RL，无其他负载；分别采用理想和0.7V恒压降模型。Positive RL without other loading; separate ideal and 0.7V constant-drop models.

分别枚举开路和固定压降两种二极管状态，检查支路电流非负、截止vD≤VD及负载KCL；峰值与门限独立计算。Enumerated open and fixed-drop states, checking nonnegative branch current, off-state vD≤VD and load KCL; independently checked peaks and thresholds.

指定要求：3.4.2Assigned requirement: 3.4.2

电池充电：先判断导通，再找正负峰值Battery charging: check conduction, then examine both source peaks

题目原文Transcribed question

12V电池的简化充电电路如图题3.4.2所示，用二极管理想模型分析，若vs是振幅为24V的正弦波，则二极管流过的峰值电流和二极管两端的最大反向电压各是多少？The simplified charging circuit for a12V battery is shown in Fig. 3.4.2. Using the ideal-diode model, find the diode peak current and maximum reverse voltage when vs is sinusoidal with amplitude 24V.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

正弦源vs经100Ω和向右导通的二极管接12V电池正端；电池负端与正弦源下端相连。The sinusoidal source connects through 100Ω and a diode conducting to the right to the positive terminal of a12V battery. The battery negative terminal returns to the lower source terminal.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想二极管分段模型；KVL；反向电压的定义。Piecewise ideal-diode model; KVL; definition of reverse voltage.
电池建立固定12V门槛。正峰值决定最大充电电流，负峰值决定最大反向电压；二者发生在不同半周。The battery creates a fixed 12V threshold. The positive source peak sets the largest charging current; the negative peak sets the largest reverse voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先判导通条件Determine the conduction condition

二极管截止时100Ω中无电流，阳极电位为vs，阴极电位为12V。只有vs>12V才导通。When the diode is off, no current flows through 100Ω, so its anode is at vs and cathode at 12V. It turns on only when vs>12V.

iD={(vs−12)100,vs>12V0,vs≤12V

正峰值求峰值电流Use the positive peak for peak current

当vs=24V时，理想二极管压降为零，电阻上电压为24−12=12V。At vs=24V, the ideal diode has zero drop and the resistor voltage is 24−12=12V.

ID,pk=24−12100=0.12A=120mA

负峰值求最大反向电压Use the negative peak for maximum reverse voltage

当vs=−24V时二极管截止，电阻压降为零。最大反向电压为阴极减阳极，即12-(-24)。At vs=−24V the diode is off and the resistor drop is zero. Reverse voltage is cathode minus anode: 12 - (-24).

VR,max=12−(−24)=36V

峰值电流120mA；最大反向电压36V。Peak current: 120mA. Maximum reverse voltage: 36V.

易错点Common errors

  • 正弦源振幅是24V，不是有效值；不再乘√2。24V is the sinusoidal amplitude, not RMS; do not multiply it by √2.
  • 反向峰值要叠加电池电压，不能只取24V。The reverse peak includes the battery voltage; it is not just 24V.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；理想12V电池。Ideal diode and ideal 12V battery.

逐半周检查理想二极管互补条件：导通时vAK=0且iD≥0；截止时iD=0且vAK=vs−12≤0。正峰值KVL为24=12+100×0.12；负峰值反向36V。Checked ideal-diode complementarity in both half-cycles: on means vAK=0 and iD≥0; off means iD=0 and vAK=vs−12≤0. Positive-peak KVL is 24 = 12 + 100(0.12); the negative peak gives 36V reverse bias.

指定要求：3.4.3(1)Assigned requirement: 3.4.3(1)

桥式整流：导通路径与二极管耐压Bridge rectification: current paths and reverse-voltage rating

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.3所示，电源vs为正弦波电压。（1）二极管采用理想模型，试绘出负载RL两端的电压波形；（2）若vs的有效值为220V，则二极管的最高反向工作电压值应为多少？The circuit in Fig. 3.4.3 has a sinusoidal source vs. (1) Using ideal diodes, draw the voltage waveform across RL. (2) If vs has RMS value 220V, what maximum reverse-working-voltage rating is required for each diode?

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

桥式整流器：上左D1、上右D2、下右D3、下左D4；交流源接桥的上下顶点，负载接左右顶点，右端为输出正端。Bridge rectifier: D1 upper left, D2 upper right, D3 lower right, D4 lower left. The AC source connects to the top and bottom bridge vertices; the load is between left and right vertices, with output positive at the right.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通路径；理想全波整流；正弦有效值与峰值。Diode conduction paths; ideal full-wave rectification; sinusoidal RMS and peak values.
分别沿正半周和负半周画闭合电流路径，确认负载电流方向始终相同，再检查每只截止管两端的节点电位。Trace a closed current path in each half-cycle. The load current keeps the same direction. Then inspect the two node potentials across each off diode.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

正半周：D2、D4导通Positive half-cycle: D2 and D4 conduct

vs>0时，电流从源上端经D2到负载正端，通过RL后经D4回源下端，故vL=vs。D1、D3反偏。For vs>0, current flows from the source upper terminal through D2, through RL from its positive terminal, then through D4 back to the source lower terminal. Thus vL=vs; D1 and D3 are reverse-biased.

vs>0:vL=vs

负半周：D3、D1导通Negative half-cycle: D3 and D1 conduct

vs<0时，源下端较高，电流经D3、RL、D1回源上端。负载方向不变，故vL=−vs。For vs<0, the source lower terminal is higher. Current returns through D3, RL and D1 to the upper terminal. Load direction is unchanged, so vL=−vs.

vs<0:vL=−vs

合并为全波整流波形Combine into the full-wave waveform

把正弦负半周翻到零线上方，峰值保持Vm，周期变为输入的一半，输出脉动频率为输入的两倍。Reflect the negative sine half-cycle above zero. The peak remains Vm, the output period is half the input period, and the ripple frequency doubles.

vs=Vmsinωt⇒vL=Vm|sinωt|

第（2）问：检查截止管反向峰值Part (2): check the off-diode reverse peak

以正半周的D1为例，其阳极在源下端电位、阴极在源上端电位，反向电压为vs。其他管对称。因此每管PIV为源峰值，而不是两倍源峰值。For D1 in the positive half-cycle, the anode is at the source lower-terminal potential and cathode at the upper-terminal potential, so its reverse voltage is vs. Symmetry applies to the others. Each diode’s PIV equals the source peak, not twice it.

VR,max=Vm=2Vs,rms=2202≈311.13V

理想桥式整流波形：灰色虚线为输入正弦，蓝绿色实线为负载输出。负半周翻到零线上方，输出峰值为Vm，输出频率为输入的两倍。Ideal bridge-rectifier waveform. Dashed gray is the sinusoidal input; solid teal is the load output. Negative half-cycles are reflected above zero, with peak Vm and twice the input frequency.

（1）vL=|vs|=Vm|sinωt|，为全波整流波形；（2）每只管的最大反向电压约311V，反向工作电压额定值须不低于该值。(1)vL=|vs|=Vm|sin(ωt)|, a full-wave rectified waveform. (2) Each diode sees about 311V maximum reverse voltage; its reverse-working-voltage rating must be at least this value.

易错点Common errors

  • 桥式整流每只管的反向峰值为Vm；不要套用中心抽头全波电路的2Vm。A bridge diode sees peak reverse voltage Vm; do not substitute the 2Vm result for a center-tapped full-wave circuit.
  • 本题为理想管，不扣除两只实际硅管的导通压降。The diodes are ideal here; do not subtract the drops of two real silicon diodes.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；负载为电阻，无滤波电容。Ideal diodes with a resistive load and no filter capacitor.

按实际图上四管方向分别追踪两种导通对，并以负载电阻电流iL=vLRL≥0复核。正半周截止D1、D3的vAK=−vs≤0，负半周截止D2、D4的vAK=vs≤0，全部满足模型条件。Traced both conducting pairs using the actual diode directions. The resistor current iL=vLRL is nonnegative. In the positive half-cycle, off diodes D1 and D3 have vAK=−vs≤0; in the negative half-cycle, off diodes D2 and D4 have vAK=vs≤0. Every ideal-model condition is satisfied.

桥内电流整流，运放抵消二极管影响Rectify meter current inside the feedback bridge

题目原文Transcribed question

图题3.4.4是一高输入阻抗交流电压表电路，二极管用理想模型分析，被测电压vi=2Visinωt。（1）当vi瞬时极性为正时，标出流过表头M的电流方向，说明哪几个二极管导通；（2）写出流过表头M的电流平均值表达式；（3）设表头满刻度平均电流为100μA，要求Vi=1V时满刻度，试求R；（4）若改为1V直流电压表，满刻度时R应如何改变？Figure 3.4.4 is a high-input-impedance AC voltmeter. With ideal diodes and vi=2Visinωt: (1) for positive instantaneous input, identify conducting diodes and meter-current direction; (2) derive average meter current; (3) find R for 100μA full-scale average current at Vi=1V; (4) find R for a1V DC full-scale range.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

同相端接vi；反相节点vn经R接地，也是整流桥左端，运放输出接桥右端；表头M位于桥A（上、+）与B（下、−）之间。D4左→A，D3右→A，D1B→左，D2B→右。Noninverting input is vi. Node vn connects through R to ground and to the bridge left terminal; op-amp output is the bridge right terminal. Meter is between upper A(+) and lower B(−). D4 runs left→A, D3 right→A, D1B→left and D2B→right.

本题图在书第85页／PDF第118页。The source figure is on printed p. 85 · PDF p. 118.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

同相负反馈；全波整流平均值；正弦有效值。Noninverting negative feedback; full-wave average; sinusoidal RMS.
虚短给vn=vi，电阻电流由viR决定；桥把两个方向都转成表头A→B。Virtual short gives vn=vi, setting resistor current viR; the bridge routes both signs through the meter A→B.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

正、负半周电流路径Current paths in both half-cycles

vi>0：运放输出→D3→A→M→B→D1→vn→R→地，D1D3导通。vi<0：地→R→vn→D4→A→M→B→D2→输出，D2D4导通。两种情况M均A→B。For vi>0: output→D3→A→M→B→D1→vn→R→ground; D1 and D3 conduct. For vi<0: ground→R→vn→D4→A→M→B→D2→output; D2 and D4 conduct. Meter current always flows A→B.

iM=|vi|R

平均电流与交流量程Average current and AC range

Vi为有效值，不是峰值。全波正弦平均值为峰值的2π。Vi is RMS, not peak. A full-wave sine has average equal to 2π times its peak.

IM,av=22ViπR;RAC=22π100μA≈9.00316kΩ

直流量程DC range

直流无需整流平均系数，故R增加至10kΩ，约为原来的1.11072倍。DC requires no waveform averaging factor; increase R to 10kΩ, about 1.11072 times the AC value.

RDC=1V100μA=10kΩ

正半周D1、D3导通，表头电流A→B；I平均=22Vi(πR)。交流1V量程R≈9.003kΩ，直流1V量程R=10kΩ。Positive input turns on D1 and D3, with meter current A→B. Average current is 22Vi(πR). Use R≈9.003kΩ for 1V RMS AC and 10kΩ for 1V DC.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能用1V100μA直接得到交流量程R。Do not use 1V100μA for the RMS AC range.

核验依据Verification

理想运放在线性负反馈内；输出有足够余量推动表头；理想二极管，表头串联阻抗由反馈补偿。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback with enough output compliance; ideal diodes and meter series impedance inside the feedback loop.

按原桥四个二极管方向逐状态列KCL，正负输入分别得到两条一致电流路径；数值积分|2sinθ|R的整周期平均为100μA。Original bridge directions and state KCL give the two consistent current paths. Numerical full-cycle integration of |2sinθ|R gives 100μA.

3.4.5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第85页／PDF第118页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 85 · PDF p. 118. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

分半周确认反馈支路Identify the active feedback path in each half-cycle

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.5所示，运放电源±10V，二极管导通压降0.7V。（1）vs=2V时，vA和vo各是多少？（2）vs=−2V时各是多少？（3）正弦vs振幅分别为2V和0.5V时，绘出相应vA、vo波形并标幅值。（4）若图题3.4.1中vs振幅也为0.5V、二极管导通压降0.7V，则vL波形怎样？据此说明本题电路的优点。提示：正负半周两管状态不同。For Fig. 3.4.5, op-amp supplies are ±10V and diode drop is 0.7V. (1) Find vA and vo for vs=2V. (2) Repeat for −2V. (3) Draw vAvo for sinusoidal amplitudes 2V and 0.5V, labeling peaks. (4) Compare with Fig. 3.4.1 for a0.5V sine and 0.7V diode, explaining this circuit’s advantage. Hint: diode states differ between half-cycles.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

输入vs经R到反相节点；输出vo经R反馈至反相节点；同相端接地。D1由反相节点指向运放输出vA，D2由vA指向vo。Input vs reaches the inverting node through R; equal R returns vo to that node. Noninverting input is grounded. D1 runs from inverting node to op-amp output vA; D2 runs from vA to vo.

本题图在书第85页／PDF第118页。The source figure is on printed p. 85 · PDF p. 118.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

运放虚短、虚断；二极管状态；精密半波整流。Op-amp input conditions; diode states; precision half-wave rectification.
vs正时走D1反馈、输出为零；vs负时走D2反馈、输出反相。二极管压降由vA承担。Positive input uses D1 feedback with zero output; negative input uses D2 feedback with inverted output. vA supplies the diode drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

vs>0与第（1）问vs>0 and part (1)

D1通、D2断，vn=0，因此vA=−0.7V、vo=0；vs=2V同此。D1 on, D2 off and vn=0 give vA=−0.7V and vo=0, including vs=2V.

vs>0:vA=−0.7V,vo=0

vs<0与第（2）问vs<0 and part (2)

D2通、D1断，等值R给vo=−vs，vA=vo+0.7；−2V时分别为2.7V、2V，均在电源余量内。D2 on and D1 off; equal resistors give vo=−vs and vA=vo+0.7. For −2V, these are 2V and 2.7V, within supply limits.

vs<0:vo=−vs,vA=−vs+0.7

两个振幅与对比Both amplitudes and comparison

振幅Vm时，vo=max(−Vmsinωt,0)，峰值Vm；vA正峰值Vm+0.7、正输入半周为−0.7。故2V输入输出峰值2V、vA正峰2.7V；0.5V输入为0.5V、1.2V。普通图3.4.1的0.5V输入不够导通，vL恒0；本题可整流小于0.7V的信号。For amplitude Vm, output is max(−Vmsinωt,0), peaking at Vm. vA peaks at Vm+0.7 and is −0.7 during positive input. The two cases give output peaks 2V and 0.5V and vA positive peaks 2.7V and 1.2V. The ordinary 0.5V rectifier remains off; this precision circuit rectifies signals below 0.7V.

2V和0.5V输入下的恒压降模型波形；裸输出理想零交越跳变不代表真实动态。Constant-drop waveforms for 2V and 0.5V inputs; ideal raw-output jumps are not real switching dynamics.

（1）vA=−0.7V，vo=0；（2）vA=2.7V，vo=2V；（3）vo为输入负半周反相，峰值分别2V、0.5V；vA按上述分段式；（4）普通整流输出0，本题能对小信号精密整流。(1)vA=−0.7V, vo=0.(2)vA=2.7V, vo=2V. (3) Negative input half-cycles become positive output peaks of 2V and 0.5V; vA follows the stated piecewise rule. (4) Ordinary output is zero; this circuit rectifies small signals.

易错点Common errors

  • 输出取D2之后的vo，不等于运放裸输出vA。Use vo after D2, not the raw op-amp output vA.
  • 零交越处理想恒压降模型不唯一限定vA；真实转换受带宽限制。At exact zero crossing, the ideal constant-drop model does not uniquely fix vA; real switching is bandwidth limited.

核验依据Verification

理想运放有足够带宽且处于负反馈；±10V电源；二极管0.7V恒压降；不把零交越的理想跳变当作真实动态。Ideal op amp with sufficient bandwidth in negative feedback, ±10V supplies, 0.7V diode drops; ideal zero-crossing jumps are not real transient predictions.

分别将两种状态代回反相端KCL和两管端电压，确认导通电流非负、另一管反偏；各指定峰值均小于±10V。Substituted each state into inverting-node KCL and both diode voltages, confirming nonnegative conducting current and reverse bias of the other diode; stated peaks remain within ±10V.

A2 is an inverting summer with inputs vs through 2R and vo1 through R, and feedback 2R; both noninverting inputs are grounded.

本题图在书第85页／PDF第118页。The source figure is on printed p. 85 · PDF p. 118.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

精密整流；反相加法；实际运放带宽与转换。Precision rectification; inverting summation; real op-amp bandwidth and switching.
A1给负半波vo1，A2实现−vs−2vo1；分别带入两种状态即可。A1 creates negative half-wave vo1; A2 forms −vs−2vo1. Substitute the two states.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

分半周求A1A1 by half-cycle

vs>0时D2通、D1断，vo1=−vs；vs≤0时D1通、D2断，vo1=0。0.7V压降落在A1裸输出内。For vs>0, D2 on and D1 off give vo1=−vs. For vs≤0, D1 on and D2 off give vo1=0. The 0.7V drop is supplied by A1’s raw output.

vo1=−max(vs,0)

A2求和并画理想波形A2 sum and ideal waveforms

虚地KCL给vo=−vs−2vo1，因此正负半周均为|vs|。2V正弦输入下，vo1从−2到0V，vo为0到2V的全波。Virtual-ground KCL yields vo=−vs−2vo1, hence |vs| for both signs. A2V sine gives vo1 from −2 to 0V and full-wave vo from 0 to 2V.

vs2R+vo1R+vo2R=0⇒vo=|vs|

与桥式整流比较Comparison with bridge rectification

优点：避免两只二极管正向压降导致的小信号死区，可由后级提供低输出阻抗。缺点：需供电、两只运放及匹配电阻，受输出范围、带宽和转换速度限制；桥式无需额外运放供电且适于较大功率整流。Advantages: avoids the two-diode small-signal dead zone and provides a low-impedance driven output. Costs: supplies, two op amps, matched resistors, finite output range and bandwidth and switching speed. A passive bridge needs no separate amplifier supplies and suits power rectification.

实际SPICE及模型边界Executed SPICE and model limits

已实际运行ngspice 47，使用TI官方UA741宏模型和OUP列出的EVAL1N4148参数。1kHz、1V峰值的末周期输出约−0.04795到1.00156V，零交越附近有动态尖差，最大|vo−|vs||约0.09030V，不能把真实741仿真画成完美绝对值。附瞬态和直流扫描传输图；网表需从下方TI链接下载模型，去末尾Ctrl−Z并另存为同目录UA741.lib。Executed ngspice 47 with TI’s UA741 macro-model and the OUP−listed EVAL1N4148 parameters. At 1kHz and 1V peak, last-cycle output spans about −0.04795 to 1.00156V, with crossover transients and maximum |vo−|vs||≈0.09030V. The real-741 simulation is not an ideal absolute value. Transient and DC-transfer plots are attached. Download the TI model below, remove its trailing Ctrl−Z and save it beside the netlist as UA741.lib.

第（2）问2V正弦输入的理想半波及全波。Part (2): ideal half-wave and full-wave outputs for a2V sine.

实际ngspice末两周期的输入与输出波形，模型条件见解析。Executed ngspice input and output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

实际DC扫描传输特性与所列简化模型对比。Executed DC transfer versus the stated simplified model.

理想vo1=−max(vs,0)，vo=|vs|；2V输入时分别为−2～0V、0～2V。μA741实际仿真另见附图，保留其零交越动态误差。Ideal vo1=−max(vs,0), vo=|vs|; a2V input gives −2…0V and 0…2V respectively. Attached μA741 simulations retain crossover errors.

易错点Common errors

  • A2输入系数为−1和−2；不能忽略vs的直通求和支路。A2 coefficients are −1 and −2; retain the direct vs summing branch.
  • 静态传输与1kHz瞬态的零交越误差不是同一个结果。DC transfer and 1kHz transient crossover errors are distinct.

核验依据Verification

（1）～（3）理想线性运放、0.7V二极管；（4）TI UA741宏模型及指定EVAL1N4148参数，27°C，供电按题为±12V；模型预测不是器件误差保证。Parts (1)–(3): ideal linear op amps and 0.7V diodes. Part (4): TI UA741 macro-model plus specified EVAL1N4148 parameters at 27°C, with the requested ±12V supplies. Simulation is a model prediction, not a guaranteed device error bound.

理想分段式经A1A2原节点KCL和二极管一致性复核；实际网表逐条按原图连接，执行瞬态及DC扫描，并减半时间步检查波形与误差。Checked ideal piecewise relations using both original summing-node KCL equations and diode consistency; wired the actual netlist from the source and executed transient and DC analyses, with a half-step convergence check.

二极管电路如图题3.4.8a，输入如图b在0<t<5ms内由0线性升至10V。（1）理想二极管，绘vo(t)；（2）二极管用1N4148，vi=10sin(2π×1000t)V，用SPICE绘vo(t)。For Fig. 3.4.8a, the input in (b) ramps from 0 to 10V over 0<t<5ms. (1) Draw vo(t) for an ideal diode. (2) With 1N4148 and vi=10sin(2π×1000t)V, plot vo(t) in SPICE.

本题图在书第86页／PDF第119页。The source figure is on printed p. 86 · PDF p. 119.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通、截止；KCL、KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on and off states; KCL and KVL; the stated simplified models.
截止时负载电阻没有电流，输出已被6V电源拉到6V，不能从零起画。When off, the load resistor has zero current and output is already 6V; do not draw from zero.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

理想门限与导通分压Ideal threshold and on-state divider

vi≤6V时截止，vo=6V。vi>6V时导通，两只等值电阻串联在vi与6V之间，vo=(vi+6)2。Off for vi≤6V, with vo=6V. Above 6V, equal series resistors divide between vi and 6V, giving vo=(vi+6)2.

vo(t)={6,0<t≤3mstms+3,3ms<t<5msV

实际SPICE及模型边界Executed SPICE and model limits

第（2）问改用正弦输入，不沿用斜坡。实际执行1N4148瞬态输出约5.99996～7.63590V；仅在正峰附近明显导通，负半周仍约6V。Part (2) uses a sine, not the ramp. Executed 1N4148 transient output spans about 5.99996…7.63590V; appreciable conduction occurs only around positive peaks, while negative half-cycles remain near 6V.

实际ngspice末两周期的输入与输出波形，模型条件见解析。Executed ngspice input and output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

斜坡输入：理想3ms开通、0.7V模型3.35ms开通。Ramp input: ideal turn-on at 3ms; constant-drop turn-on at 3.35ms.

（1）0～3ms为6V；3～5ms为(tms+3)V，末值趋于8V。（2）实际模型正弦输出约6～7.63590V，见波形。(1)6V until 3ms, then (tms+3)V, approaching 8V at 5ms. (2) Executed sine-input output is about 6…7.63590V; see plot.

易错点Common errors

  • 6V电源的极性是上正下负；截止不代表输出接地。The 6V source is positive at the top; off does not mean grounded output.

核验依据Verification

（1）理想二极管；（2）指定EVAL1N4148模型、27°C。输入源与6V电源均理想。Part (1): ideal diode. Part (2): specified EVAL1N4148 model at 27°C; ideal input and 6V sources.

用两只200Ω原支路KCL检查导通分压和截止电压，t=3ms两段连续；实际SPICE另外使用题给正弦，DC、瞬态及半步长结果对照。Original 200Ω branch KCL verifies on and off results and continuity at 3ms. SPICE separately uses the requested sine; DC and transient and half-step results were compared.

本题引用图3.4.8：输入经200Ω和正向二极管到输出，输出经200Ω到+6V；输入为图示斜坡。Uses Fig. 3.4.8: input through 200Ω and a forward diode to output, then 200Ω to +6V; input is the shown ramp.

本题图在书第86页／PDF第119页。The source figure is on printed p. 86 · PDF p. 119.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通、截止；KCL、KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on and off states; KCL and KVL; the stated simplified models.
截止输出仍是6V；要使阳极比阴极高0.7V，输入须超过6.7V。Off-state output remains 6V; input must exceed 6.7V to forward-bias the diode by 0.7V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

门限和两段输出Threshold and piecewise output

2Vms斜率给门限时刻3.35ms；导通电流(vi−6−0.7)400，输出为6+200iD。The 2Vms slope gives a threshold at 3.35ms. On-state current is (vi−6−0.7)400 and output is 6+200iD.

vo=max(6,vi+5.32);vo(t)={6,tms≤3.35tms+2.65,tms>3.35V

斜坡输入：理想3ms开通、0.7V模型3.35ms开通。Ramp input: ideal turn-on at 3ms; constant-drop turn-on at 3.35ms.

0～3.35ms为6V；3.35～5ms为(tms+2.65)V，末值趋于7.65V。6V until 3.35ms, then (tms+2.65)V, approaching 7.65V at 5ms.

易错点Common errors

  • 导通后0.7V由整个串联回路承担，等值分压使输出比理想情况低0.35V。The 0.7V belongs to the series loop; equal division lowers output by 0.35V relative to the ideal on-state.

核验依据Verification

硅二极管恒压降0.7V；反向截止，忽略漏电及动态寄生。Silicon diode with constant 0.7V forward drop, no reverse current or dynamic parasitics.

导通KVL：vi−vo−0.7=200iD，输出支路vo−6=200iD；联立独立检查门限、连续性和峰值。Independent KVL equations vi−vo−0.7=200iD and vo−6=200iD verify threshold, continuity and peak.

本题图在书第86页／PDF第119页。The source figure is on printed p. 86 · PDF p. 119.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通、截止；KCL、KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on and off states; KCL and KVL; the stated simplified models.
正峰6V时输出被钳到0.7V，电容左正右负充至5.3V；余下周期近似保持。At a+6V input peak, output clamps at +0.7V, charging the capacitor left-to-right to +5.3V, approximately held for the cycle.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

保持电容电压求平移Use held capacitor voltage for the shift

周期远短于放电时间常数，可忽略RL导致的缓慢下垂；输出为原正弦向下平移5.3V。The period is much shorter than the discharge time constant, so slow load droop is neglected; shift the sine down by 5.3V.

vC≈6−0.7=5.3V;vo≈6sinωt−5.3V

标出两端峰值Label both extrema

正峰0.7V，负峰−11.3V，峰峰值仍约12V。Maximum +0.7V, minimum −11.3V; peak-to-peak remains approximately 12V.

大时间常数近似：输出−11.3至+0.7V。Large-time-constant approximation: output −11.3…+0.7V.

vo≈6sinωt−5.3V，范围−11.3～+0.7V；这是稳态大时间常数近似。vo≈6sinωt−5.3V, spanning −11.3…+0.7V under the steady-state large-time-constant approximation.

易错点Common errors

  • 此处钳正峰；不能把波形误向上平移。The positive peak is clamped; do not shift upward.

核验依据Verification

0.7V恒压降；已达稳态，RLC远大于周期；忽略周期内放电下垂。0.7V drop, steady state and RLC much larger than the period; within-cycle droop neglected.

正峰时检查D导通vo=0.7；其余时刻vo≤0.7满足截止；输出减输入的电压为固定−5.3V，满足电容保持条件。At the positive peak vo=0.7 satisfies conduction; elsewhere vo≤0.7 is consistent with off-state operation. The constant −5.3V output-input difference matches held capacitor charge.

题目原文Transcribed question

钳位电路如图题3.4.11，D为硅二极管。（1）vs=4sinωtV，用恒压降模型绘vo稳态波形；（2）二极管用1N4148，vs=4sin(2π×1000t)V，C=10μF，用SPICE绘vo(t)稳态波形。For Fig. 3.4.11 with a silicon diode: (1) use a constant-drop model for vs=4sinωtV and draw steady-state output; (2) use 1N4148, vs=4sin(2π×1000t)V and C=10μF in SPICE to plot steady-state output.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

输入经C到输出；二极管阳极接+3V偏置上端，阴极在输出，电源下端接地；原图没有负载电阻。Input couples through C to output; diode anode is at the +3V bias source and cathode is at output. The original figure has no load resistor.

本题图在书第86页／PDF第119页。The source figure is on printed p. 86 · PDF p. 119.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

偏置钳位；电容电压连续；空载周期电荷平衡。Biased clamping; capacitor-voltage continuity; unloaded periodic charge balance.
这是下限钳位：0.7V模型将最低输出固定在3−0.7=2.3V。真实二极管空载时没有规定的毫安正向电流，不能强制保持0.7V。This is a lower clamp: the 0.7V model sets minimum output to 3−0.7=2.3V. A real unloaded diode has no fixed milliamp forward current, so its drop need not remain 0.7V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

恒压降稳态Constant-drop steady state

负峰vs=−4V时vo=2.3V，电容左减右为−6.3V，所以输出为原波形上移6.3V。At vs=−4V, output is 2.3V and capacitor left-minus-right is −6.3V, shifting the sine upward by 6.3V.

vo≈4sinωt+6.3V;2.3≤vo≤10.3V

实际SPICE及模型边界Executed SPICE and model limits

实际1N4148空载仿真没有擅加负载。先由整周期二极管平均电流为0求周期初始电荷，再运行10周期；所得平移约6.84579V、输出约2.84579～10.84579V。末周期输出减输入的变化约1.88μV，周期二极管电荷积分约4.16×10−15C，确认已近周期稳态。这个结果与0.7V近似不同，原因是实际模型的空载小电流压降不同。The executed unloaded 1N4148 simulation adds no load. Periodic initial charge is found from zero cycle-average diode current, then simulated for 10 cycles. Offset is about 6.84579V and output about 2.84579…10.84579V. Last-cycle output-input ripple is about 1.88μV and integrated diode charge about 4.16×10−15C, confirming near-periodic steady state. It differs from the 0.7V approximation because the actual unloaded, low-current diode drop differs.

实际ngspice末两周期的输入与输出波形，模型条件见解析。Executed ngspice input and output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

（1）vo≈4sinωt+6.3V，2.3～10.3V。（2）指定1N4148模型、原图空载的周期稳态约2.84579～10.84579V，不能混用固定0.7V答案。(1)vo≈4sinωt+6.3V, from 2.3 to 10.3V. (2) The specified unloaded 1N4148 model has periodic output about 2.84579…10.84579V; do not substitute the fixed-drop answer.

易错点Common errors

  • 原图没有RL；随意加负载会改变实际二极管稳态。No RL is drawn; an added load changes real-diode steady state.
  • 初始电容为零的前几个周期不等于稳态波形。The first cycles from zero capacitor charge are not the steady waveform.

核验依据Verification

（1）0.7V恒压降、稳态电容保持；（2）指定EVAL1N4148、27°C、原图空载、C=10μF、理想输入及3V偏置源。Part (1): held steady-state capacitor charge and 0.7V drop. Part (2): specified EVAL1N4148 at 27°C, original unloaded circuit, C=10μF and ideal input and 3 V sources.

恒压降式按原二极管极性检查最低输出；实际模型用独立DC I–V扫描及整周期电荷平衡求初始状态，再以瞬态周期端点、电荷积分、半步长检查。Checked constant-drop minimum against diode polarity. For the actual model, an independent DC I–V sweep and cycle charge balance determine the initial state, then transient endpoints, charge integration and a half-step check verify it.

参考模型依据Model references

  • OUP · EVAL 1N4148 parameters (PDF p.10)
