3.4.12指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第86页／PDF第119页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 86 · PDF p. 119. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.12(a)(c)Assigned requirement: 3.4.12(a)(c)

理想二极管状态：先读电池极性，再试断路Ideal-diode states: read battery polarities, then test an open diode

题目原文Transcribed question

二极管电路如图题3.4.12所示，试判断图中的二极管是导通还是截止，并求出AO两端电压VAO。设二极管是理想的。For the diode circuits in Fig. 3.4.12, determine whether each diode is on or off and find the voltage VAO across terminals A and O. Assume ideal diodes.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

四个电路都含A到固定电位的3kΩ电阻，O为参考点。(a)D阳极−6V、下拉电位−12V；(b)D阳极−15V、下拉−12V；(c)两个阳极分别0V、−15V，阴极同接A，下拉−12V；(d)两个阴极分别0V、−6V，阳极同接A，电阻另一端+12V。电池长线为正端。All four circuits have a3kΩ resistor from A to a fixed potential, with O as reference. (a) Anode −6V, pull node −12V. (b) Anode −15V, pull node −12V. (c) Anodes 0V and −15V share cathode A, with pull node −12V. (d) Cathodes 0V and −6V share anode A, with resistor pull node +12V. A battery’s longer plate is positive.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电池极性与节点电位；理想二极管开关模型；欧姆定律。Battery polarity and node potentials; ideal-diode switching model; Ohm’s law.
先把电池上端写成相对O的带符号电位，再假设管截止。若出现阳极高于阴极，则改为导通；最后确认导通电流不为负、截止管不正偏。Write the signed battery-terminal potentials relative to O. Start with the diode off; if its anode is above its cathode, turn it on. Finally check nonnegative on-current and nonpositive anode-to-cathode voltage for off diodes.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)：D导通(a): D is on

若截止，A=−12V，阳极−6V高于阴极，矛盾。因此D导通，A被钳位为−6V；电阻电流2mA从A流向−12V。If D were off, A=−12V, below its −6V anode, which contradicts the off assumption. D therefore conducts and clamps A to −6V. The resistor carries 2mA from A toward −12V.

VAO=−6V,ID=−6−(−12)3kΩ=2mA

(b)：D截止(b): D is off

截止时A=−12V，阳极−15V比阴极低3V，反偏成立。电阻无电流，A保持−12V。With D off, A=−12V and the −15V anode is 3V below its cathode. The diode is reverse-biased, no resistor current flows, and A remains −12V.

vAK=−15−(−12)=−3V<0,VAO=−12V

(c)：D1导通、D2截止(c): D1 is on and D2 is off

A由3kΩ向−12V下拉。阳极在0V的D1先导通，将A钳位到0V；D2阳极−15V，因而反偏。D1向电阻提供4mA。The resistor pulls A toward −12V. D1, whose anode is at 0V, conducts and clamps A to 0V. D2’s anode is at −15V, so D2 is reverse-biased. D1 supplies 4mA to the resistor.

VAO=0,ID1=0−(−12)3kΩ=4mA,vAK,D2=−15V

(d)：D2导通、D1截止(d): D2 is on and D1 is off

本图12V电池长线在上，电阻将A向+12V拉高。两个管共阳极，阴极更低的D2（−6V）导通，将A钳位为−6V。D1阴极0V，比阳极高6V而截止。The 12V battery has its longer plate on top, so the resistor pulls A toward +12V. With common anodes, D2’s lower cathode potential (−6V) makes D2 conduct and clamp A to −6V. D1’s0V cathode is 6V above its anode, so D1 is off.

VAO=−6V,ID2=12−(−6)3kΩ=6mA,vAK,D1=−6V

(a)D导通，VAO=−6V；(b)D截止，VAO=−12V；(c)D1导通、D2截止，VAO=0V；(d)D1截止、D2导通，VAO=−6V。(a)D on, VAO=−6V. (b)D off, VAO=−12V. (c)D1 on and D2 off, VAO=0V. (d)D1 off and D2 on, VAO=−6V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能按电池旁“6V、12V”字样直接把上端写成正电位，要看长短线。Do not assume a battery upper terminal is positive from its 6V or 12V label; inspect the plate lengths.
  • 两管共同接输出时，必须同时检查另一只管的反偏条件。When two diodes share the output, also check that the other diode remains reverse-biased.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；按原图电池极性确定各节点。Ideal diodes with battery polarities read from the original figure.

对所有四图逐项检查互补条件。导通管电流分别为2、4、6mA，均沿阳极到阴极且为正；截止管vAK分别为(b)−3V、(c)D2的−15V、(d)D1的−6V。各电阻欧姆定律和节点KCL同时成立。Checked complementarity for all four circuits. On-currents are 2, 4 and 6mA, positive from anode to cathode. Off-diode vAK values are −3V in (b), −15V for D2 in (c), and −6V for D1 in (d). Resistor Ohm’s law and nodal KCL both hold.

3.4.13指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第87页／PDF第120页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 120. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.13(a)(b)Assigned requirement: 3.4.13(a)(b)

浮动电源分压网络：用开路电位判二极管状态Floating-source divider: determine diode state from open-circuit potentials

题目原文Transcribed question

试判断图题3.4.13中二极管是导通还是截止，为什么？设二极管是理想的。Determine whether the diode in each circuit of Fig. 3.4.13 is on or off, and explain why. Assume ideal diodes.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

三图D的阳极在右侧A、阴极在左侧B。右分压为15V经140kΩ和10kΩ到地。左主分压为15V经25kΩ和5kΩ到地，记其节点为C。(a)(b)10V源接18kΩ、2kΩ串联，底端接C，B在两电阻之间；两图电源极性相反。(c)20V源上正下负，C在18kΩ和2kΩ之间，B在源下端。In all three figures, D has anode A on the right and cathode B on the left. The right divider is 140kΩ and 10kΩ from 15V to ground. The left main divider is 25kΩ and 5kΩ; call its midpoint C. In (a) and (b), a floating 10V source drives series 18kΩ and 2kΩ, with its lower terminal tied to C and B between the resistors; the source polarity reverses between figures. In (c), the 20V source is positive on top, C lies between 18kΩ and 2kΩ, and B is the source lower terminal.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

浮动电压源；电阻分压；理想二极管；戴维南等效与节点分析。Floating voltage sources; resistor division; ideal diodes; Thévenin equivalents and nodal analysis.
先把二极管断开，比较A、B的开路电位。独立的浮动电源回路只经一个节点接主网络时，不向该节点净取流，不能把它当作对地分压器。First open the diode and compare A and B potentials. A floating source loop connected to the main network at only one node draws zero net current from that node; do not treat it as a divider to ground.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先求两个主分压节点Find the two main divider potentials

D开路时，右节点A=15×10(140+10)=1V。左25kΩ、5kΩ分压节点C=15×5(25+5)=2.5V。With D open, A=15(10)(140+10)=1V. The 25kΩ5kΩ main divider gives C=15(5)(25+5)=2.5V.

VA0=1V,VC0=2.5V

(a)：B高于A，截止(a): B is above A, so D is off

10V源上正下负，2kΩ上的分压为+1V，故B=C+1=3.5V。D阳极A=1V、阴极B=3.5V，反偏2.5V。The 10V source is positive on top; the 2kΩ divider drop is +1V, so B=C+1=3.5V. With anode A=1V and cathode B=3.5V, D is reverse-biased by 2.5V.

VB0=2.5+10218+2=3.5V,vAK=−2.5V<0

(b)：电源反向后仍截止(b): reversing the source still leaves D off

10V源反向，故B=C−1=1.5V。A仍为1V，阳极仍低于阴极0.5V，因此截止。Reversing the 10V source gives B=C−1=1.5V. A remains 1V, still 0.5V below the cathode, so D is off.

VB0=2.5−10218+2=1.5V,vAK=−0.5V<0

(c)：开路试算出现正偏，必须导通(c): the open-circuit test gives forward bias

20V源使C比B高20×2(18+2)=2V，故开路B=2.5−2=0.5V。A=1V高于B，截止假设矛盾，D应导通。导通后节点会相互加载，不能继续把A固定为1V、B固定为0.5V。The 20V source puts C20(2)(18+2)=2V above B, giving open-circuit B=2.5−2=0.5V. A=1V is above B, contradicting the off assumption; D must conduct. Once on, the dividers load each other, so A and B no longer retain their open-circuit values.

VA0−VB0=1−0.5=0.5V>0

独立检查(c)导通电流方向Independently check the on-current in (c)

将两侧从A、B看入作戴维南等效。右侧电阻140kΩ∥10kΩ=283kΩ；左侧电阻(25kΩ∥5kΩ)+(18kΩ∥2kΩ)=17930kΩ。短接A、B后电流从A到B为32.68μA，正向成立。Find the Thévenin resistance seen from each side. On the right, 140kΩ∥10kΩ=283kΩ. On the left, (25kΩ∥5kΩ)+(18kΩ∥2kΩ)=17930kΩ. Shorting A to B produces 32.68μA from A to B, confirming forward conduction.

ID=1−0.5(283+17930)kΩ=130600A≈32.68μA,VA=VB=319459V≈0.69499V

(a)截止：VA=1V、VB=3.5V；(b)截止：VA=1V、VB=1.5V；(c)导通：开路试算VA=1V>VB=0.5V，实际导通电流约32.68μA（A→B）。(a) Off: VA=1V and VB=3.5V. (b) Off: VA=1V and VB=1.5V. (c) On: the open-circuit test gives VA=1V>VB=0.5V; the actual forward current is about 32.68μA from A to B.

易错点Common errors

  • D的阴极横线在左，阳极A在右；方向看反会把三图结论全部颠倒。The cathode bar is on the left and anode A on the right; reversing this interpretation reverses every conclusion.
  • 图(c)导通后的电位不能沿用开路试算值。In (c), do not keep the open-circuit node voltages after D turns on.

核验依据Verification

理想二极管；15V电源和浮动电源均理想。Ideal diode, ideal 15V supply and ideal floating sources.

(a)(b)使用含浮动电源的修正节点方程独立求解，结果分别A=1、B=3.5和A=1、B=1.5V。(c)通过节点方程与戴维南法两种方法得到同一ID=130600A、A=B=319459V、C=1210459V，二极管正向电流为正。Independently solved modified nodal equations including the floating source for (a) and (b), obtaining A=1, B=3.5V and A=1, B=1.5V. For (c), nodal and Thévenin methods both give ID=130600A, A=B=319459V and C=1210459V, with positive forward diode current.

3.4.14指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第87页／PDF第120页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 120. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3.4.14Assigned requirement: 3.4.14

带直流偏置的二极管：先静态，后小信号Biased diode: solve DC first, then the small signal

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.4.14所示，D为硅二极管，VDD=2V，R=1kΩ，正弦信号vs=50sin(2π×50t)mV。（1）静态（即vs=0）时，求二极管中的静态电流和vo的静态电压；（2）动态时，求二极管中的交流电流振幅和vo的交流电压振幅；（3）求输出电压vo的总量。In Fig. 3.4.14, D is a silicon diode, VDD=2V, R=1kΩ, and vs=50sin(2π×50t)mV. (1) With vs=0, find the diode DC current and the DC output voltage. (2) Find the AC current amplitude through the diode and the AC output-voltage amplitude. (3) Find the total output voltage vo.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

2V直流源与vs同向串联，驱动向右导通的二极管及1kΩ接地电阻。vo上正下负，测的是电阻两端电压。The 2V DC source and vs are connected in series with matching polarity, driving a diode conducting to the right and a1kΩ resistor to ground. Output vo is measured across the resistor, positive at the top.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

静态工作点；二极管恒压降模型和小信号电阻；直流与交流叠加。DC operating point; constant-drop and small-signal diode models; DC-plus-AC superposition.
先用0.7V硅管近似求Q点，再以rd=VTIDQ代替交流二极管。输出跨电阻，交流分压应取R(R+rd)。First find the Q point with the 0.7V silicon approximation, then replace the diode by rd=VTIDQ for AC. Because the output is across R, the AC divider factor is R(R+rd).
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

第（1）问：先求静态量Part (1): find the DC quantities

采用硅二极管正向压降约0.7V，静态时电阻分得2−0.7=1.3V，串联电流为1.3mA。Using a silicon forward drop of approximately 0.7V, the resistor DC voltage is 2−0.7=1.3V and the series current is 1.3mA.

IDQ≈2−0.71kΩ=1.3mA,VOQ=IDQR≈1.3V

建立交流小信号电阻Find the AC small-signal resistance

采用本章室温VT=26mV、n=1，得rd=26mV1.3mA=20Ω。交流等效中独立直流电压源短路，输入驱动rd与R串联。Using the chapter’s room-temperature VT=26mV and n=1 gives rd=26mV1.3mA=20Ω. In the AC equivalent, the independent DC voltage source is shorted and the signal drives rd in series with R.

rd≈nVTIDQ=20Ω

第（2）问：求交流振幅Part (2): find the AC amplitudes

输入峰值50mV，故交流电流峰值为50mV(1000+20)Ω，输出峰值为其乘1kΩ。The input peak is 50mV, so the AC current amplitude is 50mV(1000+20)Ω. Multiply by 1kΩ for the output amplitude.

Im≈0.0501020=49.0196μA,Vom=RIm≈49.0196mV

第（3）问：静态与交流相加Part (3): add DC and AC

交流电流与输入同相，输出也同相。把1.3V静态值与约49.02mV的50Hz正弦量相加。The AC current and output are in phase with the input. Add the 1.3V DC value to the approximately 49.02mV, 50Hz sinusoidal component.

vo(t)≈1.3+0.0490196sin(100πt)V

检查小信号和持续导通条件Check small-signal validity and continuous conduction

二极管上的交流峰值仅rdIm≈0.9804mV，远小于26mV；最小总电流约1.3−0.04902=1.25098mA>0，二极管整个周期都保持正向导通。The diode AC-voltage amplitude is only rdIm≈0.9804mV, much smaller than 26mV. Minimum total current is about 1.3−0.04902=1.25098mA>0, so the diode remains forward-conducting throughout the cycle.

vd,m≈0.9804mV≪26mV,ID,min>0

按VDQ≈0.7V、VT=26mV、n=1：（1）IDQ≈1.3mA，VOQ≈1.3V；（2）Im≈49.02μA，Vom≈49.02mV；（3）vo≈1.3+0.04902sin(100πt)V。以上交流结果为一阶小信号近似。Using VDQ≈0.7V, VT=26mV and n=1: (1)IDQ≈1.3mA and VOQ≈1.3V. (2)Im≈49.02μA and Vom≈49.02mV. (3)vo≈1.3+0.04902sin(100πt)V. AC results are first-order small-signal approximations.

易错点Common errors

  • vo跨1kΩ电阻，不是跨二极管；两者交流振幅分别约49.02mV和0.9804mV。vo is across the 1kΩ resistor, not the diode. Their AC amplitudes are approximately 49.02mV and 0.9804mV, respectively.
  • 不能把直流压降0.7V模型原封不动用于交流，否则无法给出本题的小信号电阻影响。Do not use the fixed 0.7V drop unchanged for AC; it omits the small-signal resistance requested here.

核验依据Verification

静态采用硅管0.7V近似；交流采用n=1、室温VT=26mV的小信号模型。题目没有给出器件IS，不能把近似结果宣称为某实际器件的精确指数解。DC uses the 0.7V silicon approximation; AC uses n=1 and room-temperature VT=26mV. The exercise does not specify device IS, so these approximate results are not claimed as an exact exponential solution for a particular real device.

交流KVL独立核对：(R+rd)Im=50mV，RIm+rdIm=49.0196+0.9804=50mV。以Q点校准指数模型，数值解正负输入峰值的非线性串联方程，确认输出与一阶近似的误差小于0.020mV，且始终正向导通。Independent AC KVL gives (R+rd)Im=50mV, with RIm+rdIm=49.0196+0.9804=50mV. Calibrating an exponential model at the Q point and solving the nonlinear series equation at both input peaks confirms an output error below 0.020mV from the first-order approximation and continuous forward conduction.

静态偏置DC bias

增量等效和变化范围Incremental equivalent and range

每管rd≈3.291139Ω，三管总计9.873418Ω。供电±1V通过1kΩ与输出等效电阻分压。Each diode has rd≈3.291139Ω, total 9.873418Ω. The ±1V supply change divides between 1kΩ and the incremental shunt.

ΔVO=rshunt1000+rshuntΔVDD≈±9.776886mV

易错点Common errors

核验依据Verification

静态每管0.7V；小信号n=1、VT=26mV，围绕10V供电线性化；不包含温漂及器件离散性。DC drop 0.7V per diode; small-signal n=1 and VT=26mV, linearized at 10V supply; temperature drift and device spread excluded.

题目原文Transcribed question

低压稳压电路如图题3.4.17，5V≤VI≤10V；保证二极管正向压降0.7V的最小电流ID(min)=2mA，最大整流电流ID(max)=15mA。用恒压降模型，在保持VO=0.7V时讨论R、RL取值范围。For Fig. 3.4.17, 5V≤VI≤10V. Diode current must be at least 2mA to maintain a0.7V drop and no more than 15mA. Using a constant-drop model, determine allowed R and RL while maintaining VO=0.7V.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

VI经R到输出，正向二极管和RL均从输出并联接地。VI reaches output through R; the forward diode and RL both shunt output to ground.

本题图在书第87页／PDF第120页。The source figure is on printed p. 87 · PDF p. 120.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通、截止；KCL、KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on and off states; KCL and KVL; the stated simplified models.
小输入检查二极管最小电流，大输入检查最大电流；负载电流0.7RL一直存在。R和RL是耦合范围，不能分别给两个互不相关区间。Minimum supply checks minimum diode current, maximum supply checks maximum current. Load current is always 0.7RL; RRL ranges are coupled, not independent intervals.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写两端约束Endpoint constraints

二极管电流随VI单调增加，故只需检查5V和10V两个端点。Diode current increases monotonically with supply, so only the 5V and 10V endpoints need checking.

4.3R−0.7RL≥0.002;9.3R−0.7RL≤0.015

固定负载时的R区间R interval for a given load

两不等式联立即为完整设计条件；区间存在需RL≥76.2527Ω（允许边界等号）。Their intersection gives the complete design condition; it exists for RL≥76.2527Ω, including equality.

9.30.015+0.7RL≤R≤4.30.002+0.7RL;RL≥0.70.00918≈76.2527Ω

给出可复核设计例Checkable example

例如R=1kΩ，则RL≥304.3478Ω（含空载）满足两端电流；临界负载76.2527Ω时，R只能为384.6154Ω。空载时R为620～2150Ω。For example R=1kΩ permits RL≥304.3478Ω, including open load. At the limiting load 76.2527Ω, R is fixed at 384.6154Ω. With no load, R may be 620…2150Ω.

完整范围由两端电流不等式或上述R(RL)区间给出；可行负载RL≥76.2527Ω。取R=1kΩ时，RL≥304.3478Ω。The coupled endpoint inequalities, or the stated R(RL) interval, give the full range. Feasible RL≥76.2527Ω; for R=1kΩ, RL≥304.3478Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 最大输入还必须检查15mA上限，不能只保留最低2mA。Check the 15mA limit at maximum supply as well as the 2mA minimum.

核验依据Verification

0.7V恒压降，仅在题给2～15mA内使用；电阻均正，允许RL→∞。0.7V model used only within the specified 2…15mA diode-current range; positive resistances, including RL→∞.

按原图KCL在输入两端独立回算电流；可行负载边界同时达到2mA和15mA，随机可行点扫描中间供电均在范围内。Independent original-node KCL checks both endpoints; the limiting design attains 2mA and 15mA simultaneously, and sampled feasible designs remain within bounds at intermediate supplies.

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题3.5.1，所有稳压管均为硅管，稳定电压VZ=8V，vi=15sinωtV。绘出vo1和vo2波形。In Fig. 3.5.1 all zeners are silicon with VZ=8V. For vi=15sinωtV, draw vo1 and vo2.

两图输入均经3kΩ到输出。（a）单稳压管阴极在输出、阳极接地；（b）两只稳压管反向串联接在输出与地之间。Both inputs feed output through 3kΩ. (a) One zener has cathode at output and anode at ground. (b) Two opposing series zeners connect output to ground.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第121页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 121.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通、截止；KCL、KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on and off states; KCL and KVL; the stated simplified models.
单管正向只需0.7V，反向需8V；反串双管任一方向都是一只击穿、一只正向，总计8.7V。A single zener needs 0.7V forward or 8V reverse. An opposing pair has one in breakdown and one forward in either direction, totaling 8.7V.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

单管限幅Single-zener clipping

vo1正峰钳8V、负峰钳−0.7V；未达限幅时跟随输入。vo1 clips at +8V and −0.7V, following input between limits.

vo1=min(8,max(−0.7,15sinωt))V

反串双管限幅Opposing-pair clipping

vo2在±8.7V对称限幅；不能把正向那只压降漏掉。vo2 clips symmetrically at ±8.7V; include the forward-biased diode drop.

vo2=min(8.7,max(−8.7,15sinωt))V

单管限幅−0.7V和+8V，反串双管限幅±8.7V。Single-zener limits −0.7V and +8V; opposing pair limits ±8.7V.

vo1：−0.7～+8V；vo2：−8.7～+8.7V，均在限幅区外截顶、区内跟随输入。vo1 spans −0.7…+8V; vo2 spans −8.7…+8.7V. Both follow input until clipping.

易错点Common errors

  • 稳压管反向8V不意味着正向也8V。An 8V reverse zener rating does not imply an 8V forward drop.

核验依据Verification

理想8V击穿稳压、硅正向0.7V；忽略动态电阻和反向漏电。Ideal 8V reverse regulation and 0.7V forward drop; dynamic resistance and leakage neglected.

逐极性枚举截止、正向和击穿状态，以串联3kΩ求电流并确认状态一致；双管输出对称，单管方向与原图阴极一致。Enumerated off, forward and breakdown states by polarity; series 3kΩ currents confirm each state. Pair symmetry and the single-zener orientation match the source.

3.5.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

先写功率，再说明数值范围依赖I–V模型Write power first; numerical current range needs an I–V model

题目原文Transcribed question

稳压电路如图题3.5.2。（1）近似写稳压管耗散功率PZ表达式，说明输入VI和负载RL在何种情况下PZ最大或最小；（2）写负载吸收功率和限流电阻R耗散功率表达式；（3）稳压管选1N4733（VZ=5.1V、IZ(max)=178mA、IZT=49mA），VI=10V、R=30Ω、输出稳压值5.1V，用SPICE分析VO不小于5V时输出电流范围。For Fig. 3.5.2: (1) derive approximate zener power and identify input and load conditions for maximum and minimum; (2) give load and series-resistor power; (3) use 1N4733 with VZ=5.1V, IZ(max)=178mA and IZT=49mA, VI=10V and R=30Ω in SPICE to find output-current range for VO≥5V.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

VI经R到VO；稳压管阴极接VO、阳极接地；RL并接输出。IR流入节点，IZ向下，IO流向负载。VI reaches VO through R; zener cathode is VO and anode is ground, with RL across output. IR enters, IZ flows downward and IO feeds the load.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第121页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 121.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

稳压管电流分配；功率；器件I–V模型与误差边界。Zener current sharing; power; device I–V models and uncertainty.
先用IR=IZ+IO。只给5.1V@49mA并不能唯一确定5V时IZ，所以SPICE数值必须绑定具体模型。Start with IR=IZ+IO. A5.1V @49mA point does not uniquely determine IZ at 5V, so numerical SPICE results must name a model.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

稳压管功率与最差条件Zener power and extremes

在稳压成立时VO≈VZ，输入越高、负载电阻越大（负载电流越小），PZ越大，空载最危险；输入最低且负载电阻最小时PZ最小，直到失稳边界。While regulation holds VO≈VZ. Higher input and larger load resistance increase zener power; open load is worst. Lowest input and smallest load resistance minimize it, down to the loss-of-regulation boundary.

PZ≈VZ(VI−VZR−VZRL)

负载和限流电阻功率Load and series-resistor power

表达式仅适用于输出仍稳压的区间。These expressions apply while the output remains regulated.

PL≈VZ2RL;PR≈(VI−VZ)2R

模型无关的第（3）问关系Model-independent relation for part (3)

在VO=5V边界，负载电流=(10−5)30−IZ(5V)，并须满足0≤IZ≤178mA。仅以恒定5.1V且IZ≥0近似，只能得到0～163.333mA的理想极限；不能把它说成真实1N4733的5V门限电流。At the 5V boundary, load current is (10−5)30−IZ(5V), with 0≤IZ≤178mA. An ideal fixed−5.1V approximation gives only a0…163.333mA limit; it is not a real 1N47335V threshold prediction.

IO,max=10−530−IZ(5V)

实际SPICE及模型边界Executed SPICE and model limits

为给出可复现示例，另用自写分段线性模型VZ=5.1+7(IZ−0.049)（VA单位），7Ω选自数据表在49mA处的最大微分阻抗，绝非完整厂商模型。实际DC扫描得VO=5V时IO≈131.952mA，示例范围0～131.952mA；空载约5.74892V、IZ≈141.703mA<178mA。用最大局部斜率跨区外推不构成实物保证，其他SPICE模型会改变数值；原题未指定模型，真实数值不唯一。For a reproducible illustration, an authored piecewise model uses VZ=5.1+7(IZ−0.049), in VA. The 7Ω is the datasheet’s maximum differential impedance at 49mA, not a full manufacturer model. An executed DC sweep reaches VO=5V at IO≈131.952mA, giving the illustrative range 0…131.952mA; no-load is about 5.74892V at IZ≈141.703mA<178mA. Extrapolating a maximum local slope is not a device guarantee. Other SPICE models change this result; the unspecified original model prevents a unique real-device number.

自写7Ω分段线性模型的实际DC扫描，非厂商完整模型或实物保证。Executed DC sweep of the authored 7Ω piecewise model; not a manufacturer model or device guarantee.

（1）（2）见功率式。（3）一般上限为166.667mA−IZ(5V)，必须说明器件模型。本次明确标注的7Ω分段线性SPICE示例为0～131.952mA，不冒充真实器件唯一答案。(1)–(2) See power expressions. (3) General upper limit is 166.667mA−IZ(5V), requiring an explicit I–V model. The clearly labeled 7Ω piecewise SPICE example gives 0…131.952mA, not a unique real-device answer.

易错点Common errors

  • IZT=49mA是测试电流，既不是最小稳压电流，也不是最大电流。49mA is test current, not minimum regulation current or maximum current.
  • 数据表局部最大微分阻抗不等于全范围真实I–V直线。A maximum local differential impedance is not the full-range actual I–V line.

核验依据Verification

功率式用理想恒压稳压近似；数值SPICE示例另用显式7Ω局部斜率外推，不能据此保证实际1N4733输出精度。Power expressions use ideal voltage regulation. The numerical SPICE example explicitly extrapolates a7Ω local slope and does not guarantee actual 1N4733 accuracy.

原节点KCL及功率守恒独立推得各式；示例网表实际DC扫描，与分段线性节点方程独立求解的5V交点及空载值相符，并检查178mA上限。Original-node KCL and power conservation independently give the expressions. The executed illustrative DC sweep agrees with independent piecewise nodal solutions for the 5V intersection and no-load point; the 178mA limit was checked.

先由二极管电流限制反推负载电流Infer allowed load current from zener limits

题目原文Transcribed question

稳压电路如图题3.5.2，VI=10V，R=100Ω，稳压管VZ=5V，IZ(min)=5mA、IZ(max)=50mA。（1）允许RL变化范围？（2）最大输出功率POM？（3）稳压管最大耗散功率PZM和R上最大耗散功率PRM？For Fig. 3.5.2, VI=10V, R=100Ω, VZ=5V, IZ(min)=5mA and IZ(max)=50mA. (1) Find allowed RL; (2) maximum output power; (3) maximum zener and resistor powers.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

本题引用图3.5.2：输入经100Ω到输出，5V稳压管与负载并联。Uses Fig. 3.5.2: input through 100Ω, with the 5V zener and load in parallel.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第121页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 121.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

二极管导通、截止；KCL、KVL；所列简化模型。Diode on and off states; KCL and KVL; the stated simplified models.
稳压时总电流固定50mA，二极管至少保留5mA，故负载最多取45mA。Regulated total current is fixed at 50mA; reserve at least 5mA for the zener, leaving at most 45mA load current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

负载范围Load range

IR=(10−5)100=50mA，故0≤IL≤45mA，空载恰好达到IZ最大值。IR=50mA, so 0≤IL≤45mA; open load exactly reaches maximum zener current.

RL≥50.045=111.111Ω(including open load)

三个最大功率Three maximum powers

负载最大功率在RL最小时；稳压管最大功率在空载；R压降固定5V，耗散不随负载变化。Maximum load power occurs at minimum RL; maximum zener power at open load; resistor drop stays at 5V, so its power is load independent.

POM=5(0.045)=0.225W;PZM=5(0.05)=0.25W;PRM=52100=0.25W

RL≥111.111Ω，允许空载；POM=225mW，PZM=250mW，PRM=250mW。RL≥111.111Ω including open load; POM=225mW, PZM=250mW, PRM=250mW.

易错点Common errors

  • 负载最大功率和稳压管最大功率发生在不同负载条件。Maximum load and zener powers occur at different loads.

核验依据Verification

理想5V稳压，二极管仅在5～50mA范围使用；不计电源、电阻容差。Ideal 5V regulation over the specified 5…50mA range; source and resistor tolerances excluded.

分别在最大负载与空载检查IR=IZ+IL以及VIIR=PR+PZ+PL，两个端点均满足。At both maximum load and open load, checked IR=IZ+IL and VIIR=PR+PZ+PL.

3.5.4全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第88页／PDF第121页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 121. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

由最低输入定R，再用最高输入验功率Set R from minimum input, then check maximum-input power

题目原文Transcribed question

设计一稳压管并联式稳压电路，要求VO=4V、IO=15mA；输入直流VI=6V且有10%波动。试选稳压管型号和合适限流电阻，检验功率定额。Design a shunt-zener regulator with VO=4V and IO=15mA from a6V DC input varying by ±10%. Choose a zener type and series resistor, checking power ratings.

整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

并联稳压；输入上下限；器件容差；额定功率。Shunt regulation; supply extremes; device tolerance; power ratings.
输入范围5.4～6.6V。先为稳压管保留电流，再选R；题目未给输出误差，必须区分教材4V近似与实物3.9V标称。Input spans 5.4…6.6V. Reserve zener current before selecting R. No output tolerance is given, so distinguish a textbook 4V approximation from a nominal 3.9V part.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

教材4V模型的一组设计One design under the textbook 4V model

选R=62Ω，最低输入时IZ=(5.4−4)62−15m≈7.581mA，最高输入时≈26.935mA，均为正且远低于0.5W4V。Choose R=62Ω. Zener current ranges from (5.4−4)62−15m≈7.581mA to 26.935mA, positive and far below 0.5W4V.

IZ,min≈7.58065mA;IZ,max≈26.9355mA

给出实物候选并说明精度Concrete part candidate and accuracy

可用Vishay BZX55C3V9（标称3.9V、0.5W）作约4V方案，配62Ω、0.5W电阻。数据表在5mA测试点的电压档为3.7～4.1V；该器件并不保证4.000V。若要求严格4V，原题缺少误差与温度条件，应选实测4V分档、校准方案，并复核整个工作电流范围，不能把3.9V直接宣称精确4V。Vishay BZX55C3V9 (nominal 3.9V, 0.5W) with a62Ω, 0.5W resistor is an approximately 4V candidate. Its datasheet range at the 5mA test point is 3.7…4.1V; it does not guarantee 4.000V. Strict 4V requires missing tolerance and temperature requirements, screened or calibrated parts, and verification over the operating-current range; nominal 3.9V must not be called exact 4V.

最差功率核验Worst-case power checks

在理想4V模型、15mA负载下，PZ最大≈0.107742W，PR最大≈0.109032W；高输入空载PZ≈0.167742W。若仅作3.7～4.1V恒压档的保守角点核验，带载最小IZ≈5.968mA，PZ≤0.117565W、PR≤0.135645W，空载PZ≤0.173065W；均低于所选0.5W额定。该角点检查不把数据表测试点容差当作全电流范围电压保证。In the ideal 4V model at 15mA load, maximum PZ≈0.107742W and PR≈0.109032W; high-input open-load PZ≈0.167742W. A conservative constant-voltage corner check over 3.7…4.1V gives loaded minimum IZ≈5.968mA, PZ≤0.117565W, PR≤0.135645W and open-load PZ≤0.173065W, below 0.5W ratings. This corner check does not turn test-point tolerance into a full-current voltage guarantee.

一组教材近似设计：约4V、≥0.5W稳压管，R=62Ω0.5W；可选BZX55C3V9作约4V候选，须明确其标称3.9V及精度限制。严格4.000V不能由原题信息或此型号直接保证。One textbook approximate design: approximately 4V zener rated at least 0.5W and R=62Ω0.5W. BZX55C3V9 is an approximately 4V candidate with nominal 3.9V and explicit accuracy limits; strict 4.000V is not guaranteed by this part or the given information.

易错点Common errors

  • 输入最低时仍须给稳压管留电流，不能只按15mA负载算R。Reserve zener current at minimum input; do not size R using load current alone.
  • 型号的标称、容差、测试电流及温度条件都影响实物输出。Nominal voltage, tolerance, test current and temperature all affect real output.

核验依据Verification

教材计算用恒定4V；实物选型仅为约4V候选，0.5W按数据表规定散热条件使用；未声称跨温度、电流、容差保证4V。Textbook calculations use constant 4V. The real part is only an approximately 4V candidate, with 0.5W rating subject to datasheet thermal conditions; no exact 4V guarantee across temperature and current and tolerance is claimed.

按原并联稳压KCL独立检查输入上下限、负载与空载；功率逐角点计算，并检查VZ(6.6−VZ)R在给定电压区间单调下降，最差值发生在3.7V端。Independent shunt-node KCL checks input extremes with load and open load. Power was checked at each corner; VZ(6.6−VZ)R decreases over the stated voltage interval, placing worst-case open-load power at 3.7V.

参考模型依据Model references

  • Vishay · BZX55 voltage bins and thermal ratings
4.1.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 · PDF p. 178. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.1.1Assigned requirement: 4.1.1

从转移曲线判断MOS类型及阈值Read MOS type and threshold from transfer curves

题目原文Transcribed question

图题4.1.1所示为MOS管的转移特性，请分别说明各属于何种类型的MOS管。指出它们的阈值电压各为多少？（图中iD的参考方向为流进漏极。）Fig. 4.1.1 shows MOS transfer characteristics. Identify the type of MOSFET represented by each curve and state its threshold voltage. The reference direction of iD is into the drain.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

三条iD−vGS曲线：(a)iD为正，零电流交点vGS=−3V且vGS=0时仍有正电流；(b)iD为负，零电流交点+2V且vGS=0时有负电流；(c)iD为负，在vGS=−4V进入导通，vGS=0时截止。Three iD versus vGS curves: (a) positive iD, zero-current threshold at −3V and nonzero current at vGS=0; (b) negative iD, threshold at +2V and nonzero current at zero gate voltage; (c) negative iD, onset at −4V and off at zero gate voltage.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

NMOS、PMOS电流方向；增强型、耗尽型定义；阈值电压的带符号值。NMOS and PMOS current directions; enhancement and depletion definitions; signed threshold voltage.
先用漏极电流符号识别NP沟道，再看vGS=0是否已导通识别增强、耗尽，最后读曲线与横轴的阈值交点。Use the drain-current sign to identify NP channel, then inspect conduction at vGS=0 to distinguish enhancement and depletion, and finally read the threshold at the zero-current intercept.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)：正漏极电流且零栅压导通(a): positive drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

电流参考方向流进漏极，正iD对应NMOS。vGS=0时已有电流，故为耗尽型，阈值读为−3V。With iD referenced into the drain, positive current indicates NMOS. Nonzero current at vGS=0 identifies depletion mode, with threshold −3V.

(a) NMOS depletion:VTN=−3V

(b)：负漏极电流且零栅压导通(b): negative drain current and conduction at zero gate voltage

负iD表示实际电流流出漏极，对应PMOS。零栅压仍导通，故为耗尽型；正向栅压增至+2V才截止，阈值+2V。Negative iD means current leaves the drain, identifying PMOS. Conduction at zero gate voltage indicates depletion mode; a positive gate voltage of +2V is needed to cut it off, so the threshold is +2V.

(b) PMOS depletion:VTP=+2V

(c)：负漏极电流且需负栅压开启(c): negative drain current requiring negative gate voltage

负iD对应PMOS。vGS=0时截止，只有栅压低于−4V才导通，因此为增强型PMOS，阈值−4V。Negative iD identifies PMOS. It is off at vGS=0 and turns on only when vGS falls below −4V, so it is an enhancement-mode PMOS with threshold −4V.

(c) PMOS enhancement:VTP=−4V

(a)耗尽型NMOS，VTN=−3V；(b)耗尽型PMOS，VTP=+2V；(c)增强型PMOS，VTP=−4V。(a) Depletion-mode NMOS, VTN=−3V. (b) Depletion-mode PMOS, VTP=+2V. (c) Enhancement-mode PMOS, VTP=−4V.

易错点Common errors

  • PMOS阈值不能一概写成负值，耗尽型PMOS阈值可为正。A PMOS threshold is not always negative; depletion-mode PMOS can have a positive threshold.
  • 阈值读取电流刚消失的横轴交点，不读取纵轴电流截距。Read the threshold from the zero-current gate-voltage intercept, not the drain-current-axis intercept.

核验依据Verification

按图中iD流入漏极的参考方向；以理想转移曲线读取阈值。Drain-current reference is into the drain, as stated; thresholds are read from the ideal transfer curves.

按三项独立特征复核：电流符号确定沟道类型，零栅压是否导通确定增强、耗尽，曲线开始导通方向与阈值符号满足NMOS vGS>VTN、PMOS vGS<VTP。三图均一致。Cross-checked three independent features: current sign identifies channel type, zero-gate conduction identifies enhancement and depletion, and the onset direction agrees with NMOS vGS>VTN or PMOS vGS<VTP. All three curves are consistent.

4.1.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 · PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

从零漏源电压电导求可调电阻Find the adjustable resistance from zero-drain-voltage conductance

题目原文Transcribed question

某增强型NMOS管在较低的vDS电压下工作，以使MOS管工作在可变电阻区。已知Kn′=50μAV2，W=10μm，L=1μm，VTN=1V。当rds0在500Ω到20kΩ之间变化时，求vGS的变化范围。An enhancement NMOS operates at low vDS in the variable-resistance region. Kn′=50μAV2, W=10μm, L=1μm and VTN=1V. Find the vGS range for rds0 from 500Ω to 20kΩ.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
下标0指vDS趋于0时的电阻。先对可变电阻区电流求漏源电导，再反解过驱动电压，别把恒流区平方律当作欧姆定律。The subscript 0 denotes the resistance as vDS tends to zero. Differentiate the triode-region current, then solve for overdrive; the saturation square law is not an Ohmic law.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写可变电阻区电流Write the triode-region current

取k=Kn′WL=500μAV2；题中Kn′不是已含WL与12的Kn。Let k=Kn′WL=500μAV2. Kn′ does not include WL or the saturation factor 12.

iD=k[(vGS−VTN)vDS−vDS22]

在零漏源电压求电阻Evaluate resistance at zero drain voltage

零点的微分电导为k(vGS−VTN)。正的有限电阻要求vGS>VTN。The zero-voltage differential conductance is k(vGS−VTN). A positive finite resistance requires vGS>VTN.

rds0=[∂iD∂vDS|0]−1=1k(vGS−VTN),vGS=1+1(500×10−6)rds0

代入两端并检查小电压条件Evaluate endpoints and check the low-voltage condition

500Ω对应5V，20kΩ对应1.1V；阻值随栅压上升而下降。全范围近似线性电阻需|vDS|远小于最小过驱动0.1V；单说vDS较低不足以保证任意精度。500Ω gives 5V and 20kΩ gives 1.1V. Resistance decreases with gate voltage. For an approximately linear resistor over the whole range, |vDS| must be much smaller than the minimum overdrive 0.1V; an unspecified low voltage does not guarantee any chosen accuracy.

1.1V≤vGS≤5V

vGS范围为1.1～5V；500Ω对应5V，20kΩ对应1.1V。结果为vDS→0的电阻条件。vGS ranges from 1.1 to 5V: 500Ω at 5V and 20kΩ at 1.1V, for resistance in the vDS→0 limit.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要漏乘WL=10，或多乘、漏乘12。Include WL=10 and distinguish triode k from saturation K=k2.
  • rds0与有限vDS下的静态vDSiD并不完全相同。rds0 differs from the static vDSiD at finite vDS.

核验依据Verification

长沟道低场模型，忽略体效应和沟道长度调制，rds0按vDS=0的微分定义。Long-channel low-field model, neglecting body effect and channel-length modulation; rds0 is differential resistance at vDS=0.

用原可变电阻区方程的±h中央差分求导，并分别代入两个栅压核对500Ω和20kΩ；另检查有限漏压的电阻偏差随漏压趋零而消失。Central differences of the original triode equation independently reproduce 500Ω and 20kΩ; finite-drain-voltage resistance errors vanish as drain voltage tends to zero.

4.1.3全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 · PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

耗尽型PMOS：先定电流符号，再求夹断边界Depletion PMOS: establish current sign, then find the pinch-off boundary

题目原文Transcribed question

已知耗尽型PMOS管的参数为Kp=0.2mAV2，VTP=0.5V，iD=−0.5mA（参考方向为流进漏极）。试求此时的夹断点栅源电压vGS和漏源电压vDS。A depletion PMOS has Kp=0.2mAV2, VTP=+0.5V and iD=−0.5mA, referenced into the drain. Find vGS and vDS at the pinch-off boundary.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
耗尽型PMOS的阈值可以为正，不能擅自改成−0.5V。“夹断点”指定恒流区与可变电阻区的边界，而非任意恒流区漏压。A depletion PMOS can have a positive threshold; do not change it to −0.5V. Pinch-off specifies the boundary between triode and saturation, not an arbitrary saturation drain voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

用正的过驱动量求栅压Solve gate voltage with a positive overdrive

PMOS导通要求vGS<VTP。记u=VTP−vGS>0，流进漏极的电流为负。A conducting PMOS requires vGS<VTP. Define u=VTP−vGS>0; drain-entering current is negative.

iD=−Kp(VTP−vGS)2,u=0.50.2=2.5V

选择物理解并写夹断条件Select the physical root and impose pinch-off

应取vGS=VTP−u，另一个平方根分支不满足导通条件。边界处漏栅电压为−VTP=−0.5V。Use vGS=VTP−u; the other square-root branch fails the conduction condition. At pinch-off the drain-to-gate voltage is −VTP=−0.5V.

vGS=0.5−2.5≈−1.081139V,vDS=vGS−VTP=−2.5≈−1.581139V

区别夹断与截止Distinguish pinch-off from cutoff

夹断后仍有−0.5mA恒流区电流；本题理想恒流区满足vDS≤−1.581139V。截止则为vGS≥+0.5V。Pinch-off still supports −0.5mA. Ideal saturation extends to vDS≤−1.581139V at this gate voltage. Cutoff instead requires vGS≥+0.5V.

夹断边界vGS≈−1.081139V，vDS≈−1.581139V；不是截止点。At pinch-off, vGS≈−1.081139V and vDS≈−1.581139V; this is not cutoff.

易错点Common errors

  • iD按流入漏极定义，PMOS正常电流为负。With current referenced into the drain, normal PMOS current is negative.
  • 正阈值是耗尽型PMOS的题设，不能改号。The positive threshold is intentional for the specified depletion PMOS.

核验依据Verification

教材长沟道平方律；Kp已含几何系数和12，忽略沟道长度调制及体效应。Textbook long-channel square law; Kp includes geometry and 12. Channel-length modulation and body effect are neglected.

分别将所得电压代入PMOS恒流区平方律和可变电阻区方程，边界两者均得−0.5mA；检查vD−vG=−0.5V。The PMOS saturation square law and triode equation both give −0.5mA at the boundary; vD−vG=−0.5V is checked separately.

指定要求：4.1.4Assigned requirement: 4.1.4

由迁移率、氧化层电容及宽长比求NMOS电流Find NMOS current from mobility, oxide capacitance and aspect ratio

题目原文Transcribed question

设增强型NMOS管的参数为VTN=1V，W=100μm，L=5μm，μn=650cm2(V·s)，Cox=76.7×10−9Fcm2。已知VGS=2VTN时，MOS管工作在恒流区，试计算此时的电流ID。An enhancement-mode NMOS has VTN=1V, W=100μm, L=5μm, μn=650cm2(V·s), and Cox=76.7×10−9Fcm2. At VGS=2VTN it operates in saturation. Calculate ID.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS饱和区平方律；过驱动电压；单位一致性。MOS saturation square law; overdrive voltage; consistent units.
先算过驱动VGS−VTN和几何比WL，再把迁移率与单位面积电容相乘。直接使用完整平方律，避免不同K定义造成漏掉12。First find overdrive VGS−VTN and aspect ratio WL, then multiply mobility by capacitance per unit area. Use the complete square-law expression to avoid losing the factor 12 under differing K conventions.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定过驱动与宽长比Find overdrive and aspect ratio

VGS=2VTN=2V，故过驱动为1V；W、L同用μm，因此比值为20。VGS=2VTN=2V, giving overdrive 1V. W and L are both in μm, so their ratio is 20.

VOV=VGS−VTN=1V,WL=1005=20

代入饱和区平方律Use the saturation square law

忽略沟道长度调制，恒流区电流为(12)μnCox(WL)VOV2。μn中的cm2与Cox中的cm−2互消。Neglecting channel-length modulation, saturation current is (12)μnCox(WL)VOV2. The cm2 in mobility cancels the cm−2 in oxide capacitance.

ID=12μnCoxWL(VGS−VTN)2

计算并换成mACalculate and convert to mA

代入650、76.7×10−9、20与12，得到4.9855×10−4A，约0.499mA。Substituting 650, 76.7×10−9, 20 and 12 gives 4.9855×10−4A, approximately 0.499mA.

ID=12(650)(76.7×10−9)(20)(1)2=4.9855×10−4A≈0.499mA

检查工作区前提Check the region assumption

题目已经说明处于恒流区，该假设要求VDS≥VGS−VTN=1V。题目未给VDS，因此只能列出这一必要条件，不能编造具体漏源电压。The exercise states saturation operation, which requires VDS≥VGS−VTN=1V. No VDS is supplied, so this condition can be stated but a particular drain-source voltage cannot be invented.

VGS>VTN,VDS≥1V

忽略沟道长度调制，ID=0.49855mA≈0.499mA（约0.50mA）；题设恒流区要求VDS≥1V。Neglecting channel-length modulation, ID=0.49855mA≈0.499mA (about 0.50mA). The stated saturation region requires VDS≥1V.

易错点Common errors

  • 式中已有12，不要因另定义K而再乘或再除一次2。The full equation already contains 12; do not multiply or divide by 2 again when introducing K.
  • 原题Cox为76.7×10−9Fcm2，不能误读成10−8。The original Cox is 76.7×10−9Fcm2, not 10−8.

核验依据Verification

理想长沟道MOS平方律，忽略沟道长度调制；按题设处于恒流区。Ideal long-channel MOS square law, neglecting channel-length modulation, with saturation operation as stated.

第二次独立使用SI单位：μn=0.065m2(V·s)，Cox=7.67×10−4Fm2，代入同一物理模型得到0.00049855A，与cm单位计算一致；并检查过驱动1V为正。Independent SI-unit check: μn=0.065m2(V·s) and Cox=7.67×10−4Fm2. Substitution gives 0.00049855A, matching the cm−unit calculation; the overdrive is also positive at 1V.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 · PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

栅漏短接：何时成立平方律“二极管”Gate–drain connection: when the square-law diode model applies

题目原文Transcribed question

接成“二极管”的MOS管如图题4.1.5所示。（1）试分别说明在什么情况下它们的i–v关系为i=K(v−|VT|)2；（2）为什么可以称它们为“二极管”？（注：VT表示VTN或VTP，K表示Kn或Kp。）图(a)为NMOS栅漏短接，图(b)为PMOS栅漏短接；端口电压上正下负，电流向下。The diode-connected MOS devices in Fig. 4.1.5 use voltage positive at the top and current downward. (1) State when i=K(v−|VT|)2 holds for each. (2) Explain why they are called diodes. VT denotes VTN or VTP and K denotes Kn or Kp. (a) is gate–drain-connected NMOS; (b) is gate–drain-connected PMOS.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

(a)NMOS上端为栅、漏，下端为源及衬底；(b)PMOS上端为源及衬底，下端为栅、漏，两个端口均为上正下负、电流向下。(a) NMOS gate and drain is the upper terminal and source and body the lower. (b) PMOS source and body is upper and gate and drain lower. Both use downward port current and voltage positive at the top.

本题图在书第145页／PDF第178页。The source figure is on printed p. 145 · PDF p. 178.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
先把端口v转为每只管的vGS、vDS，再检查阈值与恒流区条件。栅漏短接本身不能让任意耗尽型MOS都自动满足恒流区平方律。Translate port v into vGS and vDS, then test threshold and saturation. A gate–drain connection alone does not put every depletion MOS in saturation.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1a）增强型NMOS(1a) Enhancement NMOS

VTN>0，且v≥VTN时，vGS=vDS=v。恒流区条件vDS≥vGS−VTN自动满足；阈值以上有向下电流。For VTN>0 and v≥VTN, vGS=vDS=v. Saturation inequality vDS≥vGS−VTN is automatic, giving downward current above threshold.

i=Kn(v−VTN)2=Kn(v−|VTN|)2(v≥VTN>0)

（1b）增强型PMOS(1b) Enhancement PMOS

VTP<0，且v≥−VTP时，vGS=vDS=−v。漏极流入电流iD为负，但端口向下电流i=−iD为正。For VTP<0 and v≥−VTP, vGS=vDS=−v. Drain-entering iD is negative but downward port current i=−iD is positive.

i=−iD=Kp(v+VTP)2=Kp(v−|VTP|)2(v≥|VTP|)

适用区间之外Outside the square-law range

在0≤v<|VT|时，理想增强型沟道截止，不能把平方后的正数当成电流。耗尽型阈值符号相反，栅漏短接的正向工作通常在可变电阻区，不能直接套本式。反向v<0时还需考虑图示衬底与源短接所形成的体二极管，原题未给反向定量模型。For 0≤v<|VT|, an ideal enhancement channel is off; squaring a negative overdrive does not create current. Depletion devices have the opposite threshold sign and generally operate in triode for this positive-port connection. Reverse v<0 additionally involves the source-tied-body diode; the problem supplies no quantitative reverse model.

（2）两端非线性器件(2)A two-terminal nonlinear device

栅漏短接后只剩两个独立端子；正向超过阈值有电流，阈值以下电流近似为零，因而有类似二极管的整流特性。这里的正向沟道特性是平方律，不是PN结指数律，也不是固定0.7V压降。Connecting gate and drain leaves two independent terminals. Current flows above a forward threshold and is approximately zero below it, giving diode-like rectification. The forward channel follows a square law rather than aPN exponential or fixed 0.7V drop.

(a)增强型NMOS且v≥VTN>0；(b)增强型PMOS且v≥|VTP|、VTP<0。两者此时均在恒流区且i=K(v−|VT|)2。因栅漏短接构成两端非线性整流器件，称MOS“二极管”。(a) Enhancement NMOS with v≥VTN>0; (b) enhancement PMOS with VTP<0 and v≥|VTP|. Both then satisfy saturation and i=K(v−|VT|)2. Gate–drain connection creates a two-terminal nonlinear rectifying device.

易错点Common errors

  • 平方律有导通区间，不能延伸到阈值以下。The square law must not be extended below threshold.
  • PMOS端口电流与流入漏极的iD符号相反。PMOS port current has the opposite sign to drain-entering iD.

核验依据Verification

理想增强型长沟道沟道模型，忽略亚阈值电流与沟道长度调制；体二极管反向端口导通只作定性说明，不虚构固定压降。Ideal long-channel enhancement-channel model without subthreshold current or channel-length modulation; reverse-port body-diode conduction is qualitative, without an invented fixed drop.

按原接线分别代入NMOS与PMOS三端电流式，扫描正向端口电压核对工作区及端口电流符号；对耗尽型检验恒流区不等式以排除错误套式。Original three-terminal NMOS and PMOS equations are evaluated over a port-voltage sweep, checking operating region and current signs; depletion-device saturation inequalities are checked to reject an invalid extension.

4.2.1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第145页／PDF第178页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 145 · PDF p. 178. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

判断放大：先查直流通路，再查交流通路Check DC paths before AC signal paths

题目原文Transcribed question

试分析图题4.2.1所示各电路对交流信号有无放大作用，并简述理由（设各电路元件参数合适，电容对交流信号可视为短路）。图含(a)～(e)五个电路。For circuits (a)–(e) in Fig. 4.2.1, determine whether each amplifies an AC signal and briefly explain. Assume suitable component values and capacitors that are short circuits for AC.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

(a)NMOS偏置VGG在输入耦合电容左侧；(b)PMOS源接VDD，栅有电阻分压偏置；(c)NMOS栅直接接VDD；(d)NMOS输入与VGG串联后直接接栅；(e)增强型NMOS栅经电阻接地且源接地。(a) NMOS VGG lies before the input coupling capacitor. (b) PMOS source is at VDD with gate-divider bias. (c) NMOS gate is directly tied to VDD. (d) NMOS gate is directly driven by input plus VGG. (e) Enhancement NMOS gate is resistively grounded and source is grounded.

本题图在书第146页／PDF第179页。The source figure is on printed p. 146 · PDF p. 179.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
“元件参数合适”不能修复缺失的直流通路或被电源短路的交流输入。对每图先把电容开路找Q点，再把电源交流接地。Suitable values cannot repair a missing DC path or an AC input shorted by a supply. Open capacitors to find Q, then AC-ground the supplies.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（a）无可靠线性放大(a) No reliable linear amplification

直流时Cb1开路，VGG被隔断；栅极没有直流偏置通路，理想模型下栅电位未定。不能建立确定的线性静态工作点；实际漏电或初始电荷不是题设偏置。Cb1 is open for DC and disconnects VGG. The gate has no DC bias path and its ideal voltage is undetermined. No defined linear quiescent point is established; unspecified leakage or stored charge is not a bias design.

（b）可以：PMOS共源(b) Yes: PMOS common source

分压电阻给栅静态电位，源接正电源；合适参数使PMOS在恒流区。交流源极接地，栅压上升使PMOS下行电流减小，漏极电压下降，输出反相。The divider biases the gate and suitable values put the PMOS in saturation. Its source is AC-grounded. Rising gate voltage reduces downward PMOS current and lowers the drain voltage, giving inversion.

Av≈−gm(Rd∥ro)(unloaded output)

（c）无交流栅源输入(c) No AC gate–source excitation

栅极直接接理想VDD，是交流地。Cb1把输入接到交流地，vgs交流分量为0；即使直流有漏电流，也无所要求的信号电压放大。The gate is tied directly to ideal VDD, an AC ground. Cb1 therefore connects the input to AC ground and the AC vgs is zero. A possible DC drain current does not create signal amplification.

（d）可以：偏置直接送到栅极(d) Yes: gate receives DC bias directly

VGG与输入串联，直流偏置不被电容隔断；适当Q点下输入直接改变vGS，漏极经Rd将电流变化变为反相电压。VGG is in series with the input and is not blocked by a capacitor. With a suitable Q point, input changes vGS and Rd converts drain-current changes into an inverted voltage.

Av≈−gm(Rd∥ro)(unloaded output)

（e）无小信号线性放大(e) No small-signal linear amplification

图示为增强型NMOS。栅、源的直流电位均为0，VGSQ=0<VTN，管子截止且gmQ=0。大信号可能产生半波式失真导通，但不能算围绕Q点的线性放大。The depicted device is enhancement NMOS. Both gate and source are zero for DC, so VGSQ=0<VTN and gmQ=0.A large input may produce distorted partial-cycle conduction, not linear amplification about Q.

有线性交流放大作用的是(b)、(d)；(a)缺栅极直流偏置通路，(c)栅被电源交流接地，(e)增强型NMOS在零偏置处截止。(b) and (d) can amplify linearly. (a) lacks a gate DC-bias path; (c) has an AC-grounded gate; (e) has a cutoff enhancement NMOS at zero gate bias.

易错点Common errors

  • 耦合电容前的VGG不会穿过电容提供直流栅偏置。VGG before a coupling capacitor cannot bias the gate through it.
  • 静态有电流与交流有增益是两项独立检查。DC current and AC gain are separate checks.

核验依据Verification

图示增强型MOS，理想输入、偏置源；合适的线性Q点和小信号、无额外输出负载。浮置栅不假定未给定的漏电或初始电荷。Depicted enhancement MOS devices and ideal signal and bias sources; suitable linear Q points and small signals, without an extra output load. No unspecified leakage or initial charge is imposed on the floating gate.

逐图按原接线做直流连通性及交流接地检查；对(b)(d)用漏极节点KCL得到负增益，对(c)验证vgs=0，对(e)用分段MOS模型验证gmQ=0。Original wiring is checked for DC connectivity and AC grounding. Drain KCL produces negative gains for (b)(d); (c) enforces zero AC vgs and the piecewise MOS model gives gmQ=0 for (e).

指定要求：4.2.2(1)(3)(5)(7)Assigned requirement: 4.2.2(1)(3)(5)(7)

MOS工作区：先判导通，再比较夹断边界MOS operating regions: check turn-on before the pinch-off boundary

题目原文Transcribed question

测量电路中MOS管的漏源电压、栅源电压值如下，它们的阈值电压也已知，试判断各管工作在什么区域（恒流区、可变电阻区、夹断点或截止区）。设MOS管的衬底电极均与源极并接在一起。 （1）VDS=3V，VGS=2V，VTN=1V；（2）VDS=1V，VGS=2V，VTN=1V；（3）VDS=3V，VGS=1V，VTN=1.5V；（4）VDS=3V，VGS=−1V，VTN=−2V；（5）VDS=−3V，VGS=−2V，VTP=−1V；（6）VDS=3V，VGS=−2V，VTP=−1V；（7）VDS=−3V，VGS=−1V，VTP=−1.5V。Measured MOS drain-source and gate-source voltages, together with known thresholds, are listed below. Determine whether each transistor is in saturation, the variable-resistance region, the pinch-off boundary, or cutoff. Each body is tied to its source. (1)VDS=3V, VGS=2V, VTN=1V. (2)VDS=1V, VGS=2V, VTN=1V. (3)VDS=3V, VGS=1V, VTN=1.5V. (4)VDS=3V, VGS=−1V, VTN=−2V. (5)VDS=−3V, VGS=−2V, VTP=−1V. (6)VDS=3V, VGS=−2V, VTP=−1V. (7)VDS=−3V, VGS=−1V, VTP=−1.5V.

7个小问均已核验；第（6）问给出附模型边界的条件化答案：按本教材式（4.1.11）为可变电阻区，但真实体源相连器件的漏-体结正偏，不能仅用四区近似描述整个器件。All seven parts are checked. Part (6) has a conditional answer with an explicit model limitation: textbook Eq. (4.1.11) classifies it as triode, while a real source-tied-body device has a forward-biased drain-body junction and cannot be described completely by the four-region approximation alone.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

NMOS、PMOS的带符号阈值；过驱动电压；体结偏置。Signed NMOS and PMOS thresholds; overdrive voltage; body-junction bias.
不能把NMOS公式直接套到PMOS上。对正常极性PMOS先改用VSG、VSD和|VTP|；对反常漏源极性另查体结条件。Do not apply NMOS inequalities directly to PMOS. For normally biased PMOS use VSG, VSD and |VTP|; separately inspect body junctions for reversed drain-source polarity.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

NMOS判断规则NMOS decision rule

在通常VDS≥0的条件下，先看VGS是否超过带符号VTN；导通后再比较VDS和VGS−VTN。For normal VDS≥0, first compare VGS with the signed threshold VTN. Once on, compare VDS with VGS−VTN.

VOV=VGS−VTN;VOV<0:cutoff;VDS=VOV:boundary;VDS>VOV:saturation

（1）（2）：同一过驱动，不同VDS(1), (2): same overdrive, different VDS

两题VOV均为1V。（1）3>1，恒流区；（2）1=1，处在夹断边界。Both have VOV=1V. (1) 3>1: saturation. (2) 1=1: pinch-off boundary.

(1)3>2−1=1;(2)1=2−1=1

（3）（4）：负阈值不能漏掉符号(3), (4): retain the sign of a negative threshold

（3）1<1.5，未形成沟道，截止。（4）虽VGS=−1V，但阈值−2V更低，过驱动1V，VDS=3V，故恒流区。(3) 1<1.5: no channel, cutoff. (4)VGS=−1V still exceeds the −2V threshold; overdrive is 1V and VDS=3V, giving saturation.

(3)VOV=−0.5V;(4)VOV=−1−(−2)=1V

（5）（7）：先改成PMOS的正量(5), (7): use positive PMOS magnitudes

（5）VSG=2V>|VTP|=1V，过驱动1V，VSD=3V，恒流区。（7）VSG=1V<1.5V，截止。(5)VSG=2V exceeds |VTP|=1V; its 1V overdrive is below VSD=3V, so it is in saturation. (7)VSG=1V<1.5V: cutoff.

(5)VSD=3>VSG−|VTP|=1;(7)VSG=1<1.5

（6）：按教材判据给出条件化答案，并核对体结(6): give a conditional textbook-model answer and check the body junction

按本教材第97页式（4.1.11）列出的可变电阻区判据，VGS=−2V≤VTP=−1V，且VDS=+3V>VGS−VTP=−1V，因此在该简化判据下答“可变电阻区”。必须同时注明：题设衬底接源，实际PMOS的P型漏区比N型衬底高3V，漏-体PN结正偏。此时不能仅用忽略体结的四区沟道模型描述整个器件；这个教材模型答案不是对真实器件正常偏置状态的无条件判断。原题的正VDS和VTP均保留，不擅自改号或改管型。Using the variable-resistance-region inequalities printed in textbook Eq. (4.1.11), p. 97, VGS=−2V≤VTP=−1V and VDS=+3V>VGS−VTP=−1V. Thus the answer under that simplified criterion is the variable-resistance (triode) region. A qualification is essential: with body tied to source, the actual PMOS P−type drain is 3V above its N−type body, so the drain-body PN junction is forward biased. A four-region channel model that neglects the body junction cannot by itself describe the complete device in this condition. The textbook-model answer is therefore not an unconditional claim about a normally biased real device. Preserve the printed positive VDS and VTP; do not silently change a sign or transistor type.

VGS−VTP=−2−(−1)=−1V;−2≤−1,3>−1⇒triode under Eq. (4.1.11);VDB=VD−VB=VDS=+3V

（1）恒流区；（2）夹断点；（3）截止区；（4）恒流区；（5）恒流区；（6）按本教材式（4.1.11）的简化判据为可变电阻区；真实体源相连PMOS在给定正VDS下漏-体结正偏，须保留此模型适用范围说明；（7）截止区。(1) Saturation. (2) Pinch-off boundary. (3) Cutoff. (4) Saturation. (5) Saturation. (6) Triode under the simplified criterion of textbook Eq. (4.1.11); the real source-tied-body PMOS has a forward-biased drain-body junction at the stated positive VDS, so the model limitation must accompany the answer. (7) Cutoff.

易错点Common errors

  • 负的VGS不必然意味着截止；要与带符号阈值比较。Negative VGS does not automatically mean cutoff; compare it with the signed threshold.
  • 保留原书第（6）问的VTP和正VDS，不擅自修题。Preserve the printed VTP and positive VDS in part (6); do not silently alter the problem.

核验依据Verification

（1）（2）（3）（4）（5）（7）采用本章正常漏源极性下的理想长沟道MOS区域模型。（6）的“可变电阻区”仅指采用本教材式（4.1.11）显式判据、忽略漏-体结电流和正偏体结对沟道近似的影响时的模型分类；真实体源相连的器件在给定+3V漏源偏压下有漏-体结正偏，须另计体二极管及外电路条件。未假设原题印刷错误，也未确定教师的评分答案。Parts (1),(2),(3),(4),(5),(7) use the chapter's ideal long-channel MOS region model under normal drain-source polarity. The triode answer for (6) refers only to applying the explicit criterion of textbook Eq. (4.1.11), neglecting drain-body junction current and the effects of forward body-junction bias on the channel approximation. A real source-tied-body device at the given +3V drain-source bias has a forward-biased drain-body junction and requires body-diode and external-circuit modeling. No printing error or instructor grading decision is assumed.

逐项独立核对沟道形成及夹断条件。第（6）问目视核对原题（印刷145–146页、PDF178–179页），再按印刷97页、PDF130页式（4.1.11）的显式代数判据复算；另对照印刷98页、PDF131页的衬底接最高电位、隔离PN结反偏要求，并用MIT课程讲义及Infineon官方应用笔记交叉核对PMOS体二极管方向。未使用外部习题答案。Independently checked channel formation and pinch-off for every part. For (6), visually verified the printed problem (pp. 145–146 and PDF pp. 178–179), then evaluated the explicit algebraic inequalities of Eq. (4.1.11), printed p. 97 and PDF p. 130. Separately checked the body-at-highest-potential and reverse-biased-isolation-junction requirement on printed p. 98 and PDF p. 131, and cross-checked PMOS body-diode orientation with MIT lecture notes and an official Infineon application note. No external exercise answer key was used.

指定要求：4.2.3Assigned requirement: 4.2.3

固定分压共源极：算偏置后检查恒流区Divider-biased common source: compute bias, then check saturation

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.3.6b所示，设Rg1=90kΩ，Rg2=60kΩ，Rd=30kΩ，VDD=5V，VTN=1V，Kn=0.1mAV2。试计算电路的VGS和VDS。For the circuit in Fig. 4.3.6(b), Rg1=90kΩ, Rg2=60kΩ, Rd=30kΩ, VDD=5V, VTN=1V and Kn=0.1mAV2. Find VGS and VDS.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

分压共源极直流电路：90kΩ自+5V至栅，60kΩ自栅至地；源极及衬底接地，漏极通过30kΩ接+5V。原图标的是通用参数，数值以本题题干为准。DC common-source circuit: 90kΩ from +5V to gate, 60kΩ from gate to ground, grounded source and body, and 30kΩ from +5V to drain. The source figure uses generic labels; use the values in this exercise.

本题图在书第109页／PDF第142页。The source figure is on printed p. 109 · PDF p. 142.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS栅极零直流电流；分压；恒流区平方律；KVL。Zero DC gate current; voltage division; saturation square law; KVL.
栅极分压不被MOS输入加载，先得VGS，再假设恒流区算ID和VDS，最后检查假设。The MOS gate does not load the DC divider. Find VGS, assume saturation to compute ID and VDS, then validate that assumption.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

栅源电压Gate-source voltage

源极接地，栅极电流为零，故下分压电阻60kΩ上的电压就是VGS。The source is grounded and gate current is zero, so VGS is the voltage across the lower 60kΩ divider resistor.

VGS=56090+60=2V

电流和漏源电压Current and drain-source voltage

采用本书Kn定义ID=Kn(VGS−VTN)2，不额外乘12。Use the textbook convention ID=Kn(VGS−VTN)2; do not insert an extra factor of 12.

ID=0.1(2−1)2=0.1mA;VDS=5−0.1×30=2V

回查区域Check the region

VGS>VTN，且VDS=2V超过过驱动1V，恒流区假设成立。VGS exceeds the threshold, and VDS=2V exceeds the 1V overdrive, so saturation is consistent.

2>1,VDS=2>VGS−VTN=1V

VGS=2V，VDS=2V，ID=0.1mA，工作在恒流区。VGS=2V, VDS=2V, ID=0.1mA; saturation.

易错点Common errors

  • 本书Kn已含12；与SPICE参数KP不能直接等同。The textbook Kn already includes 12; it is not the same as SPICE KP.

核验依据Verification

理想长沟道NMOS，忽略沟道长度调制和栅极电流。Ideal long-channel NMOS, neglecting channel-length modulation and gate current.

用分压支路电流5V150kΩ=33.333μA独立回算栅电位；漏极KVL为2+0.1mA×30kΩ=5V；漏端vGD=0V低于阈值，夹断条件成立。Independent divider-current check gives 5V150kΩ=33.333μA and the same gate voltage. Drain KVL is 2+0.1mA×30kΩ=5V. Drain-end vGD=0V is below threshold, consistent with pinch-off.

PMOS分压偏置：保留源漏负号PMOS divider bias: retain signed drain–source voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题4.2.4所示。已知MOS管Kp=4mAV2，λ=0，VTP=−1.5V，电源VDD=18V。现要求MOS管工作在恒流区，静态时IDQ=1mA（按图中向下电流），VDSQ=−9V，Rg1、Rg2支路电流为2μA。（1）确定Rd、Rg1、Rg2；（2）若要保证静态工作在恒流区，Rd的最大值为多少？For Fig. 4.2.4, Kp=4mAV2, λ=0, VTP=−1.5V and VDD=18V. Require saturation, downward quiescent current 1mA, VDSQ=−9V and 2μA in the gate-divider branch. (1) Find Rd, Rg1 and Rg2. (2) Find the maximum Rd compatible with saturation.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

PMOS源和衬底接18V；漏经Rd接地，栅由上端Rg2和下端Rg1分压，输入、输出均经电容耦合。PMOS source and body is at 18V; drain connects through Rd to ground. Rg2 is the upper divider resistor and Rg1 the lower; input and output are capacitively coupled.

本题图在书第146页／PDF第179页。The source figure is on printed p. 146 · PDF p. 179.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
先定VS=18V、VD=VS+VDS，再从电流求VSG；图中Rg2在上、Rg1在下，别按名称猜位置。First set VS=18V and VD=VS+VDS, then infer VSG from current. Rg2 is above the gate and Rg1 below; use the actual diagram.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）漏极电阻(1) Drain resistor

静态电容开路，VD=18−9=9V；向下1mA全部流过Rd。Capacitors are open for DC. VD=18−9=9V, and the downward 1mA all passes through Rd.

Rd=9V1mA=9kΩ

栅压和分压电阻Gate voltage and divider resistors

由I=Kp(VSG−|VTP|)2得过驱动0.5V，VSG=2V、VG=16V。栅不取电流，分压两电阻电流均2μA。I=Kp(VSG−|VTP|)2 gives 0.5V overdrive, VSG=2V and VG=16V. With zero gate current, each divider resistor carries 2μA.

Rg1=16V2μA=8MΩ,Rg2=18−162μA=1MΩ

（2）调Rd至恒流边界(2) Increase Rd to the saturation boundary

栅偏置不变、λ=0，在恒流区电流保持1mA。恒流条件VSD≥VSG−|VTP|=0.5V，故漏电位最多17.5V。With fixed gate bias and λ=0, current stays 1mA in saturation. VSD≥VSG−|VTP|=0.5V limits the drain voltage to 17.5V.

18−(1mA)Rd≥0.5V⇒Rd,max=17.5kΩ

Rd=9kΩ，Rg1=8MΩ，Rg2=1MΩ。恒流区边界最大Rd=17.5kΩ；严格留在恒流区内部应小于该值。Rd=9kΩ, Rg1=8MΩ and Rg2=1MΩ. The saturation-boundary maximum is Rd=17.5kΩ; strict interior operation needs a smaller value.

易错点Common errors

  • VDS=−9V不等于VD=−9V；源为+18V。VDS=−9V does not mean VD=−9V; source is +18V.
  • 增加Rd使漏极上升、VSD下降，因此最终进入可变电阻区。Increasing Rd raises drain voltage and reduces VSD, eventually entering triode.

核验依据Verification

理想长沟道PMOS，λ=0、栅电流0，衬底接源；2μA分压电流独立于漏极支路。Ideal long-channel PMOS, λ=0 and zero gate current, body tied to source; the 2μA divider current is separate from drain current.

由两电阻独立分压重算VG=16V，再用PMOS分段方程核对电流、原Q点及17.5kΩ边界；节点KCL、供电与电阻、MOS功率平衡复核通过。An independent divider calculation gives VG=16V. The piecewise PMOS law verifies current, original Q and the 17.5kΩ boundary; node KCL and supply and resistor and MOS power balance are checked.

4.2.5全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第146页／PDF第179页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 146 · PDF p. 179. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

先读栅极接线，再解四个节点Read the gate connections before solving four nodes

题目原文Transcribed question

求图题4.2.5所示各电路所标节点的电压。已知所有MOS管Kn=0.25mAV2，λ=0，VTN=0.8V。图(a)：漏接+5V、栅接地、源为V1，向下10μA电流源接−5V；(b)：漏接+5V、栅接地、源为V2，向下1mA电流源接−5V；(c)：栅漏短接为V3，源接地，上接来自+5V的1mA电流源；(d)：栅漏短接为V4，源接地，V4经400kΩ接+5V。Find the labeled voltages in Fig. 4.2.5 with Kn=0.25mAV2, λ=0 and VTN=0.8V for all devices. (a) Drain +5V, grounded gate and source V1, 10μA sink to −5V. (b) Drain +5V, gate grounded, source V2, 1mA sink to −5V. (c) Gate and drain V3, grounded source, 1mA source from +5V. (d) Gate and drain V4, grounded source, 400kΩ to +5V.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

四个原电路保留±5V电源、电流源箭头、400kΩ和节点V1～V4；(a)栅接左侧地符号，源为V1，二者未短接。Four source circuits retain ±5V supplies, current arrows, 400kΩ and nodes V1–V4. In (a), the gate connects to the left ground symbol; source V1 is a different node.

本题图在书第147页／PDF第180页。The source figure is on printed p. 147 · PDF p. 180.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.
(a)(b)的栅都接地，由电流决定正的VGS，故源电位为负。每个代数根都必须回查VGS>VTN、饱和条件与电流源端电压。Both (a) and (b) have grounded gates: current sets positive VGS, so the source voltage is negative. Check every root against conduction, saturation and available current-source voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（a）10μA与接地栅极(a)A10μA current and grounded gate

原图栅极接左侧地符号，未接源极。由10μA=0.01mA，过驱动0.010.25=0.2V，VGS=1V；栅为0，所以V1=−1V。VDS=6V大于0.2V，恒流区成立，电流源两端有4V。The gate connects to the left ground symbol, not the source. With 10μA=0.01mA, overdrive is 0.010.25=0.2V and VGS=1V. Grounded gate gives V1=−1V. VDS=6V exceeds 0.2V overdrive and the sink has 4V across it.

V1=−(0.8+0.010.25)=−1V

（b）先求VGS再得源电位(b) Find VGS, then source voltage

向下1mA给VGS=0.8+10.25=2.8V，栅为0故源为−2.8V。VDS=7.8V大于过驱动2V，满足恒流区；电流源剩2.2V电压。A downward 1mA requires VGS=0.8+10.25=2.8V. Grounded gate gives V2=−2.8V. VDS=7.8V exceeds 2V overdrive and the sink has 2.2V across it.

V2=−2.8V

（c）栅漏短接(c) Gate–drain connection

源接地，VGS=VDS=V3。1mA给V3=2.8V；2.8≥2使恒流区成立，上方电流源两端为2.2V。With grounded source, VGS=VDS=V3. The 1mA current gives V3=2.8V, satisfying 2.8≥2V for saturation. The upper current source has 2.2V.

V3=2.8V

（d）电阻负载线与有效根(d) Resistor load line and valid root

电阻电流与沟道电流相等。方程给1V与0.59V两个代数根；0.59V低于阈值，不能用导通平方律，必须舍去。Equate resistor current to channel current. The algebraic roots are 1V and 0.59V; 0.59V is below threshold and invalid for the on-state square law.

5−V4400kΩ=0.25mAV2(V4−0.8)2⇒V4=1V,ID=10μA

(a)V1=−1V；(b)V2=−2.8V；(c)V3=2.8V；(d)V4=1V。(a)V1=−1V; (b)V2=−2.8V; (c)V3=2.8V; (d)V4=1V.

易错点Common errors

  • (a)栅极左下方的横线是地符号，未与源节点连接。The horizontal line below the gate in (a) is a ground symbol, not a wire to the source node.
  • 平方后的低于阈值代数根是伪解。A squared-law root below threshold is extraneous.

核验依据Verification

题给增强型NMOS的理想长沟道模型，λ=0，栅和体电流忽略，衬底与源相接；电流源理想，各解均核对可用端电压。Specified enhancement-NMOS ideal long-channel model, λ=0, zero gate and body current and body tied to source; ideal current sources, with available terminal voltage checked for each solution.

独立采用带截止分支的分段MOS函数，逐节点回代KCL与工作区；(d)另用单调负载线二分法求唯一有效根；(a)按栅极接地原拓扑回代V1=−1V，得到漏电流10μA和零节点残差。An independent piecewise MOS law with cutoff checks each node’s KCL and region. A monotonic load-line bisection finds the unique valid root for (d); (a) is checked with the original grounded gate at V1=−1V, yielding 10μA drain current and zero node residual.

4.3.1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第147页／PDF第180页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 147 · PDF p. 180. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

先画过Q点的交流线，再求反相信号Draw the AC line through Q before finding the inverted signal

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.3.6(a)，MOS输出特性如图题4.3.1。Rg1=180kΩ、Rg2=60kΩ、Rd=10kΩ、RL=20kΩ、VDD=10V。(1)用图解法作直流负载线，确定静态Q值；(2)作交流负载线；(3)当vi=0.5sinωtV时求相应vo波形和电压增益。For Fig.4.3.6(a) with characteristics Fig.4.3.1,Rg1=180kΩ,Rg2=60kΩ,Rd=10kΩ,RL=20kΩ,VDD=10V. (1)Draw the DC load line and find Q. (2)Draw the AC load line. (3)For vi=0.5sinωtV,find the output waveform and voltage gain.

教材原输出特性与相应负载线；数值按图读精度处理。Original output characteristics and load lines; numerical readings retain graph precision.

本题图在书第147页／PDF第180页。The source figure is on printed p. 147 · PDF p. 180.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

共源偏置、直流、交流负载线、Q点连续和输出摆幅。Common-source bias,DC and AC load lines,Q−point continuity and output swing.
电容直流开路、在题设中频交流短路。静态电阻只有Rd，交流负载为Rd∥RL；两条线必须过同一Q点。Capacitors are DC-open and treated as midband AC shorts. DC uses Rd and AC uses Rd∥RL; both lines pass through Q.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1)分压及直流线(1) Divider and DC line

栅电流零，VGSQ=2.5V。直流线与VGS=2.5V平台约0.5mA相交。Zero gate current gives VGSQ=2.5V. Its roughly0.5mA plateau intersects the DC line.

VGSQ=1060180+60=2.5V,VDS=10−(10kΩ)ID,Q≈(5V,0.5mA)

(2)交流线过Q(2) AC line through Q

交流电阻203kΩ，横轴截距253V，而不是10V。下式ID用mA，VDS用V。AC resistance is203kΩ and the voltage-axis intercept253V,not10V. Use mA and V below.

ID=0.5−VDS−5203(mA),Rac=203kΩ

(3)在两端栅压读出摆幅(3) Read the swing at both gate-voltage limits

vgs总量在2～3V间，原图平台电流约0.3～0.7mA；交流输出因此在±43V间。图给出的这些平台近似等间距，故按图解近似为反相正弦。Total vgs spans2–3V,whose plateaus read about0.3–0.7mA. The corresponding output swing is±43V,approximately sinusoidal under the graph’s near-uniform plateau spacing.

vo≈−43sinωtV,Av≈−83≈−2.667

引用的教材图4.3.6(a)：分压栅偏置、源体接地、漏电阻及电容耦合负载。Referenced Fig.4.3.6(a): divider gate bias,grounded source and bulk,drain resistor and capacitor-coupled load.

由原电路方程和图上估读数绘制的负载线；非精确器件拟合。Load lines from original circuit equations and approximate graph readings,not an exact device fit.

Q≈(VGSQ=2.5V,IDQ=0.5mA,VDSQ=5V)；交流线如上；vo≈−1.33sinωtV，Av≈−2.67。曲线读数均为图解近似。Q≈(VGSQ2.5V,IDQ0.5mA,VDSQ5V); AC line as above; vo≈−1.33sinωtV and Av≈−2.67,at graph-reading precision.

易错点Common errors

  • 输出交流量是漏端总电压减5V，不是把总漏端5V当正弦峰值。The output signal is total drain voltage minus5V,not a5V sine peak.

核验依据Verification

由原分压和电阻方程独立核对直流Q点、交流线斜率及输出电压电流增量；原曲线与边界高分辨率再读，数值保留近似。未用虚构平方律去替代给定曲线。Original divider and resistor equations independently check bias,AC slopes and voltage and current increments. High-resolution curve and boundary readings are explicitly approximate; no invented square-law fit replaces the supplied graph.

最大摆幅比较截止与可变电阻区两侧余量Compare cutoff and triode-side margins for maximum swing

题目原文Transcribed question

在题4.3.1所给电路参数条件下，最大不失真输出电压的幅值Vom约为多少？Using the circuit parameters of4.3.1,estimate the maximum undistorted output peak Vom.

教材原输出特性与相应负载线；数值按图读精度处理。Original output characteristics and load lines; numerical readings retain graph precision.

本题图在书第147页／PDF第180页。The source figure is on printed p. 147 · PDF p. 180.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

共源偏置、直流、交流负载线、Q点连续和输出摆幅。Common-source bias,DC and AC load lines,Q−point continuity and output swing.
沿交流线从Q向右到截止、向左到虚线恒流区边界，取两边可用电压余量较小者。Follow the AC line right to cutoff and left to the drawn saturation boundary,then choose the smaller voltage margin.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

截止侧上摆余量Positive-swing cutoff margin

Q在5V、0.5mA；截止时iD=0，漏端可到8.33V。Qis5V,0.5mA. At cutoff,the drain reaches8.33V.

VDS,cutoff=5+0.5(203)=253V,ΔV+=103V

恒流区边界侧下摆余量Negative-swing saturation-boundary margin

从高分辨率原图读边界近(3.1V,0.7mA)与(3.5V,0.9mA)，与交流线交于约3.2V、0.77mA；因此下摆约1.8V先受限。线性插值只是估读工具，不是精确器件参数。The high-resolution boundary near(3.1V,0.7mA) and(3.5V,0.9mA) intersects the AC line around3.2V,0.77mA. The roughly1.8V negative margin limits first; interpolation is a reading aid,not exact device data.

Vom≈min(8.33−5,5−3.2)V≈1.8V

引用的教材图4.3.6(a)：分压栅偏置、源体接地、漏电阻及电容耦合负载。Referenced Fig.4.3.6(a): divider gate bias,grounded source and bulk,drain resistor and capacitor-coupled load.

由原电路方程和图上估读数绘制的负载线；非精确器件拟合。Load lines from original circuit equations and approximate graph readings,not an exact device fit.

最大不失真输出峰值约1.8V，由靠近可变电阻区的负向摆幅限制；图读精度约0.1～0.2V，不报多位精确值。Maximum undistorted output peak is about1.8V,limited by the negative swing toward the triode boundary. Graph resolution is roughly0.1–0.2V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能只用截止侧3.33V，也不能拿直流线去量交流摆幅；真正非线性误差容限未给，数值按教材图解边界准则。Do not use only the3.33V cutoff margin or the DC line. The textbook boundary criterion is used because a numerical distortion tolerance is unspecified.

先读两条线的截距，再恢复电阻Read both line intercepts before recovering resistances

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.3.6(a)，交、直流负载线如图题4.3.3，已知Rg1=200kΩ。求：(1)VGSQ、IDQ、VDSQ；(2)Rg2；(3)Rd、RL；(4)最大不失真输出电压幅值Vom（设vi为正弦）。For Fig.4.3.6(a),DC and AC load lines are shown in Fig.4.3.3 and Rg1=200kΩ. Find (1)VGSQ,IDQ,VDSQ,(2)Rg2,(3)Rd,RL,(4)maximum undistorted output sine peak.

教材原输出特性与相应负载线；数值按图读精度处理。Original output characteristics and load lines; numerical readings retain graph precision.

本题图在书第147页／PDF第180页。The source figure is on printed p. 147 · PDF p. 180.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

共源偏置、直流、交流负载线、Q点连续和输出摆幅。Common-source bias,DC and AC load lines,Q−point continuity and output swing.
图中Q给2V、0.3mA、7.5V。直流横截距12V决定电源，交流横截距10V与Q决定Rac。Qreads2V,0.3mA,7.5V. The DC voltage intercept12V gives the supply; the AC intercept10V and Q give Rac.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1)直接读Q所在曲线(1) Read Q and its gate curve

Q在VGS=2V曲线，虚线给VDS约7.5V、ID约0.3mA。Q is on the VGS2V curve with VDS≈7.5V and ID≈0.3mA.

VGSQ≈2V,IDQ≈0.3mA,VDSQ≈7.5V

(2)用12V分压恢复Rg2(2) Recover Rg2 from the12V divider

源接地，VG=VGS=2V；栅极不分流。Source is grounded and VG=VGS=2V with zero gate current.

Rg2200+Rg2=212⇒Rg2≈40kΩ

(3)分别使用直流和交流线(3) Use the distinct DC and AC lines

直流线纵截距0.8mA，故Rd=120.8=15kΩ；交流Rac=(10−7.5)0.3=253kΩ。The DC current intercept0.8mA gives Rd15kΩ. AC resistance is(10−7.5)0.3=253kΩ.

Rd≈15kΩ,Rac≈253kΩ,RL=RdRacRd−Rac≈18.75kΩ

(4)截止侧先限制对称正弦摆幅(4) Cutoff limits the symmetric sine first

右侧截止只能从7.5升到10V，余量2.5V。对称反向端为5V、0.6mA，仍位于对应VGS约3V曲线的恒流区内。The positive swing reaches cutoff at10Vfrom7.5V,leaving2.5V. The symmetric opposite endpoint is5V,0.6mA,still beyond the knee of the roughly3V gate curve.

Vom≈10−7.5=2.5V

引用的教材图4.3.6(a)：分压栅偏置、源体接地、漏电阻及电容耦合负载。Referenced Fig.4.3.6(a): divider gate bias,grounded source and bulk,drain resistor and capacitor-coupled load.

由原电路方程和图上估读数绘制的负载线；非精确器件拟合。Load lines from original circuit equations and approximate graph readings,not an exact device fit.

Q≈(2V,0.3mA,7.5V)按VGS、ID、VDS顺序；Rg2≈40kΩ、Rd≈15kΩ、RL≈18.75kΩ、Vom≈2.5V，均按图读精度。Q≈(2V,0.3mA,7.5V) in VGS,ID,VDS order; Rg2≈40kΩ,Rd≈15kΩ,RL≈18.75kΩ,Vom≈2.5V,at graph precision.

易错点Common errors

  • 交流截距10V不是电源电压；电源由直流线的12V截距确定。The AC10V intercept is not the supply; use the DC12V intercept.

4.4.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第147页／PDF第180页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 147 · PDF p. 180. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.4.1Assigned requirement: 4.4.1

源极负反馈：分开输入增益与源增益Source degeneration: distinguish input gain from source gain

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.4.6a所示。已知Rd=10kΩ，Rsi=Rs=0.5kΩ，Rg1=165kΩ，Rg2=35kΩ，MOS管参数VTN=0.8V，Kn=1mAV2，λ=0。电路静态工作点处VGS=1.5V。试求电压增益Av=vovi、源电压增益Avs=vovs、输入电阻Ri和输出电阻Ro。For Fig. 4.4.6(a), Rd=10kΩ, Rsi=Rs=0.5kΩ, Rg1=165kΩ, Rg2=35kΩ, VTN=0.8V, Kn=1mAV2 and λ=0. At the bias point VGS=1.5V. Find Av=vovi, Avs=vovs, input resistance Ri, and output resistance Ro.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

源极带未旁路0.5kΩ的NMOS共源电路，漏极10kΩ到正电源；栅极由165kΩ、35kΩ偏置，信号源串0.5kΩ，经耦合电容输入，输出经耦合电容从漏极取出。NMOS common source with an unbypassed 0.5kΩ source resistor, 10kΩ drain resistor, 165kΩ and 35kΩ gate divider, 0.5kΩ signal-source resistance and coupling capacitors at input and output.

本题图在书第114页／PDF第147页。The source figure is on printed p. 114 · PDF p. 147.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS互导；源极负反馈；输入分压；测试源法求输出电阻。MOS transconductance; source degeneration; input division; output-resistance test source.
Rs没有旁路，不能使用−gmRd。先在输入端vi处求增益，再乘信号源内阻造成的分压求Avs。Rs is unbypassed, so −gmRd is not the gain. First find the gain from actual input vi, then include source-resistance division for Avs.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由工作点求gmFind gm from the bias point

过驱动0.7V。由本书平方律求IDQ=0.49mA，互导为1.4 mS。λ=0意味着rds→∞。The overdrive is 0.7V. The textbook square law gives IDQ=0.49mA and gm=1.4 mS. λ=0 makes rds infinite.

IDQ=1(1.5−0.8)2=0.49mA;gm=2Kn(VGSQ−VTN)=1.4mS

写源极反馈关系Write source-feedback equations

中频时电容短路，直流电源交流接地。id=gm(vi−vs′)，源极交流电压vs′=idRs，输出vo=−idRd。At midband, capacitors are shorts and DC supplies are AC grounds. With source-node AC voltage vs′, id=gm(vi−vs′), vs′=idRs and vo=−idRd.

Av=−gmRd1+gmRs=−1.4×101+1.4×0.5=−14017≈−8.23529

输入电阻与源增益Input resistance and source gain

MOS栅极无电流，输入负载是两个偏置电阻并联。源增益还要考虑Rsi=0.5kΩ。The gate draws no current, so input loading is the parallel bias resistors. Source gain also includes Rsi=0.5kΩ.

Ri=165∥35=28.875kΩ;Avs=Av28.87528.875+0.5≈−8.09512

输出电阻Output resistance

求输出电阻时输入信号源置零。λ=0时漏端测试电压不会经rds影响源极，因此受控电流不因测试电压而变化，输出只见Rd。Set the input source to zero. With λ=0, a drain test voltage cannot feed back through rds to the source; the controlled current does not change with that test voltage. The output sees Rd alone.

Ro=Rd=10kΩ

Av≈−8.2353，Avs≈−8.0951，Ri=28.875kΩ，Ro=10kΩ。Av≈−8.2353, Avs≈−8.0951, Ri=28.875kΩ, Ro=10kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • Rs未旁路，分母中的1+gmRs不能省。Rs is not bypassed; retain 1+gmRs.
  • 输入端vi位于Rsi之后，Av与Avs定义不同。Input vi is after Rsi, so Av and Avs have different definitions.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号、题设恒流区工作点、λ=0，无外接负载。Midband small signal, the stated saturation bias point, λ=0, no external load.

独立给输入端1V测试量，联立源极KCL得vs′=717V、vgs=1017V、id=1417mA，输出−14017V；再独立将源信号1V经过Rsi与Ri分压回算Avs。输出端1V测试得0.1mA。An independent 1V input test and source-node KCL give vs′=717V, vgs=1017V, id=1417mA and output −14017V. A separate 1V source test including Rsi and Ri reproduces Avs. A1V output test gives 0.1mA.

4.4.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第147页／PDF第180页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 147 · PDF p. 180. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

PMOS偏置与增益：先声明λ的处理PMOS bias and gain: state how λ is treated

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题4.4.2所示，设所有电容对信号而言都可视为短路。已知MOS管VTP=−0.4V，Kp=0.8mAV2，λ=0.02V−1。试求：（1）IDQ和VDSQ；（2）电压增益Av=vovi。图中Rs=1.2kΩ接+3V，Rd=2kΩ接−3V，Rg=100kΩ接地，源极有旁路电容Cs。For Fig. 4.4.2, all capacitors are shorts for signals. The MOS parameters are VTP=−0.4V, Kp=0.8mAV2 and λ=0.02V−1. Find (1)IDQ and VDSQ and (2)Av=vovi. Rs=1.2kΩ connects to +3V, Rd=2kΩ to −3V, Rg=100kΩ to ground, and Cs bypasses the source.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

PMOS源经1.2kΩ接+3V并经Cs交流接地；栅由耦合电容接vi，100kΩ接地；漏经2kΩ接−3V并经电容输出vo，iD图示方向向下。PMOS source connects through 1.2kΩ to +3V and is AC-grounded by Cs. The gate is AC-coupled to vi and grounded through 100kΩ. The drain connects through 2kΩ to −3V and is AC-coupled to vo; the indicated drain-branch current is downward.

本题图在书第148页／PDF第181页。The source figure is on printed p. 148 · PDF p. 181.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

PMOS电压参考；电容直流开路、交流短路；由器件电流偏导得到gm和ro。PMOS voltage references; capacitors open for DC and short for AC; gm and ro from terminal-current derivatives.
用正的源到漏电流I书写偏置，VDS仍按漏减源为负。主结果在直流与小信号中一致保留题给λ；另列教材常用的直流忽略λ近似，不能混用两套模型的中间量。Write bias with positive source-to-drain current I while keeping VDS negative. The main result consistently retains λ for both DC and small signals. The common DC-neglects−λ approximation is listed separately; do not mix intermediate values from the two models.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）原节点直流关系(1) Original DC node relations

直流耦合与旁路电容均开路，栅电位为0。以下I用mA、电阻用kΩ，电压自然为V。图中向下支路电流大小I为正，若定义流入PMOS漏极则iD=−I。All capacitors are open for DC and VG=0. Use I in mA and resistance in kΩ below, giving volts. Downward branch-current magnitude I is positive; a drain-entering PMOS current reference would be −I.

VS=3−1.2I,VD=−3+2I,VSG=3−1.2I,VSD=6−3.2I

保留λ求物理解Retain λ and select the physical root

采用I=Kp(VSG−|VTP|)2(1+λVSD)。求根后必须满足VSG>0.4且VSD≥VSG−0.4；其余两个三次方程根不符合正常偏置。Use I=Kp(VSG−|VTP|)2(1+λVSD). Enforce VSG>0.4 and VSD≥VSG−0.4 after root finding; the other two cubic roots are not valid normal-bias solutions.

I=0.8(2.6−1.2I)2[1+0.02(6−3.2I)]⇒I≈1.177498mA

回查工作区和极性Check region and polarity

得到VS≈1.587003V、VD≈−0.645004V，所以VDSQ≈−2.232007V。VSG≈1.587003>0.4，VSD≈2.232007大于过驱动1.187003V，恒流区成立。VS≈1.587003V and VD≈−0.645004V give VDSQ≈−2.232007V. VSG≈1.587003 exceeds 0.4 and VSD≈2.232007 exceeds the 1.187003V overdrive, confirming saturation.

IDQ≈1.177498mA downward,VDSQ≈−2.232007V

（2）电流偏导求小信号参数(2) Derive small-signal parameters from current derivatives

源极旁路使交流源电位为0，双电源都为交流地。保留同一模型的偏导：gm=2KpVOV(1+λVSD)，gds=λKpVOV2。ro=(1+λVSD)(λI)，不是不加说明地当成精确1(λI)。The bypassed source and both supplies are AC ground. Differentiate the same model: gm=2KpVOV(1+λVSD), gds=λKpVOV2. Thus ro=(1+λVSD)(λI); 1(λI) alone is an approximation.

gm≈1.983985mS,gds≈0.02254361mS,ro≈44.35848kΩ

漏极KCL给反相增益Drain KCL gives inverting gain

输出没有额外负载，输入vi直接为栅极交流电压。栅压上升使PMOS向下电流减小，输出漏压下降，所以增益为负。There is no extra output load and vi is the gate’s AC voltage. Rising gate voltage reduces downward PMOS current and lowers the drain voltage, so gain is negative.

(1Rd+gds)vo+gmvi=0,Av=−gm(Rd∥ro)≈−3.796784

常用工程近似另列State the common engineering approximation separately

若静态计算忽略λ，则I≈1.162234mA，VDSQ≈−2.280850V；再用gm≈2KpVOV≈1.928510 mS与ro≈1(λI)≈43.02058kΩ，得Av≈−3.685675（约−3.7）。这是一套常用近似，并非前面完整含λ模型的同一精确结果。If λ is neglected in DC, I≈1.162234mA and VDSQ≈−2.280850V. With gm≈2KpVOV≈1.928510 mS and ro≈1(λI)≈43.02058kΩ, Av≈−3.685675 (about −3.7). This is a common approximation, not the exact result of the full λ model above.

一致保留λ：IDQ≈1.177498mA（按图向下），VDSQ≈−2.232007V，Av≈−3.796784。若采用静态忽略λ的常用近似：1.162234mA、−2.280850V及约−3.685675；两套处理方式分别说明。Consistently retaining λ gives IDQ≈1.177498mA downward, VDSQ≈−2.232007V and Av≈−3.796784. The explicitly separate DC-neglects−λ approximation gives 1.162234mA, −2.280850V and gain about −3.685675.

易错点Common errors

  • 图中PMOS向下电流为正的大小，与“流入漏极为正”的参考符号不同。The positive downward branch-current magnitude differs from a drain-entering current reference.
  • Cs旁路Rs只对交流有效；直流仍须经过Rs求偏置。Cs bypasses Rs only for AC; DC bias still includes Rs.
  • ro不是Rs，也不是漏极电阻Rd。ro is neither source resistor Rs nor drain resistor Rd.

核验依据Verification

教材长沟道PMOS模型；Kp已含12，衬底接源，栅电流0，电容为理想交流短路，主结果保留λ；ro与gm均由同一模型求导。未给频率和电容值，不估计实际带宽。Textbook long-channel PMOS, Kp includes 12, body tied to source and zero gate current. Capacitors are ideal AC shorts. Main values retain λ, with ro and gm derived from the same model. No actual bandwidth is inferred without capacitor values or frequency.

独立用区间二分及三次多项式全部根核对直流物理解，检查源、漏节点KCL与双电源功率；对完整端电流分别做栅压、漏压中央差分求gm、gds，原漏极节点扰动给同一增益。另复算静态忽略λ的近似值。Independent bisection and all cubic roots identify the physical bias, with source and drain KCL and dual-supply power balance. Central differences of the full terminal current independently recover gm and gds; original drain-node perturbations recover gain. The DC-neglects−λ approximation is separately recomputed.

题目原文Transcribed question

已知电路参数如图题4.4.3所示，MOS管工作点上的互导gm=1 mS，设rds≫Rd。（1）画出电路的小信号等效电路；（2）求电压增益Av；（3）求电路的输入电阻Ri和输出电阻Ro；（4）设输入信号vi为正弦波，其频率为1kHz、幅值为10mV，MOS管参数设置为KP=110μAV2，W=40μm，L=2μm，VTO=1.7V，试用SPICE观测vi、vo波形。 图中：VDD=20V，Rd=10kΩ，Rg1=300kΩ，Rg2=100kΩ，Rg3=2MΩ，R1=2kΩ，R2=10kΩ，C1=0.02μF，C2=4.7μF，C=47μF。Use the component values in Fig. 4.4.3, with bias-point gm=1 mS and rds≫Rd. (1) Draw the small-signal equivalent. (2) Find voltage gain Av. (3) Find input resistance Ri and output resistance Ro. (4) With sinusoidal vi of frequency 1kHz and amplitude 10mV, use SPICE to observe vi and vo, setting KP=110μAV2, W=40μm, L=2μm and VTO=1.7V. Figure values: VDD=20V; Rd=10kΩ; Rg1=300kΩ; Rg2=100kΩ; Rg3=2MΩ; R1=2kΩ; R2=10kΩ; C1=0.02μF; C2=4.7μF; C=47μF.
