NMOS漏极接10kΩ到20V；源极经R1=2kΩ、R2=10kΩ串联接地，47μF只旁路R2。栅极通过2MΩ接300kΩ100kΩ偏置分压点。输入电容0.02μF，输出电容4.7μF。NMOS drain through 10kΩ to 20V; source through series R1=2kΩ and R2=10kΩ to ground, with 47μF bypassing only R2. Gate through 2MΩ to a300kΩ and 100kΩ bias divider. Input capacitor 0.02μF; output capacitor 4.7μF.

本题图在书第148页／PDF第181页。The source figure is on printed p. 148 · PDF p. 181.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

交流等效；源极负反馈；偏置网络输入负载；SPICE参数定义。AC equivalent circuits; source degeneration; bias-network input loading; SPICE parameter conventions.
先沿原图连接找节点。C只旁路R2；Rg3的下端接偏置分压点，它和R1R2之间的节点没有连接。Trace the actual nodes first. C bypasses only R2. The lower end of Rg3 connects to the bias divider, not the junction of R1 and R2.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）画小信号等效(1) Draw the small-signal equivalent

中频时三个电容短路，VDD交流接地；R2被旁路，保留源极R1=2kΩ。栅极经Rg3=2MΩ和(Rg1∥Rg2)=75kΩ串联接地；漏极为10kΩ接地。MOS用漏到源受控电流源gmvgs代替，忽略rds。附图按这些节点绘制。At midband the three capacitors are shorts and VDD is AC ground. R2 is bypassed; R1=2kΩ remains. The gate connects to ground through Rg3=2MΩ in series with Rg1∥Rg2=75kΩ. The drain has 10kΩ to ground. Replace MOS with the drain-to-source controlled current gmvgs and omit rds. The attached equivalent follows these nodes.

Rg1∥Rg2=300∥100=75kΩ

（2）求增益(2) Find gain

输入vi就是交流栅电位。源极R1造成局部反馈，交流漏电流为gmvi(1+gmR1)。Input vi is the AC gate voltage. Source resistor R1 produces local feedback, giving AC drain current gmvi(1+gmR1).

Av=−gmRd1+gmR1=−1×101+1×2=−103≈−3.33333

（3）求输入、输出电阻(3) Find input and output resistances

栅极不吸收电流，但Rg3中有流向偏置网络的输入电流，因此Ri要包含Rg3与并联分压电阻的串联。忽略rds时输出只见Rd。The gate draws no current, but Rg3 carries input current into the bias network. Therefore Ri includes Rg3 in series with the parallel divider. Neglecting rds, the output sees Rd.

Ri=2MΩ+75kΩ=2.075MΩ;Ro=10kΩ

（4）实际SPICE波形与解析交叉检查(4) Executed SPICE waveforms and analytical cross-check

使用下方原图网表实际运行ngspice 47（LEVEL=1，λ=0），得到VGQ=5V、VSQ≈2.83645V、VDQ≈17.6363V、IDQ≈0.2363705mA及gm≈1.019819 mS。输入为1kHz、10mV峰值正弦波；对7–10ms输出拟合基波，峰值约33.54885mV，相位约−179.715°，近似反相。保留所有电容的1kHz小信号AC结果为−3.35500−j0.0166784，独立节点方程得到相同结果。前3问按题给gm=1 mS计算，第4问由指定模型自行产生Q点和gm，不能强行令二者相同。图中为实际瞬态数据，拟合残差RMS约0.01414mV，包含微小非线性与启动余量。The attached circuit was run in ngspice 47 (LEVEL=1, λ=0), producing VGQ=5V, VSQ≈2.83645V, VDQ≈17.6363V, IDQ≈0.2363705mA and gm≈1.019819 mS. The input is a1kHz sine with 10mV peak amplitude. A fundamental fit over 7–10ms gives output peak amplitude about 33.54885mV and phase about −179.715°, approximately inverted. AC analysis retaining every capacitor gives −3.35500−j0.0166784 at 1kHz, reproduced by independent nodal equations. Parts (1)–(3) use the stated 1 mS; part (4) derives its own bias and gm from the specified model. The plot contains actual transient data. The fit residual RMS is about 0.01414mV, including slight nonlinearity and startup residue.

IDQ=1.1(5−12IDQ−1.7)2[IDQ in mA];Av(1kHz)≈−3.35500−j0.0166784;|vo1|≈33.54885mV

中频等效图：栅经2MΩ串75kΩ接地；源极2kΩ接地；漏极10kΩ接地，漏到源受控电流源gmvgs，输出在漏极。Midband equivalent: gate through 2MΩ plus 75kΩ to ground, source through 2kΩ to ground, drain through 10kΩ to ground, drain-to-source controlled current gmvgs, and output at drain.

ngspice 47实际瞬态波形，7–10ms窗口；输入10mV峰值、输出约33.55mV峰值，1kHz，近似反相。Actual ngspice 47 transient waveforms over 7–10ms: input 10mV peak, output about 33.55mV peak, 1kHz, approximately inverted.

（1）见小信号等效图；（2）Av=−103≈−3.3333；（3）Ri=2.075MΩ，Ro=10kΩ；（4）已执行ngspice 47：1kHz、10mV峰值输入，输出基波峰值约33.54885mV，相位约−179.715°，近似反相；见实际波形与网表。(1) See the equivalent. (2)Av=−103≈−3.3333. (3)Ri=2.075MΩ, Ro=10kΩ. (4) Executed in ngspice 47: a1kHz, 10mV peak input yields about 33.54885mV output fundamental peak with phase about −179.715°, approximately inverted. See the actual waveforms and netlist.

易错点Common errors

  • Rg3不接R1R2节点；Ri不是2MΩ，也不是75kΩ。Rg3 is not connected to the R1R2 junction; Ri is neither 2MΩ alone nor 75kΩ.
  • SPICE KP是μCox；本书Kn还含W(2L)。SPICE KP is μCox; textbook Kn additionally contains W(2L).

核验依据Verification

第1–3问为中频小信号、gm=1 mS，rds→∞；第4问采用题设SPICE参数、LEVEL=1、λ=0，无额外寄生参数。输出1TΩ仅提供数值直流通路，相对10kΩ对交流影响可忽略。Parts (1)–(3): midband, gm=1 mS, rds→∞. Part (4): specified SPICE parameters, LEVEL=1, λ=0, no added parasitic parameters. A1TΩ output resistor supplies a numerical DC path with negligible AC loading relative to 10kΩ.

第1–3问独立列源、漏节点KCL，1V输入给vs=23V、id=13mA、vo=−103V，输入电流1V2.075MΩ≈0.481928μA；输出1V测试给0.1mA。第4问实际ngspice 47直流、AC及瞬态运行均成功；以独立6节点复数导纳矩阵保留C1、C2、旁路C与Rg3、分压网络，得到1kHz增益−3.35499766−j0.01667836，KCL残差小于7×10−18A。瞬态输出7–10ms用正弦、余弦及常数最小二乘拟合，基波幅值与AC×10mV相差约0.0046%。Parts (1)–(3): independent source and drain KCL gives vs=23V, id=13mA and vo=−103V for a1V input; input current is 1V2.075MΩ≈0.481928μA. A1V output test gives 0.1mA. Part (4): actual ngspice 47 operating-point, AC and transient runs succeeded. An independent six-node complex admittance matrix retains C1, C2, bypass C and the Rg3 and divider network, reproducing gain −3.35499766−j0.01667836 at 1kHz with KCL residual below 7×10−18A. A least-squares sine and cosine and constant fit over 7–10ms differs from AC gain times 10mV by about 0.0046%.

画交流等效时，电源与电容先正确替换Replace supplies and capacitors before drawing AC equivalents

题目原文Transcribed question

设电路中各电容对交流信号均可视为短路。试分别画出图题4.4.4所示电路的小信号等效电路。Treat all capacitors as AC shorts and draw the small-signal equivalents for all circuits in Fig.4.4.4.

三种原图包含源随、共栅和漏栅电阻反馈共源电路，体均接源。Three original circuits: follower, common gate and resistor-feedback common source, with bulk tied to source.

本题图在书第148页／PDF第181页。The source figure is on printed p. 148 · PDF p. 181.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

长沟道模型、静态工作区、交流伴随模型、栅极零电流及节点法；保留题设与近似的区别。Long-channel models, DC region checks, small-signal equivalents, zero gate current and nodal analysis; distinguish given data from approximations.
三图分别为源极跟随器、共栅与漏栅反馈共源。独立直流电压源接交流地，MOS换成gmvgs电流源和ro；体源短接消除体效应。The circuits are follower, common gate and feedback common source. Ground DC voltage sources and replace MOS by gmvgs and ro; bulk-source ties eliminate body effect.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)源极输出(a) Source output

漏极直接交流接地，ro从源到地；Rs也从源到地。栅由vs经Rsi激励，VGG置零，栅本身不吸电流。The drain is AC ground, placing ro and Rs from source to ground. Gate is driven through Rsi and VGG is zeroed.

(gm+gds+1Rs)vo=gmvg,vgs=vg−vo

(b)共栅源极输入(b) Source input with grounded gate

栅接交流地，输入直接在源极，vgs=−vi。ro仍跨漏源，不能错误接成漏到地；Rd从漏到地。Gate is AC-grounded and input is the source, so vgs=−vi. ro remains between drain and source; Rd is drain-to-ground.

voRd+gds(vo−vi)−gmvi=0

(c)保留漏栅反馈电阻(c) Retain drain-gate feedback

源和体接地，输入电容短接到栅，输出电容短接到漏。Rg1在漏与栅之间，Rg2从栅到地；Rd、ro和受控源从漏到地。图示给出全部连接。Source and bulk are grounded. Rg1 remains drain-to-gate and Rg2 gate-to-ground, with Rd,ro and the controlled source connected from drain to ground.

voRd+gdsvo+gmvi+vo−viRg1=0

三组交流等效电路；保留ro和漏栅反馈支路，体源短接时无gmb项。Three AC equivalents retaining ro and drain-gate feedback, with no body-effect term when bulk and source are tied.

三幅小信号等效图见配图；ro可在明确忽略沟道长度调制时取∞。All three equivalents are drawn below; set ro→∞ only when explicitly neglecting channel-length modulation.

易错点Common errors

  • 电阻Rg1跨漏栅，不能同Rg2直接并联到地；(b)的ro不能误接地。Do not ground drain-gate feedback or misconnect common-gate ro.

核验依据Verification

独立按原拓扑盖印MOSJFET小信号节点方程，用直流原方程、工作区、测试源和功率复核。图读估计、有限输出电阻缺参及设计非唯一性分别注明；未称已查阅完整答案库。Independent original-topology MOSJFET nodal stamps check DC equations, operating regions, test-source resistances and power. Graph estimates, unspecified output resistance and nonunique designs are explicitly qualified; no unread answer-key comparison is claimed.

恒流源定偏置，交流旁路只短掉它两端The current source fixes bias while bypassing only its own terminals

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题4.4.5所示，设所有电容对信号而言可视为短路。已知VDD=VSS=12V、Rg=1MΩ、Rd=10kΩ、Rs=1kΩ、Rsi=100kΩ、RL=30kΩ。MOS管VTN=1V、Kn=1mAV2、λ=0。求Av=vovi、Avs=vovs、输入电阻Ri和输出电阻Ro。For Fig.4.4.5, capacitors are AC shorts. VDD=VSS=12V,Rg=1MΩ,Rd=10kΩ,Rs=1kΩ,Rsi=100kΩ,RL=30kΩ,VTN=1V,Kn=1mAV2,λ=0. Find Av,Avs,Ri,Ro.

1mA源位于源极1kΩ电阻下方，Cs只跨电流源，输出经耦合电容接30kΩ。The1mA source is below the1kΩ source resistor, with Cs only across the source; output is coupled to30kΩ.

本题图在书第149页／PDF第182页。The source figure is on printed p. 149 · PDF p. 182.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

长沟道模型、静态工作区、交流伴随模型、栅极零电流及节点法；保留题设与近似的区别。Long-channel models, DC region checks, small-signal equivalents, zero gate current and nodal analysis; distinguish given data from approximations.
图中1mA源定静态电流；Cs跨该电流源，不跨上方Rs，所以1kΩ源退化仍保留在交流回路。The1mA source fixes DC current. Cs bypasses that source, not the resistor above it, so1kΩ degeneration remains.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

静态点和跨导Bias and transconductance

栅0V，ID=1mA，Vov=1V，VGS=2V，源−2V、漏2V，VDS=4V满足恒流区。At1mA, Vov=1V,VGS=2V, source−2V and drain2V, giving VDS=4V in saturation.

gm=2KnID=2mS

带源退化的增益Gain with source degeneration

有效漏负载10∥30=7.5kΩ，分母1+gmRs=3。The drain load is7.5kΩ and degeneration denominator3.

Av=−gm(Rd∥RL)1+gmRs=−5,Avs=AvRgRg+Rsi=−5011

输入与输出电阻Input and output resistance

栅无电流，输入为Rg；输出电阻去掉负载、信号置零，λ=0使ro∞。Gate current is zero. Remove the load and zero input for output resistance; λ=0 gives infinite device ro.

Ri=1MΩ,Ro=Rd=10kΩ

Av=−5，Avs=−5011≈−4.54545，Ri=1MΩ，Ro=10kΩ。Av=−5,Avs=−5011≈−4.54545,Ri=1MΩ,Ro=10kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要把Cs误读为把Rs一起旁路；这会错误去掉分母3。Do not bypass Rs along with the current source or the denominator3 is lost.

核验依据Verification

独立按原拓扑盖印MOSJFET小信号节点方程，用直流原方程、工作区、测试源和功率复核。图读估计、有限输出电阻缺参及设计非唯一性分别注明；未称已查阅完整答案库。Independent original-topology MOSJFET nodal stamps check DC equations, operating regions, test-source resistances and power. 4.5.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第148页／PDF第181页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 148 · PDF p. 181. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：4.5.1（源电压增益不要求）Assigned requirement: 4.5.1 (source voltage gain not required)

源极跟随器：先剔除平方方程的无效根Source follower: reject the invalid square-law root first

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.5.1a所示，设电路参数为VDD=12V，Rg1=150kΩ，Rg2=450kΩ，Rs=1kΩ，Rsi=10kΩ。MOS管参数为VTN=1.5V，Kn=2mAV2，λ=0。试求（1）静态工作点Q；（2）电压增益Av和源电压增益Avs；（3）输入电阻Ri和输出电阻Ro。For Fig. 4.5.1(a), VDD=12V, Rg1=150kΩ, Rg2=450kΩ, Rs=1kΩ and Rsi=10kΩ. MOS parameters: VTN=1.5V, Kn=2mAV2, λ=0. Find (1) the bias point Q; (2) voltage gain Av and source voltage gain Avs; (3) input resistance Ri and output resistance Ro.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

NMOS共漏极源极跟随器：漏极接12V，源极经1kΩ接地并取输出；栅极150kΩ上拉、450kΩ下拉，10kΩ内阻信号源通过耦合电容接栅。NMOS source follower: drain at 12V, source through 1kΩ to ground with output at source, gate divider 150kΩ upper and 450kΩ lower, and input through a coupling capacitor from a source with 10kΩ resistance.

本题图在书第121页／PDF第154页。The source figure is on printed p. 121 · PDF p. 154.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

栅极分压；源极跟随器平方律偏置；过驱动正值；小信号KCL。Gate divider; square-law source-follower bias; positive overdrive; small-signal KCL.
先把ID写成源极电压反馈后的平方方程。平方会产生不满足VGS>VTN的根，必须筛选。再由有效工作点求gm。Write the square-law equation including source-voltage feedback. Squaring can produce a root with VGS below threshold; reject it before finding gm.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）分压及偏置方程(1) Divider and bias equation

栅极电位9V，源极电位为IDRs。若ID用mA表示，则VGS=9−ID。Gate voltage is 9V and source voltage is IDRs. With ID in mA, VGS=9−ID.

VG=12450150+450=9V;ID=2(7.5−ID)2[ID in mA]

选择物理根并核对恒流区Choose the physical root and check saturation

两根约5.79744、9.70256mA。第二根使VGS−VTN<0，不能使用导通平方律，舍去。有效根给VGS≈3.20256V、VDS≈6.20256V；VDS大于过驱动1.70256V，恒流区成立。The roots are about 5.79744 and 9.70256mA. The second has negative overdrive, so the on-state square law does not apply and that root is rejected. The valid root gives VGS≈3.20256V and VDS≈6.20256V, exceeding the 1.70256V overdrive.

IDQ=31−614≈5.79744mA;VGSQ≈3.20256V;VDSQ≈6.20256V

（2）求两种增益(2) Find both gains

互导约6.81025 mS。源极跟随器同相且电压增益小于1。源电压增益另考虑10kΩ信号源内阻。课程不要求源电压增益，但为完整覆盖教材小问仍给出。Transconductance is about 6.81025 mS. The source follower is non-inverting with gain below one. Source gain also includes the 10kΩ source resistance. Although the course excludes Avs for this exercise, it is included to complete the textbook part.

gm=2Kn(VGSQ−VTN)≈6.81025mS;Av=gmRs1+gmRs≈0.871963;Avs=Av112.5112.5+10≈0.800782

（3）求输入输出电阻(3) Find input and output resistances

输入是偏置电阻并联。求输出电阻时信号源置零、输入端栅极交流接地，在源极加测试电压，测试电流为vtRs+gmvt。Input resistance is the parallel bias resistors. For output resistance, zero the source and AC-ground the gate. A source-node test voltage draws vtRs+gmvt.

Ri=150∥450=112.5kΩ;Ro=Rs∥1gm=10001+6.81025≈128.037Ω

（1）IDQ≈5.79744mA，VGSQ≈3.20256V，VDSQ≈6.20256V；（2）Av≈0.871963，Avs≈0.800782；（3）Ri=112.5kΩ，Ro≈128.037Ω。(1)IDQ≈5.79744mA, VGSQ≈3.20256V, VDSQ≈6.20256V. (2)Av≈0.871963, Avs≈0.800782. (3)Ri=112.5kΩ, Ro≈128.037Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能只看到平方方程两根都为正就全保留；还要检查过驱动为正。Two positive roots are not both valid; require positive overdrive.
  • 求Ro时不能保留外部信号，也不能把源极Rs遗漏。Zero the signal when finding Ro and retain the source resistor Rs.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号、λ=0、无额外输出负载、衬底接源。Midband small signal, λ=0, no additional output load, body tied to source.

将有效ID代回直流平方律、栅源电压和漏源KVL，残差在浮点精度内。独立用源节点测试KCL gm(1−vs)=vsRs重求Av，输出测试KCL重求Ro；0<Avs<Av<1，满足跟随器物理趋势。Substitution into the DC square law and gate and source and drain KVL gives floating-point residuals. Independent source-node KCL gm(1−vs)=vsRs reproduces Av, and an output test reproduces Ro. The ordering 0<Avs<Av<1 matches a follower.

ID=1mA，Vov=1V，VGS=2.2V，源−2.2V，VDS=7.2V≥1V。ID=1mA gives Vov=1V,VGS=2.2V, source−2.2V and VDS=7.2V≥1V.

gm=2mS

带载时gm(vi−vo)=voRL；输出测试输入为零。Loaded source KCL is gm(vi−vo)=voRL. Ground input for the output test.

Av=gmRL1+gmRL=89,Ro=1gm=500Ω

5mA源从+5V向下供源极，PMOS漏接−5V，源极耦合输出到1kΩ。A5mA source from+5V feeds the PMOS source; drain is−5V and output is source-coupled to1kΩ.

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.5.4所示。I=1mA、VDD=VSS=12V、Rg=100kΩ、Rd=10kΩ、RL=1kΩ、Rsi=1kΩ，MOS管VTN=1V、Kn=1mAV2、λ=0。求：(1)输入电阻Ri和输出电阻Ro；(2)电压增益Av=vovi和电流增益Ai=ioii。For Fig.4.5.4,I=1mA,VDD=VSS=12V,Rg=100kΩ,Rd=10kΩ,RL=1kΩ,Rsi=1kΩ,VTN=1V,Kn=1mAV2,λ=0. Find (1)Ri,Ro and (2)Av=vovi,Ai=ioii.

栅极Rg由Cg旁路，输入源串Rsi耦合到源极，漏端Rd与RL作负载。Gate Rg is bypassed by Cg. The source input is driven through Rsi, with Rd and RL at the drain.

输入输出电阻Input and output resistances

Ri=1gm=500Ω,Ro=Rd=10kΩ

同相电压增益和电流分流Non-inverting voltage gain and current division

输出电流只取流过RL的部分，不是全部漏极信号电流。Output current is only the part through RL, not the entire drain signal current.

Av=gm(Rd∥RL)=2011,Ai=RdRd+RL=1011

Ri=500Ω，Ro=10kΩ，Av=2011≈1.81818，Ai=1011≈0.909091。Ri=500Ω,Ro=10kΩ,Av=2011≈1.81818,Ai=1011≈0.909091.

指定要求：4.5.5Assigned requirement: 4.5.5

共栅极：静态检查后求同相增益Common gate: check the bias point, then find non-inverting gain

题目原文Transcribed question

共栅极放大电路如图题4.5.5所示。电路参数为VDD=VSS=5V，Rs=10kΩ，Rd=5kΩ，RL=5kΩ。MOS管参数Kn=3mAV2，VTN=1V，λ=0。（1）计算静态工作点Q；（2）求gm；（3）求Av=vovi。For the common-gate amplifier in Fig. 4.5.5, VDD=VSS=5V, Rs=10kΩ, Rd=5kΩ and RL=5kΩ. MOS parameters: Kn=3mAV2, VTN=1V, λ=0.(1) Find Q. (2) Find gm. (3) Find Av=vovi.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

NMOS共栅电路：栅接地，源极经10kΩ接−5V并经耦合电容接输入；漏极经5kΩ接+5V并经耦合电容接5kΩ负载到地。衬底接源。NMOS common gate: grounded gate; source through 10kΩ to −5V and through a coupling capacitor to input; drain through 5kΩ to +5V and through a coupling capacitor to a5kΩ grounded load. Body tied to source.

本题图在书第149页／PDF第182页。The source figure is on printed p. 149 · PDF p. 182.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

双电源偏置；平方律选根；共栅极小信号模型。Dual-supply bias; square-law root selection; common-gate small-signal model.
静态时耦合电容断开，RL不参与偏置；动态时负载经电容并到Rd上。输入vi已经是实际源极交流电压，不再为Rs乘额外分压。At DC, coupling capacitors are open and RL does not load the bias. At AC, RL is in parallel with Rd. Input vi is already the actual source-node voltage, so no extra Rs division is needed.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）列直流方程(1) Write the DC equation

栅极为0V，源极VS=−5+10ID（ID以mA计），故过驱动为4−10ID。The gate is at 0V and VS=−5+10ID with ID in mA, so overdrive is 4−10ID.

ID=3(4−10ID)2[ID in mA];VOV=481−160≈0.348862V

选择有效根并检查区域Choose the valid root and check the region

有效根ID≈0.365114mA；另一根约0.438220mA使过驱动为负，舍去。源极约−1.34886V，漏极约3.17443V，因此VGS≈1.34886V、VDS≈4.52329V，远大于过驱动。The valid root is ID≈0.365114mA; the other, about 0.438220mA, gives negative overdrive and is rejected. The source is about −1.34886V and drain about 3.17443V, giving VGS≈1.34886V and VDS≈4.52329V, well above overdrive.

IDQ≈0.365114mA;VGSQ≈1.34886V;VDSQ≈4.52329V

（2）求互导(2) Find transconductance

本书Kn已经含几何因子及12，故gm=2KnVOV。The textbook Kn already contains geometry and 12, so gm=2KnVOV.

gm=2(3)(0.34886187)≈2.09317mS

（3）求同相电压增益(3) Find non-inverting voltage gain

栅极交流接地，vgs=−vi。漏电流增量为−gmvi，输出vo=−id(Rd∥RL)，两次负号给同相增益。The gate is AC-grounded, so vgs=−vi and id=−gmvi. Output vo=−id(Rd∥RL), giving a positive gain.

Av=gm(Rd∥RL)=2.09317122×2.5≈5.23293

（1）IDQ≈0.365114mA，VGSQ≈1.34886V，VDSQ≈4.52329V；（2）gm≈2.09317 mS；（3）Av≈+5.23293，同相。(1)IDQ≈0.365114mA, VGSQ≈1.34886V, VDSQ≈4.52329V. (2)gm≈2.09317 mS. (3)Av≈+5.23293, non-inverting.

易错点Common errors

  • RL被耦合电容隔离，不计入直流漏极电阻。The coupling capacitor isolates RL at DC; omit it from the DC drain load.
  • VSS=5V表示负电源端为−5V，不是源极电压固定−5V。VSS=5V means the negative rail is −5V; it does not fix the source node at −5V.

核验依据Verification

长沟道MOS平方律；λ=0；中频耦合电容短路；衬底接源。Long-channel square-law MOS, λ=0, midband coupling capacitors shorted, body tied to source.

独立以过驱动x代替ID，解30x2+x−4=0得到同一物理根。再代回Rs、Rd的直流欧姆定律及MOS平方律。交流用漏节点KCL voRd+voRL−gmvi=0独立得到增益。Independently solving in overdrive x gives 30x2+x−4=0 and the same physical root. Substitution verifies both resistor DC laws and the MOS square law. Independent drain-node KCL voRd+voRL−gmvi=0 reproduces the AC gain.

先给出明确电源和控制电平，再验证LED驱动Choose explicit supply and control levels before verifying the LED driver

题目原文Transcribed question

试用MOS管设计一个能控制LED灯珠亮灭的驱动电路。灯珠由2个LED串联，控制电压高电平时点亮、否则熄灭。LED工作电流150mA、正向压降3.2～3.5V；MOS管VTN=1.7V、Kn=30mAV2。(1)确定电路结构、电源电压和控制电压大小；(2)计算相关参数并确定MOS管的极限参数。Design aMOS−controlled driver for two series LEDs, on for high control and off otherwise. LEDcurrent150mA,each forward drop3.2–3.5V; MOSVTN=1.7V,Kn=30mAV2. (1)Choose topology,supply and control levels. (2)Calculate circuit parameters and device limits.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

长沟道模型、静态工作区、交流伴随模型、栅极零电流及节点法；保留题设与近似的区别。Long-channel models, DC region checks, small-signal equivalents, zero gate current and nodal analysis; distinguish given data from approximations.
本题允许设计选择，不存在唯一电源。给出一个理想平方律下的低侧NMOS恒流方案：12V经两LED接漏，源接地，高电平精确设定电流。The supply is a design choice. One ideal square-law solution uses a low-side NMOS current sink:12V through both LEDs to drain, source grounded, with high gate voltage setting current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1)选电源与控制电平(1) Choose supply and control

明确假设λ=0、参数固定，体接源。低电平0V截止；高电平由150mA平方律反求，不假称任意逻辑高都得相同电流。Assume λ=0,fixed parameters and bulk tied to source. Low0V cuts off; the high level is calculated for150mA.

VDD=12V,VG,L=0,VG,H=1.7+15030=1.7+5≈3.93607V

(2)检查所有LED压降端点(2) Check both LED endpoints

两LED共6.4～7.0V，导通MOS承受5.0～5.6V，均大于过驱动5V，恒流区成立。无需再虚构未给定的串联限流电阻。The LEDs total6.4–7.0V,leaving5.0–5.6V across MOS,above 5V overdrive. This chosen constant-current topology does not require a fictitious series resistor.

VDS,on∈[5.0,5.6]V,ID=0.15A,PMOS∈[0.75,0.84]W

从工作点给极限参数要求Derive device-rating requirements

关断时按最不利漏端接近12V计算，连续电流至少150mA，工作温度下允许耗散至少0.84W，并覆盖线性区安全工作点。图是题设理想模型的一种可行设计；实际电流精度需闭环或器件实测，不由固定典型K保证。Allow a worst-case off drain near12V,continuous current at least150mA and at least0.84W dissipation at the operating temperature,including the linear SOA point. Practical current accuracy needs regulation or characterization,not nominal K alone.

VDS,rated≥12V,ID,rated≥0.15A,Prated≥0.84W,|VGS,rated|≥3.93607V

一种明确选择12V电源的理想恒流驱动方案；不是唯一设计，也不是SPICE仿真。One explicit ideal constant-current design using a12V supply; neither a unique design nor a SPICE simulation.

一种明确可行的理想方案：12V、低侧NMOS恒流150mA、高、低栅压约3.9360V。导通MOS耗散0.75～0.84W；极限参数需覆盖12V、150mA及最大耗散。方案非唯一。One explicit ideal solution:12V,low-side NMOS150mA current sink,gate high and low≈3.9360V. MOSdissipation0.75–0.84W; ratings cover12V,150mA and that dissipation. The design is not unique.

易错点Common errors

  • 这是恒流驱动，不是把MOS当零压降理想开关；若改成5V逻辑高加电阻的开关方案，必须重新算电流及LED压降范围。This is a current-sink design,not a zero-drop switch. A logic-high and resistor switching design needs a separate current-range calculation.

核验依据Verification

独立按原拓扑盖印MOSJFET小信号节点方程，用直流原方程、工作区、测试源和功率复核。图读估计、有限输出电阻缺参及设计非唯一性分别注明；未称已查阅完整答案库。Independent original-topology MOSJFET nodal stamps check DC equations, operating regions, test-source resistances and power. Graph estimates, unspecified output resistance and nonunique designs are explicitly qualified; no unread answer-key comparison is claimed.

直耦共源加源随器：级间负载要读原图Direct-coupled common source plus follower: read the actual interstage load

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.7.1所示。RL=5kΩ、Rd1=3.3kΩ、Rsi=20kΩ、Rs2=5kΩ、Rg1=500kΩ、Rg2=300kΩ。两MOS均在恒流区，VGS1Q=VGS2Q=3V，Kn1=Kn2=1mAV2、VTN1=VTN2=1.5V、λ1=λ2=0，衬底各接自身源。求：(1)输入和输出电阻；(2)源电压增益Avs。For Fig.4.7.1,RL=5kΩ,Rd1=3.3kΩ,Rsi=20kΩ,Rs2=5kΩ,Rg1=500kΩ,Rg2=300kΩ. Both MOS are saturated with VGSQ=3V,Kn=1mAV2,VTN=1.5V,λ=0 and each bulk tied to source. Find (1)input and output resistances and (2)Avs.

T1共源、源电阻被Cs1旁路，漏极直接接T2栅；T2源极经Rs2到负电源并耦合RL。T1 is common-source with bypassed source resistor; its drain directly drives T2 gate. T2 source has Rs2 to the negative supply and a coupled load.

本题图在书第131页／PDF第164页。The source figure is on printed p. 131 · PDF p. 164.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

长沟道模型、静态工作区、交流伴随模型、栅极零电流及节点法；保留题设与近似的区别。Long-channel models, DC region checks, small-signal equivalents, zero gate current and nodal analysis; distinguish given data from approximations.
Rg1、Rg2是第一级分压偏置，不是分别属于两级的输入负载。第一级漏极直连第二级栅，栅零电流。Rg1 and Rg2 are the first-stage bias divider,not separate stage input loads. Stage1 drain directly drives stage2’s zero-current gate.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

跨导与端口电阻Transconductance and port resistances

两gm均为3 mS；第一级源电阻由Cs1交流旁路。Both gm values are3 mS and Cs1 bypasses stage1 source resistance.

gm1=gm2=3mS,Ri=500∥300=187.5kΩ,Ro=Rs2∥1gm2=312.5Ω

逐级增益再计源加载Multiply stage gains and include source loading

第一级无第二级电阻性栅负载，A1=−gmRd；第二级负载为5∥5kΩ。Stage1 has no resistive gate load from stage2. The follower load is5∥5kΩ.

A1=−9.9,A2=7.58.5=1517,Avs=187.5187.5+20(−9.9)1517≈−7.893338

Ri=187.5kΩ，Ro=312.5Ω，Avs≈−7.893338。Ri=187.5kΩ,Ro=312.5Ω,Avs≈−7.893338.

先解第一管，再把它漏压作为第二管栅压Solve transistor1 first, then use its drain voltage as gate2 bias

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.7.1所示，VDD=VSS=10V、RL=4kΩ、Rs1=1.7kΩ、Rs2=5kΩ、Rsi=10kΩ、Rd1=3.3kΩ、Rg1=560kΩ、Rg2=300kΩ。两管Kn=1mAV2、VTN=2V、λ=0，衬底各接源。求：(1)静态工作点；(2)输入电阻和输出电阻；(3)源电压增益。For Fig.4.7.1,VDD=VSS=10V,RL=4kΩ,Rs1=1.7kΩ,Rs2=5kΩ,Rsi=10kΩ,Rd1=3.3kΩ,Rg1=560kΩ,Rg2=300kΩ. Both devices have Kn=1mAV2,VTN=2V,λ=0 and bulk-source ties. Find (1)DC points,(2)Ri,Ro,(3)source gain.

与4.7.1相同的直耦共源—共漏电路，偏置电阻跨双电源。The same direct-coupled common-source and follower circuit as4.7.1,with its bias divider across both supplies.

本题图在书第131页／PDF第164页。The source figure is on printed p. 131 · PDF p. 164.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

长沟道模型、静态工作区、交流伴随模型、栅极零电流及节点法；保留题设与近似的区别。Long-channel models, DC region checks, small-signal equivalents, zero gate current and nodal analysis; distinguish given data from approximations.
第一级栅由跨±10V的分压决定，第二级栅直接是第一级漏压；不能把两栅都设为0。Gate1 is set by the divider across±10V; gate2 is the actual drain1 voltage. Neither should be arbitrarily grounded for DC.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

第一管正过驱动根Physical positive-overdrive root for T1

以下电流用mA、电阻用kΩ。栅VG1=−3.0232558V；只取VGS>2V的根。Use mA and kΩ below. VG1=−3.0232558V; choose only the VGS>2V root.

I1=(4.976744186−1.7I1)2⇒I1≈2.079279mA

从漏压递推第二管Propagate drain1 bias to T2

VD1=3.1383803V，所以第二管的过驱动表达式为VD1+8−5I2。VD1=3.1383803V,so T2 overdrive is VD1+8−5I2.

I2=(11.138380333−5I2)2⇒I2≈1.948499mA

回查两个工作区Verify both operating regions

T1：VGS≈3.441970V、VDS≈9.603607V；T2：VGS≈3.395886V、VDS≈10.257506V。均大于相应过驱动。T1 has VGS≈3.441970,VDS≈9.603607V; T2 has VGS≈3.395886,VDS≈10.257506V. Both satisfy saturation.

gm1≈2.883941mS,gm2≈2.791773mS

交流输入、输出及总增益AC ports and total gain

Ri=Rg1∥Rg2；输出移除负载测量。源随级的信号负载为5kΩ∥4kΩ。Ri=Rg1∥Rg2; remove the load for Ro. Follower signal load is5kΩ∥4kΩ.

Ri≈195.348837kΩ,Ro≈334.249985Ω,Avs=RiRi+Rsi[−gm1Rd1]gm2(Rs2∥RL)1+gm2(Rs2∥RL)≈−7.796799

T1：(IDQ,VGSQ,VDSQ)≈(2.079279mA,3.441970V,9.603607V)；T2≈(1.948499mA,3.395886V,10.257506V)。Ri≈195.349kΩ、Ro≈334.250Ω、Avs≈−7.796799。T1 bias≈(2.079279mA,3.441970V,9.603607V); T2≈(1.948499mA,3.395886V,10.257506V),in the order ID,VGS,VDS. Ri≈195.349kΩ,Ro≈334.250Ω,Avs≈−7.796799.

  • 平方方程的另一根可能违反正过驱动；直流时Cs1开路，交流时才旁路Rs1。The other square-law root can violate positive overdrive. Cs1 is open for DC and only bypasses Rs1 in AC.

cascode含λ时，先说明偏置电压是否足够For a cascode with λ, state whether DC drain biases are specified

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图4.7.4(a)所示。设MOS管工作在恒流区且VGS1Q=VGS2Q=2.8V。两管Kn=1.2mAV2、VTN=1.9V、λ=0.01V−1。求电路的电压增益。For the cascode in Fig.4.7.4(a),both devices are saturated with VGSQ=2.8V,Kn=1.2mAV2,VTN=1.9V and λ=0.01V−1. Find voltage gain.

两只NMOS堆叠，下管栅输入，上管栅固定偏置，顶部理想电流源作有源负载，输出在上管漏极。Two stacked NMOS: lower gate input,upper fixed gate,ideal current-source load and output at the upper drain.

本题图在书第135页／PDF第168页。The source figure is on printed p. 135 · PDF p. 168.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

长沟道模型、静态工作区、交流伴随模型、栅极零电流及节点法；保留题设与近似的区别。Long-channel models, DC region checks, small-signal equivalents, zero gate current and nodal analysis; distinguish given data from approximations.
理想上方恒流源交流开路。精确小信号增益能写出；若直流也保留λ，题目未给VDS或恒流源值，不能唯一确定数值。The ideal upper current source is AC-open. An exact small-signal expression is available, but fully retaining λ in DC requires the unspecified drain biases or bias current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

从两节点方程求一般增益Derive general gain from both nodes

输出开路使第二管交流漏电流为零，第一管节点x=−gm1ro1vi，第二级vo=(1+gm2ro2)x。Open output gives zero T2 drain signal current. The internal node is x=−gm1ro1vi and output(1+gm2ro2)x.

Av=−gm1ro1(1+gm2ro2)

列教材常用偏置近似State the conventional bias approximation

若静态忽略λ，ID=Kn(0.9)2=0.972mA，gm=2.16 mS；再用ro≈1(λID)=102.88066kΩ。该近似必须标明。Neglecting λ in DC gives ID=0.972mA and gm=2.16 mS; then ro≈1(λID)=102.88066kΩ. This is explicitly approximate.

Av≈−49604.9383[large gmro: Av≈−49382.7160]

完整λ模型为何欠定Why the full λ model is underdetermined

完整模型I=KnVov2(1+λVDS)，gm=2KnVov(1+λVDS)，gds=λKnVov2。相同VGS、参数和串联电流要求两VDS相等，却不确定这个值。若VDS均取1V、3V，均可饱和，但增益约−50599.75、−52619.01。The full model has I=KnVov2(1+λVDS),gm=2KnVov(1+λVDS),gds=λKnVov2. Equal VGS,parameters and series current imply equal VDS,but not its value. Equal biases1Vor3V are both saturated yet give different gains.

gmgds=2(1+λVDS)λVOV

一般式Av=−gm1ro1(1+gm2ro2)。教材常用静态忽略λ近似Av≈−4.96049×104；完整含λ偏置模型缺少VDS或I，数值不唯一。General Av=−gm1ro1(1+gm2ro2). Conventional DC-neglects−λ approximation gives≈−4.96049×104. A full λ−dependent bias model lacks specified VDS or current and has no unique numerical gain.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要一面声称完整保留λ，一面把ID=KnVov2当精确；也不要把理想偏置电流源短路。Do not claim full λ consistency while using ID=KnVov2 as exact; the ideal bias source is AC-open.

4.7.4全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第150页／PDF第183页。范围状态：考试范围（课程纲领4.1～4.5、4.7）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 150 · PDF p. 183. Coverage: required by course plan: 4.1–4.5 and 4.7.

高输入—高增益—低输出，逐项计算加载High input resistance, high gain, low output resistance: include every load

题目原文Transcribed question

有三种放大电路备用：(1)高输入电阻型Ri1=1MΩ、Avo1=10、Ro1=10kΩ；(2)高增益型Ri2=10kΩ、Avo2=100、Ro2=1kΩ；(3)低输出电阻型Ri3=10kΩ、Avo3=1、Ro3=20Ω。用这三种放大电路组合，设计在100Ω负载上提供至少0.5W功率的放大器。信号源开路电压30mV（有效值）、内阻Rsi=0.5MΩ。Combine three amplifiers: (1)Ri=1MΩ,Avo=10,Ro=10kΩ; (2)Ri=10kΩ,Avo=100,Ro=1kΩ; (3)Ri=10kΩ,Avo=1,Ro=20Ω. Drive100Ω with at least0.5W from a30mV RMS source with0.5MΩ resistance.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

长沟道模型、静态工作区、交流伴随模型、栅极零电流及节点法；保留题设与近似的区别。Long-channel models, DC region checks, small-signal equivalents, zero gate current and nodal analysis; distinguish given data from approximations.
把高输入电阻级放最前、低输出电阻级放最后，高增益级居中；不是只把三个开路增益相乘。Place high input resistance first,low output resistance last,and high gain between; do not multiply only open-circuit gains.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

明确三级顺序与分压Specify all three stages and divider factors

选择1→2→3。源输入、两处级间和末端负载均分压。Choose1→2→3 and include source,interstage and final load dividers.

VL=0.0311+0.5(10)1010+10(100)101+10(1)10020+100V=25033V

按有效值检查功率Check power using RMS

输出约7.57576V RMS，比0.5W所需50≈7.07107V高。独立枚举6种顺序，只有1→2→3达到目标。Output7.57576V RMS exceeds 50V required for0.5W. Independent enumeration of all six orders finds only1→2→3 meets the target.

PL=VL2100=6251089W≈0.573921W≥0.5W

说明线性模型的输出能力条件State the output-capability condition

上述设计按给定线性模型成立。末级实际至少支持约10.714V峰值和107.14mA峰值；题目未给供电或限幅，不能仅由增益推断真实器件一定具备这些摆幅。The result uses the given linear models. A physical final stage needs at least about10.714V peak and107.14mA peak; supplies and clipping limits are unspecified.

VL,m=2VL≈10.71374V,IL,m≈0.107137A

高输入电阻级→高增益级→低输出电阻级，级间分压全部计入。High-input-resistance stage, high-gain stage, then low-output-resistance stage, with every loading divider included.

按1→2→3串联，理想线性模型下VL≈7.57576V RMS、PL≈0.573921W，满足至少0.5W。Cascade1→2→3; the given linear models give VL≈7.57576V RMS and PL≈0.573921W,meeting0.5W.

易错点Common errors

  • 最后一级并非高增益级；让低输出电阻级最后可避免100Ω负载吞掉增益。The last stage is the low-output-resistance buffer,preventing the100Ω load from collapsing gain.

核验依据Verification

完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

按教材常见完整画法分类Classify under the usual textbook domains

(a)在正VGS反偏区降到零，通常为P沟道JFET；(b)负阈值、零栅压导通且正栅压继续增强，通常为N沟道耗尽MOS；(c)正阈值、零栅压导通且负栅压增强，通常为P沟道耗尽MOS；(d)正阈值后才导通，为N沟道增强MOS。Usual types: (a)P−channel JFET over its reverse-biased positive−VGS domain; (b)N−channel depletion MOS; (c)P−channel depletion MOS; (d)N−channel enhancement MOS.

局部曲线不能唯一识别栅结构A local curve cannot uniquely identify gate construction

若这些只是局部测量曲线，JFET与耗尽型MOS可以在相同区间有相同形状；仅凭(a)局部不能严格排除耗尽PMOS。上述具体JFETMOS名称依赖教材所示允许域；沟道与增强、耗尽方向则可从曲线判断。For local measured segments,JFET and depletion MOS can share a transfer shape. In particular,(a)alone cannot strictly exclude depletion PMOS. The specific gate-structure labels rely on the textbook domain convention.

按教材惯用画法：(a)P沟道JFET；(b)N沟道耗尽MOS；(c)P沟道耗尽MOS；(d)N沟道增强MOS。若仅有局部曲线，JFET、耗尽MOS的结构判别需额外栅电流或完整允许域。Usual textbook labels: (a)P−JFET,(b)N−depletion MOS,(c)P−depletion MOS,(d)N−enhancement MOS. Local curves alone need gate-current or full-domain information to distinguish JFET from depletion MOS.

题目原文Transcribed question

图题4.8.3的JFET放大电路中，VDD=20V、VGS=−2V、IDSS=4mA、VP=−4V。C1、C2交流短路。(1)求R1和静态IDQ；(2)若VDS=6V，求R2；(3)设rds影响可忽略，在上述条件下计算Av和Ro。图中Rd=10kΩ、Rg=1MΩ。For Fig.4.8.3,VDD=20V,VGS=−2V,IDSS=4mA,VP=−4V; C1,C2 are AC shorts. Find (1)R1 and IDQ,(2)R2 for VDS=6V,(3)Av and Ro neglecting finite rds effects. Rd=10kΩ,Rg=1MΩ.

源串R1、R2接地，栅通过1MΩ接两电阻中点；漏经10kΩ接20V。Source uses series R1,R2 to ground; gate has1MΩ to their junction; drain has10kΩto20V.

完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1)偏置电流与R1(1) Bias current and R1

Shockley式给1mA；VGS只跨R1。The Shockley equation gives1mA,and VGS spans only R1.

IDQ=4(1−−2−4)2=1mA,R1=2kΩ

(2)完整漏源直流回路(2) Complete drain-source DC loop

VDS要扣掉Rd及两只源电阻的压降。Subtract drops across Rd and both source resistors.

6=20−(1mA)(10kΩ+R1+R2)⇒R2=2kΩ

(3)保留有限Rg节点方程(3) Retain the finite−Rg nodal equations

gm=1 mS。令中点vx、源vs，输入栅vi。rds影响忽略按漏源电导为0处理，不是把漏源短路。gm=1 mS. Let junction be vx,source vs and gate input vi. Neglecting rds effects means zero output conductance,not a drain-source short.

vs−vxR1=gm(vi−vs),vxR2+vx−vsR1+vx−viRg=0,vo=−gmRd(vi−vs)

完整Rg结果和常用近似Finite−Rg result and common approximation

原节点式给Av≈−1.997603，若Rg支路交流电流也忽略则常用源退化公式给−2。输出测试Rg保留、输入置零、负载移除，Ro=Rd。The original nodal solve gives−1.997603. Neglecting Rg AC current gives−2. The output test retains Rg and gives Ro=Rd.

Av≈−1.99760288 (≈−2),Ro=10kΩ

IDQ=1mA，R1=R2=2kΩ，Av≈−1.997603（通常近似−2），Ro=10kΩ。IDQ=1mA,R1=R2=2kΩ,Av≈−1.997603 (usually−2),Ro=10kΩ.

先列有限ro通式，再给常用源随近似State the finite−ro formula before the usual follower approximation

题目原文Transcribed question

源极输出器电路如图题4.8.4所示。JFET工作点跨导gm=0.9 mS，其他参数如图：VDD=12V、Rg1=300kΩ、Rg2=100kΩ、Rg3=2MΩ、Rs=12kΩ，Cb1=0.02μF、Cb2=10μF。求电压增益Av、输入电阻Ri和输出电阻Ro。For the source follower in Fig.4.8.4,gm=0.9 mS,VDD=12V,Rg1=300kΩ,Rg2=100kΩ,Rg3=2MΩ,Rs=12kΩ,Cb1=0.02μF,Cb2=10μF. Find Av,Ri,Ro.

漏接12V，源12kΩ接地并经输出耦合电容输出；栅通过2MΩ接300100kΩ分压中点。Drain is12V,source has12kΩ to ground and output coupling; gate has2MΩ to the300100kΩ divider midpoint.

输入端的电阻连接Input resistance topology

电源交流接地，分压中点到地为300∥100=75kΩ。With the supply AC-grounded,the divider midpoint has75kΩ to ground.

Ri=2MΩ+75kΩ=2.075MΩ

Av=gmgm+1Rs+1ro,Ro=1gm+1Rs+1ro

常用ro远大于Rs近似Usual approximation ro much larger than Rs

指定要求：5.1.1Assigned requirement: 5.1.1

由三端电位识别PNP与电极Identify aPNP and its terminals from three voltages

题目原文Transcribed question

测得某放大电路中处于放大状态的BJT的三个电极A、B、C的对地电位分别为VA=−9V，VB=−6V，VC=−6.2V，试分析A、B、C中哪个是基极b、发射极e、集电极c，并说明此BJT是NPN型管还是PNP型管。An amplifying circuit has aBJT operating in its forward-active region. Its terminal voltages relative to ground are VA=−9V, VB=−6V and VC=−6.2V. Identify the base b, emitter e and collector c among A, B and C, and determine whether the transistor is NPN or PNP.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT放大区：发射结正偏、集电结反偏；带负号电位排序。Forward-active BJT: forward-biased emitter junction, reverse-biased collector junction; ordering negative voltages.
先找只差约0.2V的一对作为发射结，再用另一结必须反偏来排除错误极性。不能强加硅管0.7V条件。First identify the pair separated by about 0.2V as the emitter junction, then use reverse collector-junction bias to reject the wrong polarity. Do not impose a0.7V silicon drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

判断发射结Identify the emitter junction

B端−6V比C端−6.2V高0.2V。若为PNP，较高电位的P区B端可作发射极，C端为N区基极，满足发射结正偏。这里字母B是题目端点标签，不是基极的缩写。Terminal B at −6V is 0.2V above terminal C at −6.2V. For PNP, the higher P−type terminal B can be emitter and C the N−type base, forward-biasing the emitter junction. The capital letter B is only a terminal label, not the base designation.

VE=VB=−6V;Vb=VC=−6.2V;VEb=0.2V>0

检查集电结并排除NPNCheck collector bias and reject NPN

剩下A端−9V是PNP的P区集电极，它比N区基极低2.8V，集电结反偏。若把B作NPN基极、C作发射极，则A集电极低于基极，集电结正偏，不符合题设放大区。The remaining A terminal at −9V is the PNP collector, 2.8V below the N−type base, so the collector junction is reverse-biased. Assigning B as an NPN base and C as emitter would forward-bias the collector junction because A is below the base, contradicting forward-active operation.

VCb=VA−VC=−9−(−6.2)=−2.8V<0(PNP collector junction reverse-biased)

A为集电极c，B为发射极e，C为基极b；PNP型BJT。A is collector c, B is emitter e, C is base b; PNPBJT.

易错点Common errors

  • −6V高于−6.2V和−9V；不能按绝对值排序。−6V is above −6.2V and −9V; do not order by magnitude.
  • 题目的端点B不是基极b；大小写标签不可混用。Problem terminal B is not automatically base b; keep the labels distinct.

核验依据Verification

题设BJT处于正常放大区；不预设硅管固定0.7V压降。The stated normal forward-active BJT condition; no assumed fixed 0.7V silicon drop.

独立检查PNP两结偏置：VE−Vb=+0.2V，发射结正偏；Vc−Vb=−2.8V，集电结反偏。检查NPN替代分配会使集电结正偏，故排除。未据0.2V电压差断言具体材料。Independently checked both PNP junctions: VE−Vb=+0.2V gives forward emitter bias, and Vc−Vb=−2.8V gives reverse collector bias. The alternative NPN assignment forward-biases the collector junction and is rejected. No material is inferred solely from the 0.2V drop.

5.1.2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第183页／PDF第216页。范围状态：考试范围：BJT5.1、共射5.2.1～5.2.4。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 183 · PDF p. 216. Coverage: required: BJTsection5.1 and CEsections5.2.1–5.2.4.

极限电流、电压与功耗必须同时满足Apply current,voltage and power limits together

题目原文Transcribed question

某BJT的极限参数ICM=100mA、PCM=150mW、V(BR)CEO=30V。若工作电压VCE=10V，工作电流IC不得超过多大？若工作电流IC=1mA，工作电压的极限值应为多少？ABJT has ICM=100mA,PCM=150mW and V(BR)CEO=30V. At VCE=10V,what maximum IC is permitted? At IC=1mA,what is the limiting operating voltage?

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT工作区、有限β偏置、交直流通路及端口加载。BJT operating regions,finite−β bias,DC and AC paths and port loading.
每次同时检查三个额定约束，取最严格者。这里只按题给的静态额定参数求上限。Apply all three supplied static ratings and choose the tightest bound.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

固定10V时检查功耗Power limit at10V

功耗先限制为15mA，低于100mA额定电流；10V也低于击穿上限。Power permits15mA,below the100mA current rating;10V is below breakdown.

IC≤min(100mA,150mW10V)=15mA

固定1mA时检查击穿Breakdown limit at1mA

仅看功耗会得到150V，但30V击穿参数先限制。此处30V是题设额定上界，实际设计应留裕量并考虑温度降额。Power alone permits150V,but the30V breakdown rating is tighter. The exercise asks for the nominal upper bound; a physical design needs margin and thermal derating.

VCE≤min(30V,150mW1mA)=30V

两问上界分别为15mA和30V。The two nominal upper bounds are15mAand30V.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能把最大电流、最大电压同时加在管上；其乘积可能超功耗。Maximum current and maximum voltage generally cannot be applied simultaneously because their product may exceed the power rating.

核验依据Verification

按原图电源极性、电容及负载连接重建方程；独立KCL、KVL复算，5.2.13的三种接法另用数值节点矩阵求解，核对放大区。没有声称与未读取的外部答案库比对。Equations are rebuilt from original supply polarities,capacitors and load connections. Independent KCL and KVL checks include numerical nodal matrices for all three connections of5.2.13 and active-region checks. No comparison with an unread external answer collection is claimed.

5.1.3指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第183页／PDF第216页。范围状态：考试范围：BJT5.1、共射5.2.1～5.2.4。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 183 · PDF p. 216. Coverage: required: BJTsection5.1 and CEsections5.2.1–5.2.4.

指定要求：5.1.3Assigned requirement: 5.1.3

用同一组电流定义计算β与αCompute β and α from consistent terminal currents

题目原文Transcribed question

设某BJT处于放大状态。（1）若基极电流iB=6μA，集电极电流iC=510μA，试求β、α及iE；（2）如果iB=50μA，iC=2.65mA，试求β、α及iE。ABJT operates in its forward-active region. (1) If iB=6μA and iC=510μA, find β, α and iE. (2) If iB=50μA and iC=2.65mA, find β, α and iE.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All parts of the exercise have been checked; assigned parts are marked separately.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT电流KCL；β=iCiB；α=iCiE；单位换算。BJT current KCL; β=iCiB; α=iCiE; unit conversion.
先把电流统一单位，再用iE=iC+iB；β与α分母不同。不要把第（2）问已知的iC误读成iE。First use consistent units and iE=iC+iB. Beta and α have different denominators. Do not misread the given iC in part (2) as iE.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一定义Use consistent definitions

本章按正向放大状态的电流大小计算；发射极电流为基极与集电极之和。Use positive current magnitudes in forward-active operation. Emitter current is the sum of base and collector currents.

iE=iC+iB;β=iCiB;α=iCiE=β1+β

（1）计算(1) Calculate

两电流均以μA计，直接相加与相除。Both currents are in μA; add and divide directly.

iE=510+6=516μA;β=5106=85;α=510516=8586≈0.988372

（2）先换单位(2) Convert units first

iC=2.65mA=2650μA；加上50μA得到发射极2.70mA。iC=2.65mA=2650μA. Add 50μA to obtain emitter current 2.70mA.

iE=2650+50=2700μA=2.70mA;β=265050=53;α=26502700=5354≈0.981481

（1）β=85，α=8586≈0.988372，iE=516μA；（2）β=53，α=5354≈0.981481，iE=2.70mA。(1)β=85, α=8586≈0.988372, iE=516μA. (2)β=53, α=5354≈0.981481, iE=2.70mA.

易错点Common errors

  • 第（2）问原书给的是集电极iC=2.65mA，不是发射极。Part (2) gives collector current iC=2.65mA, not emitter current.
  • α小于1，而β通常远大于1；两者不要互换。Alpha is below one, while β is typically much larger than one; do not interchange them.

核验依据Verification

正常放大区电流大小，忽略题中未给出的漏电流修正。Forward-active current magnitudes, with no unspecified leakage correction.

独立用α=β(1+β)复算两组结果；再以iE(1−α)恢复iB为6μA和50μA，iEα恢复iC为510μA和2.65mA。Independently recomputed both α values using α=β(1+β). Then iE(1−α) recovers base currents 6μA and 50μA, while iEα recovers collector currents 510μA and 2.65mA.

指定要求：5.2.2Assigned requirement: 5.2.2

开关偏置：先比较βIB与负载限流Switched bias: compare β times base current with load-limited current

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题5.2.2所示，设BJT的β=80，VBE=0.6V，ICEO、VCES可忽略不计，试分析当开关S分别接通A、B、C三位置时，BJT各工作在其输出特性曲线的哪个区域，并求出相应的集电极电流IC。For Fig. 5.2.2, β=80, VBE=0.6V, and ICEO and VCES are negligible. For switch positions A, B and C, identify the BJT operating region and find collector current IC.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

NPN发射极接地，集电极通过4kΩ接+12V；基极开关A经40kΩ接+12V，B经500kΩ接+12V，C经20kΩ接−12V。NPN emitter grounded, collector through 4kΩ to +12V. Switch A biases the base through 40kΩ to +12V, B through 500kΩ to +12V, and C through 20kΩ to −12V.

本题图在书第184页／PDF第217页。The source figure is on printed p. 184 · PDF p. 217.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT分段模型；基极回路KVL；集电极负载上限。Piecewise BJT model; base-loop KVL; collector load-current limit.
不能在所有状态都写IC=βIB。先算负载允许的最大集电极电流，再试放大区，超过上限就改为饱和。IC=βIB does not hold in every state. First compute the collector current allowed by the load, then test forward-active operation; exceeding the load limit implies saturation.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

集电极限流Collector-current limit

忽略饱和压降时，集电极降到0V，4kΩ电阻最大电流为3mA。With negligible saturation voltage, the collector reaches 0V and the 4kΩ resistor limits current to 3mA.

IC,sat=12(4kΩ)=3mA

A：基极驱动过强，饱和A: excessive base drive, saturation

40kΩ使基极电流0.285mA，假设放大区会要求22.8mA，远超3mA，故饱和。实际IC由负载决定。The 40kΩ resistor supplies 0.285mA base current. An active-state calculation would demand 22.8mA, exceeding 3mA, so the transistor saturates and the load sets IC.

IB=(12−0.6)V40kΩ=0.285mA;βIB=22.8mA>3mA;IC=3mA

B：检查放大区B: check forward-active operation

500kΩ给出22.8μA基流，集电流1.824mA。集电极4.704V高于基极0.6V，集电结反偏，放大区成立。500kΩ gives 22.8μA base current and 1.824mA collector current. The collector is at 4.704V, above the 0.6V base, so the collector junction is reverse-biased.

IB=22.8μA;IC=80IB=1.824mA;VC=12−1.824×4=4.704V

C：反向偏置，简化模型截止C: reverse base bias, cutoff in the simplified model

C接−12V，基极低于接地发射极，不满足发射结正偏；按题设忽略漏电流的截止模型，IC=0。这个答案采用本题分段模型，不扩展到未给出的反向击穿参数。C connects to −12V, placing the base below the grounded emitter, so the emitter junction is not forward-biased. Under the stated no-leakage cutoff model, IC=0; no unspecified reverse-breakdown model is assumed.

IC=0(simplified cutoff model)

A：饱和区，IC=3mA；B：放大区，IC=1.824mA；C：截止区，IC=0（题设简化模型）。A: saturation, IC=3mA. B: forward-active, IC=1.824mA. C: cutoff, IC=0 under the stated simplified model.

易错点Common errors

  • 饱和区的实际IC不能继续用βIB计算。Do not use βIB for actual collector current in saturation.

核验依据Verification

按题设恒定VBE和忽略漏电流、饱和压降的分段BJT模型；开关C按无反向击穿的简化截止模型。Piecewise BJT model with stated constant VBE and negligible leakage and saturation voltage; switch C uses the simplified cutoff model without reverse breakdown.

独立检查A的负载KVL为3mA×4kΩ=12V；B的基极KVL为22.8μA×500kΩ+0.6=12V，集电结反偏；C的简化截止解满足ICEO=0。Independently checked A load KVL, 3mA×4kΩ=12V; B base KVL, 22.8μA×500kΩ+0.6=12V, with reverse collector bias; C follows the zero−ICEO cutoff model.

5.2.4指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第184页／PDF第217页。范围状态：考试范围：BJT5.1、共射5.2.1～5.2.4。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 184 · PDF p. 217. Coverage: required: BJTsection5.1 and CEsections5.2.1–5.2.4.

指定要求：5.2.4Assigned requirement: 5.2.4

强射极退化的共射：输入电阻含(β+1)ReDegenerated common emitter: input resistance includes (β+1)Re

题目原文Transcribed question

在图题5.2.4电路中，设VCC=VEE=12V，Rc=4kΩ，Re=6.2kΩ，BJT的β=100，VBEQ=0.7V。（1）估算Q点；（2）求Av、Ri和Ro。For Fig. 5.2.4, VCC=VEE=12V, Rc=4kΩ, Re=6.2kΩ, β=100 and VBEQ=0.7V. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Find Av, Ri and Ro.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

NPN基极由理想信号源接地参考，集电极经4kΩ接+12V，发射极经6.2kΩ接−12V，输出在集电极。NPN base driven by an ideal ground-referenced source; collector through 4kΩ to +12V; emitter through 6.2kΩ to −12V; collector output.

本题图在书第185页／PDF第218页。The source figure is on printed p. 185 · PDF p. 218.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

双电源直流偏置；BJT电流KCL；rbe模型；未旁路发射极反馈。Dual-supply bias; BJT current KCL; rbe model; unbypassed emitter degeneration.
基极静态为0V，先求发射极电流。交流时Re未旁路，不能把输入电阻写成rbe，也不能把增益写成−βRcrbe。The DC base voltage is zero, so find emitter current first. Re is unbypassed at AC; neither Ri=rbe nor Av=−βRcrbe applies.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）直流工作点(1) DC operating point

VBQ=0，VEQ=−0.7V，Re上电压11.3V。保留β有限时IC=βIE(β+1)。VBQ=0 and VEQ=−0.7V, so the emitter resistor sees 11.3V. Retain finite β using IC=βIE(β+1).

IEQ=11.3V6.2kΩ≈1.82258mA;ICQ≈1.80454mA;VCEQ=24−IERe−ICRc≈5.48186V

检查放大区Check forward-active operation

集电极VC≈4.78186V，基极0V，集电结反偏；发射结0.7V正偏，工作点成立。若按IC≈IE估算，则得到IC≈1.823mA、VCE≈5.410V。Collector voltage is about 4.78186V, above the 0V base; the collector junction is reverse-biased and the emitter junction has 0.7V forward bias. Using IC≈IE instead gives approximately 1.823mA and VCE≈5.410V.

VC=12−4kΩIC≈4.78186V>VB=0

（2）小信号参数(2) Small-signal parameter

采用授课课件第5章第41页常用估算rbb′≈200Ω、室温VT=26mV。题目未给实际rbb′，所报小信号数值依赖此课程模型。Use the course slide 41 convention rbb′≈200Ω and room-temperature VT=26mV. Actual rbb′ is not given, so the reported small-signal values depend on this course model.

rbe≈200+(1+β)26mVIEQ≈1640.814Ω

输入电阻和增益Input resistance and gain

基极输入电压需同时承担rbe压降与发射极电阻上的(β+1)ibRe，故分母包含反馈电阻的放大反映。输出为−βibRc。The base input supplies both ibrbe and emitter drop (β+1)ibRe. The output is −βibRc.

Ri=rbe+(1+β)Re≈627.841kΩ;Av=−βRcrbe+(1+β)Re≈−0.637104

输出电阻Output resistance

忽略晶体管输出电阻，输入源置零后输出测试电压不会改变基极电流，输出见Rc。Taking ro→∞ (neglecting the Early effect), a collector test voltage with the input zeroed does not change base current; the output sees Rc.

Ro=Rc=4kΩ

保留有限β：ICQ≈1.80454mA，VCEQ≈5.48186V；按课件rbb′≈200Ω、VT=26mV：Av≈−0.637104，Ri≈627.841kΩ，Ro=4kΩ。With finite β: ICQ≈1.80454mA and VCEQ≈5.48186V. With course rbb′≈200Ω and VT=26mV: Av≈−0.637104, Ri≈627.841kΩ, Ro=4kΩ.

易错点Common errors

  • Re没有旁路，计算交流通路时不能删掉。Re is not bypassed and must remain in the AC circuit.

核验依据Verification

恒VBE=0.7V，保留有限β；中频、rbb′=200Ω、VT=26mV、忽略晶体管输出电阻。Constant VBE=0.7V with finite β; midband, rbb′=200Ω, VT=26mV, the Early effect neglected (ro→∞).

独立以1V基极输入列KCL：ib=1[rbe+(β+1)Re]，ie=(β+1)ib，vo=−βibRc，与结果一致；直流分别验证两结偏置和双电源KVL。Independent KCL with a1V base test gives ib=1[rbe+(β+1)Re], ie=(β+1)ib and vo=−βibRc. Both DC junction biases and dual-rail KVL also check.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第185页／PDF第218页。范围状态：考试范围：共射偏置设计5.2.4；本习题号不是被排除的小节号。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 185 · PDF p. 218. Coverage: required: CE bias design section5.2.4; this exercise ID is not the excluded section number.

分压偏置设计保留基极分流Retain base-current loading in divider design

题目原文Transcribed question

放大电路如图题5.2.5，β=100、VBEQ=0.7V、VCC=12V、Rc=4.3kΩ、I1=10IB。要求ICQ=1mA、VCEQ=5V。设计Re、Rb1和Rb2。For Fig.5.2.5,beta100,VBEQ0.7V,VCC12V,Rc4.3kΩ and I1=10IB. Design Re,Rb1 and Rb2 for ICQ1mA and VCEQ5V.

教材原图，保留电源极性、端口和电容连接。Original textbook diagram preserving supply polarities,ports and capacitor connections.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT工作区、有限β偏置、交直流通路及端口加载。BJT operating regions,finite−β bias,DC and AC paths and port loading.
先由集电极回路定VE，再用上支路I1和下支路I1−IB分别求分压电阻。Find VE from the collector loop,then distinguish upper current I1 from lower current I1−IB.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由Q点确定射极、基极电压Find emitter and base voltages

VC=7.7V，所以VE=2.7V、VB=3.4V；VC>VB，满足放大区。VC7.7V gives VE2.7V and VB3.4V; VC>VB verifies active operation.

VE=12−(1mA)(4.3kΩ)−5=2.7V,VB=3.4V

保留有限β及分流Retain finite β and divider loading

IB=10μA、IE=1.01mA；图示上支路I1=100μA，流经Rb2的是90μA。IB10μA and IE1.01mA; the drawn upper current is100μA,and Rb2carries90μA.

Re=2.71.01mA≈2.67327kΩ,Rb1=12−3.4100μA=86kΩ,Rb2=3.490μA≈37.7778kΩ

Re≈2.673kΩ、Rb1=86kΩ、Rb2≈37.778kΩ（未取标准阻值）。Re≈2.673kΩ,Rb1=86kΩ,Rb2≈37.778kΩ,before choosing standard values.

易错点Common errors

  • 题设I1是上支路电流，不能让两个偏置电阻都流100μA。I1 is the upper-branch current; the lower resistor does not also carry100μA.

核验依据Verification

按原图电源极性、电容及负载连接重建方程；独立KCL、KVL复算，5.2.13的三种接法另用数值节点矩阵求解，核对放大区。没有声称与未读取的外部答案库比对。Equations are rebuilt from original supply polarities,capacitors and load connections. Independent KCL and KVL checks include numerical nodal matrices for all three connections of5.2.13 and active-region checks. No comparison with an unread external answer collection is claimed.

5.2.7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第185页／PDF第218页。范围状态：考试范围：BJT5.1、共射5.2.1～5.2.4。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 185 · PDF p. 218. Coverage: required: BJTsection5.1 and CEsections5.2.1–5.2.4.

指定要求：5.2.7(1)(2)(3)Assigned requirement: 5.2.7(1)(2)(3)

PNP共射极：用带符号电压判断失真PNP common emitter: use signed voltage to classify clipping

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题5.2.7a所示，已知BJT的β=100，VBEQ=−0.7V。（1）试估算该电路的Q点；（2）画出小信号等效电路；（3）求该电路的电压增益Av、输入电阻Ri、输出电阻Ro；（4）若vo出现图题5.2.7b所示的失真现象，问是截止失真还是饱和失真？为消除此失真，应调整电路中的哪个元件？如何调整？ 图中：电源−12V，Rb=300kΩ，Rc=2kΩ，RL=4kΩ；信号源内阻Rsi未给数值。图b为输出负半周被削平。For Fig. 5.2.7(a), β=100 and VBEQ=−0.7V. (1) Estimate Q. (2) Draw the small-signal equivalent. (3) Find voltage gain Av, input resistance Ri and output resistance Ro. (4) If vo has the distortion in Fig. 5.2.7(b), determine whether it is cutoff or saturation distortion, and identify the component and adjustment needed to eliminate it. Figure values: −12V rail, Rb=300kΩ, Rc=2kΩ and RL=4kΩ; source resistance Rsi is unspecified. Figure (b) clips the negative output half-cycle.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

PNP发射极接地，基极通过300kΩ接−12V，集电极通过2kΩ接−12V；耦合电容输入与输出，输出负载4kΩ接地。右图输出负半周削平。Grounded-emitter PNP, base through 300kΩ to −12V, collector through 2kΩ to −12V, input and output coupling capacitors, and 4kΩ grounded output load. The right waveform clips on its negative half-cycle.

本题图在书第186页／PDF第219页。The source figure is on printed p. 186 · PDF p. 219.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

PNP带符号偏置；共射极小信号模型；截止、饱和边界。Signed PNP bias; common-emitter small-signal model; cutoff and saturation boundaries.
PNP电流大小先取正值算，再恢复VCE的负号。交流增益仍反相；用含RL的交流负载线判断削平方向，不能把有载中频波形的截止边界直接设为负电源电压。Compute positive PNP current magnitudes first, then restore the negative VCE. The AC gain still inverts. Use the AC load line including RL to classify clipping; do not set the cutoff boundary of the loaded midband waveform directly to the negative supply rail.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）Q点(1) Bias point

发射极0V，基极−0.7V，基极电阻上电压11.3V。The emitter is at 0V and base at −0.7V, leaving 11.3V across Rb.

|IBQ|=11.3V300kΩ=37.6667μA;|ICQ|=3.76667mA;VCEQ=−12+|IC|2kΩ=−4.46667V

检查两结偏置Check both junction biases

基极−0.7V，集电极−4.46667V，PNP集电极低于基极，集电结反偏，放大区成立。The PNP collector at −4.46667V is below the −0.7V base; its collector junction is reverse-biased, consistent with forward-active operation.

VCB=−4.46667−(−0.7)=−3.76667V<0

（2）小信号等效(2) Small-signal equivalent

中频电容短路，−12V为交流地。发射极交流接地，基极rbe与Rb并联接地；集电极Rc与RL并联接地。晶体管用rbe和从集电极到发射极的受控增量电流βib表示，ib定义为流入基极的带符号增量。信号源保留串联Rsi。At midband the capacitors are shorts and −12V is AC ground. The emitter is grounded; rbe and Rb are parallel to ground at the base; Rc and RL are parallel to ground at the collector. Model the transistor by rbe and controlled incremental current βib from collector to emitter, with ib defined as the signed current increment entering the base. Retain source resistance Rsi.

rbe≈200+101×26mV3.80433mA≈890.265Ω

（3）增益和电阻(3) Gain and resistances

Av以实际输入vi定义，不需要未给值的Rsi；输入电阻需并联300kΩ偏置电阻，不能只报rbe。Av is defined from actual input vi, so the unspecified Rsi is not needed. Input resistance includes the 300kΩ bias resistor in parallel, rather than rbe alone.

Av=−β(Rc∥RL)rbe≈−149.768;Ri=300kΩ∥890.265Ω≈887.631Ω;Ro=2kΩ

（4）带负载交流负载线：负向削平为截止(4) Loaded AC load line: negative clipping is cutoff

在中频近似下，输出耦合电容的直流电压约保持Q点值，故vo=vC−VCQ。令ICQ=3.76667mA表示静态集电流大小，jC为PNP从发射极流向集电极的瞬时电流大小，集电极KCL给jC=ICQ+vo(Rc∥RL)。截止时jC=0，所以vo约为−5.0222V，为负向极限；对应瞬时vC约−9.4889V，并非−12V。饱和端则是集电极趋近发射极，对应正输出。图b的负向削平因此是截止失真。减小Rb可提高静态电流、增加截止端的交流摆幅余量；调整后仍须检查饱和端余量。该负载线用于给定Q点附近的中频近似，题目未给信号幅度、频率和电容数值，不能据此精确预测大失真后的整个稳态波形。At midband, the output coupling capacitor approximately retains its quiescent DC voltage, so vo=vC−VCQ. Let ICQ=3.76667mA denote the quiescent collector-current magnitude, and let jC be the instantaneous PNP current magnitude flowing from emitter to collector. Collector KCL gives jC=ICQ+vo(Rc∥RL). At cutoff jC=0, giving vo≈−5.0222V: the negative swing limit. The corresponding instantaneous collector voltage is about −9.4889V, not −12V. At the saturation end the collector approaches the emitter, producing positive output. The negative clipping in Fig. (b) is therefore cutoff distortion. Decreasing Rb raises bias current and increases cutoff-side AC headroom; recheck saturation-side headroom after adjustment. This is a midband load-line approximation about the stated Q point. Signal amplitude, frequency and capacitance values are unspecified, so it is not an exact prediction of the entire steady-state waveform after strong clipping.

Rac=Rc∥RL=43kΩ;jC=ICQ+voRac;vo,cut=−ICQRac≈−5.02222V;vC,cut=VCQ+vo,cut≈−9.48889V

共射极增量等效图：输入端rbe并Rb接地；输出端Rc并RL接地，受控增量电流βib从集电极到交流接地发射极。Common-emitter incremental equivalent: rbe parallel Rb at the input, Rc parallel RL at the output, and controlled incremental current βib from collector to AC-grounded emitter.

（1）|ICQ|≈3.76667mA，VCEQ≈−4.46667V；（2）见小信号等效图；（3）采用rbb′=200Ω、VT=26mV：Av≈−149.768，Ri≈887.631Ω，Ro=2kΩ；（4）截止失真，减小Rb提高偏置电流，并复查饱和余量。(1)|ICQ|≈3.76667mA, VCEQ≈−4.46667V. (2) See the equivalent. (3) With rbb′=200Ω and VT=26mV: Av≈−149.768, Ri≈887.631Ω, Ro=2kΩ. (4) Cutoff distortion; decrease Rb to raise bias current, then recheck saturation headroom.

易错点Common errors

  • PNP的VCE为负，不能只给其绝对值而不说明。PNPVCE is negative; do not silently give only its magnitude.
  • Ri=rbe∥Rb；忽略Rb只是一种数值近似。Ri=rbe∥Rb; omitting Rb is only a numerical approximation.
  • 输出耦合电容隔直但传递交流，截止摆幅要用Rc∥RL的交流负载线，不能直接用直流负载线的−12V端点。The output coupling capacitor blocks DC but passes AC. Use the Rc∥RL AC load line for cutoff swing; do not directly use the −12V endpoint of the DC load line.

核验依据Verification

直流取恒VBE=−0.7V及有限β。交流取中频、rbb′=200Ω、VT=26mV；忽略厄利效应，即晶体管ro→∞。失真方向按含RL、耦合电容近似保留Q点直流电压的交流负载线判断；不声称精确预测任意频率或强失真后的完整波形。DC uses constant VBE=−0.7V and finite β. AC uses midband operation, rbb′=200Ω and VT=26mV; neglect the Early effect, taking transistor ro→∞. Clipping direction uses the AC load line including RL, with the coupling capacitor approximately retaining its quiescent DC voltage. This does not claim an exact complete waveform at arbitrary frequency or after strong distortion.

独立重算直流电阻KVL与PNP两结偏置；采用带符号的流入基极增量电流，rbe、βib方向与反相增益一致。交流以vi=1mV列集电极KCL回算Av。失真方向改用含RL的交流负载线复核：耦合电容保持Q点直流电压时jC=(vC+12)Rc+voRL=ICQ+vo(Rc∥RL)；令jC=0得到vo≈−5.02222V、vC≈−9.48889V，原电路KCL残差为0，负向削平是截止。不能用VC→−12V代替有载中频波形的核验。Independently recomputed DC resistor KVL and both PNP junction biases. With the signed incremental current entering the base, the rbe and βib references are consistent with the inverting gain. A1mV AC test input and collector KCL reproduce Av. Clipping direction was independently checked with the AC load line including RL: with the coupling capacitor retaining its quiescent DC voltage, jC=(vC+12)Rc+voRL=ICQ+vo(Rc∥RL). Setting jC=0 gives vo≈−5.02222V and vC≈−9.48889V, satisfying the original collector KCL with zero residual and establishing negative clipping as cutoff. VC→−12V is not used as the loaded midband waveform check.

5.2.8指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第186页／PDF第219页。范围状态：考试范围：BJT5.1、共射5.2.1～5.2.4。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 186 · PDF p. 219. Coverage: required: BJTsection5.1 and CEsections5.2.1–5.2.4.

指定要求：5.2.8Assigned requirement: 5.2.8

射极偏置：基极加载不可在精确复核时漏掉Emitter bias: retain base loading in the checked solution

题目原文Transcribed question

射极偏置电路如图题5.2.8所示，已知β=60。（1）用估算法求Q点；（2）求BJT的输入电阻rbe；（3）用小信号模型分析法求电压增益Av；（4）电路其他参数不变，如果要使VCEQ=4V，问基极上偏流电阻Rb1为多大？ 图中：VCC=16V，Rb1=60kΩ，Rb2=20kΩ，Rc=3kΩ，Re=2kΩ，RL=6kΩ；输入、输出耦合电容各30μF，射极旁路50μF，BJT标为3DG4。For the emitter-biased circuit in Fig. 5.2.8, β=60.(1) Estimate Q. (2) Find transistor input resistance rbe. (3) Use the small-signal model to find voltage gain Av. (4) With all other parameters unchanged, find the upper base-bias resistor Rb1 needed for VCEQ=4V. Figure values: VCC=16V, Rb1=60kΩ, Rb2=20kΩ, Rc=3kΩ, Re=2kΩ, RL=6kΩ; input and output coupling capacitors 30μF each, emitter bypass 50μF, transistor 3DG4.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

NPN分压射极偏置：60kΩ20kΩ基极分压，3kΩ集电极电阻，2kΩ射极电阻由50μF旁路；输出耦合到6kΩ负载。Divider-biased NPN: 60kΩ and 20kΩ base divider, 3kΩ collector resistor, 2kΩ emitter resistor bypassed by 50μF, and output coupled to 6kΩ.

本题图在书第186页／PDF第219页。The source figure is on printed p. 186 · PDF p. 219.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

分压器戴维南等效；有限β的基极加载；旁路射极共射增益。Divider Thevenin equivalent; finite−β base loading; bypassed-emitter common-emitter gain.
分压器戴维南电阻15kΩ相对(β+1)Re=122kΩ并非完全可忽略。主解保留基极加载，并另给常见忽略加载估算，避免混用两组Q点。Divider resistance 15kΩ is not entirely negligible beside (β+1)Re=122kΩ. The checked main solution retains base loading and separately identifies the common unloaded-divider estimate, avoiding mixed bias points.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

（1）估算模型中保留分压加载(1) Retain divider loading in the estimate

取硅BJT恒VBE≈0.7V，分压等效VTH=4V、RTH=15kΩ。由基极回路求IB，再得IC、IE。Use silicon constant VBE≈0.7V. The divider gives VTH=4V and RTH=15kΩ. Solve the base loop, then find IC and IE.

IB=4−0.715kΩ+61(2kΩ)≈24.0876μA;IC≈1.44526mA;IE≈1.46934mA

求VCE并说明常见近似Find VCE and identify the common approximation

保留加载时VE≈2.93869V、VC≈11.66423V，VCE≈8.72555V；两结偏置满足放大区。若课堂直接忽略基流对分压器的加载并取IC≈IE，则得IC≈1.65mA、VCE≈7.75V；这是一组精度较低的另一近似，不能拿它与主解的rbe交叉混用。With loading retained, VE≈2.93869V, VC≈11.66423V and VCE≈8.72555V; both junction biases satisfy forward-active operation. Ignoring divider loading and taking IC≈IE instead gives about 1.65mA and 7.75V. This lower-accuracy approximation must not be mixed with the main solution’srbe.

VCEQ=16−3kΩIC−2kΩIE≈8.72555V

（2）求rbe(2) Find rbe

按课件常用rbb′≈200Ω、VT=26mV，始终使用主解的IE。Use course rbb′≈200Ω and VT=26mV, consistently with the main solution’sIE.

rbe≈200+61(26mV)1.46934mA≈1279.394Ω

（3）求增益(3) Find gain

中频射极旁路有效，发射极交流接地；负载并到集电极电阻，Rc∥RL=2kΩ。At midband, the emitter bypass grounds the emitter at AC. The collector load is Rc∥RL=2kΩ.

Av=−β(Rc∥RL)rbe=−60(2kΩ)1279.394Ω≈−93.7944

（4）先由目标VCE反求IB(4) Recover IB from the target VCE

保留β有限，VCE=16−IB[βRc+(β+1)Re]。目标4V给出IB≈39.7351μA和VB≈5.54768V。With finite β, VCE=16−IB[βRc+(β+1)Re]. The 4V target gives IB≈39.7351μA and VB≈5.54768V.

IB=16−460(3kΩ)+61(2kΩ)=12302kΩ;VB=0.7+61IB(2kΩ)≈5.54768V

基极KCL求Rb1并回代Use base KCL for Rb1, then substitute back

上电阻电流必须同时提供下分压电流和基流。用目标VB及IB解Rb1，得到约32.96kΩ。若忽略基极加载并取IC≈IE，常见粗略结果约38.18kΩ，代回有限β模型不会得到精确4V。The upper resistor must supply both lower-divider current and base current. Using target VB and IB gives about 32.96kΩ. The common unloaded-divider estimate of about 38.18kΩ does not reproduce exactly 4V in the finite−β model.

16−VBRb1=VB20kΩ+IB;Rb1≈32.9602kΩ

按VBE=0.7V并保留有限β加载：（1）ICQ≈1.44526mA，VCEQ≈8.72555V；（2）rbe≈1.27939kΩ；（3）Av≈−93.7944；（4）Rb1≈32.9602kΩ。rbe和Av另采用课件rbb′=200Ω、VT=26mV。With VBE=0.7V and finite−β loading: (1)ICQ≈1.44526mA, VCEQ≈8.72555V. (2)rbe≈1.27939kΩ. (3)Av≈−93.7944. (4)Rb1≈32.9602kΩ. The small-signal values additionally use course rbb′=200Ω and VT=26mV.

易错点Common errors

  • 保留加载与忽略加载是不同精度模型，不能把两种结果混合。Loaded and unloaded divider calculations use different approximations; do not mix their results.
  • 设计Rb1时上电阻电流不等于下电阻电流，相差IB。When designing Rb1, upper and lower resistor currents differ by IB.

核验依据Verification

恒VBE=0.7V，有限β及分压加载；中频、rbb′=200Ω、VT=26mV，射极旁路有效；忽略厄利效应，即晶体管ro→∞。Constant VBE=0.7V with finite β and divider loading; midband operation, rbb′=200Ω, VT=26mV and an effective emitter bypass. Neglect the Early effect, taking transistor ro→∞.

独立在基极直接写原网络KCL，核对(16−VB)60k=VB20k+IB；直流两结偏置均满足放大区。第4问将新Rb1代回原分压网络重新求IB和VCE，回得4V。交流以测试输入列集电极KCL复核增益。Independently checked original-network base KCL, (16−VB)60k=VB20k+IB, and both forward-active junction biases. For part (4), re-solving the original divider with the new Rb1 recovers VCE=4V. A test-input collector KCL independently verifies the AC gain.

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第186页／PDF第219页。范围状态：考试范围：BJT5.1、共射5.2.1～5.2.4。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 186 · PDF p. 219. Coverage: required: BJTsection5.1 and CEsections5.2.1–5.2.4.

双电源偏置与源电阻压降Dual-supply bias and source-resistance drop

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题5.2.10，vs为正弦波，Rsi=500Ω、β=100、vBE=0.7V，Cb1、Cb2容抗可忽略。电源为±15V。(1)使IEQ约1mA，求Re；(2)使VCQ=+5V，求Rc；(3)若RL=5kΩ，求Avs。For Fig.5.2.10,vs is sinusoidal,Rsi500Ω,beta100,vBE0.7V and both capacitor reactances are negligible,with ±15V supplies. (1)Choose Re for IEQ≈1mA. (2)Choose Rc for VCQ+5V. (3)Find Avs with RL5kΩ.

教材原图，保留电源极性、端口和电容连接。Original textbook diagram preserving supply polarities,ports and capacitor connections.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

BJT工作区、有限β偏置、交直流通路及端口加载。BJT operating regions,finite−β bias,DC and AC paths and port loading.
直流时旁路电容开路，源直流值零但Rsi仍承载IB；交流时射极被Cb2接地。The bypass is DC-open; the zero-DC source still carries IB through Rsi. In AC,Cb2 grounds the emitter.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1)先求有限β偏置(1) Finite−β bias

以IE=1mA设计，则IB≈9.90099μA，VB=−RsiIB，VE=VB−0.7V。Design at IE1mA: IB≈9.90099μA,VB=−RsiIB and VE=VB−0.7V.

BJT工作区、有限β偏置、交直流通路及端口加载。BJT operating regions,finite−β bias,DC and AC paths and port loading.
(a)基极被Cb接地，为共基；(b)源极R1未旁路，是源退化共源；(c)从射极取输出，为共集。(a)Cb grounds the base: common base. (b)Unbypassed R1 gives source-degenerated common source. (c)Emitter output gives common collector.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1)分别看输入端(1) Examine each input port

(a)射极低阻，Re仍并联；(b)栅极不吸电流但Rg3串联偏置等效电阻；(c)射极负载按β+1反射到基极，再与偏置电阻并联。(a)Emitter input is low resistance with Re in parallel. (b)Zero gate current still leaves Rg3 in series with the divider resistance. (c)Reflect the emitter load by β+1,then shunt the base divider.

Ri,a=3.3kΩ∥1530Ω51≈29.7297Ω,Ri,b=2MΩ+(300∥100)kΩ=2.075MΩ,Ri,c=12kΩ∥[1530Ω+51(3.3∥5.1)kΩ]≈10.7555kΩ

(2)输出电阻先移除外接负载(2) Remove external loads for output resistance

输入电压源置零。基本模型忽略晶体管输出电导；若要实际器件的精确结果，还需ro或rds，题目未给。Zero the input source. These basic-model values neglect transistor output conductance; exact device results would require the unspecified ro or rds.

Ro,a=3.3kΩ,Ro,b=10kΩ,Ro,c=3.3kΩ∥1530Ω51≈29.7297Ω

(3)(4)按实际交流负载比较增益和相位(3)(4) Compare loaded gains and phase

(a)共基同相；(b)共源反相且R1造成退化；(c)跟随器同相。两个BJT的给定rbe直接使用，不另添加基区电阻。(a)Common base is non-inverting. (b)Common source inverts and R1 degenerates its gain. (c)The follower is non-inverting. Use the given BJTrbe without adding base resistance again.

Av,a=50(3.3∥5.1)kΩ1.53kΩ≈65.4762,Av,b=−gmRd1+gmR1=−103,Av,c=51(3.3∥5.1)kΩ1.53kΩ+51(3.3∥5.1)kΩ≈0.985248

(1)Ri最大(b)、最小(a)；(2)Ro最大(b)、最小(c)；(3)|Av|最大(a)、最小(c)；(4)仅(b)反相。数值及比较采用所列中频基本模型。(1)Ri largest(b),smallest(a). (2)Ro largest(b),smallest(c). (3)|Av| largest(a),smallest(c). (4)Only(b) inverts,under the stated midband basic model.

易错点Common errors

  • 看到BJT不要一律套共射公式；先判断哪个电极是交流公共端。(b)的C只旁路R2，没有旁路R1。Do not apply common-emitter formulas to every BJT: first identify the AC-common terminal. In(b),C bypasses R2,not R1.

核验依据Verification

按原图电源极性、电容及负载连接重建方程；独立KCL、KVL复算，5.2.13的三种接法另用数值节点矩阵求解，核对放大区。没有声称与未读取的外部答案库比对。Equations are rebuilt from original supply polarities,capacitors and load connections. Independent KCL and KVL checks include numerical nodal matrices for all three connections of5.2.13 and active-region checks. No comparison with an unread external answer collection is claimed.

8.1.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第348页／PDF第381页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 348 · PDF p. 381. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.1.1Assigned requirement: 8.1.1

追踪反馈通路：电容决定直流还是交流Trace feedback paths: capacitors determine DC versus AC feedback

题目原文Transcribed question

在图题8.1.1所示的各电路中，哪些元件组成了级间反馈通路？它们所引入的反馈是正反馈还是负反馈？是直流反馈还是交流反馈（设各电路中电容的容抗对交流信号均可忽略）？For every circuit in Fig. 8.1.1, identify the components forming interstage feedback paths, determine positive or negative feedback, and identify DC and and or AC feedback. Capacitor reactances are negligible for the AC signal.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R2R1反馈到反相端；(b)A2作电压跟随器，经R3反馈到A1反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R6，其电压返回A1同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R1接地，并经R2回反相求和点，漏极Rd输出；(e)三级共源极，Rf从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T1与T3共用Re1，Rf1Rf2之间有接地电容C2，输出经C3耦合。Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R2 and R1 feedback to the inverting input; (b)A2 voltage follower returns through R3 to A1 summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R6 returning to A1 non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R1 and R2 return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with Rf from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T1 and T3 emitter resistor Re1, and grounded C2 at the Rf1 and Rf2 junction, with C3 output coupling.

本题图在书第349页／PDF第382页。The source figure is on printed p. 349 · PDF p. 382.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反馈通路；瞬时极性法；电容直流开路、交流短路。Feedback paths; instantaneous-polarity method; capacitors open at DC and short at AC.
先把输出量扰动，沿返回路径追踪净输入变化；不能只数反相级。含电容的图先分别画直流与中频通路。Perturb the output and trace how the return path changes the net input; counting inversions alone is insufficient. Analyze separate DC and midband circuits where capacitors appear.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)R1、R2(a)R1 and R2

输出电压增大使反相输入经R2R1分压增大，运放输出及跟随器输出被压低，负反馈。反馈通路无隔直电容，直流、交流都存在。A higher output increases the inverting-input divider voltage, reducing the amplifier and follower output. This is negative feedback at both DC and AC; the return path has no blocking capacitor.

(b)A2、R3(b)A2 and R3

A2自身为电压跟随器，输出电压经A2缓冲、R3返回A1反相求和点；输出增大会使A1输出下降，为负反馈，兼有直流与交流。A2 is a voltage follower. The output returns through A2 and R3 to the inverting summing node of A1. A positive output change drives A1 output down: negative feedback at DC and AC.

(c)R6及其返回导线(c)R6 and the return connection

负载电流增大使R6电压增大，A1同相端增大使A1输出增大；A2为反相级，末级输出及负载电流反而减小，为负反馈。R2、R5分别是运放局部反馈，R6构成跨级电流反馈；直流交流都有。Increased load current raises the R6 voltage and A1 non-inverting input, increasing A1 output. A2 inverts, reducing final output and current: negative feedback. R2 and R5 are local op-amp loops; R6 supplies the interstage current feedback. It acts at DC and AC.

(d)R1、R2(d)R1 and R2

漏、源电流增大使源极取样电压增大，经R2提高运放反相端，运放输出下降，抑制MOS电流，为负反馈。反馈通路对直流与交流都存在。Increased MOS drain and source current raises the source-sense voltage. R2 raises the inverting input, lowering op-amp output and opposing the MOS−current increase. Negative feedback acts at DC and AC.

(e)Rf(e)Rf

末级输出升高经Rf使首级栅极升高，三级共源极放大总反相，末级输出被拉低，为负反馈。电路直接耦合，直流交流都有。A positive final output change raises the first gate through Rf. Three common-source stages invert overall, driving the final output down. Direct coupling permits DC and AC negative feedback.

(f) 两条通路必须分开(f) Separate the two paths

Re1由T1、T3共用，末级电流改变首级射极电位，形成直流和交流的电流串联负反馈。Rf2、Rf1从末级集电极回首级基极，形成直流电压并联负反馈；中频C2把二者中点交流接地，切断这条跨级交流返回通路，Rf1、Rf2只分别作为输入、输出交流负载。C1、C3为输入输出耦合电容。Shared emitter resistor Re1 links T1 and T3, giving DC and AC negative current-series feedback. Rf2 and Rf1 return the final collector voltage to the first base, providing DC negative voltage-shunt feedback. At midband C2 AC-grounds their junction, interrupting that interstage AC return; Rf1 and Rf2 separately load the input and output. C1 and C3 are coupling capacitors.

(a)R1R2、(b)A2R3、(c)R6、(d)R1R2、(e)Rf均引入负反馈，兼有直流与交流。(f)共用Re1：直流和交流电流串联负反馈；Rf1Rf2：仅直流跨级电压并联负反馈，交流被C2隔断。(a)R1R2, (b)A2R3, (c)R6, (d)R1R2 and (e)Rf all give negative feedback at DC and AC. (f) Shared Re1 gives DC and AC current-series negative feedback; Rf1Rf2 give DC interstage voltage-shunt negative feedback, interrupted at AC by C2.

易错点Common errors

  • (f)中C2接地而非串联隔直，它通过交流短路中间节点切断Rf链的信号传输。C2 in (f) shunts the middle node to AC ground; it is not a series blocking capacitor.
  • 局部反馈与跨级反馈要分清。Distinguish local feedback from interstage feedback.

核验依据Verification

器件处于小信号放大区，运放线性；按题设中频电容短路，直流电容开路。Small-signal active devices and linear op amps; capacitors short at midband and open at DC.

逐图使用输出扰动法，与输入扰动法交叉核对负反馈极性；(f)另按C2直流开路、交流短路重新画连接，确认交流仍存在共享射极Re1反馈。Cross-checked output-perturbation and input-perturbation sign tracing for every circuit. For (f), separately redrew C2 open at DC and short at AC, confirming that shared-emitter Re1 feedback remains at AC.

8.1.2指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第348页／PDF第381页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 348 · PDF p. 381. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.1.2Assigned requirement: 8.1.2

反馈组态：输出短路测试，加上输入求和方式Feedback topology: output-short test plus input mixing

题目原文Transcribed question

试判断图题8.1.1所示各电路中，级间交流反馈的组态。Determine the interstage AC-feedback topology for every circuit in Fig. 8.1.1.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R2R1反馈到反相端；(b)A2作电压跟随器，经R3反馈到A1反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R6，其电压返回A1同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R1接地，并经R2回反相求和点，漏极Rd输出；(e)三级共源极，Rf从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T1与T3共用Re1，Rf1Rf2之间有接地电容C2，输出经C3耦合。Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R2 and R1 feedback to the inverting input; (b)A2 voltage follower returns through R3 to A1 summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R6 returning to A1 non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R1 and R2 return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with Rf from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T1 and T3 emitter resistor Re1, and grounded C2 at the Rf1 and Rf2 junction, with C3 output coupling.

本题图在书第349页／PDF第382页。The source figure is on printed p. 349 · PDF p. 382.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电压、电流取样；串联、并联混合；交流通路。Voltage and current sampling; series and shunt mixing; AC equivalent circuits.
输出短路后返回量消失的是电压取样，仍可由输出电流产生返回量的是电流取样；再看净输入是电压差还是电流和。If shorting the output removes the feedback signal, sampling is voltage-based. If current still produces feedback, it is current-based. Then identify voltage subtraction versus current summation at the input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a)、(b)(a), (b)

(a)输出电压分压送反相端，与同相输入电压相减，是电压串联。(b)输出电压由A2缓冲后经R3返回同一个反相求和点，是电压并联。(a)A divided output voltage is subtracted from the non-inverting input: voltage-series. (b)A2 buffers output voltage and R3 returns current to the inverting summing node: voltage-shunt.

(c)、(d)(c), (d)

(c)R6与负载电流串联取样，返回A1另一个输入端形成电压差，是电流串联。(d)源极支路取样MOS电流，R2把反馈电流送回与输入R1共用的求和点，是电流并联。(c)R6 samples load current and returns a voltage to the other A1 input: current-series. (d) The source branch samples MOS current, with R2 returning current to the same summing node as input R1: current-shunt.

(e)、(f)(e), (f)

(e)Rf跨输出电压与输入栅极求和点，是电压并联。(f)C2切断电阻链交流跨级返回，剩下共享Re1取样末级电流并改变首级射极电位，与基极输入相减，是电流串联。(e)Rf connects output voltage to the input gate summing node: voltage-shunt. (f)C2 interrupts the resistive interstage AC path; shared Re1 samples final-stage current and changes the first emitter voltage, subtracting from base input: current-series.

(a)电压串联；(b)电压并联；(c)电流串联；(d)电流并联；(e)电压并联；(f)电流串联。各图均为负反馈。(a) Voltage-series. (b) Voltage-shunt. (c) Current-series. (d) Current-shunt. (e) Voltage-shunt. (f) Current-series. All are negative feedback.

易错点Common errors

  • 不要仅凭“反馈电阻接输出端”判断电压反馈，要看被取样的具体电流、电压。A resistor connected near an output does not by itself establish voltage feedback; identify the sampled quantity.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号，题设电容容抗忽略。Midband small signal with negligible capacitor reactance.

输出短路测试与输入混合关系分别核对六图；特别(c)(d)(f)输出短路并不消除各电流取样支路中的反馈信号，(a)(b)(e)则消除电压返回量。Applied output-short and input-mixing tests independently to all six circuits. In particular, shorting the output does not remove the current-sampling signals in (c), (d) and (f), but removes the voltage feedback in (a), (b) and (e).

8.1.7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第351页／PDF第384页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 351 · PDF p. 384. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.1.7Assigned requirement: 8.1.7

差分输入反馈：判断哪一支栅压抵消净输入Differential-input feedback: identify the opposing gate signal

题目原文Transcribed question

试判断图题8.1.7所示各电路中，级间交流反馈的极性及组态。Determine the polarity and topology of the interstage AC feedback in each circuit of Fig. 8.1.7.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

四图均以MOS差分级为输入。(a)T2栅由末级T3源电流经过R3及R1R2分压返回；(b)T1栅接地，电流源输入T2栅求和点，末级T5源电流由R2取样、经R1返回；(c)输入T1栅，T3为PNP级，反馈由其集电极R3及R1R2送T2栅，输出取T3发射极；(d)末级源极输出直接送T2栅。Four MOS differential-input circuits: (a) final T3 source current is sampled by R3 and divided by R1 and R2 back to T2 gate; (b)T1 gate grounded, current-source input at the T2 gate summing node, with final T5 source current sensed by R2 and returned through R1; (c)PNP final T3, collector current sampled through R3 and R1 and R2 to T2 gate, with output at the emitter; (d) final source output directly returns to T2 gate.

本题图在书第351页／PDF第384页。The source figure is on printed p. 351 · PDF p. 384.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

差分级电流转向；有源负载；电流取样与电压取样；输入混合。Differential current steering; active loads; current and voltage sampling; input mixing.
差分级的两个栅输入极性相反，不能把左右支路都当作普通共源反相级。先追踪电流转向，再追末级和返回信号。The two differential gates have opposite signal signs; do not treat both branches as ordinary common-source stages. Trace current steering, final-stage response, then the return signal.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 电流串联负反馈(a) Negative current-series feedback

T1输入升高使T1电流增大、T2电流减小，T2漏电压升高，使T3电流增大。其源极取样电压经R2R1使T2栅升高，促使T2电流回升，抵消原来的差分输入；输出电流取样、栅极电压差混合。Raising T1 gate raises its current and lowers T2 current, raising T2 drain voltage and T3 current. The source-sense voltage divided by R2R1 raises T2 gate and restores T2 current, opposing the original differential input. Sampling is current-based and mixing is a gate-voltage difference.

(b) 电流并联负反馈(b) Negative current-shunt feedback

输入电流进入T2栅求和节点，栅压升高使T2漏极节点下降，末级T5电流下降，R2取样节点下降，经R1送回的电流减小，抵消输入作用。反馈与输入在同一节点按电流求和。Input current enters the T2 gate summing node. Increased gate voltage lowers its drain node and final T5 current; the R2 sense node falls and returns less current through R1, opposing the input change. Input and feedback currents mix at one node.

(c) 电流串联负反馈(c) Negative current-series feedback

T1栅升高使其漏极电压下降，PNPT3基极下降，集电流大小增大；R3上取样电压升高，经R2R1提高T2栅，抵消差分输入。输出取T3发射极，但反馈取其集电流；不能仅看vo端位置判断为电压反馈。Raising T1 gate lowers its drain and the PNPT3 base, increasing collector-current magnitude. The R3 sense voltage rises and raises T2 gate through R2R1, opposing the differential input. The output is at T3 emitter, but feedback samples collector current; the vo terminal alone does not make this voltage feedback.

(d) 电压串联负反馈(d) Negative voltage-series feedback

T1栅升高经差分有源负载使T5栅升高，源极输出升高；输出直接提高T2栅，减小差分净输入。输出电压直接取样，与T1输入构成电压差。Raising T1 gate raises the T5 gate through the active-loaded differential stage, raising its source output. Direct return to T2 gate reduces the differential input. This samples voltage and mixes a voltage difference.

(a)电流串联负反馈；(b)电流并联负反馈；(c)电流串联负反馈；(d)电压串联负反馈。(a) Negative current-series. (b) Negative current-shunt. (c) Negative current-series. (d) Negative voltage-series.

易错点Common errors

  • (c)取样端不是标注vo的端点，必须检查实际反馈网络。In (c), sampling is not at the labeled vo terminal; inspect the actual return network.

核验依据Verification

晶体管均工作于小信号放大区；恒流源为理想；差分有源负载按图中连接。All transistors in small-signal active regions, ideal current sources, active loads connected as drawn.

对每图独立做输入正扰动和反馈端正扰动，两者对差分净输入的作用相反；输出短路测试将(a)(b)(c)的电流取样与(d)电压取样区分开。Independently traced positive input and feedback-terminal perturbations; they oppose one another at the differential input. The output-short test separates current sampling in (a), (b), (c) from voltage sampling in (d).

8.2.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第352页／PDF第385页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 352 · PDF p. 385. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.2.1Assigned requirement: 8.2.1

负反馈方框图：分清输入、反馈与净输入Feedback block diagram: distinguish input, feedback and error

题目原文Transcribed question

某反馈放大电路的方框图如图题8.2.1所示，已知其开环电压增益Av=2000，反馈系数Fv=0.0495。若输出电压vo=2V，求输入电压vi、反馈电压vf及净输入电压vid的值。For the feedback amplifier in Fig. 8.2.1, open-loop voltage gain Av=2000 and feedback factor Fv=0.0495. If vo=2V, find input vi, feedback vf and net input vid.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

输入求和点vid=vi−vf，前向增益Av，输出经Fv返回负号端。Summing junction vid=vi−vf, forward gain Av, with output returned through Fv to the negative input.

本题图在书第352页／PDF第385页。The source figure is on printed p. 352 · PDF p. 385.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

负反馈方框图代数；反馈深度；增益定义。Feedback block algebra; feedback depth; gain definitions.
已知输出时先沿两条路径分别反求净输入和反馈，再用求和关系求外部输入，最不易混淆。With output known, separately recover error and feedback from the two paths, then use the summing relation for external input.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由前向增益求净输入Recover error from forward gain

Av乘的是净输入vid，而非外部输入vi。Av multiplies net input vid, not external input vi.

vid=voAv=22000=0.001V=1mV

由反馈系数求反馈电压Recover feedback voltage

反馈系数定义vfvo。The feedback factor is vfvo.

vf=Fvvo=0.0495×2=0.099V=99mV

求和及闭环增益复核Sum and check closed-loop gain

负反馈vid=vi−vf，所以外部输入是净输入与反馈之和。Negative feedback means vid=vi−vf, so external input is their sum.

vi=vid+vf=0.100V;Avf=20001+2000(0.0495)=20

vi=100mV，vf=99mV，vid=1mV。vi=100mV, vf=99mV, vid=1mV.

易错点Common errors

  • vid不是vi；两者相差反馈电压99mV。vid is not vi; they differ by the 99mV feedback voltage.

核验依据Verification

线性静态方框图，图中负号连接，给定增益与反馈系数均为实数。Linear static block model with the shown subtractive junction and real stated gains.

独立代回：2000(0.100−0.099)=2V，0.0495×2=0.099V；闭环增益20.1=20与A(1+AF)一致。Independent substitution gives 2000(0.100−0.099)=2V and 0.0495×2=0.099V. Closed-loop gain 20.1=20 matches A(1+AF).
