8.4.1指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第354页／PDF第387页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 354 · PDF p. 387. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.4.1（闭环电压增益）Assigned requirement: 8.4.1 (closed-loop voltage gain)

深反馈闭环增益：先定义输入输出量及电流方向Deep-feedback gains: define input and output quantities and current signs

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题8.1.1a、b、d、e、f所示，试在深度负反馈条件下，近似计算它们的闭环增益和闭环电压增益。For circuits (a), (b), (d), (e) and (f) of Fig. 8.1.1, approximately calculate their closed-loop gain and closed-loop voltage gain under deep negative feedback.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

图8.1.1的六图：(a)运放和射极跟随器，输出经R2R1反馈到反相端；(b)A2作电压跟随器，经R3反馈到A1反相求和点；(c)两运放串联，负载电流经过R6，其电压返回A1同相端；(d)运放驱动NMOS，源极经R1接地，并经R2回反相求和点，漏极Rd输出；(e)三级共源极，Rf从末级漏极回首级栅极；(f)三级PNP共射，T1与T3共用Re1，Rf1Rf2之间有接地电容C2，输出经C3耦合。Six circuits: (a) op amp plus emitter follower with R2 and R1 feedback to the inverting input; (b)A2 voltage follower returns through R3 to A1 summing node; (c) two op amps, with load-current sense resistor R6 returning to A1 non-inverting input; (d) op amp driving NMOS, source resistor R1 and R2 return to the summing node, drain-resistor output; (e) three common-source stages with Rf from final drain to first gate; (f) three PNP common-emitter stages, shared T1 and T3 emitter resistor Re1, and grounded C2 at the Rf1 and Rf2 junction, with C3 output coupling.

本题图在书第349页／PDF第382页。The source figure is on printed p. 349 · PDF p. 382.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

深反馈净输入趋零；四种闭环增益单位；节点KCL；反馈网络加载。Near-zero error under deep feedback; units of four gain types; nodal KCL; feedback-network loading.
电压并联的基本闭环增益是跨阻，电流串联是跨导；先定义量，才不会把不同单位的增益当成同一个数。电流取样支路会分流，需列KCL。Voltage-shunt feedback gives a transresistance; current-series feedback gives a transconductance. Define the quantities before comparing gains with different units. Current-sense branches divide current, so use KCL.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 电压串联(a) Voltage-series

运放两输入端交流电位近似相等，反馈分压节点等于vi，输出包含射极跟随器且由总环路校正。The op-amp inputs are nearly equal, so the feedback divider node equals vi. The overall loop includes and corrects the emitter follower.

Af=Avf=vovi≈1+R2R1

(b) 电压并联(b) Voltage-shunt

A2为理想电压跟随器，送回R3的电压为vo。A1反相求和点近似零，正输入电流ii=viR1由R3返回输出。A2 is a voltage follower, returning vo through R3. The A1 summing node is nearly zero; positive input current ii=viR1 returns through R3.

Af=voii≈−R3[Ω];Avf=vovi≈−R3R1

(d) 电流并联：必须保留R2的反馈电流(d) Current-shunt: retain R2 feedback current

定义ii=viR1流入求和点，io=iD沿漏极流入MOS。运放反相节点≈0，KCL给vs=−R2ii。源极电流分到R1与R2两条通路，因此iD=vs(1R1+1R2)，不能只取vsR1。输出vo=−RdiD。Define ii=viR1 entering the summing node and io=iD entering the MOS drain. The inverting node is nearly zero, so KCL gives vs=−R2ii. Source current divides through both R1 and R2, giving iD=vs(1R1+1R2), not just vsR1. Output is vo=−RdiD.

Af=iDii≈−(1+R2R1);Avf≈RdR1(1+R2R1)

(e) 电压并联(e) Voltage-shunt

三级放大使总开环反相增益很大，首级栅极求和点近似零，MOS栅电流为零。定义ii=vsRsi，KCL给ii=−voRf。电压增益以图中源电压vs为输入，实际首级栅电压是净输入而非外部信号。With large inverting three-stage gain, the first gate summing node is nearly zero and gate current is zero. Define ii=vsRsi; KCL gives ii=−voRf. Voltage gain is referenced to the diagram’s source vs; the actual first gate voltage is the error, not the external signal.

Af=voii≈−Rf[Ω];Avf=vovs≈−RfRsi

(f) 电流串联，中频输出负载包含Rf2(f) Current-series, with Rf2 loading the output at midband

C2把电阻链中点交流接地，因此Rf2与Rc3共同加载输出；共享Re1仍反馈末级电流。采用本章常见深反馈近似：忽略T1射极增量电流相对T3，并取T3集电流≈射极电流，净输入vbe1≈0，故ve1≈vi。定义io为流入T3集电极的带符号增量，io≈viRe1；输出vo=−io(Rc3∥Rf2)。C2 AC-grounds the resistive-chain junction, so Rf2 loads the output in parallel with Rc3. Shared Re1 still feeds back final-stage current. Use the chapter’s usual deep-feedback approximation: neglect T1 emitter-current increment relative to T3, and approximate T3 collector current by emitter current. Near-zero vbe1 gives ve1≈vi. With io defined as the signed increment entering the T3 collector, io≈viRe1, and vo=−io(Rc3∥Rf2).

Af=iovi≈1Re1[S];Avf≈−Rc3∥Rf2Re1

(a)Af=Avf≈1+R2R1；(b)Af≈−R3Ω，Avf≈−R3R1；(d)按所定义电流方向Af≈−(1+R2R1)，Avf≈(RdR1)(1+R2R1)；(e)Af≈−RfΩ，vovs≈−RfRsi；(f)Af≈1Re1S，Avf≈−(Rc3∥Rf2)Re1，后者另采用首级射极电流可忽略、末级β大近似。(a)Af=Avf≈1+R2R1. (b)Af≈−R3Ω, Avf≈−R3R1. (d) With defined current signs, Af≈−(1+R2R1), Avf≈(RdR1)(1+R2R1). (e)Af≈−RfΩ, vovs≈−RfRsi. (f)Af≈1Re1S, Avf≈−(Rc3∥Rf2)Re1, additionally neglecting first-stage emitter current and assuming large final-stage β.

易错点Common errors

  • (d)R2也承载取样电流；漏掉它会把1+R2R1错写为R2R1。R2 in (d) also carries sense current; omitting it incorrectly changes 1+R2R1 into R2R1.
  • 电流增益正负号依赖所规定的io方向，本解已明确方向。Current-gain signs depend on the defined io direction, stated here.
  • (f)C2交流短路后Rf2成为输出负载，不可从交流电路删除。After C2 becomes an AC short, Rf2 loads the output and must remain.

核验依据Verification

中频深度负反馈，器件放大区、忽略Early效应与沟道长度调制，取器件输出电阻rords→∞；(f)另忽略首级射极电流并近似末级IC≈IE。Midband deep negative feedback, active devices and device output resistances rords→∞ (Early effect and channel-length modulation neglected); (f) additionally neglects first-stage emitter current and uses final-stage IC≈IE.

(a)(b)(d)(e)独立用理想输入条件列节点KCL，尤其(d)同时检查输入求和节点和MOS源节点；(f)用共享射极节点KCL及输出负载KCL验证所列近似，并明确忽略项。Independently wrote nodal KCL under ideal input conditions for (a), (b), (d), (e), checking both input and MOS−source nodes in (d). For (f), shared-emitter and output-load KCL verify the stated approximation, with neglected terms explicit.

8.4.3指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第355页／PDF第388页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 355 · PDF p. 388. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：8.4.3Assigned requirement: 8.4.3

按跨级环路判断深反馈，再核对加载Check global loop depth, then loading

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题8.4.3所示，试在深度负反馈的条件下，近似计算它的闭环电压增益。For Fig. 8.4.3, approximately calculate the closed-loop voltage gain under deep negative feedback.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

T1为NMOS，漏极经Rd接VDD并驱动PNPT2基极；T2发射极经Re接VDD，集电极为vo。T1源极经R1接地，并经R2接vo；栅极为vi且Rg接地。NMOS T1 drain through Rd to VDD drives PNPT2 base. T2 emitter through Re to VDD, collector at vo. T1 source connects through R1 to ground and R2 to vo. Input vi is at the gate, with Rg to ground.

本题图在书第355页／PDF第388页。The source figure is on printed p. 355 · PDF p. 388.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

MOS源极KCL；PNP带射极电阻的小信号输入；深反馈近似的适用条件。MOS−source KCL; emitter-degenerated PNP input model; conditions for deep-feedback approximations.
本题问跨级深度负反馈下的近似增益，考试结论为1+R2R1。要把“跨级环路很深”与“仅MOS互导很大”区分；后者单独不能保证反馈分压不被源极电流加载。The requested deep global-feedback approximation gives the exam result 1+R2R1. Distinguish a large interstage loop gain from merely large MOS transconductance; the latter alone does not ensure negligible source-current loading of the divider.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

考试主线：跨级深负反馈的电压增益Exam route: voltage gain with deep global feedback

T1共源与T2共射两次反相，输出升高经R2提高T1源极，减小净输入vgs1，为电压串联负反馈。按授课课件的跨级深反馈近似，vs≈vi，且首级源极电流相对跨级反馈电流可忽略，R1R2形成近似不加载的反馈分压。因此以实际栅极电压vi定义的闭环增益如下，Rg不引入额外源分压。Common-source T1 and common-emitter T2 invert twice. A higher output raises the T1 source through R2 and reduces vgs1, giving negative voltage-series feedback. Under the course’s deep global-feedback approximation, vs≈vi and first-stage source current is negligible relative to interstage feedback current, so R1R2 form an approximately unloaded feedback divider. The gain below is referred to actual gate voltage vi; Rg adds no source-divider factor.

Fv≈R1R1+R2;Avf≈1Fv=1+R2R1

保留加载：从原图列有限参数KCLRetain loading: finite-parameter KCL from the original

取VDD为交流地，T1源极为vs，T2带符号基流ib2定义为流入基极的增量；Zb=rbe2+(β2+1)Re。漏极、基极节点给ib2=−iD(1+ZbRd)，输出节点给(vo−vs)R2+β2ib2=0，源节点给vsR1+(vs−vo)R2=iD。再用iD=gm1(vi−vs)，得到有限参数下的一般增益。With VDD at AC ground, let vs be the T1 source voltage and define signed incremental ib2 entering the T2 base. Set Zb=rbe2+(β2+1)Re. Drain and base KCL gives ib2=−iD(1+ZbRd); output KCL gives (vo−vs)R2+β2ib2=0; source KCL gives vsR1+(vs−vo)R2=iD. Combining these with iD=gm1(vi−vs) gives the finite-parameter gain.

D=β21+ZbRd;m=gm1R1;r=R2R1;G=m[1+D+Dr]1+m(1+D)

用跨级环路增益核对“深度”条件Check depth using the interstage loop gain

把源极局部退化吸收到前向通道，令a=m(1+m)、Tglobal=aD。一般式可严格重写为下式。Tglobal≫1时趋于考试答案1+r；而Tglobal≤D，所以跨级环路足够深本身要求D很大，源极电流的加载修正随之变小。不是只检查gm1R1(1+D)≫1就足够。Absorb local source degeneration into the forward path and set a=m(1+m), Tglobal=aD. The general gain rewrites exactly as below. For Tglobal≫1 it approaches the exam result 1+r. Since Tglobal≤D, deep interstage feedback itself requires large D, making the source-current loading correction small. Merely checking gm1R1(1+D)≫1 is insufficient.

a=m1+m;Tglobal=aD;G=a+Tglobal(1+r)1+Tglobal;(1+r)−G=1+r−a1+Tglobal

拓展检查：仅增大MOS互导的极限Further check: increasing MOS transconductance alone

若只令gm1→∞而D保持有限，会得到1+rD(1+D)，其中保留了源极电流加载。这个结果描述vgs1很小的局部极限，不能当成“跨级全局深反馈”的替代答案。若需评估实际器件误差，使用一般有限参数式；题目没有给数值参数，不据此虚构数值增益。If only gm1→∞ while D stays finite, gain becomes 1+rD(1+D), retaining source-current loading. This is a local small−vgs1 limit, not a replacement for the deep global-feedback answer. Use the general finite-parameter expression to assess a real device’s error. No numerical gain is invented because the problem supplies no device values.

limgm1→∞G=1+R2R1β2β2+1+[rbe2+(β2+1)Re]Rd

按本题跨级深度负反馈近似，Avf≈1+R2R1，为同相增益。条件为跨级环路Tglobal=[gm1R1(1+gm1R1)]·β2[1+(rbe2+(β2+1)Re)Rd]≫1；仅gm1很大不等于满足此条件。有限参数加载修正见推导。Under the requested deep interstage negative-feedback approximation, Avf≈1+R2R1, a noninverting gain. The condition is Tglobal=[gm1R1(1+gm1R1)]·β2[1+(rbe2+(β2+1)Re)Rd]≫1; large gm1 alone does not establish it. See the derivation for finite-parameter loading corrections.

易错点Common errors

  • 考试主线用题设跨级深反馈条件，不要用仅gm1→∞的有限D极限替代它。Use the stated deep interstage-feedback condition for the exam answer; do not substitute the finite−D limit obtained by gm1→∞ alone.
  • MOS栅极电流为零，不代表源极电流恒为零；加载能否忽略要由环路与电流比验证。Zero gate current does not imply zero source current. Check loop gain and current ratios before neglecting loading.

核验依据Verification

中频小信号，两管具有正确偏置并处于放大区；忽略Early效应与沟道长度调制，取rords→∞。考试近似另要求跨级Tglobal≫1；一般式保留有限gm1、β2、rbe2与电阻加载。Midband small signal with both devices correctly biased in active operation; rords→∞, neglecting Early effect and channel-length modulation. The exam approximation additionally requires interstage Tglobal≫1. The general expression retains finite gm1, β2, rbe2 and resistor loading.

依据课件第8章第47、70、80页关于1+AF≫1的深反馈定义；独立按原图源极、漏极、基极、T2发射极及输出节点列MNA，与一般有限参数式交叉核验。再把局部源极退化并入前向，代数上严格重写为[a+Tglobal(1+r)](1+Tglobal)，证明真正跨级Tglobal≫1时趋向1+R2R1。有限D、gm1→∞的加载式仅标为另一极限，不用于替代题设答案。合成参数检查不冒充教材数据；未使用外部标准答案。Used the course slides, chapter 8 slides 47, 70 and 80, defining deep feedback by 1+AF≫1. Independent original-node MNA at source, drain and base, T2 emitter and output agrees with the general finite-parameter expression. Absorbing local source degeneration into the forward path rewrites it exactly as [a+Tglobal(1+r)](1+Tglobal), proving convergence to 1+R2R1 for deep interstage Tglobal≫1. The finite−D, gm1→∞ loading expression is identified only as a different limit, not substituted for the requested answer. Synthetic checks are not presented as textbook values; no external answer key was used.

参考模型依据Model references

  • COCOA · Introduction to Feedback (loading and return-ratio analysis)

10.2.3指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第434页／PDF第467页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 434 · PDF p. 467. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.2.3Assigned requirement: 10.2.3

先高通分压，再乘同相增益High-pass division followed by noninverting gain

题目原文Transcribed question

图题10.2.3所示为一阶高通滤波器电路，设A为理想运放，试推导电路的传递函数，并画出其幅频响应波特图，求−3dB截止角频率ωL。Figure 10.2.3 is a first-order high-pass filter. With ideal op amp A, derive its transfer function, draw its magnitude Bode plot and find the −3dB cutoff angular frequency ωL.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

输入vi经串联电容C接运放同相端，同相端经R接地；反相端经R1接地、经Rf接输出vo。Input vi reaches the noninverting input through series C, with R from that input to ground. The inverting input connects through R1 to ground and Rf to output vo.

本题图在书第434页／PDF第467页。The source figure is on printed p. 434 · PDF p. 467.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

复阻抗分压；理想运放虚短、虚断；同相放大；−3dB定义。Complex-impedance division; ideal op-amp input conditions; noninverting gain; the −3dB definition.
电容在输入串联支路，低频时隔断信号。先求同相端vp，再求运放比例，不能把R误当作R1。Series input C blocks low-frequency signals. Find vp first, then the amplifier gain; R and R1 are different components.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

输入RC高通分压Input RC high-pass division

运放输入电流为零，同相端只由串联C、对地R分压决定。Zero op-amp input current leaves a series C and shunt R divider.

Vp(s)Vi(s)=RR+1(sC)=sRC1+sRC

同相放大与总传递函数Noninverting amplification and total transfer

反相节点电压等于同相节点，R1与Rf的电流相等。定义高频通带增益A0=1+RfR1。The inverting and noninverting voltages are equal; R1 and Rf carry equal currents. Define high-frequency passband gain A0=1+RfR1.

Av(s)=Vo(s)Vi(s)=(1+RfR1)sRC1+sRC;Av(jω)=A0jωωL1+jωωL

幅频、截止频率和波特图Magnitude, cutoff and Bode plot

幅值从直流0趋向高频A0。截止处幅值为通带的12，约低3.0103dB。低频渐近线斜率+20dB每十倍频，高频水平于20log10A0。附图纵轴减去了通带分贝值。Magnitude rises from zero at DC to A0 at high frequency. At cutoff it is A02, about 3.0103dB below passband. The low-frequency asymptote rises at +20 dBdecade; the high-frequency level is 20log10A0. The plot subtracts the passband dB level.

|Av(jω)|=A0ωRC1+(ωRC)2;ωL=1RC;fL=12πRC

一阶高通归一化幅频波特图；纵轴相对通带增益，横轴ωωL。Normalized high-pass Bode magnitude relative to passband gain, versus ωωL.

Av(s)=(1+RfR1)sRC(1+sRC)，ωL=1(RC) rads。低频+20dB每十倍频，高频增益1+RfR1，截止点相对通带−3.0103dB。Av(s)=(1+RfR1)sRC(1+sRC), ωL=1(RC) rads. The low-frequency slope is +20 dBdecade; high-frequency gain is 1+RfR1, with cutoff 3.0103dB below passband.

易错点Common errors

  • ωL是角频率；若求Hz需再除2π。ωL is angular frequency; divide by 2π for Hz.
  • −3dB相对通带增益，而非固定输出增益−3dB。The −3dB level is relative to passband, not an absolute gain of −3dB.

核验依据Verification

理想运放线性负反馈、零输入电流、无限开环增益；R、R1、Rf、C均为正，忽略真实运放带宽限制。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, zero input current and infinite open-loop gain; positive R, R1, Rf and C. Real op-amp bandwidth limits are excluded.

从原图分别列同相端jωC(vp−vi)+vpR=0、反相端vnR1+(vn−vo)Rf=0及vn=vp，直接数值解节点，在归一化频率0.01、0.1、1、10、100处与传递函数一致；截止处归一化模平方恰为12；直流和高频极限相符。Independently solved the original noninverting-node equation jωC(vp−vi)+vpR=0, inverting-node equation vnR1+(vn−vo)Rf=0 and vn=vp. Direct node solutions at normalized frequencies 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 and 100 agree with the transfer function; normalized magnitude squared is exactly 12 at cutoff, and both endpoint limits agree.

10.3.4指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第435页／PDF第468页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 435 · PDF p. 468. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.3.4Assigned requirement: 10.3.4

按储能元件和连接判断阶数Determine order from storage elements and connections

题目原文Transcribed question

设A为理想运放，试写出图题10.3.4所示电路的传递函数，指出这是一个什么类型的滤波电路。With ideal op amp A, write the transfer function of Fig. 10.3.4 and identify the filter type.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

vi经R1、电容C串联接运放反相端；反相端经Rf接输出，同相端接地。Input vi passes through series R1 and C to the inverting input. Rf connects that input to the output; the noninverting input is grounded.

本题图在书第435页／PDF第468页。The source figure is on printed p. 435 · PDF p. 468.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

反相运放；输入复阻抗；低频和高频极限。Inverting op amp; complex input impedance; low and high-frequency limits.
输入阻抗是R1+1(sC)，不是并联。题目位于高阶滤波章节，但本图只有一个独立储能电容，传递函数是一阶。Input impedance is R1+1(sC), not a parallel combination. Although placed in the higher-order-filter section, this figure has one independent capacitor and a first-order transfer function.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写反相端KCLWrite inverting-node KCL

虚地vn=0，运放输入电流为零；输入串联支路电流全部流过Rf。The inverting node is at virtual ground, vn=0, with zero op-amp input current. All input-branch current flows through Rf.

Vi(s)R1+1(sC)=−Vo(s)Rf

化为标准高通形式Put into standard high-pass form

分子在s=0有零点，分母为一次式。直流被隔断，高频时电容短路而恢复普通反相比例放大。There is a zero at s=0 and a first-order denominator. DC is blocked; at high frequency C becomes a short, recovering an ordinary inverting amplifier.

Av(s)=−sCRf1+sCR1=−RfR1sωL1+sωL;ωL=1R1C

由端点核对滤波类型Check filter type using endpoint limits

直流增益0，高频增益−RfR1，故为反相一阶高通，Rf决定通带增益，R1C决定截止频率。DC gain is zero and high-frequency gain is −RfR1. It is therefore an inverting first-order high-pass filter. Rf sets passband gain while R1C sets cutoff.

Av(0)=0;Av(∞)=−RfR1

Av(s)=−sCRf(1+sCR1)，是一阶反相高通滤波电路；ωL=1(R1C)。Av(s)=−sCRf(1+sCR1), an inverting first-order high-pass filter, with ωL=1(R1C).

易错点Common errors

  • 不能根据章节名称直接断言本题是二阶滤波。Do not infer second order from the chapter heading.
  • R1与C串联，不能把输入阻抗写成R1∥1(sC)。R1 and C are in series; input impedance is not R1∥1(sC).

核验依据Verification

理想运放线性负反馈、正电阻电容、零初始条件的拉普拉斯传递函数。Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, positive resistors and capacitor and zero-initial-condition Laplace transfer function.

独立保留R1C之间节点vx：列(vx−vi)R1+jωCvx=0、−jωCvx−voRf=0，并与传递函数做多频点复数对照；单极点−1(R1C)位于左半平面，直流0和高频−RfR1均回代成立。Retained the original intermediate node vx between R1 and C and independently solved (vx−vi)R1+jωCvx=0 and −jωCvx−voRf=0. Complex solutions agree across multiple frequencies. The sole pole −1(R1C) is in the left half-plane; DC zero and high-frequency gain −RfR1 both check.

10.8.2指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第441页／PDF第474页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 441 · PDF p. 474. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.8.2Assigned requirement: 10.8.2

先比较v2−v1，再沿交点画输出Compare v2−v1 and switch at each intersection

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如图题10.8.2a所示，其输入电压的波形如图题10.8.2b所示，已知输出电压vo的最大值为±10V，运放是理想的，试画出输出电压vo的波形。The circuit and its input waveforms are shown in Fig. 10.8.2(a) and (b). The output limits are ±10V and the op amp is ideal. Draw output waveform vo.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

v1接反相端、v2接同相端，各有5.1kΩ对地电阻；输出负载5.1kΩ。图b中v1先于v2，起点v1=0且v2<0，两条近似同幅正弦曲线依次相交，未给数值幅值、周期或相位差。v1 drives the inverting input and v2 the noninverting input, each with 5.1kΩ to ground; load is 5.1kΩ. In Fig. (b), v1 leads v2, initially v1=0 and v2<0. The roughly equal-amplitude sinusoidal sketches cross repeatedly; no numerical amplitudes, period or phase difference are specified.

本题图在书第441页／PDF第474页。The source figure is on printed p. 441 · PDF p. 474.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想比较器；同相、反相输入符号；两信号大小比较。Ideal comparators; input polarities; comparison of two signal levels.
这是开环比较器，不能套用虚短。输出符号由同相端减反相端决定，即v2−v1。This is an open-loop comparator, so virtual-short analysis does not apply. Output sign follows noninverting minus inverting input, v2−v1.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写比较规则Write the comparison rule

理想运放无输入电流，5.1kΩ对地电阻不改变理想电压源给定的输入。输出在题给±10V间切换。The ideal op amp draws no input current. The grounded 5.1kΩ resistors do not change input voltages imposed by ideal sources. Output switches between the specified ±10V limits.

v2>v1⇒vo=+10V;v2<v1⇒vo=−10V

在图b标出交点Mark the intersections in Fig. (b)

按时间从左向右把输入交点记为t1、t2、t3。起始v2<v1，输出−10V；第一交点后v2>v1，输出+10V；第二交点后回−10V；第三交点后再+10V。附图是定性重绘，交点定义切换时刻，不添加原题没有给出的时间、相位数值。Label the successive input intersections t1, t2, t3. Initially v2<v1, giving −10V; after t1, v2>v1 gives +10V; after t2 output returns to −10V; after t3 it returns to +10V. The attached reconstruction is qualitative: intersections define switching times, without adding numerical time or phase data absent from the problem.

交点及理想模型的边界Intersection values and ideal-model boundary

恰好v1=v2时，理想无偏置比较器不唯一规定输出电平；画竖直跳变即可，不应硬指定为0V。真实器件会受输入失调、延迟等影响，题目不要求这些参数。At exactly v1=v2, the ideal zero-offset comparator does not uniquely determine an output level. Draw a vertical transition rather than assigning 0V. Real offsets and delays lie outside the stated problem.

定性重绘输入与输出：t1、t2、t3为输入交点，输出依次−10、+10、−10、+10V；未假设原题未给的数值相位。Qualitative reconstruction: t1,t2,t3 are input intersections; output levels are −10,+10,−10,+10V. No numerical source phase is assumed.

v2>v1时vo=+10V，v2<v1时vo=−10V；图示初始为−10V，之后在相邻输入交点依次切换为+10、−10、+10V。vo=+10V for v2>v1 and −10V for v2<v1. The shown waveform starts at −10V, then switches to +10, −10 and +10V at successive input intersections.

易错点Common errors

  • 反相端接v1，不能按v1−v2决定输出正负。v1 is the inverting input; do not determine output sign from v1−v2.
  • 未给数值相位或周期，只能依据交点给出定性波形。Numerical phase and period are unspecified; the waveform is defined qualitatively by intersections.

核验依据Verification

理想开环比较器，输入为题给理想电压波形，输出限幅±10V；忽略传播延时与失调，输入相等时不唯一。Ideal open-loop comparator driven by the given ideal voltage waveforms, output limited to ±10V. Delay and offset are neglected; equal inputs do not determine a unique level.

逐段对照原图两条输入曲线的上下关系，并在每个交点左右检查v2−v1的符号。输出电平严格采用题给±10V，不误用电源±12V；原图起点及交点顺序与定性输出一致。Checked which original input curve is higher in each interval and the sign of v2−v1 on both sides of every intersection. Output levels use the specified ±10V rather than ±12V supply rails; initial sign and switching order match the original sketch.

10.8.4指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电子技术基础·模拟部分，第7版，康华光、张林等 · 书第441页／PDF第474页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Electronic Technology: Analog, 7th ed. · printed p. 441 · PDF p. 474. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：10.8.4Assigned requirement: 10.8.4

正反馈产生两个门限：随输出状态分别求Positive feedback gives two state-dependent thresholds

题目原文Transcribed question

设运放为理想器件，试求图题10.8.4所示电压比较器的门限电压，并画出它的传输特性（图中VZ=9V）。With an ideal op amp, find the comparator thresholds and draw the transfer characteristic for Fig. 10.8.4, where VZ=9V.

整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

反相端接地；vi经R1=5kΩ到同相节点vp；输出vo经R2=15kΩ反馈到vp。运放输出经R3=5kΩ到限幅后的vo，双向稳压管将vo限制在±VZ=±9V。Inverting input is grounded. Input vi reaches noninverting node vp through R1=5kΩ; vo returns through R2=15kΩ. The op-amp output reaches the clamped output vo through R3=5kΩ; the bidirectional limiter holds vo at ±VZ=±9V.

本题图在书第441页／PDF第474页。The source figure is on printed p. 441 · PDF p. 474.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

正反馈比较器；节点KCL；稳态一致性；滞回方向。Positive-feedback comparators; nodal KCL; state consistency; hysteresis direction.
输出返回同相端，所以有记忆、两个门限。先固定输出为+9V或−9V，再令vp=vn=0求翻转边界；不要先套线性运放虚短。Output returns to the noninverting input, producing memory and two thresholds. Fix output at +9 or −9V, then set vp=vn=0 only at the switching boundary. Do not apply a linear virtual short throughout.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

同相端KCLNoninverting-node KCL

输入电流为零，vp由vi与限幅后vo加权决定。反馈取样点在R3之后，因此门限用±9V。Zero input current makes vp the weighted average of vi and the clamped vo. Feedback samples after R3, so thresholds use ±9V.

vp−vi5kΩ+vp−vo15kΩ=0⇒vp=3vi+vo4

上升输入的上门限Upper threshold for increasing input

此前输出为低电平−9V。输入上升至vp=0时满足3vi−9=0，于+3V跳到+9V。Starting from low output −9V, increasing input reaches vp=0 when 3vi−9=0. At +3V output switches upward to +9V.

VT+=−R1R2(−9)=+3V

下降输入的下门限Lower threshold for decreasing input

此前输出为高电平+9V。输入下降至3vi+9=0，于−3V跳到−9V。两个门限之间两种状态都可自洽，取决于历史。Starting from high output +9V, decreasing input reaches 3vi+9=0 and switches down at −3V. Both output states are consistent between thresholds, so history determines the state.

VT−=−R1R2(+9)=−3V;ΔVT=VT+−VT−=6V

画同相滞回传输特性Draw the noninverting hysteresis characteristic

上升扫描：保持−9V到+3V后跳到+9V。下降扫描：保持+9V到−3V后跳到−9V。vi>3V唯一高电平，vi<−3V唯一低电平；中间保持先前状态。Increasing sweep: stay at −9V until +3V, then jump to +9V. Decreasing sweep: stay at +9V until −3V, then jump to −9V. Above +3V only high output is consistent; below −3V only low output is consistent; between thresholds retain the previous state.

同相滞回特性：上升输入在+3V由−9跳到+9V，下降输入在−3V由+9跳到−9V。Noninverting hysteresis: rising input switches −9 to +9V at +3V; falling input switches +9 to −9V at −3V.

同相滞回比较器；上门限VT+=+3V，下门限VT−=−3V，滞回宽度6V。输出±9V；上升输入在+3V由低跳高，下降输入在−3V由高跳低。Noninverting Schmitt comparator: upper threshold +3V, lower threshold −3V, hysteresis width 6V and output ±9V. Rising input switches low-to-high at +3V; falling input switches high-to-low at −3V.

易错点Common errors

  • 门限来自±9V限幅输出，而非未给出的运放饱和电压。Use the ±9V clamped output, not an unspecified op-amp saturation voltage.
  • −3<Vi<3V时输出与先前状态有关，不是一个单值线性函数。For −3<Vi<3V, output depends on history; it is not a single-valued linear function.

核验依据Verification

按图中双向限幅±VZ=±9V建模，不另外加未给出的正向压降；理想比较器零输入电流，忽略延时，门限等值时为切换边界。Use the drawn bidirectional clamp ±VZ=±9V without adding an unspecified forward drop. Ideal comparator has zero input current and no delay; exact threshold equality is the switching boundary.

独立逐状态检查比较器一致性：vo=+9时vp>0要求vi>−3；vo=−9时vp<0要求vi<+3。边界分别−3和+3V；以离散上升、下降输入扫描，检查每个稳态同时满足节点KCL、限幅及比较器符号，得到图示滞回方向。Independently checked state consistency: vo=+9 requires vp>0, hence vi>−3; vo=−9 requires vp<0, hence vi<+3. Boundaries are −3 and +3V. Discrete rising and falling input sweeps satisfy node KCL, clamping and comparator sign in every stable state, reproducing the plotted hysteresis direction.
